IncludeMbmsTraffic.defaultValue: 1 (MBMS traffic is per default included in MB-TAC measurements, and under MB-TAC control.)
IncludeMbmsTraffic.description: The parameter defines whether the MBMS traffic is included in measurement based TAC (MB-TAC) measurements, and under control of TAC. As a consequence, set-up of MBMS connections may be rejected by MB-TAC in case no sufficient transport bandwidth is available. If set to false, the MBMS traffic is not included in MB-TAC measurements, and MB-TAC will respond to any new MBMS connection set-up request by ‘accept’.
IncludeMbmsTraffic.relatedFeatures: •  LTE3552 eMBMS capacity enhancement and support for overlapping of MBSFN Areas (Standard)
IncludeMbmsTraffic.source: Nokia LTE18 official BTS parameter dictionary (FDD)

RmExceptions.description:
The IPRM object provides filtering services for IP packets from and to the attached site support equipment. In this concept, by default the site support equipment cannot be accessed. IPRM defines up to 32 exceptions to this rule. Each exception is defined as a destination IP address to/from which traffic is allowed. Ports or protocol types are not taken into account.
NOTE: Exception can overlap but they cannot have exactly the same configuration

aPucchAddAUeRrHo.defaultValue: 10.0 (default value is assigned for 10 MHz BW)
aPucchAddAUeRrHo.description:
Additional margin in automatic PUCCH allocation to be considered for the maximum number of active UEs in the cell accessing the cell via handover with HO-cause: "HO desirable for radio reasons".

This additional margin is used also for UEs accessing the cell via hand over with HO-cause:   “Reduce load in serving cell” but only when Composite Available Capacity (CAC) in the Cell is bigger than 0. If CAC in the Cell is zero, the HO for "Reduce load in serving cell" are always rejected. This margin is added to the threshold maxNumActUE.
aPucchAddAUeRrHo.fullName: Automatic PUCCH allocation, add number UEs RR HO
aPucchAddAUeRrHo.relatedFeatures:
•  LTE1130 Dynamic PUCCH allocation (Standard)  
•  LTE3296 Harmonized Object Model for SRAN and LTE (Standard)

aPucchMinNumEmergencySessions.description:
Minimum number reserved for Emergency Sessions.
This margin increases the thresholds for active UEs, active DRBs and active QCI1-DRBs in the cell. Please note that active QCI1-DRBs thresholds are not considered when actEnhAcAndGbrServices is true.

Note: Any change of actEmerCallRedir or actIMSEmerSessR9 will only be applied in case of other activities leading to LNCEL lock.

aPucchMinNumEmergencySessions.notes:
Related functions: Radio Admission Control Related parameters: LNBTS - actEmerCallRedir
LNBTS_FDD - actIMSEmerSessR9 All of the following conditions are applicable in APUCCH_FDD only if actAutoPucchAlloc is set to 'true'.
(1) If (actEmerCallRedir = 'Enabled') OR (actIMSEmerSessR9 = 'true')
- aPucchMinNumEmergencySessions must be configured.

aPucchMinNumRrc.description:
Minimum allocated number of UEs in the cell which may establish a RRC connection.
This is needed for AirScale where resources may be shifted from one cell to the other where needed; for dynamic PUCCH this parameter can control the minimum PUCCH configuration per cell.

In case baseband pooling is activated the value of these parameters may be internally adapted by the system based on the number of cells allocated to a baseband pool.
aPucchMinNumRrc.fullName: Automatic PUCCH allocation, min number RRC
aPucchMinNumRrc.notes:
Related functions: Radio Admission Control Related parameters: LNCEL_TDD - actAutoPucchAlloc
LNCEL_TDD - maxNumActUE All of the following conditions are applicable only if actAutoPucchAlloc is set to 'true'.

(1) Following condition needs to be fulfilled with respect to aPucchMinNumRrc:
- aPucchMinNumRrc =< maxNumActUE
aPucchMinNumRrc.relatedFeatures:

•  LTE3296 Harmonized Object Model for SRAN and LTE (Standard)

aPucchSrPeriodUpperLimit.description:
Defines the upper limit of the Scheduling Request periodicity to be used in the cell by the PUCCH algorithm.

The configured value expresses the upper SR periodicity allowed in the LNCEL.
If '20 ms' is configured, the BTS uses 10 ms or 20 ms SR periodicity, where for '40 ms' the BTS uses 10 ms, 20 ms or 40 ms SR periodicity.

acBarCsfbOcAutoMax.description: Maximum access barring for originating CS fallback when automatic AC barring broadcast condition is triggered by: C-Plane overload or number of RRC connections.

acBarCsfbOcAutoMax.notes:

LNBTS - actAcBarringRrcConn
LNCEL - cellTechnology
LNCEL - maxCrSibDl
LNCEL_FDD - actDlSlimCarrier
LNCEL_FDD - dlChBw
LNCEL_FDD - numBlankDlPrbsDown
LNCEL_FDD - numBlankDlPrbsUp The following checks are applicable based on the LNCEL-cellTechnology of the parent LNCEL the SIB that references the ACBPR instance belongs to (i.e. in the ACBPR instance where ACBPR-acbPrId is equal to SIB-acbProfileId).

Conditions in (1.x) are valid if the cellTechnology is configured to 'FDD' or 'TDD':
(1.1) If actAcBarringRrcConn is set to 'CellOnly' and acBarCsfbOcAutoMin is configured in same ACBPR instance, acBarCsfbOcAutoMax must be configured.

Conditions in (2.x) are valid in addition to (1.x) if the cellTechnology is configured to 'FDD':
(2.1) If dlChBw is set to '1.4 MHz' AND maxCrSibDl is less than 0.24, acBarCsfbOcAutoMax must not be configured.
(2.2) If dlChBw is set to '3 MHz' AND maxCrSibDl is less than 0.24
(2.2.1) if actDlSlimCarrier is set to 'true' AND numBlankDlPrbsUp + numBlankDlPrbsDown > 0,acBarCsfbOcAutoMax must not be configured.
acBarCsfbOcAutoMax.relatedFeatures:
•  LTE2823 RRC connection triggered access class barring (Standard)  
•  LTE3145 Slim Carrier (Standard)

acBarSkipForMMTELVideo.description:
Indicates if access barring for  mobile originating MMTEL video  calls within RRC layer is skipped in this cell.
If this parameter is TRUE, eNB indicates UE to skip ACB in RRC layer when UE establishes the RRC connection for mobile originating MMTEL video call; otherwise (i.e. this parameter is FALSE), UE performs ACB in RRC layer. 

Note: SIB2:ssac-barringForMMTEL-Video, if presented, shall always be applicable in UE,  no matter this parameter is configured to TRUE or FALSE.
acBarSkipForMMTELVideo.fullName: Skip Indicator for mobile originating MMTEL video
acBarSkipForMMTELVideo.notes:
Related functions: System Information Broadcast (Access Class Barring) Related parameters: ACBPR - acBarSkipForMMTELVoice
ACBPR - acBarSkipForSMS
SIB - acbSkipTimer If acbSkipTimer is configured, at least one of the following parameters must be configured to value 'true' in the related ACBPR instance (i.e. in the ACBPR instance where ACBPR-acbPrId is equal to SIB-acbProfileId):
acBarSkipForMMTELVoice, acBarSkipForMMTELVideo or acBarSkipForSMS.
acBarSkipForMMTELVideo.relatedFeatures:
•  LTE2505 Access Class Barring skip (Standard)  
•  LTE2828 LNCEL LNBTS refactoring (Standard)

acBarring0To9.description:
Access Class Barring - 0 to 9
Defines the 1x Radio Transmission Technology (1xRTT) access class barring factor for access overload classes 0 through 9. This parameter is used to determine the value of the ac-Barring0to9-r9 field of the AC-BarringConfig1XRTT-r9 Information Element (IE) broadcast in the RRC: SystemInformationBlockType8 (SIB8) message. It is the parameter “PSIST” in C.S0004  for access overload classes 0 through 9
acBarring0To9.fullName: AC barring factor for overload classes 0 to 9
acBarring0To9.notes:
Related functions: Idle Mode Mobility (CDMA2000) Related parameters: CDFIM - acBarring0To9Ovl
LNBTS - actAutoAcBarring acBarring0To9Ovl shall be equal or larger than CDFIM-rttAcBar-acBarring0To9, if CDFIM-rttAcBar-acBarring0To9 is configured and actAutoAcBarring is set to 'true'.
acBarring0To9.source: Nokia SBTS 18A official SingleRAN AirScale parameter dictionary

acBarring0To9Adapt.description:
The switch enable/disable the SIB8 acBarring0To9 adaption.
FALSE means that ac-Barring0to9-r9 field of SIB8 AC-BarringConfig1XRTT-r9 is set to the value of acBarring0To9 of CDFIM rttAcBar/rttAcBarOvl.  

TRUE means that ac-Barring0to9-r9 field of SIB8 AC-BarringConfig1XRTT-r9 is set to the value based on combination of both acBarring0To9 of CDFIM rttAcBar/rttAcBarOvl and ac-BarringFactor of SIB2 ac-BarringForMo-Data

The SIB8 acBarring0To9 adaption is applicable for:static AC Barring or automatic AC Barring for overload or RRC connection triggered AC Barring.
acBarring0To9Adapt.relatedFeatures:
•  LTE1635 SIB 8 AC barring for 1xRTT (Standard)  
•  LTE2823 RRC connection triggered access class barring (Standard)
acBarring0To9Adapt.source: Nokia SBTS 18A official SingleRAN AirScale parameter dictionary

acbECTimer.description:
When emergency call barring timer expires emergency calls will be barred automatically if configured so by the ACBPR-eCallAcBarredAuto parameter. 
If the previous ACB level (Max threshold and ACB Skip IEs are deactivated) lasts for at least acbEcTimer, emergency calls may be barred if configured so by ACBPR-eCallAcbarredAuto.
The timer is configured in counter mode as multiplicity of acbUpdateTimer.

This parameter defines when ACB settings step-wise  upgrade or downgrade and their modification in the SIB2 is allowed.

acceptableFrameTypes.description:
If the value of this parameter is "AdmitTagged", the device will discard untagged and Priority-tagged frames received on this interface. If the value is “AdmitAll”, tagged, untagged, and Priority-tagged frames received on this interface will be accepted. Untagged and Priority-tagged frames are assigned to the VLAN defined by the portDefaultVlanId parameter for this interface.
Notes:
1) Priority tagged" frames (IEEE 802.1Q tagged frames with VLAN ID=0) can be configured via the VLAN filter list of parameter l2VlanIdList.
2) Ethernet management frames (i.e. Synchronous Ethernet and Ethernet OAM frames) are always allowed to ingress and egress the Ethernet interface of the layer 2 switch independent of the status of the value of the discardUntagged parameter.

•  RC0249 Porting of legacy transport features for Cloud BTS (Standard)

act1TxIn2Tx.description: This is to activate Dual transmission mode 1 operation when 2 Tx RF unit can be used for two times 1Tx transmission in Distributed Antenna Systems (DAS)

act1xCsfb.description:
This parameter enables the feature LTE1441 enhanced CSFB to CDMA2000 1xRTT. 
This parameter enables also the feature LTE1635 SIB8 AC Barring.
act1xCsfb.notes:
Related functions: Handover Control (Inter RAT CDMA2000) Related parameters: CDFIM - hrpdNCList
CDFIM - rttNCList
LNBTS - actCSFBRedir
LNBTS - actCsfbPsHoToUtra
LNBTS - actEmerCallRedir
LNCEL - c2KTimers
LNCEL - rttCellIdInfo
LNCEL - rttCsfbType
LNCEL - rttRefCellId
SIB - sibSchedulingList
SYNC - btsSyncMode act1xCsfb can only be configured to 'true' if all of the following conditions are fulfilled:
- actCsfbPsHoToUtra is set to 'false'
- actCSFBRedir is set to 'false '
- actEmerCallRedir is set to 'Disabled '

If act1xCsfb is set to 'true' for each LNCEL instance rttCsfbType must be configured.

For the combination act1xCsfb set to 'true' and rttCsfbType set to 'R9e1xCsfb' c2KTimers and rttCellIdInfo must be configured.

If act1xCsfb is set to 'true' and additionally rttCsfbType for the cell is not set to 'forbidden', SIB8 must be present in sibSchedulingList-siMessageSibType and rttRefCellId must be configured.

The total number of list items of hrpdNCList and rttNCList in all CDFIM per LNCEL depends on act1xCsfb value (please refer to hrpdNCList or rttNCList for details). 

If act1xCsfb is equal to 'true' and rttCsfbType is equal to 'R9e1xCsfb' in at least one LNCEL instance then btsSyncMode must be equal to 'PhaseSync'.
act1xCsfb.relatedFeatures:
•  LTE1441 Enhanced CS fallback to CDMA/1xRTT (e1xCSFB) (Standard)  
•  LTE738 SRVCC to 1xRTT/CDMA (Standard)  
•  LTE1635 SIB 8 AC barring for 1xRTT (Standard)  
•  LTE3296 Harmonized Object Model for SRAN and LTE (Standard)

actACNonOpBackhaul.description:
This parameter activates the support of auto-connection functionality when eNB is connected to a non-operator owned (untrusted) backhaul.

The default value is "false".
actACNonOpBackhaul.fullName: Activate Autoconnection in Non-Operator Owned Network
actACNonOpBackhaul.notes:
Related parameters: MRBTS/LNBTS/FTM/IPNO - actDynamicIP: 
MRBTS/LNBTS/FTM/IPNO - actIPv6Mplane: 
MRBTS/LNBTS/FTM/IPNO - actIpv6: 
MRBTS/LNBTS/FTM/IPNO - actMultipleDynamicIP: 
MRBTS/LNBTS/FTM/IPSECC - dynamicIpCfg-cPlaneIpDynCfg: I1. The following deployments are considered:
    1.1 If actACNonOpBackhaul = FALSE (private backhaul deployment), then:
        1.1.1 if additionally actDynamicIP = TRUE, eNB shall use the DHCP assigned IP address for transport and M/C/U/S plane.
        1.1.2 if additionally actDynamicIP = FALSE, the operator must configure the transport and M/C/U/S plane IP addresses.
    1.2 If actACNonOpBackhaul = TRUE (public backhaul deployment), then:
        1.2.1 if additionally actDynamicIP = FALSE and actMultipleDynamicIp = FALSE, eNB shall use the DHCP assigned IP address for transport (outer) IP address and Splane IP address and the operator must configure the M/C/U plane (inner IP address).
        1.2.2 if additionally actDynamicIP = TRUE, eNB shall use the DHCP assigned IP address for transport (outer) IP address and Splane IP address and shall use the IP addresses provided by SeGW for M/C/U plane (single inner IP address).
        1.2.3 if additionally actDynamicIP = FALSE and actMultipleDynamicIp = TRUE, eNB shall use the DHCP assigned IP address for transport (outer) IP address and Splane IP address and shall use the IP addresses provided by SeGW for M/C/U plane(s) (possible multiple inner IP addresses).
2. IEIF-overrideMTUSize can be set to non-zero value only if actACNonOpBackhaul and/or actDynamicIP is set to TRUE.
3. If actACNonOpBackhaul is set to 'true', and IEIF-overrideMTUSize is set to a non-zero value, then eNB shall use overrideMTUSize for MTU value.
4. If actMultipleDynamicIP is set 'true', then actACNonOpBackhaul must be set to 'true'.
5. If actDynamicIP is set to 'true' and actACNonOpBackhaul is set to 'false', then:
5.1 actIpv6 must be set to 'false'.
5.2 actIPv6Mplane must be set to 'false'.

actAcBarringRrcConn.description:
This parameter activates LTE2823 'RRC Connection triggered access class barring'.
The feature detects that number of RRC connections is near RAC limit on cell level and triggers access class barring parameters broadcast in SIB2.
The feature introduces ACB step-wise algorithm to broadcast access class barring parameters in SIB2.
If LTE4175 is activated, i.e. actAcBarringCFR is set to ‘true’ then LTE2823 does not detect that number of RRC connections is near RAC limit on cell level and does not  trigger access class barring parameters broadcast in SIB2. LTE2823 ACB step-wise algorithm is triggered by LTE4175, LTE2235 or LTE1788 if activated.

actAdvStepwiseScellAdd.description:
Activate advanced step-wise SCell addition.
If this parameter is set to 'oneStepAdvanced', and step-wise cell addition is enabled (numTxWithHighNonGbr is not equal to '0'), one step SCell addition occurs when the UE enters the cell.
If this parameter is set to 'buffer-based', and step-wise cell addition is enabled, the eNB starts buffer measurements when the UE enters the cell. Upon buffer overflows, one step SCell addition occurs if no SCells are configured for this UE, otherwise step-wise addition is performed.
If this parameter is 'off', and step-wise cell addition is enabled, the eNB starts buffer measurements when the UE enters the cell, and step-wise cell addition is performed upon buffer overflows.
If numTxWithHighNonGbr is equal to '0', this parameter is ignored.

actAnrRtt.description:
Feature 'ANR interRAT 1xRTT - O&M assisted'  is activated, if actAnrRtt is set to "oamAssisted". 

Feature 'ANR interRAT 1xRTT - O&M assisted'  is deactivated, if  actAnrRtt is set to "false".  

Please note that ANR interRAT 1xRTT will not be supported in cells with 1.4 MHz or 3 MHz bandwidth.

The feature 'O&M assisted CDMA2000 1xRTT ANR' can not be activated if rttCellIdInfo in any of the LTE cells is set to '1'.

LNRELXs created by feature 'O&M assisted CDMA2000 1xRTT ANR' are only intended to be used in rttCellIdInfo  '000' mode.
actAnrRtt.notes:
Related functions: SON (Miscellaneous) Related parameters: LNBTS - actHOtoWcdma
LNBTS - actUeBasedAnrUtran
LNBTS - acteNACCtoGSM
LNBTS - supportedCellTechnology
LNBTS_FDD - actSrvccToGsm
LNBTS_TDD - actHOtoTdscdma
LNBTS_TDD - actSrvccToGsm
LNCEL - cellTechnology
LNCEL - rttCellIdInfo
LNCEL - rttRefCellId
SIB - sibSchedulingList-siMessageSibType

(1.1) If actAnrRtt is set to 'oamAssisted' all of the following conditions need to be fulfilled:
- btsSyncMode must be equal to 'PhaseSync'
- rttRefCellId must be configured in all LNCEL instances
- actUeBasedAnrUtran must be equal to 'false'
- acteNACCtoGSM must be equal to 'false'
- actHOtoWcdma must be equal to 'false'
- rttCellIdInfo must be set to 0 in each LNCEL instance if it's configured

(2) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'FDD' following conditions must be fulfilled in addition to (1):
(2.1) If actAnrRtt is set to 'oamAssisted' all of the following conditions need to be fulfilled in addition to those mentioned in (1.1)
(2.1.1) in LNBTS_FDD:
- actSrvccToGsm must be equal to 'false'
(2.1.2) in all LNCEL instances with cellTechnology set to 'FDD'
- SIB8 must be present in sibSchedulingList in all LNCEL instance with dlChBw not equal to 1.4MHz or 3Mhz

(3) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'TDD' following conditions must be fulfilled in addition to (1):

- actHOtoTdscdma must be equal to 'false'
(3.1.2) in all LNCEL instances with cellTechnology set to 'TDD'
- SIB8 must be present in sibSchedulingList.

(4) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'mixed_FDD_TDD' conditions of (2) AND (3) must be fulfilled in addition to (1).

actAsi.description:
This parameter allows the support of the ASi. With the feature enabled, the ASIRMODs are allowed to be created and operator is able to use ASiManager to manage the ASi. 

When the feature is disabled, operator is not able to use ASiManager to manage the ASi and all the cells using the ASIRMOD will be disabled.

actAutoAcBarring.description: This parameter activates the feature LTE1788 'Automatic access class barring'.
actAutoAcBarring.notes:
Related functions: Overload Handling Related parameters: ACBPR - acbPrId
CDFIM - rttAcBar
CDFIM - rttAcBarOvl
LNBTS - actAutoPlmnRemoval
LNBTS - actCplaneOvlHandling
SIB - acbProfileId actAutoAcBarring can be set to 'true' only if actCplaneOvlHandling is set to 'true'.

If actAutoPlmnRemoval is set to 'true', actAutoAcBarring must be set to 'true'.

If actAutoAcBarring is set to 'true', all of the following conditions need to be fulfilled (dependent on the mentioned additional parameter):
- rttAcBarOvl shall be configured if rttAcBar is configured.
- in SIB of each cell acbProfileId must be configured
- at least one instance of the MOC ACBPR must exist with acbPrId equal to acbProfileId in SIB.
actAutoAcBarring.relatedFeatures:
•  LTE1788 Automatic access class barring (Standard)  
•  LTE2460 Automatic access class barring with PLMN disabling (Standard)  
•  LTE2823 RRC connection triggered access class barring (Standard)

actAutoPucchAlloc.description:
This parameter activates the automatic PUCCH configuration of the LNCEL. When activated a limited set of PUCCH parameter need to be configured in class MPUCCH belonging to the cell, all other parameter are assigned by the system itself automatically.

For disabled functionality the standard PUCCH remain available.

Note: Only if actAutoPucchAlloc of the LNCEL_FDD instance is activated, the configured value of actLbPucchReg is considered by the BTS.
actAutoPucchAlloc.notes:
Related functions: PHY/MAC Configuration (Uplink) Related parameters: APUCCH_FDD - aPucch_FddId
LNBTS - actBbPooling
LNCEL_FDD - actCatM
LNCEL_FDD - actMMimo
LNCEL_FDD - actUlPwrRestrScn
LNCEL_FDD - dlChBw
LNCEL_FDD - ulChBw
MPUCCH_FDD - mPucch_FddId
SLCOMMRES - dataTFResConfigPrbEnd
SLCOMMRES - dataTFResConfigPrbNum
SLCOMMRES - dataTFResConfigPrbStart
SLCOMMRES - scTFResConfigPrbEnd
SLCOMMRES - scTFResConfigPrbNum
SLCOMMRES - scTFResConfigPrbStart (1.1) If ulChBw or dlChBw is set to '1.4 MHz' or '3 MHz' in the same LNCEL_FDD instance, actAutoPucchAlloc must be configured to 'false'.

(2.1) If actAutoPucchAlloc is set to 'false', a MPUCCH_FDD instance must be created and configured with all mandatory parameter for the LNCEL_FDD instance.
(2.2) If actAutoPucchAlloc is set to 'false' range restrictions for configuration of sidelink resources apply, see SLCOMMRES parameters scTFResConfigPrbNum, scTFResConfigPrbStart, scTFResConfigPrbEnd, dataTFResConfigPrbNum, dataTFResConfigPrbStart and dataTFResConfigPrbEnd.

(3.1) If actAutoPucchAlloc is set to 'true', a APUCCH_FDD instance must be created and configured with all mandatory parameter for the LNCEL_FDD instance.
(3.2) Only if actAutoPucchAlloc is set to 'true' in all LNCEL_FDD instances then actBbPooling can be set to 'true' with nbIoT mode of the superior LNCEL instance equal to 'disabled' or 'inband' or 'guardband'
(3.3) If actUlPwrRestrScn is not set to 'none', actAutoPucchAlloc must be set to 'true'.

(4) actAutoPucchAlloc must be set to 'true' if actCatM is set to 'true'.

(5) if actMMimo is set to 'true' , actAutoPucchAlloc must be configured to 'true' in the cell

actBbPooling.description: This parameter activates baseband pooling. The feature requires at least AirScale.
actBbPooling.notes:
Related functions: PHY/MAC Configuration (Downlink) Related parameters: APUCCH_FDD - actLbPucchReg
APUCCH_TDD - actLbPucchReg
BBMOD - bbCardUsage
BBPOOLALLOC - bbPoolAllocId
LNBTS - actEnhAcAndGbrServices
LNBTS - bbPoolEvalPeriod
LNBTS - bbPoolMinResource
LNCEL - cellTechnology
LNCEL - nbIoTMode
LNCEL_FDD - actAutoPucchAlloc
LNCEL_FDD - dlChBw
LNCEL_TDD - actAutoPucchAlloc
LNCEL_TDD - actSuperCell FSMr3: Only  value 'false' is allowed.

Following conditions are applicable for AirScale only.
If actBbPooling is set to 'true' then all following conditions must be fulfilled:
(1) General to be fulfilled:
- actEnhAcAndGbrServices must be set to 'true'
- bbPoolMinResource and bbPoolEvalPeriod must be configured
- a BBPOOLALLOC instance must exist subordinate to each LNCEL instance
- bbCardUsage must be configured in each BBMOD instance

(2) for each LNCEL instance with cellTechnology set to 'FDD' all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- actLbPucchReg must be set to 'true' in the APUCCH_FDD instance of the cell
- actAutoPucchAlloc must be set to 'true' in each LNCEL_FDD instance if nbIoTMode of the superior LNCEL instance is 'disabled' or 'inband' or 'guardband'
- dlChBw must not be set to '1.4 MHz' or '3 MHz'

(3) for each LNCEL instance with cellTechnology set to 'TDD' all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- actSuperCell must be set to 'false' in the LNCEL_TDD instance
- actLbPucchReg must be set to 'true' in the APUCCH_TDD instance of the cell
- actAutoPucchAlloc must be set to 'true' in the LNCEL_TDD instance

actCEBB.description:
This parameter activates feature LTE1783 "Constrained Beamforming" per individual cell.

Constrained Beamforming in the cell will be functional only if the relative antenna element spacing of the antenna used for the cell is in range 0.470...0.525 lambda or 0.620...0.675 lambda.
Calculation:
relative antenna element spacing [lambda] = antennaElementSpacing [mm]/1000*earfcn[Hz]/(3*10^8 [m/s])
actCEBB.notes:
Related functions: Beamforming (Coordinated scheduling) Related parameters: LNBTS_TDD - dlSectorBFWeightCusProf
LNCEL_TDD - actCEBB If actDlMuMimo is set to 'true' in the LNCEL_TDD instance, actCEBB must be configured to 'CEBB_disabled'.
For actCEBB set to another value, actDlMuMimo in the LNCEL_TDD instance must be configured to 'false'.

actCEBB allowed value depends on the specified actTmSwitch and dlMimoMode of same LNCEL_TDD instance:
- for dlMimoMode set to ('Dynamic Open Loop MIMO' AND actTmSwitch is set to 'false'), actCEBB must be configured to 'CEBB_disabled' 
- for dlMimoMode set to ('Dynamic Open Loop MIMO' AND actTmSwitch is set to 'true'), actCEBB must be configured to 'CEBB_disabled' or 'CEBB_enabled_for_TM7_TM8'
- for dlMimoMode set to ('Single Stream Beamforming' or 'Dual Stream Beamforming'), actCEBB must be configured to 'CEBB_disabled' or 'CEBB_enabled_for_TM7_TM8'
- for dlMimoMode set to 'Closed Loop MIMO (8x2)', actCEBB can be configured to any value
- for dlMimoMode set to another value than listed, actCEBB must be configured to 'CEBB_disabled'.

If actCEBB is set different than 'CEBB_disabled' and dlSectorBFWeightCusProf-dlSectorBFWeightProfName is referred by the LNCEL_TDD-dlSectorBFWeightProfName, this dlSectorBFWeightCusProf-antennaElementSpacing item must be configured. The calculated lambda value need to be in the range of 0.470...0.525 lambda or 0.620...0.675 lambda, so that CEBB can be used for this cell carrier frequency, calculation formular used in the validation below:
- relative antenna element spacing [lambda] = antennaElementSpacing [mm]/1000*earfcn[Hz]/(3*10^8 [m/s])

SIB - sibSchedulingList-siMessageSibType (1) If supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'FDD' or 'TDD' or 'mixed_FDD_TDD' following conditions must be fulfilled:
(1.1) If actCMAS is set to 'true', then all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- actETWS must be set to 'false'
- 'SIB12' must be present in sibSchedulingList
- pwsWithEmAreaId is mandatory required
- siWindowLen must be greater than or equal to '20 ms'.

(2) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'FDD' following conditions must be fulfilled in addition to (1):
(2.1) If actCMAS is set to 'true' all of the following conditions must be fulfilled in addition to those mentioned in (1.1) if the LNCEL has cellTechnology set to 'FDD':
- if (actEicic is set to 'true') and (cellType is set to 'large' in any eNB cell), then eIcicMaxMutePattern in that LNCEL must be greater than 'mp1'.
- if actLiquidCell is set to 'true', then liquidCellConfigInfo-csiRsSubfr must be set to one of the following values: '3', '8', '18' or '38'.
- if actOtdoa is set to 'true' AND the number of configured SIBs (i.e. the number of sets in structure sibSchedulingList + 2) is 7 or smaller, then if prsConfigurationIndex is > 150, prsConfigurationIndex must be set to one of the following values: '151', '471', '1111' or '2391'.
- if actOtdoa is set to 'true' AND siWindowLen is set to '20 ms' AND the number of configured SIBs (i.e. the number of sets in structure sibSchedulingList + 2) is 8 or higher then if prsConfigurationIndex is > 150, prsConfigurationIndex must be set to one of the following values:  '471', '1111' or '2391'.
- if actOtdoa is set to 'true' AND siWindowLen is set to '40 ms' AND the number of configured SIBs (i.e. the number of sets in structure sibSchedulingList + 2) is 8 or higher then if prsConfigurationIndex is > 150, prsConfigurationIndex must be set to one of the following values:  '1111' or '2391'.
- For MBMS related dependencies see actMBMS.
(2.2) The allowed values of LNCEL_FDD-csiRsConfigInfo-csiRsSubfrConf depends on actCMAS in specific conditions. Please refer to LNCEL_FDD-csiRsSubfrConf for details.
(2.3) If (actCMAS or actETWS or sib2xTransmit) is 'true' AND actOtdoa is set to 'true' AND LNCEL_FDD-prsConfigurationIndex is set < 151  and dlChBw > '5 MHz', then prsNumDlFrames must be set to 1.

(3) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'TDD' following conditions must be fulfilled in addition to (1):
(3.1) If actCMAS is set to 'true' all of the following conditions must be fulfilled in addition to those mentioned in (1.1) for cell instances with cellTechnology set to 'TDD'
- the allowed range of prsConfigurationIndex depends on sib2xTransmit, actETWS, actCMAS, siWindowLen, sibSchedulingList, actOtdoa, tddFrameConf. Please see the parameter LNCEL_TDD-prsConfigurationIndex for the detailed parameter relationship.
- the allowed range of csiRsSubfrConf depends on sib2xTransmit, actETWS, actCMAS, actOtdoa, tddFrameConf, actEicic, tddSpecSubfConf, cellType and eIcicMaxMutePattern. Please see the parameter LNCEL_TDD-csiRsConfigInfo-csiRsSubfrConf for the detailed parameter relationship
- actMicroDtx must be set to 'false'.

(4) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'mixed_FDD_TDD' conditions of (2) AND (3) must be fulfilled in addition to (1).

actCSFBRedir.description:
The parameter activates the feature 'Circuit Switched Fallback to UTRAN or GSM via Redirection'.

If the feature is activated, mobile originated and mobile terminated CS calls are redirected to targets which are to be configured via  REDRT objects.

At the same time this parameter also activates the feature 'Cause value for CSFB to GERAN without DTM support'.
actCSFBRedir.notes:
Related functions: Handover Control (Miscellaneous) Related parameters: LNBTS - act1xCsfb
LNBTS - actCsfbPsHoToUtra
LNBTS - actDualRx1xCsfb

REDRT - csFallBPrio
REDRT - redrtId (1) If supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'FDD' or 'TDD' or 'mixed_FDD_TDD' following conditions must be fulfilled:
(1.1) actCSFBRedir can be only set to 'Disabled' 
- if actCsfbPsHoToUtra is set to 'false' AND
- if actGsmRedirWithSI is set to 'false' OR (if actGsmRedirWithSI is set to 'true' AND (actRedirect is set to 'enabled' OR actEmerCallRedir is set to 'Enabled')).
(1.2) The parameter actCSFBRedir can only be set to 'Enabled' if act1xCsfb AND actDualRx1xCsfb are set to 'false'.
(1.3) If actCSFBRedir is set to 'Enabled' following conditions need to be fulfilled:
- at least one instance of REDRT must be created per LNCEL where csFallBPrio is configured
- geranDtmCap must be configured.

(2) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'FDD' following conditions must be fulfilled in addition to (1):
(2.1) If actCSFBRedir is set to 'Enabled' following condition need to be fulfilled in addition to (1.3):
- in each additional REDRT instance of the FDD-cell (LNCEL-cellTechnology set to 'FDD') csFallBPrio must be configured if redirRat is set to 'geran' or 'utraFDD' AND if in the REDRT instance redirectPrio AND emerCallPrio are both not specified.

(3) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'TDD' following conditions must be fulfilled in addition to (1):
(3.1) If actCSFBRedir is set to 'Enabled' following condition need to be fulfilled in addition to (1.3):
- in each additional REDRT instance of the TDD-cell (LNCEL-cellTechnology set to 'TDD') csFallBPrio must be configured if redirRat is set to 'geran', 'utraFDD' or 'utraTDD' AND if in the REDRT instance redirectPrio AND emerCallPrio are both not specified.

(4) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'mixed_FDD_TDD' conditions of (2) AND (3) must be fulfilled in addition to (1).

SLCOMMPROF - slUlChBw actCatM can only be configured to 'true' if all of the following conditions are fulfilled:
(1.1) in LNCEL_FDD:
- dlChBw and ulChBw must be set identical, allowed values are '5 MHz', '10 MHz', '15 MHz' or '20 MHz'
- blankedPucch must be less than or equal to 20 if ulChBw is set to '10 MHz', '15 MHz' or '20 MHz'
- blankedPucch must be less than or equal to 6 if ulChBw is set to '5 MHz'
- selectOuterPuschRegion must be set to 'None'
- actLiquidCell must be set to 'false'
- actAutoPucchAlloc must be set to 'true'.
- activatedMimoTM is set to 'TM4' or not configured
- actUlPwrRestrScn must be set to 'none'
- dlIshConfig-actDlIsh must be set to 'false'
(1.2) in SIB-siWindowLen:
(1.2.1) If actEicic is set to 'false', siWindowLen must have a value greater than or equal to '20ms'.
(1.2.2) If actEicic is set to 'true', siWindowLen must be equal to '40ms'.
(1.4) In APUCCH_FDD of the LNCEL_FDD:
- If actCatM is set to 'true', selectPrachRegion must be set to 'InnerLowerEdge'.
(1.5) in LNCEL:
- If actEicic is set to 'true', cellType must be set to 'large'
- If (actMBMS is set to 'true' and in the LNCEL instances containing MBSFNCEL) and the subordinate LNCEL_FDD instance actCatM is set to 'true', dlsDciCch must be set to 'DCI format 1A'.
- If ulChBw is '5MHz', raPreGrASize must be equal to raNondedPreamb
- if actTtiBundling is set to 'true' and ulBwCh is set to ‘5 MHz’, ttibMinUlPrb must be set to fixed value of 2
- if numCELevelCatM is set to '3' or '4', dlsDciCch must be set to 'DCI format 1A'.
- If ulChBw is set to '5 MHz' and if raSmallVolUl set to '144 bits', raSmallMcsUl range is restricted to 2...15
- if ulChBw is set to '5 MHz' and if raSmallVolUl set to '208 bits', raSmallMcsUl range is restricted to 4...15
- if ulChBw is set to '5 MHz' and if raSmallVolUl set to '256 bits', raSmallMcsUl range is restricted to 6...15

(2) If actCatM is set to 'true' all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- one instance of MOC CATMCEL must exist for the cell
- catMProfId must be configured and a CATMPR managed object with naming attribute catMPrId equal to catMProfId must exist
- if numCELevelCatM is set to '3' or '4',  catMBProfId must be configured and a CATMBPR managed object with naming attribute catMBPrId equal to catMBProfId must exist.

(3) Only if actCatM is set to 'true':
- actConvVoiceCatM can be set to 'true'.
- actIntraFreqHoCatM can be set to 'true'.

(4) If actEDrxIdleCatM is set to 'true' then actCatM must be set to 'true'.

(5)If actCatM is set to 'true', SIB-modPeriodCoeff must set to (rf512/LNCEL-defPagCyc).

6.1) If actCatM is set to 'true' and numCELevelCatM is set to '3' or '4' and mpdcchMaxNumRepRaModeBCatM is set to '256', then catMCELevel2-mpdcchRepLevRaCatM is allowed to be set to 'n4' only if all following condition is fulfilled:
- catMCELevel2-numRepPerPreambAttemptCECatM must be set to >= '64';
- if (pdschMaxNumRepModeBCatM is set to '512' or 'NotConfigured_r512') , then catMCELevel2-pdschRepLevMsg4ModeBCatM must not be set to 'n8';
- prachConfIndex must not be set to values from {5,6,7,8,21,22,23,24,53,54,55,56}; 
 - actMBMS is set to 'false' or in the LNCEL instance no MBSFNCEL exist;
- actOtdoa is set to 'false';
- actSf9InvalidLVRBCatM is set to 'false';
Conditions in (6.2) are valid in addition to (6.1) if the numCELevelCatM is set to '4', 
6.2) catMCELevel3-mpdcchRepLevRaCatM is allowed to be set to 'n4' only if all following condition is fulfilled
- catMCELevel3-numRepPerPreambAttemptCECatM must be set to >= '64';
- if (pdschMaxNumRepModeBCatM is set to '512' or 'NotConfigured_r512') , then catMCELevel3-pdschRepLevMsg4ModeBCatM must not be set to 'n8'.

7) If actCatM is set to 'true' and (numCELevelCatM is set to '3' or '4') and in addition (actMBMS is set to 'true' and in the LNCEL instances containing MBSFNCEL) or actOtdoa is set to 'true' or actSf9InvalidLVRBCatM is set to 'true', all following condition must be fulfilled:
- mpdcchMaxNumRepRaModeBCatM must be set to  <= '128'.
- mpdcchMaxNumRepRaCatM must be set to  >= '8'.
- if (pdschMaxNumRepModeBCatM is set to '512' or 'NotConfigured_r512') ,then (catMCELevel2-pdschRepLevMsg4ModeBCatM and catMCELevel3-pdschRepLevMsg4ModeBCatM must be not set to 'n8')

8) If actProSeComm is set to 'true' then actCatM must be set to 'false' in each cell with earfcnUL and ulChBw equal to slEarfcnUL and slUlChBw of a SLCOMMPROF instance.

If the value is set to TRUE the eNB will send the CELL TRAFFIC TRACE message to MME for every call in every cell trace session.

If the parameter is set to FALSE the eNB will not send the CELL TRAFFIC TRACE message to MME for all calls in all Cell Trace Sessions.

actCoMp.description:
Coordinated multipoint (CoMP) feature activation for the eNB. The parameter is used to configured CoMP features supported by the eNB for UL and /or DL CoMP.

For UL CoMP features LTE1402, LTE1691, LTE2104 and LTE2128 please configure the value to 'fixedULCoMp'.
For measurement based CoMP features LTE3102 (DL) and LTE3286 (UL) please configure the value to 'measBasedCoMp'.

For 'fixedULCoMP', SINR measurements are used, where for 'measBasedCoMp' A3 measuremets are used in addition to SINR.

The eNB will dynamically decide dependent on the current and newly required DSP deployment if eNB restart or dropping of all cells is needed.

Configuration rules for FDD:
Distributed sites are only supported if the distance between RRHs is less than 1 km.

Notes for TDD:
Recommendations for balancing increased TDD cell throughput and link level gain (not considered in validation) for LTE1402, LTE1691, LTE2104 or LTE2128 configurations:
If chBw is set to '20MHz' AND dlMimoMode is set to 'Closed Loop MIMO (4x4)', actCoMp is recommended to be configured to 'fixedULCoMp'.

Configuration rules for TDD:
Distributed sites are only supported if the distance between RRHs is less than 1 km, with a maximal Doppler shift of 250 Hz.
For 4 Rx UL-CoMP (LTE1691) only cells with 15 MHz and 20 MHz bandwidth are supported.
For 2 Rx, 4 Rx and 8 Rx UL-CoMP (LTE1402, LTE2104 and LTE2128) cells with 10 MHz, 15 MHz and 20 MHz bandwidth are supported.

(1.1) If actCoMp is set to 'fixedULCoMp' all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:

Conditions in (2.x) are valid in addition to (1.x) if the supportedCellTechnology of the LNBTS instance is configured to 'FDD' or 'mixed_FDD_TDD' for all cells with cellTechnology set to 'FDD':
(2.1) If actCoMp is set to 'fixedULCoMp', following condition must be fulfilled in addition to (1.1): 
(2.1.1) actSuperCell AND actCombSuperCell AND actLiquidCell must be set to 'false' for all LNCEL instances belonging to an ulCoMpCellList.
(2.1.2) If there is at least one 2RX comp set configured then actCoMp can only be configured to 'fixedULCoMp' if actHighRrc is set to 'false'. 
Note: A 2RX comp set is an ULCOMP instance which comprises only cells with 2RX paths defined in the CHANNEL instances contained in the CHANNELGROUP instances of the related LCELL object.
(2.1.3) actCombSuperCell setting depends on the used HW variant:
- FSMr3: actCombSuperCell must be 'false' for all LNCEL_FDD instances of the BTS
- AirScale HW: actCombSuperCell must be 'false' for all LNCEL_FDD instances belonging to an ulCoMpCellList.

(2.2) If actCoMp is set to 'measBasedCoMp' all of the following conditions must be fulfiled:
(2.2.1) site configuration conditions
- actBbPooling is set to 'true'
- in BBPOOLALLOC bbPoolAllocMode is set to 'automatic'
(2.2.2) eNB wide feature conditions
- an instance of A2DPR must be configured
- an instance of A3DPR must be configured
- an instance of COMPCONF must be configured
(2.2.3) cell related feature
- actAutoPucchAlloc must be configured to 'true'
- actCombSuperCell must be 'false' if the cell is included in COMPCONF-measBasedCellConf-lnCelId.
(2.2.4) FDD massive MIMO feature
- actMMimo must be configured to 'false'
(2.2.5) If in addition actInterEnbDLCAggr is configured to 'true', the caClusterMemberId configuration must follow strict rules, please refer to caClusterMemberId 

Conditions in (3.x) are valid in addition to (1.x) if the supportedCellTechnology of the LNBTS instance is configured to 'TDD' or 'mixed_FDD_TDD' for all cells with cellTechnology set to 'TDD':

(3.1.3) actSFN must be set to 'false' in the LNCEL instances that belong to an ulCoMpCellList

Conditions in (4.x) are valid in addition to (1.x) if the supportedCellTechnology of the LNBTS instance is configured to 'TDD':

actCombSuperCell.description:
This parameter activates the feature 'Combined Supercell'.
Combined supercells can consist of two to six subcells, i.e. CHANNELGROUP instances. In DL, the same data is transmitted from all subcells. In UL, data is received from selected subcells.
actCombSuperCell.notes:
Related functions: BTS Site or Cell Configuration Related parameters: CHANNEL - antlDN
CHANNEL - direction
CHANNELGROUP - channelGroupId
COMPCONF - measBasedCellConf-lnCelId
LNBTS - actCoMp
LNBTS - actLBRTXPowerSaving

MTRACE - enhCellVendorSpecTracing-ripTracing
ULCOMP - ulCoMpCellList If actCoMp is set to 'measBasedCoMp', actCombSuperCell must be 'false' if the cell is included in COMPCONF-measBasedCellConf-lnCelId.
If actCoMp is set to 'fixedULCoMp' following is applicable based on the used HW variant:
- FSMr3: actCombSuperCell must be 'false' for all LNCEL_FDD instances of the BTS
- AirScale HW: actCombSuperCell must be 'false' for all LNCEL_FDD instances belonging to an ulCoMpCellList.

If actCombSuperCell is set to 'true' all of the following conditions need to be fulfilled: 
- dlMimoMode must be set to one of the values: 'SingleTX', 'TXDiv', 'Dynamic Open Loop MIMO' or 'Closed Loop Mimo'.
- the related LCELL must contain at least 2 CHANNELGROUP instances (subcells), and may contain up to 6 CHANNELGROUP instances (subcells)
> in each of those CHANNELGROUP instances
>> for each channelGroupId there must be a subCellConf-subCellId configured with the same value as channelGroupId
>> if dlMimoMode is set to 'TXDiv', 'Dynamic Open Loop MIMO' or 'Closed Loop Mimo' then 4 CHANNEL instances must be contained and each of two of the CHANNEL instances must have identical configuration for parameter antlDN, and must have different configuration for parameter direction
>> if dlMimoMode is set to 'SingleTX' then 3 CHANNEL instances must be contained where two of the CHANNEL instances must have identical configuration for parameter antlDN, and must have different configuration for parameter direction (i.e. in one of these CHANNEL instances direction must be set to 'TX' and in the other CHANNEL instance direction must be set to 'RX') and in the third CHANNEL instance direction must be set to 'RX' and antlDN must be different from the antlDN configured in the other two CHANNEL instances.
- dlChBw must be set to value '5 MHz', '10 MHz', '15 MHz' or '20 MHz'.
- enhCellVendorSpecTracing-ripTracing must be configured to 'false' in all MTRACE instances belonging to the LNCEL/LNCEL_FDD.
- ripAlarmingConfig-actRIPAlarming must be configured to 'false' in same LNCEL_FDD instance.
- actSuperCell and actLiquidCell must be configured to 'false'.
- subCellConf must be configured.
- superCellParSet must be configured.
- actLBRTXPowerSaving must be set to 'false'.
- actEicic must be set to 'false'.
- prachConfIndex cannot have value in range (51..56).
- actLPPaEcid must be set to 'false'
- nbIoTMode must be set to 'disabled'.
- actUlPwrRestrScn must be set to 'none'
- actMMimo in same LNCEL_FDD instance is 'false'

If actCombSuperCell is set to 'false', all of the following conditions need to be fulfilled:
- subCellConf shall not be configured
- if (actSuperCell is set to 'false' AND actLiquidCell is set to 'false') then there must be just 1 CHANNELGROUP instance contained in the related LCELL object.

For definitions regarding carrier aggregation used in below parameter relationships, please, see the definitions at parameter actDLCAggr.
Pre-condition: actULCAggr is set to 'UL_CA_with_smartSched' in the parent LNBTS of the PCell.
actCombSuperCell must have the same value in the PCell and all its related own SCells.

Activate non-TM9 UEs to be scheduled in CSI-RSI sub-frames. 
If actCsiRsSubFNonTM9Sch is set to 'TRUE':

MPUCCH_TDD - riEnable Following definitions are used in connection with carrier aggregation (CA):
- PCell (= P-LNCEL = LNCEL in a PCell role): An instance of LNCEL that has one or more instances of MOC CAREL configured.
- SCell (= S-LNCEL = LNCEL in a SCell role): An instance of LNCEL that is referenced by an instance of MOC CAREL, where CAREL-lcrId is the same than LNCEL-lcrId and CAREL-lnBtsId  is the same than the LNBTS-lnBtsId of the SCell's parent LNBTS.
Note: SCells can be located
- in the same LNBTS than the PCell (denoted as 'own' SCell/CAREL), if CAREL-lnBtsId  is the same than the LNBTS-lnBtsId of the PCell's parent LNBTS or
- in a different LNBTS than the PCell (denoted as 'foreign' or 'partner' SCell/CAREL), if CAREL-lnBtsId  is different than the LNBTS-lnBtsId of the PCell's parent LNBTS

(1) If supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'FDD' or 'TDD' or 'mixed_FDD_TDD' following conditions must be fulfilled:
(1.1) actDLCAggr can only be configured to 'true' if actEnhAcAndGbrServices is set to 'true'.
(1.2) actDLCAggr must be configured to 'true' if at least one of the following conditions is fulfilled:
- actA3ScellSelect is set to 'true'
- actInterEnbDLCAggr is set to 'true'
- actPcellSwap is set to 'true'
- actULCAggr is NOT set to 'false'
- actCaBlocking is set to 'true' in at least one LNCEL child instance.
(1.3) If actDLCAggr is 'true', then all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- an instance of CAGENB must exist
- one instance of CADPR must exist
- scellFastSchedulingSelect must be configured in each PCell of the BTS
(1.4) If actDLCAggr is 'true' and actCplaneOvlHandling is set to 'true', then the following condition must be fulfilled:
- caConfigRatioOvl1 must exist
(1.5) If actDLCAggr is 'false', actCAggrLteNrDualConnectivity must be configured to 'disabled'. 

(2) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'FDD' following conditions must be fulfilled in addition to (1):
(2.1) Pre-condition: actDLCAggr is 'true' AND cellTechnology set to 'FDD':
(2.1.1) - if in addition actFlexScellSelect is set to 'false' then:
(2.1.1.0) - for each PCell, all instances of own CARELs must point to SCells with totally no more than two different values for LNCEL_FDD-earfcnDL, which are different from PCell's LNCEL_FDD-earfcnDL.
(2.1.1.1) - for each PCell there can be a maximum of 1 own CAREL instance, which has an identical value for SCell's LNCEL_FDD-earfcnDL, i.e., there can be a maximum of 1 own SCell per SCell frequency layer.
(2.1.1.2) - there can be a maximum of two CAREL instances (own and/or foreign) per PCell. 
(2.1.2) - if in addition actFlexScellSelect is set to 'true' then:
(2.1.2.0) - for each PCell, all instances of own CARELs must point to SCells with totally no more than six different values for LNCEL_FDD-earfcnDL, which are different from PCell's LNCEL_FDD-earfcnDL.
(2.1.2.1) - for each PCell there can be a maximum of 6 own CAREL instances, which have an identical value for SCell's LNCEL_FDD-earfcnDL, i.e., there can be a maximum of 6 own SCells per SCell frequency layer.
(2.1.2.2) - for each PCell, all own SCells with the same value for SCell's LNCEL-earfcnDL must also have the same value for SCell's LNCEL_FDD-dlChBw.
(2.1.3) - in LNBTS, all instances of LNCEL must have a value for caPoolId configured.
(2.1.4) - in LNBTS, a maximum of 13 instances of LNCEL can have the same value for caPoolId configured.
(2.1.5) - for each PCell, in all instances of CAREL, the combination of CAREL-lnBtsId + CAREL-lcrId must be unique and different from the combination of PCell's parent LNBTS-lnBtsId + PCell's LNCEL-lcrId. 
(2.1.6) - for each PCell, for all instances of own CAREL, the LNCEL with LNCEL-lcrId identical to CAREL-lcrId must exist. 
(2.1.7) - for each PCell, the PCell and all related own SCells must have the same value configured for
(2.1.7.1) - caPoolId
(2.1.8) - for each PCell, the PCell and all related own SCells with LNCEL_FDD-dlChBw unequal to 1.4 MHz, must have the same value configured for
(2.1.8.1) - rcEnableDl
(2.1.8.2) - rcEnableUl
(2.1.9) - in LNBTS, caSchedFairFact must be configured
(2.1.10) - actAutoPucchAlloc of the PCell and its own belonging SCells are configured identical.
(2.1.11) For all PCells:
(2.1.11.0) - if maxNumScells is greater than '2', actUciOnlyGrants must be set to 'true'.
(2.1.11.1) - if maxNumScells is greater than '2' AND cellType is NOT 'large', actEicic must be set to 'false'.
(2.1.11.2) - if dlChBw in corresponding instance of LNCEL_FDD is '1.4 MHz' or '3 MHz', then no instances of MOC CAREL must be configured to the instance of LNCEL representing the PCell.
(2.1.12) All of the following conditions are applicable in MPUCCH_FDD of all LNCEL instances configured as PCells if actAutoPucchAlloc is set to 'false'.
(2.1.12.1) - if maxNumScells is greater than '1', then nPucchF3Prbs must be greater than '0'.
(2.1.12.2) - if maxNumScells is smaller than or equal to '1', then nPucchF3Prbs must be '0'.
(2.1.12.3) - nCqiRb must be greater than the sum of nPucchF3Prbs and blankedPucch.
(2.1.12.4) - if maxNumScells is greater than '1', then cqiPerNp must be smaller than or equal to '40 ms'; NOTE: This check is valid only for Flexi Macro BTS.
(2.1.12.5) - if (exactly one CAREL instance exists for the LNCEL instance) OR (maxNumScells is greater than '1'), n1PucchAn must be configured to '10' or >= '72'.
(2.1.12.6) - if (two or more CAREL instances exist for the LNCEL instance) AND (maxNumScells is '1'), n1PucchAn must be configured to >= '72'.
(2.1.12.7) - deltaPucchShift must be smaller than or equal to ‘2'.
(2.1.13) actAutoPucchAlloc of the PCell and all its related SCells must be configured to the same value.
(2.1.14) If actLiquidCell in a PCell is set to 'true', then actLiquidCell in all related own SCells must be also set to 'true'.
(2.2) If act1TxIn2Tx is 'true', then actDLCAggr must be 'false'.

(3) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'TDD' following conditions must be fulfilled in addition to (1):
(3.1) Pre-condition: actDLCAggr is 'true' in the parent LNBTS AND cellTechnology set to 'TDD':
(3.1.1) - if in addition actFlexScellSelect is set to 'false' then:
(3.1.1.0) - for each PCell, all instances of own CARELs must point to SCells with totally no more than two different values for LNCEL_TDD-earfcn, which are different from PCell's LNCEL_TDD-earfcn.
(3.1.1.1) - for each PCell there can be a maximum of 1 own CAREL instance, which has an identical value for SCell's LNCEL_TDD-earfcn, i.e., there can be a maximum of 1 own SCell per SCell frequency layer.
(3.1.1.2) - there can be a maximum of two CAREL instances (own and/or foreign) per PCell.
(3.1.2) if in addition actFlexScellSelect is 'true' then
(3.1.2.0) - for each PCell, all instances of own CARELs must point to SCells with totally no more than five different values for LNCEL_TDD-earfcn, which are different from PCell's LNCEL_TDD-earfcn.

(3.1.6) - for each PCell, for all instances of own CAREL, the LNCEL with LNCEL-lcrId identical to CAREL-lcrId must exist 
(3.1.7) - for each PCell, the PCell and all related own SCells must have the same value configured for 
(3.1.7.1) - caPoolId
(3.1.7.2) - rcEnableDl
(3.1.7.3) - rcEnableUl
(3.1.8) - actAutoPucchAlloc of the PCell and its own belonging SCells are configured identical
(3.1.9) - if in addition maxNumScells is greater than '1' in an LNCEL, actSuperCell must be set to false in this PCell and all its related own SCells
(3.1.10) - for each PCell: if actAutoPucchAlloc is 'false' AND maxNumCaConfUe is greater than '100', then n1PucchAn must be greater than or equal to '144'.
(3.1.11) - if in addition dlMimoMode is 'Closed Loop MIMO (8x4)' in at least one instance of LNCEL_TDD, then actLBRTXPowerSaving must be 'false'.
(3.1.12) - for each PCell, if riEnable is 'false' in the sub-ordinated instance of LNCEL_TDD, then cqiPerNp in the sub-ordinated instance of LNCEL_TDD must be smaller than or equal to '80ms'.
(3.1.13) If actSFN in a PCell is set to 'true' and actDLCAggr is set to 'true' in the parent LNBTS, actSFN in all related own SCells must be also set to 'true'.
(3.1.14) If actSFN in an own SCell is set to 'true' and actDLCAggr is set to 'true' in the parent LNBTS, actSFN in all related PCells must be also set to 'true'.

(3.2.3) - for each PCell, if maxNumScells is greater than '1', then nPucchF3Prbs must be greater than '0'
(3.2.4) - for each PCell, nCqiRb must be greater than nPucchF3Prbs

actDlIntShaping.description: This parameter activates/de-activates the optional feature "Downlink Interference Shaping"
actDlIntShaping.notes:
Related functions: Scheduler (Downlink) Related parameters: ISHPR - ishPrId
LNBTS - actEnhAcAndGbrServices
LNCEL - cellResourceSharingMode
LNCEL - cqiAperEnable
LNCEL - dlIshConfig-actDlIsh
LNCEL - dlIshConfig-amountBlankedRes
LNCEL - dlIshConfig-ishPrId
LNCEL_FDD - actLiquidCell
LNCEL_FDD - dlChBW If actDlIntShaping is set to 'true' all of following conditions must be fulfilled in LNCEL:
- cqiAperEnable must be configured to 'true' in all LNCEL instances where dlChBw is set to larger or equal than '5MHz'
- actEnhAcAndGbrServices must be configured to 'true'
- cellResourceSharingMode must be configured to 'none'
- actLiquidCell must be configured to 'false'
- for all LNCEL-ishPrId instances, a corresponding instance of ISHPR must exist with LNCEL-dlIshConfig-ishPrId equal to ISHPR-ishPrId

If actDlIntShaping is set to 'false' all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- dlIshConfig-actDlIsh must be set to 'false'
- dlIshConfig-amountBlankedRes must be set to '0'.

actDlMuMimo.description: Parameter to activate or deactivate DL MU-MIMO in a cell. It is used to support TM8 or TM9 MU-MIMO.
actDlMuMimo.notes:
Related functions: MU-MIMO Related parameters: LNBTS - actEnhAcAndGbrServices
LNBTS_TDD - actConvVoice
LNBTS_TDD - actCsBIA
LNCEL - dlamcEnable
LNCEL_TDD - actCEBB
LNCEL_TDD - actMMimo
LNCEL_TDD - dlMimoMode
LNCEL_TDD - dlMuMimoParSet actDlMuMimo must be set to 'false' if
- dlamcEnable is set to 'false' OR
- both actConvVoice and actEnhAcAndGbrServices are set to 'false' OR
- actCEBB set to another value than 'CEBB_disabled' in the LNCEL_TDD instance.

If actDlMuMimo is set to 'true' all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- dlMuMimoParSet must be configured
- if actMMimo is set to ‘false’, dlMimoMode must be configured to 'Dual Stream Beamforming' or 'Closed Loop MIMO (8x2)'
- if actMMimo is set to ‘true’, dlMimoMode must be configured to ‘Single Stream Beamforming’ or 'Dual Stream Beamforming'
- actCEBB in same LNCEL instance must be configured to 'CEBB_disabled'

actDlMuMimo must be set to 'false' for each cell in the csBIACellList if actCsBIA is set to 'true'

actDlSlimCarrier.description: This parameters activates/deactivates feature 'Slim Carrier' in the downlink.
actDlSlimCarrier.notes:
Related functions: Radio L1/2 Configuration
BTS Site or Cell Configuration
Scheduler (Downlink) Related parameters: CDFIM - csfbRegParam1xRtt
CDFIM - hrpdNCList
CDFIM - rttNCList
IRFIM - intFrBCList
IRFIM - intFrNCList
IRFIM - irfimId
LNBTS - act1xCsfb
LNCEL - actOtdoa
LNCEL - cellTechnology
LNCEL - dlInterferenceEnable
LNCEL - dlIshConfig-actDlIsh
LNCEL - dlIshConfig-amountBlankedRes
LNCEL - dlsDciCch
LNCEL - lcrId
LNCEL - nbIoTMode
LNCEL - rttCsfbType
LNCEL_FDD - actCatM
LNCEL_FDD - dlChBw
LNCEL_FDD - numBlankDlPrbsDown
LNCEL_FDD - numBlankDlPrbsUp
MBSFNCEL - mbsfnCelId
NBIOT_FDD - inbandPRBIndexDL actDlSlimCarrier can be set to 'true' only if all following conditions are fulfilled:
- dlsDciCch is set to 'DCI format 1A'
- dlChBw is not equal to '1.4 MHz'
- no MBSFNCEL instance is created in the related LNCEL instance
- actDlIsh is set to 'false' and amountBlankedRes is equal to '0'
- actCatM is set to 'false'
- actOtdoa is set to 'false'
- dlInterferenceEnable is set to 'false'
- numBlankDlPrbsDown and numBlankDlPrbsUp must be configured 
- numBlankDlPrbsUp + numBlankDlPrbsDown must be <=  20% of max number of downlink PRBs of the cell. 
- nbIoTMode is not set to 'guardband'.

If actDlSlimCarrier is set to 'true' and nbIotMode is set to 'inband' in the superior LNCEL instance then the following conditions must be additionally fulfilled in the related NB IoT inband LNCEL instance, i.e. the LNCEL instance with lcrId equal to nbIotLinkedCellId of hosting wideband LNCEL instance:
- inbandPRBIndexDL must be greater than or equal to numBlankDlPrbsDown
- inbandPRBIndexDL + numBlankDlPrbsUp must be less than max number of downlink PRBs of the cell.

The number of IRFIM instances and the number of list items in intFrBCList and intFrNCList  depend among others on the slim carrier configuration (for details please refer to the definition in intFrNCList and intFrBCList).

The number of list items in rttNCList and hrpdNCList depend among others on the slim carrier configuration (for details please refer to the definition in rttNCList and hrpdNCList).

The value that rttCsfbType shall be set depend among others on the slim carrier configuration (note1)(for details please refer to the definition in rttCsfbType).

The configuration of structure csfbRegParam1xRtt depends among others on the slim carrier configuration (note1)(for details please refer to the definition in csfbRegParam1xRtt ).

note1:
LTE3145 disabled = actDlSlimCarrier is set to 'false' or ( numBlankDlPrbsUp+ numBlankDlPrbsDown =0 )
LTE3145 enabled = actDlSlimCarrier is set to 'true' and ( numBlankDlPrbsUp+ numBlankDlPrbsDown >0 )

Hints:
max number of downlink PRBs of the cell depends on the bandwidth and is:
- 25 if dlChBw is equal to '5 MHz'
- 50 if dlChBw is equal to '10 MHz'
- 75 if dlChBw is equal to '15 MHz'
- 100 if dlChBw is equal to '20 MHz'

20% of max number of downlink PRBs of the cell depends on the bandwidth and is:
- 3 if dlChBw is equal to '3 MHz'
- 5 if dlChBw is equal to '5 MHz'
- 10 if dlChBw is equal to '10 MHz'
- 15 if dlChBw is equal to '15 MHz'
- 20 if dlChBw is equal to '20 MHz'

actDownSampling.notes:

ULCOMP - ulCoMpMode Conditions in (1.x) are valid if the cellTechnology is configured to 'FDD':
(1.1) Only on AirScale HW actDownSampling is allowed to be configured to 'true'.
(1.2) Only if ulChBw and dlChBw are set to '20 MHz', actDownSampling is allowed to be configured to 'true'.
(1.3) If ulChBw and dlChBw are set to '20 MHz' AND actDownSampling is set to 'false', all the SMODs and/or BBMODs connected to the radio(s) (directly or via an FHS) serving the cell must have in the corresponding CABLINK instances iqCompression set to 'none'.
(1.4) If actUnlicensedAcc is 'true' and four instances of LNCEL in the unlicensed band  as defined in parameters actUnlicensedAcc and actUnlicensedDfs are configured and linked to the same instance of RMOD (via rModId), then actDownSampling must be 'true' in all these four cells.

Conditions in (2.x) are valid if the cellTechnology is configured to 'TDD':
(2.1) Only if chBw is set to '20 MHz', actDownSampling is allowed to be configured to 'true'.
(2.2) If chBw is set to '20MHz' AND actDownSampling is set to 'false', all the SMODs and/or BBMODs connected to the radio(s) serving the cell must have in the corresponding CABLINK instances iqCompression set to 'none'.
(2.3) If actCoMp is set to 'fixedULCoMp' AND ulCoMpMode is set to 'IQ_Combining', the same actDownSampling must be configured in all LNCEL_TDD instances belonging to the same ulCoMpCellList.

Conditions in (3.x) are valid if the cellTechnology is configured to 'NB-IoT-FDD':
(3.1) actDownSampling is not allowed to be configured to 'true'.

actDrx.description:
Parameter to activate or deactivate the DRX feature in a cell.

Note for the case where periodic subband CQI reporting (periodicCqiFeedbackType) is enabled together with DRX functionality:
It may not be possible to synchronize DRX start offset such that the wideband CQI report is received during the DRX OnDuration (due to periodicities) and that may cause small performance degradation in DL whenever fresh wideband channel quality information cannot be get in time. It is up to an operator whether to prevent activation of periodic subband CQI reporting and DRX in parallel because of this restriction.

It is highly recommended to stay with DRX default values if dlChBw is set to '1.4 MHz'.

This parameter defines the use of the feature "Dual Stack IPv4/IPv6 for S1/X2".
If IPv6 addresses shall be used the feature must be enabled.

If dual stack S1/X2 is disabled (FALSE): 

  1.) Only IPv4 addresses configured: The configured IPv4 addresses are bound to applications and are operational.
  2.) Both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses configured: The configured IPv4 addresses are bound to applications and are operational. The configured IPv6 addresses are not bound to applications.
       This allows to pre-configure IPv6 addresses an take them into use ate a later point in time by enabling the feature. This is to allow easy migration from IPv4 to IPv6.

If Dual Stack S1/X2 is enabled (TRUE):
  1.) All configured IP versions/addresses are bound to applications and are operational.

actDynamicIP.description:
The parameter "actDynamicIP" activates the support for dynamic assignment of IP addresses for transport and M/C/U/S plane from DHCP server and/or Security gateway depending on the deployment scenario (private or public backhaul).
The default value is "false".
By default initial IP addresses obtained from DHCP server and/or Security gateway during autoconnection phase will be replaced after final configuration is received from NetAct.
actDynamicIP.fullName: Feature Activation Flag Dynamic IP assignment
actDynamicIP.notes:
Related parameters: MRBTS/LNBTS/FTM/IPNO - actACNonOpBackhaul: 
MRBTS/LNBTS/FTM/IPNO - actDualUPlaneIpAddress: 
MRBTS/LNBTS/FTM/IPNO - actIPv6Mplane: 
MRBTS/LNBTS/FTM/IPNO - actIpv6: 
MRBTS/LNBTS/FTM/IPNO - actMultipleDynamicIP: 
MRBTS/LNBTS/FTM/IPNO - actSeparationRanSharing: 
MRBTS/LNBTS/FTM/IPNO - cPlaneIpAddress: 
MRBTS/LNBTS/FTM/IPNO - cPlaneIpAddressSec: 
MRBTS/LNBTS/FTM/IPNO - mPlaneIpAddress: 
MRBTS/LNBTS/FTM/IPNO - sPlaneIpAddress: 
MRBTS/LNBTS/FTM/IPNO - uPlaneIpAddress: 
MRBTS/LNBTS/FTM/IPNO/IEIF - localIpAddr: 
MRBTS/LNBTS/FTM/IPNO/IEIF - netmask: 
MRBTS/LNBTS/FTM/IPNO/IEIF - overrideMTUSize: 
MRBTS/LNBTS/FTM/IPNO/IEIF/IVIF - localIpAddr: 
MRBTS/LNBTS/FTM/IPNO/IEIF/IVIF - netmask: 
MRBTS/LNBTS/FTM/IPNO/IPRT - staticRoutes-gateway: 
MRBTS/LNBTS/FTM/IPSECC - securityPolicies-ipSecStatus: 
MRBTS/LNBTS/FTM/IPSECC - securityPolicies-localTunnelEndpoint: 1. The following deployments are considered:
    1.1 If actACNonOpBackhaul = FALSE (private backhaul deployment), then:
        1.1.1 if additionally actDynamicIP = TRUE, eNB shall use the DHCP assigned IP address for transport and M/C/U/S plane.
        1.1.2 if additionally actDynamicIP = FALSE, the operator must configure the transport and M/C/U/S plane IP addresses.
    1.2 If actACNonOpBackhaul = TRUE (public backhaul deployment), then:
        1.2.1 if additionally actDynamicIP = FALSE and actMultipleDynamicIp = FALSE, eNB shall use the DHCP assigned IP address for transport (outer) IP address and Splane IP address and the operator must configure the M/C/U plane (inner IP address).
        1.2.2 if additionally actDynamicIP = TRUE, eNB shall use the DHCP assigned IP address for transport (outer) IP address and Splane IP address and shall use the IP addresses provided by SeGW for M/C/U plane (single inner IP address).
        1.2.3 if additionally actDynamicIP = FALSE and actMultipleDynamicIp = TRUE, eNB shall use the DHCP assigned IP address for transport (outer) IP address and Splane IP address and shall use the IP addresses provided by SeGW for M/C/U plane(s) (possible multiple inner IP addresses).
2. If actDynamicIP is set to 'true', the the following rules must be fulfilled:
    2.1 The following IP addresses should be set to 0.0.0.0:
        IPNO-cPlaneIpAddress
        IPNO-mPlaneIpAddress
        IPNO-sPlaneIpAddress
        IPNO-uPlaneIpAddress
        IEIF-localIpAddr
        IEIF-NetMask
        IPRT-staticRoutes::gateway
        IPSECC-securityPolicies::localTunnelEndpoint
    Note: The eNB shall send CCN to iOMS/NetAct to update the values for the above attributes.
    2.2 if additionally operator creates VLAN (IVIF) object, then the operator should set the vlanId to 0 and the following IP addresses to 0.0.0.0:
        IEIF/IVIF-localIpAddr
        IEIF/IVIF-netmask
    Note: The eNB shall send CCN to iOMS/NetAct to update the values for the above attributes.
    2.3 actDualUPlaneIpAddress must be set to FALSE.
    2.4 actSeparationRanSharing must be set to FALSE.
    2.5 cPlaneIpAddressSec must not be specified.
    2.6 if additionally IEIF-overrideMTUSize is set to a non-zero value, then eNB shall use the overrideMTUSize for MTU value.
    2.7 actMultipleDynamicIp must be set to FALSE.
    2.8 If additionally actACNonOpBackhaul is set to 'false', then:
    2.8.1 actIpv6 must be set to 'false'.
    2.8.2 actIPv6Mplane must be set to 'false'.

3. IEIF-overrideMTUSize can be set to non-zero value only if IPNO-actACNonOpBackhaul and/or IPNO-actDynamicIP is set to TRUE.
actDynamicIP.relatedFeatures:
•  LTE2949 Flexi Zone Dynamic IP Assignment (Optional)  
•  LTE955 IPv6 for Mplane (Standard)  
•  LTE3978 FZM Dynamic IP for multiple tunnels (Standard)
actDynamicIP.source: Nokia LTE18 official BTS parameter dictionary (FDD)

Activates ETWS support
If ETWS support is set to 'true', ETWS primary and secondary notification are broadcasted (SIB10 and SIB11) in case of Write-Replace Warning Request incl. ETWS, data is received from MME.

This parameter also activates the feature 
- LTE2085 'SIB reception with parallel measurement gaps' that enables UEs in measurement gaps to receive ETWS notification at least once per SIB window.
- LTE2120 TDD SIB reception with parallel measurement gaps that enables UEs in measurement gaps to receive ETWS notification at least once per SIB window.

Note: All Cat-M UEs in RRC Connected mode may be released, when this parameter is online modified together with Cat-M are activated.

- if actLiquidCell is set to 'true', then liquidCellConfigInfo-csiRsSubfr must be set to one of the following values: '3', '8', '18' or '38'.

- the allowed range of prsConfigurationIndex depends on sib2xTransmit, actETWS, actCMAS, siWindowLen, sibSchedulingList, actOtdoa, tddFrameConf. Please see the parameter LNCEL_TDD-prsConfigurationIndex for the detailed parameter relationship.

- if in addition actOtdoa is set to 'true', prsConfigurationIndex must be set to a value of 158, 478, 1118 or 2398

- maxNumRrcEmergency >= maxNumRrc + max(addAUeRrHo, addAUeTcHo)
(2.2)   If actEmerCallRedir is set to 'Enabled' AND in LNCEL_FDD actAutoPucchAlloc is set to 'true', following need to be assured in MPUCCH_FDD:
- aPucchMinNumEmergencySessions must be configured.
Note:
For Carrier Aggregation: limitations are applicable on maxNumRrcEmergency when actEmerCallRedir set to 'Enabled' please refer to maxNumRrcEmergency.

(3) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'TDD' following conditions must be fulfilled in addition to (1):
(3.1)  If actEmerCallRedir is set to 'Enabled' AND in LNCEL_TDD actAutoPucchAlloc is set to 'false', following need to be assured in MPUCCH_TDD:
- maxNumRrcEmergency >= maxNumRrc + max(addAUeRrHo, addAUeTcHo)
(3.2)   If actEmerCallRedir is set to 'Enabled' AND in LNCEL_TDD actAutoPucchAlloc is set to 'true', following need to be assured in MPUCCH_TDD:
- aPucchMinNumEmergencySessions must be configured.
Note:
For Carrier Aggregation: limitations are applicable on maxNumRrcEmergency when actEmerCallRedir set to 'Enabled' please refer to maxNumRrcEmergency.

(4) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'mixed_FDD_TDD' conditions of (2) AND (3) must be fulfilled in addition to (1).

actEnhAcAndGbrServices.description:
This parameter activates support of the following features
LTE534: ARP based Admission Control 
LTE497: Smart Admission Control, comprising RAC and TAC
LTE496: EPS bearers with QCI 2, 3 and 4
Feature LTE496 introduces support of QCI 2, 3, and 4 along with higher guaranteed bit rates and related congestion detection and handling mechanisms.

Admission control functionality (LTE497) is extended at the same time from a counter based solution to become load based and offer in addition congestion handling functionality to better address the needs being imposed by higher guaranteed bit rates.

Finally the ARP based admission control (LTE534) allows to consider the ARP priority in load-based admission and admission related pre-emption as well as in congestion handling as an additional more service-related dimension for differentiated treatment of bearers with guaranteed resources.

As those features are closely inter-related, they are activated via a common activation parameter.

LNCEL_FDD - dlChBw Conditions in (1.x) are valid if the supportedCellTechnology of the LNBTS instance is configured to 'FDD' or 'TDD' or 'mixed_FDD_TDD' and applicable to all cells:
(1.1) actEnhAcAndGbrServices can only be configured to 'true' if all following conditions are fulfilled:
- actMultBearers is equal to 'true'
- congWeightAlg is configured.
(1.2) Only if actEnhAcAndGbrServices is set to 'true' then ...
- actDLCAggr can be configured to 'true'
- actHighPrioServices can be configured to 'true'
- actMultGbrBearers can be configured to 'true'
- act8EpsBearers can be configured to 'true'
- cellResourceSharingMode is allowed to be configured to 'DLandUL' or 'DLonly'.
- actNbrForNonGbrBearers can be configured to 'true'
- actPartialAcHo can be configured to 'true'
- actAcSrvcc can be configured to 'true'
- actBbPooling can be configured to 'true'
- actPubSafetyBearers can be configured to 'true'
- actContextPreemption can be configured to 'true'
- actPlmnBasedPreemption can be configured to 'true'.
(1.3) If actEnhAcAndGbrServices is set to 'false' all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- gbrCongHandling must be configured to 'none'
- actOperatorQCIGBR must be configured to 'false'.

Conditions in (2.x) are valid in addition to (1.x) if the supportedCellTechnology of the LNBTS instance is configured to 'FDD' or 'mixed_FDD_TDD' for all cells with cellTechnology set to 'FDD':
(2.1) Only if actEnhAcAndGbrServices is set to 'true' then actDlIntShaping in LNBTS_FDD can be configured to 'true'.

Conditions in (3.x) are valid in addition to (1.x) if the supportedCellTechnology of the LNBTS instance is configured to 'TDD' or 'mixed_FDD_TDD':
(3.1) Only if actEnhAcAndGbrServices is set to 'true' then actDlIntShaping in LNBTS_TDD can be configured to 'true'.

Conditions in (4.x) are valid if the supportedCellTechnology of the LNBTS instance is configured to 'FDD':
(4) if actCatM of at least one LNCEL instance is set to 'true', following conditions must be fulfilled:
(4.1) only if actEnhAcAndGbrServices is 'true', actPreempVulCatM is allowed to be configured to 'true'.

actFastMimoSwitch.description:
Enables 'Fast Adaptive MIMO Switching' for Closed Loop MIMO modes based on PMI/RI reports sent by UEs if actFastMimoSwitch is set to 'true'.
Enables 'Dynamic MIMO Switching' if actFastMimoSwitch is set to 'false'.
actFastMimoSwitch is set to 'true': Activation of 'Fast Adaptive MIMO Switching'
'Fast adaptive MIMO Switching' supports fast rank selection and fast codebook based precoding of data transmission using closed loop feedback of precoding matrix indicator (PMI) in combination with rank indicator (RI). PMI and RI reporting delays shall be minimized by periodic and aperiodic reports sent by UEs in order to optimize PMI closed loop gains in combination with optimized rank selection.  

actFastMimoSwitch is set to 'false': Activation of 'Dynamic MIMO Switching'
'Dynamic MIMO Switching' supports RI and CQI based rank selection after filtering of CQI and RI reports sent by the UE. 'Dynamic MIMO Switching' is using RI and CQI thresholds for rank selection by comparison with filtered values. The threshold parameters 'mimoClCqiThD', 'mimoClCqiThU', 'mimoClRiThD', 'mimoClRiThU' are activated and used for rank switching.
actFastMimoSwitch.notes:
Related functions: MIMO Control Related parameters: LNCEL_FDD - actAutoPucchAlloc
LNCEL_FDD - dlMimoMode
LNCEL_FDD - mimoClConfig
MPUCCH_FDD - riEnable
MPUCCH_FDD - riPerM
MPUCCH_FDD - riPerOffset (1.1) If actFastMimoSwitch is set to 'true' following conditions need to be fulfilled:
- dlMimoMode must be configured to ('Closed Loop Mimo' OR 'Closed Loop MIMO (4x2)' OR 'Closed Loop MIMO (4x4)' OR 'Closed Loop MIMO (8x2) OR 'Closed Loop MIMO (8x4)').
- when in addition actAutoPucchAlloc is set to 'false', following must be considered in MPUCCH:
> riPerOffset must be configured to '-1'
> riPerM must be configured to '1'
> riEnable must be configured to 'true'
(1.2) If actFastMimoSwitch set to 'false' and dlMimoMode is set to ('Closed Loop Mimo' or 'Closed Loop Mimo (4x2)'), mimoClConfig must be configured.

actFlexBbUsage.description:
Activation of more flexible base band usage by allowing more enhanced recovery in case of HW failure. If set to 'true', the size of PUCCH PRB may be limited on 10 MHz system bandwidth or lower. It need to be set to 'true' to configure more than 2 cells with FSMD, more than 3 with FSME or FSMF without extension Baseband module, more than 6 with FSMF with extension Baseband module or more than 9 with FSMF+FBBx+FBBC or more than 6 with FSMF+FBBx+FBBC, if there are cells present with any of the following properties: ( (20MHz 4RX and actOptimizedBbUsage set to false) or (4x4 DL MIMO enabled) or UL CoMP 4RX enabled ) ). When set to 'true', range of parameters maxNumActUE and maxNumRrc will be limited for 5 MHz and 10 MHz cells.

AirScale:
actFlexBbusage shall be set to false in any deployment.

eNB will dynamically decide dependent on the current and newly required DSP deployment if dropping of all cells is needed. 
It is recommended to consider planned site extensions already with first commissioning if limitations for parameters maxNumActUE, maxNumRrc, addAUeTcHo, maxNumRrcEmergency, n1PucchAn, pucchNAnCs and deltaPucchShift are acceptable.

Activate Flexible Baseband Usage on BTS
Activation of more flexible baseband usage by allowing more enhanced recovery in case of HW failure.  Parameter is affecting only into  cells with uplink and downlink channel bandwidth is 5 MHz or 10 MHz. In case parameter is set to 'true', there may be limitations in the amount 
FSMD: value 'false' => up to 2 cells can be configured. Value 'true' => up to 3 cells can be configured.
FSME: value 'false' => up to 3 cells can be configured. Value 'true' => up to 6 cells can be configured.
FSMF: value 'false' => up to 3 cells can be configured. Value 'true' => up to 6 cells can be configured.
FSMF + 1 x Extension Baseband Module: value 'false' => up to 6 cells can be configured. Value 'true' => up to 12 cells can be configured.
FSMF + FBBA + FBBC: value 'true' => up to 18 cells can be configured.

For SRAN only: 
FSMF (4DSP deployment): value 'false' => up to 2 cells can be configured. Value 'true' => up to 4 cells can be configured.

Note: For AirScale the parameter value is not applicable.
actFlexBbUsage.notes:
Related functions: BTS Site or Cell Configuration Related parameters: LNBTS - actDLCAggr
LNBTS_FDD - actHighRrc
LNCEL - raRespWinSize
LNCEL_FDD - actSuperCell
LNCEL_FDD - maxNumActDrb
LNCEL_FDD - maxNumActUE
MPUCCH_FDD - addAUeRrHo
MPUCCH_FDD - addAUeTcHo
MPUCCH_FDD - maxNumRrc (1) Applicable only for AirScale:
If AirScale HW is used (BPF property HW.Release= 4) then actFLexBbUsage is set to 'false'.

Conditions (2) -(6) are applicable only for FSMr3:
(2) If actFlexBbUsage is set to 'true' following condition need to be fulfilled:
- when in addition ((ulChBw,dlChBw) is '5 MHz' or '10 MHz') the value range for maxNumRrc, addAUeRrHo, addAUeTcHo and maxNumActUE is limited according to following conditions:
 > maxNumActUE value range is restricted to 0...420
 > maxNumActUE+max(addAUeRrHo, addAUeTcHo) <= 420
 > maxNumRrc <= 420
 > maxNumRrcEmergency <= 420

(3) The range of MaxPucchResource size (defined by parameters n1PucchAn, pucchNAnCs and deltaPucchShift) depends on parameters ulChBw and actFlexBbUsage:
(a) if actFlexBbUsage = 'true'
 - for ulChBw set to '5MHz' or '10MHz', MaxPucchResourceSize shall be less than or equal to 10PRB
 - for ulChBw set to '15MHz' or '20MHz', MaxPucchResourceSize shall be less than or equal to 20PRB
 (b) if actFlexBbUsage = 'false'
 - for ulChBw set to '5MHz' or '10MHz', MaxPucchResourceSize shall be less than or equal to 20PRB
 - for ulChBw set to '15MHz' or '20MHz', MaxPucchResourceSize shall be less than or equal to 20PRB

(4) If (actFlexBbUsage is set to 'true' AND ((ulChBw,dlChBw) are set to ('5 MHz' or '10 MHz'))), raRespWinSize must be configured to value '10'.

(5) if actHighRrc is set to 'true' actFlexBbUsage must be configured to 'false'

(6) if in at least one LNCEL instance actSuperCell is set to 'true', actflexBbUsage must be configured to 'true'

actFlexScellSelect.description: This parameter activates the feature for flexible SCell selection for carrier aggregation.
actFlexScellSelect.notes:
Related functions: Carrier Aggregation Related parameters: LNBTS - actDLCAggr
LNBTS - supportedCellTechnology
LNCEL - cellTechnology
LNCEL_FDD - dlChBw
LNCEL_FDD - earfcnDL
LNCEL_TDD - chBw
LNCEL_TDD - earfcn For definitions regarding carrier aggregation used in below parameter relationships, please, see the definitions at parameter actDLCAggr.

(1) If supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'FDD' or 'TDD' or 'mixed_FDD_TDD' following conditions must be fulfilled:
(1.1) actFlexScellSelect can only be set to 'true' if actDLCAggr is set to 'true.

(2) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'FDD' following conditions must be fulfilled in addition to (1):
Pre-condition: actDLCAggr is 'true' AND cellTechnology set to 'FDD'
(2.1) – if actFlexScellSelect is set to 'false' then:
   (2.1.0) – for each PCell, all instances of own CARELs must point to SCells with totally no more than two different values for LNCEL_FDD-earfcnDL, which are different from PCell's LNCEL_FDD-earfcnDL.
   (2.1.1) – for each PCell there can be a maximum of 1 own CAREL instance, which has an identical value for SCell's LNCEL_FDD-earfcnDL, i.e., there can be a maximum of 1 own SCell per SCell frequency layer.
   (2.1.2) – there can be a maximum of two CAREL instances (own and/or foreign) per PCell.
(2.2) – if actFlexScellSelect is 'true' then:
   (2.2.0) – for each PCell, all instances of own CARELs must point to SCells with totally no more than six different values for LNCEL_FDD-earfcnDL, which are different from PCell's LNCEL_FDD-earfcnDL.
   (2.2.1) – for each PCell there can be a maximum of 6 own CAREL instances, which have an identical value for SCell's LNCEL_FDD-earfcnDL, i.e., there can be a maximum of 6 own SCell per SCell frequency layer.
   (2.2.2) – for each PCell, all own SCells with the same value for SCell's LNCEL_FDD-earfcnDL must also have the same value for SCell's LNCEL_FDD-dlChBw.

(3) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'TDD' following conditions must be fulfilled in addition to (1):
Pre-condition: actDLCAggr is 'true' AND cellTechnology set to 'TDD'
(3.1) – if actFlexScellSelect is set to 'false' then:
   (3.1.0) – for each PCell, all instances of own CARELs must point to SCells with totally no more than two different values for LNCEL_TDD-earfcn, which are different from PCell's LNCEL_TDD-earfcn.
   (3.1.1) – for each PCell there can be a maximum of 1 own CAREL instance, which has an identical value for SCell's LNCEL_TDD-earfcn, i.e., there can be a maximum of 1 own SCell per SCell frequency layer.
   (3.1.2) – there can be a maximum of two CAREL instances (own and/or foreign) per PCell.
(3.2) – if actFlexScellSelect is 'true' then:
   (3.2.0) – for each PCell, all instances of own CARELs must point to SCells with totally no more than five different values for LNCEL_TDD-earfcn, which are different from PCell's LNCEL_TDD-earfcn.
   (3.2.1) – for each PCell there can be a maximum of five own CAREL instances, which have an identical value for SCell's LNCEL_TDD-earfcn, i.e., there can be a maximum of five own SCell per SCell frequency layer.
   (3.2.2) – for each PCell, all own SCells with the same value for SCell's LNCEL_TDD-earfcn must also have the same value for SCell's LNCEL_TDD-chBw.
   (3.2.3) – for each PCell, a total maximum of five instances of CAREL are allowed.

(4) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'mixed_FDD_TDD' conditions of (2) AND (3) must be fulfilled in addition to (1).
