actForceAutoReset.description:
If this parameter is set to false, the BTS initiates an autonomous BTS reset or RAT reset or Site reset or BTS secondary core reset or FHS for fault recovery, only if 1) the recovery reset does not disable any working cell and 2) the reset counter value for the BTS/RAT/Site/secondary core/FHS is lower than number of allowed resets.

If this parameter is set to true, the BTS initiates an autonomous BTS reset or RAT reset or Site reset or BTS secondary core or FHS reset for fault recovery, when the BTS/RAT/Site/secondary core/FHS reset counter value is lower than number of allowed resets, even if the recovery reset temporary disables working cell(s). If any of the affected working cell(s) is in a degraded state, the autonomous fault recovery reset is abandoned, as degraded cell setup is not yet supported in the BTS.
If this parameter is set to true, the recovery reset is performed only after a graceful shutdown of the affected working cell(s). It may happen that not all calls are handed over from the shutdown cell to another cell within the shutdown time window. In this case, the calls are terminated.

SBTS Exceptions: 
a. 3G RAT reset is executed regardless of actForceAutoReset value. 
b. 3G cells are not gracefully shutdown before 1) 3G RAT reset or 2) site reset.
c. If 3G RAT reset is escalated to site reset, but site reset is not allowed, for example because actForceAutoReset is set to false and there are other RAT's working cells in the SBTS, all 3G cells are shutdown.

RAT autonomous reset for fault recovery is only applicable for SBTS.
BTS autonomous reset for fault recovery is only applicable for eNB.

•  LTE3342 SRAN Improved FM Service (Standard)  
•  LTE3656 Fronthaul Switch Outdoor DC (Standard)  
•  LTE3685 AFAA AirScale PIM Cancellation Unit (Standard)

actForceUnitAutoReset.description:
If this parameter is set to false, the BTS initiates an autonomous DSP group or FSP or radio reset for fault recovery, only if 1) the recovery reset does not disable any working cell and 2) the reset counter value for the DSP group/FSP/radio is lower than number of allowed resets 3) the DSP group/FSP only supports LTE application (condition 3 valid for DSP group/FSP reset).
If this parameter is set to true, the BTS initiates an autonomous DSP group reset or FSP or radio reset for fault recovery, when the DSP group/FSP/radio reset counter value is lower than number of allowed resets and the DSP group/FSP only supports LTE application for DSP group/FSP resets, even if the recovery reset temporary disables working cell(s). If any of the affected working cell(s) is in a degraded state, the autonomous fault recovery reset is abandoned, as degraded cell setup is not yet supported in the BTS.
If this parameter is set to true, the recovery reset is performed only after a graceful shutdown of the affected working cell(s). It may happen that not all calls are handed over from the shutdown cell to another cell within the shutdown time window. In this case, the calls are terminated.

If a device/unit recovery reset is escalated to BTS/Site/RAT/secondary core recovery reset, actForceAutoReset is taken into account. It may happen actForceUnitAutoReset is set to true and actForceAutoReset is set to false and recovery reset escalated from device/unit reset to BTS/Site/RAT/secondary core reset is blocked due to working cells.

DSP group and FSP autonomous reset for fault recovery is only applicable for eNB.

This parameter activates SRVCC to GSM measurement optimization

actHOtoHrpd.description: This parameter activates the feature Handover from LTE to eHRPD.
actHOtoHrpd.fullName: Activate handover from LTE to eHRPD
actHOtoHrpd.notes:
Related functions: Handover Control (Inter RAT CDMA2000) Related parameters: CDFIM - hoRegParamHrpd
LNBTS - actHOtoWcdma
LNBTS - actImmHRPD
LNBTS - actUeBasedAnrUtran
LNBTS - acteNACCtoGSM
LNBTS - supportedCellTechnology
LNBTS_FDD - actSrvccToGsm
LNBTS_TDD - actHOtoTdscdma
LNBTS_TDD - actSrvccToGsm
LNCEL - cellTechnology
LNCEL - eHrpdSectList
LNCEL - hrpdTimers
LNCEL - threshold2C2kConfig
LNCEL_FDD - dlChBw
SYNC - btsSyncMode (1) If supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'FDD' or 'TDD' or 'mixed_FDD_TDD' following conditions must be fulfilled:
(1.1) actHOtoHrpd can only be configured to 'true' if all of the following conditions are fulfilled in LNBTS:
- actImmHRPD is set to 'true'
- actHOtoWcdma is set to 'false'
- acteNACCtoGSM is set to 'false' 
- actUeBasedAnrUtran is set to 'false'.
(1.2) if actHOtoHrpd is set to 'true' all of the following conditions need to be fulfilled:
- eHrpdSectList must be configured in all LNCEL instances
- threshold2C2kConfig must be configured in all LNCEL instances
- hrpdTimers must be configured in all LNCEL instances
- btsSyncMode must be configured to 'PhaseSync'
- hoRegParamHrpd must be configured in all CDFIM instances of LNCEL instances with dlChBw of the related LNCEL_FDD instance equal to or greater than  '5 MHz
- hoRegParamHrpd must not be configured in all CDFIM instances of LNCEL instances with dlChBw of the related LNCEL_FDD instance equal to '1.4 MHz' or '3 MHz'.

(2) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'FDD' following conditions must be fulfilled in addition to (1):
(2.1) actHOtoHrpd can only be configured to 'true' if all of the following conditions are fulfilled in LNBTS_FDD in addition to (1.1):
- actSrvccToGsm is set to 'false'.
(2.2) if actHOtoHrpd is set to 'true' all of the following conditions are fulfilled in addition to (1.2):
- hoRegParamHrpd must be configured in all CDFIM instances of FDD cells (LNCEL-cellTechnology=’FDD’) whose cell bandwidth in LNCEL_FDD dlChBw is equal to or bigger than '5MHz'

(3) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'TDD' following conditions must be fulfilled in addition to (1):
(3.1) actHOtoHrpd can only be configured to 'true' if all of the following conditions are fulfilled in LNBTS_TDD in addition to (1.1):
- actSrvccToGsm is set to 'false' 
- actHOtoTdscdma is set to 'false'.
(3.2) if actHOtoHrpd is set to 'true' all of the following conditions are fulfilled in addition to (1.2):
- hoRegParamHrpd must be configured in all CDFIM instances of TDD cells (LNCEL-cellTechnology=’TDD’).

(4) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'mixed_FDD_TDD' conditions of (2) AND (3) must be fulfilled in addition to (1).
actHOtoHrpd.relatedFeatures:
•  LTE60 Inter RAT handover to HRPD/3GPP2 (Standard)  
•  LTE738 SRVCC to 1xRTT/CDMA (Standard)  
•  LTE3296 Harmonized Object Model for SRAN and LTE (Standard)  
•  LTE3106 IRAT idle mode mobility for 1.4Mhz and 3Mhz bandwidth cell (Standard)  
•  LTE2927 Changed feature restriction policy for 1.4 and 3 MHz (Standard)
actHOtoHrpd.source: Nokia SBTS 18A official SingleRAN AirScale parameter dictionary

(3.1) actHOtoWcdma can be only set to 'false' if  LNBTS_TDD-actSrvccToWcdma is set to 'false'.

(3.3) If actHOtoWcdma is set to 'true' it is allowed to configure actCsfbPsHoToUtra to 'true'.
(3.4) If actHOtoWcdma is set to 'true', preventPsHOtoWcdma in LNBTS_TDD must be configured.

(4) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'mixed_FDD_TDD' conditions of (2) AND (3) must be fulfilled in addition to (1).

- ulChBw must be '5 MHz', '10 MHz' '15 MHz' or '20 MHz'

- maxNumActDrb must be less than or equal to 2520
- actCoMp can be configured to 'fixedULCoMp'

actIfHo.notes:
Related functions: Handover Control (Intra LTE) Related parameters: CATMCEL - actInterFreqHoCatM
CATMCEL - actIntraFreqHoCatM
LNBTS - actPcellSwap
LNBTS - supportedCellTechnology
LNBTS_FDD - actDedVoLteInterFreqHo
LNBTS_FDD - actInterFreqServiceBasedHo
LNBTS_TDD - actDedVoLteInterFreqHo

LNCEL - a1TimeToTriggerDeactInterMeas

LNCEL - cellTechnology

LNCEL - threshold2a (1) If supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'FDD' or 'TDD' or 'mixed_FDD_TDD' following conditions must be fulfilled:

- a2TimeToTriggerActInterFreqMeas must be configured
- threshold2InterFreq must be configured
- threshold2a must be configured
- hysThreshold2a must be configured

(1.2) If actInterFreqLB is set to 'true', actIfHo must be configured to 'enabled'.

(2) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'FDD' following conditions must be fulfilled in addition to (1):
(2.1) Only if actIfHo is set to 'enabled', actDedVoLteInterFreqHo in LNBTS_FDD is allowed to be configured to 'true', i.e. if actIfHo is set to 'disabled' actInterFreqServiceBasedHo must be configured to 'false'.

(3) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'TDD' following conditions must be fulfilled in addition to (1):

- actDedVoLteInterFreqHo is allowed to be configured to 'true', i.e. if actIfHo is set to 'disabled' actInterFreqServiceBasedHo must be configured to 'false'.
- actRedirVoLte is allowed to be configured to 'true'.

(4) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'mixed_FDD_TDD' conditions of (2) AND (3) must be fulfilled in addition to (1).

actInterFreqRstdMeasSupp.description:
The parameter configures feature LTE1638 "Inter-frequency RSTD measurement support".
If the feature is activated (configured to 'true') the Flexi-BTS supports UE RSTD (reference signal time difference) inter-frequency measurements for OTDOA.
The UE may request the eNode B to start / stop measurements gaps via the RRC:InterFreqRSTDMeasurementIndication message (UEs with 3GPP Release 8 or 9 are not able to request this).

The timing of the measurement gap is derived from the IE measPRS-Offset. 

UE controlled inter-frequency RSTD measurements may help to improve the accuracy of OTDOA, without having the pre-requirement of activated OTDOA.
actInterFreqRstdMeasSupp.notes: Related functions: Handover Control Related parameters: LNCEL - measGapPattern If actInterFreqRstdMeasSupp is set to 'true', measGapPattern must be set to 'gap0'.

actIntraFreqLoadBal.description:
If activated, the intra-frequency load balancing algorithm continuously estimates the cell load, triggering a handover threshold negotiation with the neighbors when the cell load is above a predefined value. The handover threshold negotiation procedure is done over the X2 interface to align the handover thresholds between neighbor cells.
If the feature is deactivated, the "cellIndOffNeighDelta" parameter is implicitly set to 0 in all LNREL objects.

actLBPowerSaving.description:
This parameter activates the feature LTE1103 'Load-Based Power Saving for Multi-Layered Networks'. When the feature is activated, intra-eNB cells that provide service to the same coverage area may be automatically switched off/on according to the aggregate load across the set of cells (Power Group).
LTE1103 Load-Based Power Saving is not meant to be used with eNBs that support RF Sharing (BTSSCL:rfSharingEnabled = 'true'). There is no coordination between the technologies that are configured for RF Sharing. However, LTE1103 Load-Based Power Saving can be used for LTE cells in frequencies that do not share power amplifiers across technologies.
actLBPowerSaving.notes:
Related functions: Load Control (Connected Mode) Related parameters: LNCEL - cellTechnology
LNCEL - loadSettings
LNCEL_TDD - actMMimo If actLBPowerSaving is 'true', loadSettings must be configured in all instances of LNCEL with cellTechnology equal to ('FDD' or 'TDD') of the LNBTS.

If actMMimo is 'true', then actLBPowerSaving must be configured to 'false'.

However, LTE1203 Load-Based Power Saving can be used for LTE cells in frequencies that do not share power amplifiers across technologies.

(3.2) If actMMimo is 'true', then actLBRTXPowerSaving must be configured to 'false'.
(3.3) If actDLCAggr is 'true' AND (dlMimoMode is 'Closed Loop MIMO (8x4)' in at least one instance of LNCEL_TDD), then actLBRTXPowerSaving must be configured to 'false'.

actLdPdcch.description:
Activate or deactivate the load adaptive number of PDCCH symbols in a cell
The actual OFDM symbol amount used for PDCCH in a TTI is selected from values between the minimum reasonable amount of symbols for the selected DL bandwidth and maximum allowed number of PDCCH symbols (maxNrSymPdcch).

Note for FDD cell:
If the bandwidth is set to '3 MHz'. it is recommended to set the parameter to 'false'.

Note for TDD cell:
Not every sub-frame need adaptive PDCCH symbol adjustment because not every sub-frame has PDSCH.
actLdPdcch.notes:
Related functions: PHY/MAC Configuration (Downlink) Related parameters: LNCEL - adaptPdcchDwellTime
LNCEL - cellResourceSharingMode
LNCEL - cellTechnology
LNCEL - pdcchUlDlBal
LNCEL_FDD - actAutoPucchAlloc
LNCEL_FDD - dlChBw
LNCEL_FDD - maxNrSymPdcch
LNCEL_TDD - actAutoPucchAlloc
LNCEL_TDD - actPdcchLoadGen
LNCEL_TDD - chBw
LNCEL_TDD - maxNrSymPdcch
MPUCCH_FDD - phichDur
MPUCCH_TDD - phichDur Conditions in (1.x) are valid if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'FDD' or 'TDD':
(1.1) If actLdPdcch is set to 'false', configured UL and DL split of PDCCH resources (pdcchUlDlBal) is fixed used.
(1.2) If actLdPdcch is set to 'true', UL and DL split of PDCCH resources may be adjusted runtime based on load and the configured value (pdcchUlDlBal) defines the initial starting point then.
(1.3) If actLdPdcch is set to 'true', then adaptPdcchDwellTime must be configured.

Conditions in (2.x) are valid in addition to (1.x) if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'FDD':
(2.1) If dlChBw is set to '1.4 MHz', actLdPdcch must be configured to 'false'.
(2.2) actLdPdcch can only be configured to 'true' if all of the following conditions are fulfilled:
- when in addition actAutoPucchAlloc in LNCEL_FDD  of the cell instance is set to 'false': phichDur in MPUCCH_FDD is set to 'Normal'
- maxNrSymPdcch is greater than '1'
- cellResourceSharingMode is set to 'none'.

Conditions in (3.x) are valid in addition to (1.x) if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'TDD':
(3.1) actLdPdcch can only be configured to 'true' if all of the following conditions are fulfilled:
- when in addition actAutoPucchAlloc in LNCEL_TDD  of the cell instance is set to 'false': phichDur in MPUCCH_TDD is set to 'Normal'
- maxNrSymPdcch is greater than '1'
- chBw is configured greater than '5MHz'
- actPdcchLoadGen in the LNCEL_TDD of this LNCEL instance is set to 'false'  (i.e. actLdPdcch and actPdcchLoadGen can't be configured to 'true' simultaneously)
- cellResourceSharingMode is set to 'none'.

actLiquidCell.description:
This parameter activates the feature LTE1709 'Liquid cell'.
The feature 'Liquid cell' allows to reuse the same PRBs in downlink for different UEs.

actLiquidCell can be configured to 'true' only on FSMr3 and later HW releases .

Downlink MIMO mode must be set to 'Closed Loop Mimo'. No other modes are supported.

For better performance it is recommended to activate also the feature LTE980 '4Rx IRC for 4RX Path'.

Related functions: Interference Mitigation Related parameters: CHANNEL - antlDN
CHANNEL - direction

ULCOMP - ulCoMpCellList If actLiquidCell is set to 'true' then all the following conditions must be fulfilled: 
- The related LCELL must contain 2 CHANNELGROUP instances (subcells).
> Each CHANNELGROUP instance of the related LCELL must contain 4 CHANNEL instances.
 >>  each of two of the CHANNEL instances must have identical configuration for parameter antlDN, and must have different configuration for parameter direction.
- dlMimoMode must be set to 'Closed Loop Mimo'
- dlChBw must be set to '10 MHz', '15 MHz' or '20 MHz'
- liquidCellConfigInfo must be configured
- actSuperCell must be set to ‘false’
- actCombSuperCell must be configured to 'false'
- actEicic must be set to 'false'
- prachHsFlag must be set to 'false'
- actOtdoa must be set to 'false'
- actDlIntShaping must be set to 'false'
- siWindowLen must be set to '20ms' or greater
- if actCMAS or actETWS or sib2xTransmit is set to 'true', then liquidCellConfigInfo-csiRsSubfr must be set to one of the following values: '3', '8', '18' or '38'
- if actMBMS is set to 'true', then liquidCellConfigInfo-csiRsSubfr must be set to one of the following values in all LNCEL_FDD instances with earfcnDL in LNCEL_FDD equal to mbsfnEarfcn in MBSFNSYNCAREA_FDD and dlChBw in same LNCEL_FDD equal to mbsfnDlChBw in same MBSFNSYNCAREA_FDD: '3', '8', '9', '18', '19', '38', or '39'
- actCatM must be set to 'false'
- nbIoTMode must be set to 'disabled' or 'guardband'
- actLBRTXPowerSaving must be set to 'false'
- prachConfIndex cannot have value in range (51..56)

actLiquidCell must be configured to 'false' in following conditions:
- if actCoMp is set to 'fixedULCoMp' AND the LNCEL instance belongs to an ulCoMpCellList
- if actCoMp is set to 'measBasedCoMp' if the cell is included in COMPCONF-measBasedCellConf-lnCelId
- if actUlPwrRestrScn is not set to 'none'.

Definitions used in below parameter relationships:
- P-LNCEL: the parent LNCEL instance of the CAREL instance
- S-LNCEL: the LNCEL instance referred by the CAREL instance having identical lcrId in the LNCEL instance

For definitions regarding carrier aggregation used in below parameter relationships, please, see the definitions at parameter actDLCAggr.
If actLiquidCell in a PCell is set to 'true' and actDLCAggr is set to 'true' in the parent LNBTS, actLiquidCell in all related own SCells must be also set to 'true'.
If actLiquidCell in an own SCell is set to 'true' and actDLCAggr is set to 'true' in the parent LNBTS, actLiquidCell in all related PCells must be also set to 'true'.

If (actSuperCell is set to 'false' AND actCombSuperCell is set to 'false' AND actLiquidCell is set to 'false') then there must be just 1 CHANNELGROUP instance contained in the related LCELL object.

SYNC - btsSyncMode MBMS is not yet supported, i.e. actMBMS must be set to 'false' if the supportedCellTechnology of the LNBTS instance is configured to 'TDD' or 'mixed_FDD_TDD'.

(1) If supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'FDD' or 'TDD' or 'mixed_FDD_TDD' following conditions must be fulfilled:
(1.1) actMBMS can be set to 'true' only if all following conditions are fulfilled:
- btsSyncMode is equal to 'PhaseSync'
- the LNMCE instance is created
- the M1SYNC instance is created
- at least one LNM3 instance is created.
(1.2) If actMBMS is equal to 'true' following conditions are to be fulfilled according to the supportedCellTechnology value:
(1.2.1) for supportedCellTechnology configured to 'FDD', at least one MBSFNSYNCAREA_FDD instance must be required with one MBSFN_FDD instance created
(1.2.2) for supportedCellTechnology configured to 'TDD', at least one MBSFNSYNCAREA_TDD instance must be required with one MBSFN_TDD instance created
(1.2.3) for supportedCellTechnology configured to 'mixed_FDD_TDD', at least one MBSFNSYNCAREA_FDD or MBSFNSYNCAREA_TDD instance must be required with one MBSFN_FDD or MBSFN_TDD instance created.

(2) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'FDD' following conditions must be fulfilled in addition to (1):
(2.1) actMBMS can be set to 'true' only if all following conditions are fulfilled in addition to those mentioned in (1.1):
- there is at least one LNCEL instance with earfcnDL in LNCEL_FDD of this cell equal to mbsfnEarfcn in MBSFNSYNCAREA_FDD and dlChBw in same LNCEL_FDD of this cell equal to mbsfnDlChBw in same MBSFNSYNCAREA_FDD
- in all LNCEL instances containing MBSFNCEL with earfcnDL in LNCEL_FDD of this cell equal to mbsfnEarfcn in MBSFNSYNCAREA_FDD and dlChBw in same LNCEL_FDD of this cell equal to mbsfnDlChBw in same MBSFNSYNCAREA_FDD all following conditions are fulfilled:
 + actEicic is equal to 'false'.
 + prachHsFlag is equal to 'false'.
 + cellResourceSharingMode is equal to 'none'
 + drxOnDuratT, drxRetransT and raRespWinSize must be greater than or equal to 6 if maxSyncSubfrPShare in MBSFNSYNCAREA_FDD is less than or equal to 30%.
 + drxOnDuratT, drxRetransT and raRespWinSize must be greater than or equal to 8 if maxSyncSubfrPShare in MBSFNSYNCAREA_FDD is greater than 30% AND less than or equal to 40%.
 + drxOnDuratT, drxRetransT and raRespWinSize must be greater than or equal to 10 if maxSyncSubfrPShare in MBSFNSYNCAREA_FDD is greater than 40%.
 + SIB13 must be present in sibSchedulingList-siMessageSibType
 + mbmsNeighCellConfigIntraF is configured
 + If actLteU is 'true', MBSFNSYNCAREA_FDD-mbsfnEarfcn cannot be from the unlicensed band
 + liquidCellConfigInfo-csiRsSubfr is set to either '9', '19' or '39' if actLiquidCell is equal to 'true' and actETWS and actCMAS and actOtdoa and sib2xTransmit are equal to 'false'
 + dependencies to siWindowLen are fulfilled (see parameter siWindowLen)
 + if actLiquidCell is set to 'true', liquidCellConfigInfo-csiRsSubfr must be set to one of the following values: '3', '8', '9', '18', '19', '38', or '39'
 + actMicroDtx is set to 'false'.
 + the value of actLiquidCell must be identical
 + the value of liquidCellConfigInfo-csiRsSubfr must be identical if actLiquidCell is equal to 'true'.
 + the value of csiRsConfigInfo-csiRsSubfrConf must be identical if (dlMimoMode is set to ('Closed Loop MIMO (4x2)' OR 'Closed Loop MIMO (4x4)' OR 'Closed Loop MIMO (8x2)' OR 'Closed Loop MIMO (8x4)') AND (activatedMimoTM is NOT set to 'TM4') 
 + the value of actOtdoa must be identical
 + if actOtdoa is equal to 'true' then prsConfigurationIndex must be set to a value from the same set of the following four mutually exclusive sets: [14], [151, 471, 1111, 2391], [7, 47, 87, 127], [27, 67, 107, 147]
 + the value of Sib2xTransmit must be identical
 + csiRsConfigInfo--csiRsSubfrConf is set to either '9', '19' or '39' if (dlMimoMode is set to ('Closed Loop MIMO (4x2)' OR 'Closed Loop MIMO (4x4)' OR 'Closed Loop MIMO (8x2)' OR 'Closed Loop MIMO (8x4)') AND (activatedMimoTM is NOT set to 'TM4')
 + SIB-modPeriodCoeff must be the same
 + LNCEL-defPagCyc must be the same
 + if actCatM is set to 'true',dlsDciCch must be set to 'DCI format 1A'.
 + if actCatM is set to 'true' and (numCELevelCatM is set to '3') and mpdcchMaxNumRepRaModeBCatM is set to '256', then catMCELevel2-mpdcchRepLevRaCatM must not be set to 'n4'.
 + if actCatM is set to 'true' and (numCELevelCatM is set to '4') and mpdcchMaxNumRepRaModeBCatM is set to '256', then catMCELevel2-mpdcchRepLevRaCatM and catMCELevel3-mpdcchRepLevRaCatM must not be set to 'n4'.
- for all MBSFNSYNCAREA_FDD instances which are referenced via earfcnDL in LNCEL_FDD  and dlChBw in same LNCEL_FDD instance equal to mbsfnEarfcn and mbsfnDlChBw by at least one LNCEL containing MBSFNCEL the following conditions must be fulfilled:
 + if (parent) MBSFNSYNCAREA_FDD-mbsfnOverlapAllowed is equal to 'true' then  MBSFNSYNCAREA_FDD-maxSyncSubfrPShare must be greater than or equal to (child) MBSFN_FDD-maxSubfrPShare.
 + if (parent) MBSFNSYNCAREA_FDD-mbsfnOverlapAllowed is equal to 'false' then MBSFNSYNCAREA_FDD-maxSyncSubfrPShare must be greater than or equal to the sum of all associated (child) MBSFN_FDD-maxSubfrPShare.
(2.2) If actMBMS is 'true' then the maximum cell power reduction (dlCellPwrRed) additionally depends on the configured cellPwrRedForMBMS.
(2.3) If actMBMS is 'true', for each LNCEL containing MBSFNCEL, where earfcnDL is equal to MBSFNSYNCAREA-mbsfnEarfcn and LNCEL-dlChBw equal to MBSFNSYNCAREA-mbsfnDlChBw, SIB-modPeriodCoeff must be the same.
(2.4) If actMBMS is 'true', for each LNCEL containing MBSFNCEL, where earfcnDL is equal to MBSFNSYNCAREA-mbsfnEarfcn and LNCEL-dlChBw equal to MBSFNSYNCAREA-mbsfnDlChBw, defPagCyc must be the same.
(2.5) If actMBMS is 'true', mbsfnEarfcn must not belong to an unlicensed band as defined in parameter relationships of parameter actUnlicensedAcc.
(2.6) If actMBMS is equal to 'true' all LNCEL instances with earfcnDL in LNCEL_FDD of this cell equal to mbsfnEarfcn in MBSFNSYNCAREA_FDD and dlChBw in same LNCEL_FDD of this cell equal to mbsfnDlChBw in same MBSFNSYNCAREA_FDD cannot be used for UMBSFN.

The following checks are NOT YET APPLICABLE because MBMS is not supported for TDD cells, i.e. actMBMS can be only set to 'false' if the supportedCellTechnology of the LNBTS instance is configured to 'TDD' or 'mixed_FDD_TDD'. 
(3) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'TDD' following conditions must be fulfilled in addition to (1):
Conditions in (3.x) are valid in addition to (1.x) if the supportedCellTechnology of the LNBTS instance is configured to 'TDD' or 'mixed_FDD_TDD' for all cells with cellTechnology set to 'TDD':
(3.1) actMBMS can be set to 'true' only if all following conditions are fulfilled in addition to those mentioned in (1.1):
- there is at least one LNCEL instance with earfcn is equal to mbsfnEarfcn in MBSFNSYNCAREA_TDD and chBw in same LNCEL_TDD of this cell is equal to mbsfnDlChBw in same MBSFNSYNCAREA_TDD.
- in all LNCEL instances where earfcn is equal to mbsfnEarfcn in MBSFNSYNCAREA_TDD and chBw in same LNCEL_TDD of this cell is equal to mbsfnDlChBw in same MBSFNSYNCAREA_TDD all following conditions are fulfilled:
 + actEicic is equal to 'false'
 + prachHsFlag is equal to 'false'.
 + cellResourceSharingMode is equal to 'none'
 + drxProfile2/drxProfile6/drxSmartProfile3-drxOnDuratT is equal to or greater than '6' if maxSyncSubfrPShare in MBSFNSYNCAREA_TDD is less than or equal to 18.750%
 + drxProfile2/drxProfile6/drxSmartProfile3-drxOnDuratT is equal to or greater than '10' if maxSyncSubfrPShare in MBSFNSYNCAREA_TDD is greater than 18.750%
 + drxProfile3-drxOnDuratT is equal to or greater than or '6' if maxSyncSubfrPShare is less than or equal to 9.375%
 + drxProfile3-drxOnDuratT is equal to or greater than '10' if maxSyncSubfrPShare is greater than 9.375% 
 + drxRetransT is greater than or equal to '4'.
 + SIB13 is present in sibSchedulingList-siMessageSibType
 + mbmsNeighCellConfigIntraF is configured
 + the value of actOtdoa must be identical
 + if actOtdoa is equal to 'true' then prsNumDlFrames must be configured to '1' AND prsConfigurationIndex is set to either '158', '478', '1118' or '2398' AND MBSFNSYNCAREA_TDD-maxSyncSubfrPShare is set to 34.375%
 + if maxSyncSubfrPShare is greater than or equal to 37.500% then actOtdoa is equal to 'false'.
 + tddFrameConf is equal to '2'
 + csiRsSubfrConf is equal to '8', '18', '28', '38', '48', '58', '68', '78', '88', '98', '108', '118', '128', '138' or '148'
 + raRespWinSize is greater than or equal to 6 if maxSyncSubfrPShare in MBSFNSYNCAREA_TDD is less than or equal to 18.750%
 + raRespWinSize is greater than or equal to '10' if maxSyncSubfrPShare in MBSFNSYNCAREA_TDD is greater than 18.750% 
 + dependencies to siWindowLen are fulfilled (see parameter siWindowLen)
 + csiRsSubfrConf is set to either '8', '28', '48', '68', '88', '108', '128' or '148' if (actETWS or actCMAS or sib2xTransmit) is equal to 'true' 
- for all MBSFNSYNCAREA_TDD instances which are referenced via earfcn in LNCEL_TDD and chBw in same LNCEL_TDD instance equal to mbsfnEarfcn and mbsfnDlChBw by at least one LNCEL containing MBSFNCEL the following conditions must be fulfilled:
 + if (parent) MBSFNSYNCAREA_TDD-mbsfnOverlapAllowed is equal to 'true' then MBSFNSYNCAREA_TDD-maxSyncSubfrPShare must be greater than or equal to (child) MBSFN_TDD-maxSubfrPShare.
 + if (parent) MBSFNSYNCAREA_TDD-mbsfnOverlapAllowed is equal to 'false' then MBSFNSYNCAREA_TDD-maxSyncSubfrPShare must be greater than or equal to the sum of all associated (child) MBSFN_TDD-maxSubfrPShare
 + actMicroDtx is set to 'false'
(3.2) If actMBMS is set to 'true', for each LNCEL containing MBSFNCEL, where LNCEL_TDD-earfcn equal to MBSFNSYNCAREA_TDD-mbsfnEarfcn and LNCEL_TDD-chBw equal to MBSFNSYNCAREA_TDD-mbsfnDlChBw all following conditions must be fulfilled:
- SIB-modPeriodCoeff must be the same
- LNCEL-defPagCyc must be the same
- if actMBMS is set to 'false' then actMBMSPS must be set to 'false'.
(3.3) If actMMimo is 'true', then actMBMS must be configured to 'false'.

actMMimo.description: This parameter activates Massive MIMO with AAS mMIMO capable antenna system.
actMMimo.notes:
Related functions: Beamforming (Antenna configuration) Related parameters: CHANNEL - direction
CHANNEL - resourceDN
LNBTS - actCoMp
LNBTS - actLBPowerSaving
LNBTS - actLBRTXPowerSaving
LNBTS - actMBMS
LNBTS_TDD - actCsBIA
LNBTS_TDD - actDlIntShaping
LNCEL - actEicic
LNCEL - actOtdoa
LNCEL_TDD - actDlMuMimo
LNCEL_TDD - actRIAvoidance
LNCEL_TDD - actSFN
LNCEL_TDD - actSuperCell
LNCEL_TDD - actUlSps
LNCEL_TDD - activatedMimoTM
LNCEL_TDD - chBw
LNCEL_TDD - dlMimoMode
LNCEL_TDD - mMimoAntArrayMode
LNCEL_TDD - mMimoSectorBFProfName
LNCEL_TDD - prachConfIndex
LNCEL_TDD - prachHsFlag
LNCEL_TDD - tddFrameConf
LNCEL_TDD - tddSpecSubfConf
LNCEL_TDD - ulCombinationMode actMMimo must be set to 'true' if the referenced RF module is 'massive MIMO' capable
actMMimo must be set to 'false' if the referenced RF module is NOT 'massive MIMO' capable

If actMMimo is set to 'true' all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- 64 or 32 LCELL/CHANNELGROUP/CHANNEL instances with direction value set to 'RX' must exist
- 64 or 32 LCELL/CHANNELGROUP/CHANNEL instances with direction value set to 'TX' must exist
- mMimoSectorBFProfName in same LNCEL_TDD must be configured
- mMimoAntArrayMode in same LNCEL_TDD must be configured
- actLBPowerSaving must be configured to 'false'
- actLBRTXPowerSaving must be configured to 'false'
- actMBMS must be configured to 'false'
- actCoMp must be configured to 'disabled'
- actEicic must be configured to 'false'
- actSuperCell must be configured to 'false'
- actSFN must be configured to 'false'
- actUlSps must be configured to 'false'
- chBw must be configured to '20 MHz' or '10 MHz'
- if actDlMuMimo is set to 'false', dlMimoMode is allowed to be configured to 'Dynamic Open Loop MIMO', 'Single Stream Beamforming' or 'Dual Stream Beamforming' or 'Closed Loop MIMO (8x2)' or 'Closed Loop MIMO (8x4)'.
- if actDlMuMimo is set to 'true', dlMimoMode is allowed to be configured to 'Single Stream Beamforming' or 'Dual Stream Beamforming' or 'Closed Loop MIMO (8x2)' or 'Closed Loop MIMO (8x4)'.
- prachConfIndex must be configured to the values 3...7
- prachHsFlag must be configured to 'false'
- ulCombinationMode must be configured to 'IRC'
- tddFrameConf is set to '1' (sa1) and tddSpecSubfConf is set to '7' (ssp7) OR 
- tddFrameConf is set to '2' (sa2) and (tddSpecSubfConf is set to '5' (ssp5), '6' (ssp6), or '7' (ssp7))
- actOtdoa must be configured to 'false'
- actDlIntShaping must be configured to 'false'
- actCsBIA must be configured to 'false'
- actRIAvoidance must be set to 'false'

For any two or more cells in the eNB, if (actMMimo is 'true') AND (resourceDN is the same for all channels under the same LCELL instance), the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- The value of mMimoAntArrayMode must be identical
- The value of tddFrameConf must be identical
- The value of tddSpecSubfConf must be identical
actMMimo.relatedFeatures:
•  LTE2666 Massive MIMO (Standard)  
•  LTE3463 DL MU-MIMO for massive MIMO (Standard)  
•  LTE3464 UL MU-MIMO for massive MIMO (Standard)  
•  LTE3621 Single Frequency Network for 2 Pipe Scenario (Standard)  
•  LTE3690 TDD downlink carrier aggregation with massive MIMO (Standard)  
•  LTE4566 TDD Massive MIMO 10Mhz Support (Standard)  
•  LTE4573 TDD massive MIMO DL 256QAM and UL64QAM (Standard)  
•  LTE4655 TDD 32TRX massive MIMO (Standard)
actMMimo.source: Nokia SBTS 18A official SingleRAN AirScale parameter dictionary

actMicroDtx.description:
This parameter activates the feature 'eNode B power saving - Micro DTX'.
It is possible to reduce power consumption by having the power amplifiers associated with a cell shut down during OFDM symbol times that are not used for any DL transmission.
actMicroDtx.fullName: Activate eNode B power saving - Micro DTX
actMicroDtx.notes:
Related functions: BTS Site or Cell Operability Related parameters: CHANNEL - antlDN
CHANNEL - direction
FEATCADM - rfSharingEnabled
LNBTS - actCMAS
LNBTS - actETWS
LNBTS - actMBMS
LNCEL - actEicic
LNCEL - actOtdoa
LNCEL - cellResourceSharingMode
LNCEL - cellTechnology
LNCEL - cellType
LNCEL - dlInterferenceEnable
LNCEL - mdtxAggressiveness
LNCEL - mdtxPdcchSymb
LNCEL - nbIoTMode
LNCEL - raContResoT
LNCEL - raRespWinSize
LNCEL_FDD - actMMimo
LNCEL_FDD - earfcnDL
LNCEL_FDD - prsConfigurationIndex
LNCEL_TDD - csiRsConfigInfo-csiRsSubfrConf
LNCEL_TDD - earfcn
LNCEL_TDD - prsConfigurationIndex
LNCEL_TDD - tddFrameConf
MBSFNSYNCAREA_FDD - mbsfnDlChBw
MBSFNSYNCAREA_FDD - mbsfnEarfcn
MBSFNSYNCAREA_TDD - mbsfnDlChBw
MBSFNSYNCAREA_TDD - mbsfnEarfcn
RMOD - cpriARfSharing
SIB - siWindowLen
SIB - sib2xTransmit Conditions in (1.x) are valid if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'FDD' or 'TDD':
(1.1) If actMicroDtx is set to true, following conditions must be fulfilled:
- mdtxAggressiveness must be configured
- mdtxPdcchSymb must be configured

Conditions in (2.x) are valid in addition to (1.x) if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'FDD':
(2.1) actMicroDtx can only be set to 'true' if all of the following conditions are fulfilled:
- siWindowLen is set to '10ms', '20ms' or '40ms'
- cellResourceSharingMode is set to 'none'
- actMMimo in same LNCEL_FDD instance is 'false'
- if ((rfSharingEnabled is set to 'false') OR (none of the RMODs servicing the LNCEL in TX direction is present in a CABLINK as the secondEndpointDN where the firstEndpointDN references an SMOD_EXT instance)) AND (all RMODs servicing the LNCEL in TX direction have cpriARfSharing set to STANDALONE or not configured)
- none of the antenna lines serving this LNCEL in TX direction (CHANNEL-antlDN with parameter CHANNEL-direction set to 'TX') are utilized by other LNCEL instances
- dlInterferenceEnable is set to 'false'
- raRespWinSize must be set to '8' or higher
- raContResoT must be set to '16 ms' or higher
- (actEicic is set to 'false') OR (actEicic is set to 'true' AND cellType is set to 'large')
- if actMBMS is set to 'true' for the eNB, actMicroDtx can only be set to 'true' in LNCEL instances with earfcnDL in LNCEL_FDD of this cell not equal to mbsfnEarfcn in MBSFNSYNCAREA_FDD and dlChBw in same LNCEL_FDD of this cell not equal to mbsfnDlChBw in same MBSFNSYNCAREA_FDD
- CHANNEL instances of the related LCELL contain parameter direction set to 'TX' from at least one radio module supporting micro-DTX
- if actOtdoa is set to 'true', actMicroDtx can only be set to 'true' if prsConfigurationIndex is set to a value < 150, or is set to one of the following values: '151', '471', '1111' or '2391'
- nbIoTMode must be set to 'disabled'. 
- all of the antenna lines of the radio serving this LNCEL instance are only configured to LTE (all CHANNEL-antlDN for the related RMOD are under LCELL hierarchy)

Conditions in (3.x) are valid in addition to (1.x) if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'TDD':
(3.1) actMicroDtx can only be set to 'true' if all of the following conditions are fulfilled:
- sib2xTransmit is set to 'false'
- actETWS is set to 'false'
- actCMAS is set to 'false'
- siWindowLen is set to '10ms', '20ms' or '40ms'
- cellType is set to 'large'
- cellResourceSharingMode is set to 'none'
none of the antenna lines serving this LNCEL in TX direction (CHANNEL-antlDN with parameter CHANNEL-direction set to 'TX') are utilized by other LNCEL instances
- dlInterferenceEnable is set to 'false'
- raRespWinSize is set to '10' or higher
- raContResoT is set to '16 ms' or higher
- if actMBMS is set to 'true' for the eNB, actMicroDtx can be set to 'true' only in LNCEL instances with earfcn in LNCEL_TDD not equal to mbsfnEarfcn in MBSFNSYNCAREA_TDD and chBw in same LNCEL_TDD of this cell not equal to mbsfnDlChBw in same MBSFNSYNCAREA_TDD
- the related LCELL uses TX resources from at least one radio module supporting micro-DTX, i.e. in the related LCELL there are contained CHANNEL instances with parameter direction set to 'TX', where at least one parameter antlDN refers to an ANTL instance contained in a RMOD instance that supports micro-DTX.
(3.2) If actMicroDtx is set to true, following conditions must be fulfilled:
- if actOtdoa is set to 'true' and tddFrameConf is '1' then prsConfigurationIndex must be set to a value of 159, 479, 1119 or 2399
- if actOtdoa is set to 'true' and tddFrameConf is '2' then prsConfigurationIndex must be set to a value of 158, 478, 1118 or 2398
- if tddFrameConf is set to ’1’ then csiRsSubfrConf must be set to one of the following values: 9, 19, 29, 39, 49, 59, 69, 79, 89, 99, 109, 119, 129, 139 or 149
- if tddFrameConf is set to ’2’ then csiRsSubfrConf must be set to one of the following values: 8, 18, 28, 38, 48, 58, 68, 78, 88, 98, 108, 118, 128, 138 or 148.

If 64QAM is selected this includes also 16QAM and QPSK
If 256QAM is selected this includes also 64QAM, 16QAM and QPSK.
Please note that the LNCEL parameter actDl256QamChQualEst must be configured if 256QAM is selected. It must be either set to ‘true or ‘false’ dependent if quality estimation shall be activated or not.
actModulationSchemeDl.notes:
Related functions: Scheduler (Downlink) Related parameters: LNCEL - actDl256QamChQualEst
LNCEL - cellTechnology
LNCEL - dlInterferenceModulation
LNCEL - iniMcsDl
LNCEL_TDD - actTmSwitch
LNCEL_TDD - tmSwitchProfileId
TMSWPR - tmSwitchThresholdDef256Qam Conditions in (1.x) are valid if the cellTechnology of the parent LNCEL instance is configured to 'FDD' or 'TDD':
(1.1) If actModulationSchemeDl is set to 'QPSK' all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- the maximum value for iniMcsDl is 9
- actDl256QamChQualEst must be either not configured or set to 'false'.
- dlInterferenceModulation must be set to 'QPSK' for interference generation.
(1.2) If actModulationSchemeDl is set to '16QAM' all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- the maximum value for iniMcsDl is 16
- actDl256QamChQualEst must be either not configured or set to 'false'
- dlInterferenceModulation is not allowed to be set to '64QAM' for interference generation.
(1.3) If actModulationSchemeDl is set to '64QAM' all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- actDl256QamChQualEst must be either not configured or set to 'false'
(1.4) If actModulationSchemeDl is set to '256QAM' all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- actDl256QamChQualEst must be configured.

Conditions in (2.x) are valid in addition to (1.x) if the cellTechnology of the parent LNCEL instance is configured to 'TDD':
(2.1) If actModulationSchemeDl is set to '256QAM' AND actTmSwitch in the LNCEL_TDD of this LNCEL is set to 'true' following in addition to (1.4) must be fulfilled:
- a TMSWPR instance must be created (referred via tmSwitchProfileId in LNCEL_TDD) and tmSwitchThresholdDef256Qam must be configured in the assigned profile.

actModulationSchemeUL.description:
The parameter selects the highest order modulation scheme which is supported in the cell for UL transmissions .

Depending on the setting of actModulationSchemeUl the supported MCS range is determined for the UEs in the cell.

- QPSK: supported MCS range is from MCS0 to MCS10 for all UEs
- 16QAM: supported MCS range is from MCS0 to MCS20 for all UEs
- 16QAMHighMCS: supported MCS range is from MCS0 to MCS24 for all UEs
- 64QAM: supported MCS range is from MCS0 to MCS28 for UEs with 64QAM capability and from MCS0 to MCS20 for UEs without 64QAM capability
- 64QAMand16QAMHighMCS: supported MCS range is from MCS0 to MCS28 for UEs with 64QAM capability and from MCS0 to MCS24 for UEs without 64QAM capability.
actModulationSchemeUL.notes:
Related functions: Scheduler (Uplink) Related parameters: LNCEL - cellTechnology
LNCEL - iniMcsUl Conditions in (1.x) are valid if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'FDD':
(1.1) Depending on the setting of actModulationSchemeUL the supported range of iniMcsUl is determined:
- if actModulationSchemeUL is set to QPSK, iniMcsUl must be within 0 - 10
- if actModulationSchemeUL is set to 16QAM, iniMcsUl must be within 0 - 20 
- if actModulationSchemeUL is set to 16QAMHighMCS, iniMcsUl must be within 0 - 24

Conditions in (2.x) are valid if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'TDD':
(2.1) iniMcsUl (ULAMC_INI_MCS) can be located only between MCS0 and MCS20, MCS21 to MCS24 shall not be applicable even if actModulationSchemeUL = "16QAMHighMCS".

actMultBearers.description: This parameter activates the support of multiple EPS Bearers.
actMultBearers.notes:
Related functions: Bearer Management (Miscellaneous) Related parameters: LNBTS - actEnhAcAndGbrServices
LNBTS - supportedCellTechnology
LNBTS_FDD - actConvVoice

MPUCCH_TDD - maxNumRrcEmergency (1) If supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'FDD' or 'TDD' or 'mixed_FDD_TDD' following conditions must be fulfilled:
(1.1) actMultBearers can only be set to 'false' if actEnhAcAndGbrServices is set to 'false'.
(1.1.1) Only if actMultBearers is set to 'true', actEnhAcAndGbrServices can be set to 'true'.

(2) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'FDD' following conditions must be fulfilled in addition to (1):
(2.1) If actMultBearers is set to 'false', actConvVoice in LNBTS_FDD must be set to 'false'.
All of the following conditions in (2.2.x) are applicable in MPUCCH_FDD of the FDD-cell only if actAutoPucchAlloc is set to 'false'
(2.2) If actMultBearers is set to 'true' following condition need to be fulfilled for maxNumRrc:
- min(6*(maxNumRrc+ max(addAUeRrHo, addAUeTcHo)), 4500) >= maxNumActDrb + max(addNumDrbRadioReasHo, addNumDrbTimeCriticalHo)
(2.2.1) if in addition actIMSEmerSessR9 is set to 'true' for maxNumRrcEmergency following condition must be fulfilled:
if actEnhAcAndGbrServices is set to 'false' 
- min(6*maxNumRrcEmergency, 4500) >= maxNumActDrb + max(4*addEmergencySessions, addNumDrbRadioReasHo, addNumDrbTimeCriticalHo)
(2.2.1.1) if in addition actEnhAcAndGbrServices is set to 'false' for maxNumRrcEmergency following condition must be fulfilled:
- maxNumRrcEmergency >= maxNumQci1Drb + max(addEmergencySessions, addNumQci1DrbRadioReasHo, addNumQci1DrbTimeCriticalHo)

(3) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'TDD' following conditions must be fulfilled in addition to (1):
(3.1) If actMultBearers is set to 'false' all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- actConvVoice in LNBTS_TDD must be configured to 'false'
- actVoLteCallSteering in LNBTS_TDD must be configured to 'false'.
All of the following conditions in (3.2.x) are applicable in MPUCCH_TDD of the TDD-cell only if actAutoPucchAlloc is set to 'false'
(3.2) If actMultBearers is set to 'true' following condition need to be fulfilled for maxNumRrc:
- min(6*(maxNumRrc+ max(addAUeRrHo, addAUeTcHo)), 4200) >= maxNumActDrb + max(addNumDrbRadioReasHo, addNumDrbTimeCriticalHo)
(3.2.1) if in addition actIMSEmerSessR9 is set to 'true' for maxNumRrcEmergency following condition must be fulfilled:
if actEnhAcAndGbrServices is set to 'false' 
- min(6*maxNumRrcEmergency, 4500) >= maxNumActDrb + max(4*addEmergencySessions, addNumDrbRadioReasHo, addNumDrbTimeCriticalHo)
(3.2.1.1) if in addition actEnhAcAndGbrServices is set to 'false' for maxNumRrcEmergency following condition must be fulfilled:
- maxNumRrcEmergency >= maxNumQci1Drb + max(addEmergencySessions, addNumQci1DrbRadioReasHo, addNumQci1DrbTimeCriticalHo)

(4) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'mixed_FDD_TDD' conditions of (2) AND (3) must be fulfilled in addition to (1).

actMultipleCarrier.description:
This parameter activates multiple carrier operation.
When the parameter is set to value "false", the eNB is working in single carrier operation, when set to one of the other values, it is working in multi carrier operation. The parameter need to be configured always to the highest number of carriers transmitted over the same antenna line in the eNB.

An FDD eNB supports up to 6 carrier configurations at the same antenna line.
A TDD eNB supports up to 4 carrier configurations at the same antenna line.

eNB will dynamically decide dependent on the current and newly required DSP deployment if eNB restart or dropping of all cells is needed.
actMultipleCarrier.notes:
Related functions: BTS Site or Cell Configuration Related parameters: CHANNEL - antlDN
CHANNEL - direction
LNBTS - supportedCellTechnology
LNCEL - cellTechnology
LNCEL_FDD - earfcnDL
LNCEL_TDD - tddFrameConf
LNCEL_TDD - tddSpecSubfConf (1) If supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'FDD' or 'TDD' or 'mixed_FDD_TDD' following conditions must be fulfilled:
(1.1) LCELL-CHANNELGROUP-CHANNEL configuration:
In the following conditions, cells having LNCEL_FDD-earfcnDL configured in an unlicensed band are excluded. 
(1.1.1) If actMultipleCarrier parameter value is 'false' just a single LCELL can be assigned per antenna line, i.e. there cannot be several LCELLs having identical configuration in parameter CHANNEL-antlDN with parameter CHANNEL-direction set to 'TX'.
(1.1.2) If actMultipleCarrier parameter value is '2_carrierOperation' up to two LCELL can share the same antenna line, i.e. have identical configuration in parameter CHANNEL-antlDN with parameter CHANNEL-direction set to 'TX'.
(1.1.3) If actMultipleCarrier parameter value is '3_carrierOperation' up to three LCELL can share the same antenna line, i.e. have identical configuration in parameter CHANNEL-antlDN with parameter CHANNEL-direction set to 'TX'.
(1.1.4) If actMultipleCarrier parameter value is '4_carrierOperation' up to four LCELL can share the same antenna line, i.e. have identical configuration in parameter CHANNEL-antlDN with parameter CHANNEL-direction set to 'TX'.
(1.1.5) If actMultipleCarrier parameter value is '5_carrierOperation' up to five LCELL can share the same antenna line, i.e. have identical configuration in parameter CHANNEL-antlDN with parameter CHANNEL-direction set to 'TX'.
(1.1.6) If actMultipleCarrier parameter value is '6_carrierOperation' up to six LCELL can share the same antenna line, i.e. have identical configuration in parameter CHANNEL-antlDN with parameter CHANNEL-direction set to 'TX'.

(2) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'TDD' following conditions must be fulfilled in addition to (1):
(2.1) actMultipleCarrier can just be configured to value 'false', '2_carrierOperation' or '3_carrierOperation' or '4_carrierOperation'.
(2.2) If actMultipleCarrier is not set to 'false', all carrier sharing the same antenna for transmission must have configured same tddFrameConf and tddSpecSubfConf in cells with cellTechnology set to 'TDD'.

(3) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'mixed_FDD_TDD' conditions of (1) AND (2) must be fulfilled.

actMultipleDynamicIP.description:
This parameter  activates the support for dynamic assignment of IP addresses for multiple tunnels in case of public backhaul scenario. Both IPv6 or IPv4 inner IP addresses obtained for LTE M/C/U/S-planes through IPv4 IPSec tunnels are supported.
The default value is "false".
When this feature is activated the following IP addresses should be set to 0.0.0.0: IPNO-cPlaneIpAddress, IPNO-mPlaneIpAddress, IPNO-sPlaneIpAddress, IPNO-uPlaneIpAddress, IEIF-localIpAddr, IEIF-NetMask, IPRT-staticRoutes::gateway, IPSECC-securityPolicies::localTunnelEndpoint. Moreover, if operator creates VLAN (IVIF) object, then the operator should set the vlanId to 0 and the following IP addresses to 0.0.0.0: IEIF/IVIF-localIpAddr, IEIF/IVIF-netmask (the eNB shall send CCN to iOMS/NetAct to update the values for the above attributes).

MRBTS/LNBTS/FTM/IPSECC - securityPolicies-localTunnelEndpoint: 1. If actMultipleDynamicIP is set 'true', then the following rules must be fulfilled:
1.1 actDynamicIP must be set to 'false'.
1.2 actACNonOpBackhaul must be set to 'true'.
1.3 if additionally ipSecStatus is set to 'PROTECT' for the securityPolicies then:
 ikeIdentityIndex must be set and be unique among these securityPolicies.
1.4 dynamicIpCfg structure must exist.
1.5 actDualUPlaneIpAddress must be set to FALSE.
1.6 actSeparationRanSharing must be set to FALSE.
1.7 ikeConfigRequest cannot be set to "NO".
1.8 ipSecEnabled must be set to 'true'.
1.9 If parameters from dynamicIpCfg are set to non-empty ikeIdentityIndex (value in range \{1..9\}), then securityPolicies with chosen ikeIdentityIndex must exist.
1.10 If cPlaneIpDynCfg, cPlaneIpSecDynCfg, uPlaneIpDynCfg is set to value in range \{1..9\}, then inner IP address of the pointed securityPolicies must be configured as IPv4. 
1.11 If cPlaneIpv6DynCfg, cPlaneIpv6SecDynCfg, uPlaneIpv6DynCfg is set to value in range \{1..9\}, then inner IP address of the pointed securityPolicies must be configured as IPv6. 
1.12 If mPlaneIpDynCfg is set to value in range \{1..9\}, then the following rules must be fulfilled:
1.12.1 If additionally actIPv6Mplane is set to 'false', then inner IP address of the pointed securityPolicies must be configured as IPv4. 
1.12.2 If additionally actIPv6Mplane is set to 'true', then inner IP address of the pointed securityPolicies must be configured as IPv6.
1.13 If actIpv6 is set to 'false' then cPlaneIpDynCfg, uPlaneIpDynCfg are mandatory parameters.
1.14 If actIpv6 is 'true', then (uPlaneIpDynCfg and cPlaneIpDynCfg must be configured) OR (uPlaneIpv6DynCfg and cPlaneIpv6DynCfg must be configured).
1.15 btsNumberOfSubjectAltNames must be set to value greater than '0'.
1.16 range of ikeIdentityIndex enumeration shall be limited to \{1..btsNumberOfSubjectAltNames\}.
1.17 authenticationScheme must be set to 'CERTIFICATE' value..
1.18 If additionally cmpCrlIpDynCfg is set to value in range \{1..9\}, then version of inner IP address of the pointed securityPolicies must be consistent with cmpServerIpAddress.
1.19 If additionally cmpCrlIpDynCfg is set to '100:DHCP', then cmpServerIpAddress must be configured as IPv4.
1.20 If additionally cmpCrlIpDynCfg is not configured, then if cmpServerIpAddress is configured, it needs to be consistent with actIPv6Mplane:
1.20.1 If actIPv6Mplane is set to 'false', then cmpServerIpAddress must be configured as IPv4.
1.20.2 Otherwise, cmpServerIpAddress must be configured as IPv6.
1.21. sfnPort must be set to 'none'.
1.22 If additionally actIPv6Mplane is set to 'true', then mPlaneIpDynCfg value can't be set to '100:DHCP'.

actOTNRecovery.description:
Activate OTN Link Loss Self-Recovery flag
This parameter specifies the behavior of Optical Network (OTN) recovery actions. When this parameter is set to true, a 1956 fault (critical BER detected on the optical connection to Radio Module) will not trigger the BTS to reset the impacted RF modules immediately. Instead, the BTS will stay in service and attempt to re-adjust the delays within the time limit as specified in OTN Recovery Period. The radios will self-reset if readjustments failed within the time period.

When this parameter is set to false, adjustments will not occur and the BTS will reset the impacted RF modules when fault 1956 is detected.

O&M switch for activating / deactivating an additional Outer Loop Link Adaptation for PDCCH. This additional PDCCH Outer Loop Link Adaptation controls the PDCCH link adaptation CQI shift such that the PDCCH and HARQ Response Target BLER is achieved when the OLQC Target BLER is achieved.
If PDCCH OLLA is additionally based on PUSCH TX/DTX detection, PDCCH Outer Loop Link Adaptation controls the PDCCH link adaptation CQI shift such that the PDCCH target BLER and PUSCH missed detection is achieved.

actOptimizedBbUsage.description:
This parameter enables the mapping of 2TX4RX cells to optimized baseband resources

This parameter is valid for FSMr3 HW only.

This parameter applies when there are cells with following properties configured to eNB: 
∙	2TX4RX with 5MHz, 10MHz, 15MHz or 20MHz and ‘LNCEL instance ID’ (LNCEL-lnCelId) is not member of any Uplink CoMP cell list (ULCOMP-ulCoMpCellList)

If there are no corresponding cells configured in the eNB, the parameter doesn't have any impact.

If ‘actOptimizedBbUsage’ is set to 'true' and above conditions are met, corresponding cells will receive optimize baseband resource mapping. 
In all other cases, corresponding cells will receive standard baseband resource mapping. 

With  'actOptimizedBbUsage' set to 'true' it becomes possible to create configurations for 2x2 MIMO with 4Rx diversity for up to 6 cells of 5 or 10 MHz in one basic cell set or up to 3 cells of 15 or 20 MHz in one basic cell set. No additional baseband extension module FBBA or FBBC are needed. This is refered to optimized baseband resource mapping. If parameter is set to 'false', above cells are mapped to FSMF plus FBBC or FBBA, as in all previous releases. This is refered to standard baseband resource mapping.

- actHighRrc must be set to 'false'
- actCoMp can not be configured to 'measBasedCoMp' if the cell is included in COMPCONF-measBasedCellConf-lnCelId.

TOPP - actTopPhaseSynch Conditions in (1.x) are valid if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'FDD' or 'TDD':
(1.1) If actOtdoa set to 'true' all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- siWindowLen must be set appropriately depending on the individual PRS configuration. For details on appropriate values please refer to parameter siWindowLen.
- drxProfile2-drxOnDuratT must be greater than 3
- drxProfile3-drxOnDuratT must be greater than 3
- drxProfile6-drxOnDuratT must be greater than 3
- drxSmartProfile2-drxOnDuratT must be greater than 3
- drxSmartProfile3-drxOnDuratT must be greater than 3
- drxSmartProfile6-drxOnDuratT must be greater than 3
- following parameters are mandatory required: prsPowerBoost, prsConfigurationIndex, prsBandwidth, prsNumDlFrames (in the technology specific child object instance), actPrsTxDiv
(1.2) actOtdoa in at least one LNCEL instance must be configured to 'true' if actLPPaOtdoa is set to 'true'.
(1.3) If actOtdoa is set to 'true', structure otdoaProfileList must exist.

Conditions in (2.x) are valid in addition to (1.x) if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'FDD':
(2.1) If (actOtdoa set to 'true') AND (prsConfigurationIndex is > 150) then all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- if (actCMAS or actETWS or sib2xTransmit is set to 'true') AND the number of configured SIBs (i.e. the number of sets in structure sibSchedulingList + 2) is 7 or smaller, then prsConfigurationIndex must be set to one of the following values:  '151', '471', '1111' or '2391'.
- if (actCMAS or actETWS or sib2xTransmit is set to 'true') AND siWindowLen is set to '20 ms' AND the number of configured SIBs (i.e. the number of sets in structure sibSchedulingList + 2) is 8 or higher, then prsConfigurationIndex must be set to one of the following values: '471', '1111' or '2391'.
- if (actCMAS or actETWS or sib2xTransmit is set to 'true') AND siWindowLen is set to '40 ms' AND the number of configured SIBs (i.e. the number of sets in structure sibSchedulingList + 2) is 8 or higher, then prsConfigurationIndex must be set to one of the following values:  '1111' or '2391'+V54
- actMicroDtx can only be set to 'true' if LNCEL_FDD-prsConfigurationIndex is set to one of the following values:  '151', '471', '1111' or '2391'.
(2.2) actOtdoa can only be set to 'true', if btsSyncMode is set to 'PhaseSync'.
(2.3) actOtdoa must be configured to 'false' if at least one of the following conditions is fulfilled:
- actSuperCell is set to 'true'
- actLiquidCell is set to 'true'
- actDlSlimCarrier is set to 'true'
- dlChBw is set to '1.4 MHz' or '3 MHz'
- (actCatM is set to 'true') AND (numCELevelCatM is set to '3' or '4') AND (mpdcchMaxNumRepRaModeBCatM is set to '256') AND (catMCELevel2-mpdcchRepLevRaCatM  is set to 'n4').
- (actCatM is set to 'true') AND (numCELevelCatM is set to '4') AND (mpdcchMaxNumRepRaModeBCatM is set to '256') AND (catMCELevel3-mpdcchRepLevRaCatM is set to 'n4').
(2.4) if (actCMAS or actETWS or sib2xTransmit) is 'true' AND actOtdoa is set to 'true' AND prsConfigurationIndex is set < 151  and dlChBw > '5 MHz', then prsNumDlFrames must be set to 1.
(2.5) if actUnlicensedAcc is 'LAA' and earfcnDL belongs to an unlicensed band as defined at parameter actUnlicensedAcc, actOtdoa must be 'false'.

Conditions in (3.x) are valid in addition to (1.x) if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'TDD':
(3.1) actOtdoa can only be set to 'true' if 
- (syncInputType is set to '1pps/ToD from Sync Hub Master' OR '1pps/ToD from external GNSS receiver' OR 'internal GNSS receiver' OR '1pps/ToD from GNSS receiver via RRH') OR (actTopPhaseSynch is set to 'true') AND
- btsSyncMode is set to 'PhaseSync'.

(3.2) actOtdoa must be configured to 'false' if at least one of the following conditions is fulfilled:
- if actSuperCell is set to 'true'
- if actSFN is set to 'true'
(3.3) actOtdoa must be configured to 'false' if all of the following conditions are fulfilled
- dlMimoMode is set to ('Closed Loop MIMO (8x2)' or 'Closed Loop MIMO (8x4)'), AND
- tddFrameConf is set to '1' (sa1) AND
- csiRsSubfrConf is set to '4'.
(3.4) If actOtdoa is set to 'true' AND actMicroDtx is set to 'true' AND 
- tddFrameConf is set to '1', then prsConfigurationIndex shall be set to one of the following values: '159', '479', '1119' or '2399'.
- tddFrameConf is set to '2', then prsConfigurationIndex shall be set to one of the following values: '158', '478', '1118' or '2398'.
(3.4) For MBMS related dependencies see actMBMS.
(3.5) The allowed range of prsConfigurationIndex depends on sib2xTransmit, actETWS, actCMAS, siWindowLen, sibSchedulingList, actOtdoa, tddFrameConf. Please see the parameter LNCEL_TDD-prsConfigurationIndex for the detailed parameter relationship. 
(3.6) The allowed range of csiRsSubfrConf depends on sib2xTransmit, actETWS, actCMAS, actOtdoa, tddFrameConf, actEicic, tddSpecSubfConf, cellType and eIcicMaxMutePattern. Please see the parameter LNCEL_TDD-csiRsConfigInfo-csiRsSubfrConf for the detailed parameter relationship.
(3.7) If LNCEL-actOtdoa is set to 'true', CLOCK_TDD-dualModeSyncSlave must be set to 'dual mode disabled'
(3.8) If actOtdoa is 'true', actMMimo must be configured to 'false’.

Conditions in (4.x) are valid in addition to (1.x) if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'NB-IoT-FDD':
(4.1) actOtdoa must be configured to 'false'

This parameter activates the feature 'ARP based partial admission control for handover'.
If the feature is activated Target eNodeB will perform ARP based partial admission control for incoming handover due to radio reasons and service based handover for emergency services. actPcellSwap.description: This parameter activates the feature 'PCell Swap' for the Flexi Macro FDD and TDD eNBs.
actPcellSwap.notes:
Related functions: Carrier Aggregation Related parameters: LNBTS - actDLCAggr
LNBTS - actIfHo
LNBTS - actInterEnbDLCAggr
LNBTS - supportedCellTechnology
LNCEL - cellTechnology
LNCEL - numCaUeThreshold
LNCEL - pcellSwapConfig
LNCEL_FDD - maxNumCaConfUe
LNCEL_TDD - maxNumCaConfUe For definitions regarding carrier aggregation used in below parameter relationships, please, see the definitions at parameter actDLCAggr.

(1) If supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'FDD' or 'TDD' or 'mixed_FDD_TDD' following conditions must be fulfilled:
(1.1) if actPcellSwap is 'true' then all following conditions must be fulfilled:
- actDLCAggr must be 'true'
- actIfHo must be 'enabled'
- loadSettings must be configured in all instances of LNCEL with cellTechnology equal to ('FDD' or 'TDD') of the LNBTS.

(2) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'FDD' following conditions must be fulfilled in addition to (1):
(2.1) Following conditions need to be fulfilled, if a cell with cellTechnology set to 'FDD' is configured as a PCell:
- structure pcellSwapConfig must be configured for each cell instance
> where pcellSwapConfig-numCaUeThreshold must be smaller than or equal to maxNumCaConfUe in LNCEL_FDD.

(3) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'TDD' following conditions must be fulfilled in addition to (1):
(3.1) Following conditions need to be fulfilled, if a cell with cellTechnology set to 'TDD' is configured as a PCell:
- structure pcellSwapConfig must be configured for each cell instance
> where pcellSwapConfig-numCaUeThreshold must be smaller than or equal to maxNumCaConfUe in LNCEL_TDD.

(4) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'mixed_FDD_TDD' conditions of (2) AND (3) must be fulfilled in addition to (1).
actPcellSwap.relatedFeatures:
•  LTE2275 PCell swap (Standard)  
•  LTE3296 Harmonized Object Model for SRAN and LTE (Standard)

actProSeComm.description: This parameter activates ProSe sidelink communication for Public Safety.
actProSeComm.notes:
Related functions: PHY/MAC Configuration (Sidelink) Related parameters: LNBTS - actLteNrDualConnectivity
LNBTS - actULCAggr
LNCEL - actEicic
LNCEL - cellResourceSharingMode
LNCEL - earfcUL
LNCEL_FDD - actCatM
LNCEL_FDD - actUlMultiCluster
LNCEL_FDD - srsActivation
LNCEL_FDD - ulChBw
PSGRP - lbpsCellList-lbpsCellSOOrder
PSGRP - lbpsCellList-lnCelId
PSGRP - lbpsLastCellSOEnabled
SLCOMMPROF - slCommProfId
SLCOMMPROF - slEarfcnUL
SLCOMMPROF - slUlChBw
SLCOMMRES - dataTFResConfigPrbEnd
SLCOMMRES - dataTFResConfigPrbNum
SLCOMMRES - dataTFResConfigPrbStart
SLCOMMRES - scTFResConfigPrbEnd
SLCOMMRES - scTFResConfigPrbNum
SLCOMMRES - scTFResConfigPrbStart
SLCOMMRES - slCommResId
SLCOMMSYNC - slCommSyncId
SLCOMMTX - slCommTxId
SLMEAS - slMeasId
SYNC - btsSyncMode If actProSeComm is set to 'true' then all following conditions must be fulfilled:
- At least one SLCOMMPROF instance must exist 
- At least SLCOMMRES instance 0 and one SLCOMMSYNC instance must exist subordinate to each SLCOMMPROF instance
- one SLCOMMTX instance must exist subordinate to the SLCOMMRES instance 0
- actULCAggr must be set to 'false'
- actLteNrDualConnectivity must be set to 'false' 
- btsSyncMode must be set to 'PhaseSync'
- in all cells with earfcnUL and ulChBw equal to slEarfcnUL and slUlChBw of a SLCOMMPROF instance all following conditions must be fulfilled:
  + cellResourceSharingMode must be set to 'none'
  + srsActivation must be set to 'false'
  + actEicic must be set to 'false'
  + actUlMultiCluster must be set to 'false'
  + actCatM must be set to 'false'
  + one SLMEAS instance must exist
  + 'SIB18' must be present in sibSchedulingList-siMessageSibType of the cell's SIB instance
  +  the conditions for ProSe sidelink configuration apply, see parameter SLCOMMRES-scTFResConfigPrbEnd, SLCOMMRES-scTFResConfigPrbNum, SLCOMMRES-scTFResConfigPrbStart, SLCOMMRES-dataTFResConfigPrbEnd, SLCOMMRES-dataTFResConfigPrbNum, SLCOMMRES-dataTFResConfigPrbStart

If actProSeComm is set to 'true' and if a LNCEL with earfcnUL and ulChBw equal to slEarfcnUL and slUlChBw of a SLCOMMPROF instance is configured in PSGRP-lbpsCellList of a PSGPR instance, i.e. it’s lnCelId is contained in this list, then lbpsCellSOOrder of this list item must be set to ‘100’ and lbpsLastCellSOEnabled of the according PSGRP instance must be set to ‘false’.

actRLFReportEval.description:
This parameter is used for enabling/disabling of the feature "UE Radio Link Failure report evaluation".
When the feature is activated the eNB will trigger the retrieval of RLF reports from UEs if it has received the rlf-InfoAvailable IE either during
- RRCConnectionSetupComplete
- RRCConnectionReestablishmentComplete
- RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete
message.

This retrieval is independent whether there is a trace session active to trace these messages or not.

Furthermore, RLF reports are forwarded via RLFIndication message on X2AP interface to the "RLF cell" if applicable, i.e. when the "RLF cell" is different to the current Pcell.
actRLFReportEval.notes:
Related functions: UE Control
Operability Related parameters: LNBTS - actCellTrace
MTRACE - jobType actRLFReportEval can only be set to 'true' if actCellTrace is set to 'true'.

MTRACE-jobType can be set to RLFReportsOnly, only if LNBTS-actRLFReportEval is set to true.
actRLFReportEval.relatedFeatures: •  LTE678 MDT - UE Radio Link Failure report evaluation (Standard)
actRLFReportEval.source: Nokia SBTS 18A official SingleRAN AirScale parameter dictionary

actRadioPosFlexibility.description:
This parameter indicates whether the cell should be mapped to the configured topology RMOD-conneciontList-positionInChain or to the same previously connected radio when there is an OBSAI Optical Transport Network (OTN) topology change between the System/Baseband and Radio Module. 
When actRadioPosFlexibility = false, the BTS will not re-establish the cell if the radio detected is not in the same position as defined in the RMOD-conneciontList-positionInChain.
When actRadioPosFlexibility = true, the BTS will check if an RF module matches the one used prior to the OTN change by its serial number, and based on it re-establishes a cell.

actReduceWimaxInterference.description:
Activates reduced WiMax interference.

Under scenario which have WiMAX co-existence, the parameter shall be set to true to indicate the co-existence of WiMAX.

Under scenario which has no WiMAX co-existence but has other vendor's TD-LTE in co-existence there are two options:
  - (1) to activate feature LTE1913, which requires configuring 'actReduceWimaxInterference' to 'true'  
  - (2) to activate feature LTE1388 to support SSP=4. This solution is preferred in this scenario, since it does not sacrifice the last symbol of normal uplink subframe #3 and #8.
actReduceWimaxInterference.notes:
Related functions: Scheduler (Miscellaneous) Related parameters: LNCEL_TDD - actUpPtsBlanking
LNCEL_TDD - srsActivation
LNCEL_TDD - srsBwConf
LNCEL_TDD - srsDlMimoModeDepConf-srsUePeriodicity
LNCEL_TDD - srsSubfrConf
LNCEL_TDD - tddFrameConf
LNCEL_TDD - tddSpecSubfConf (1) If actUpPtsBlanking is set to 'false' actReduceWimaxInterference must be configured to 'false'.

(2) If actReduceWimaxInterference is set to 'true', all of the following conditions must be fullfilled: 
- tddFrameConf must be configured to '1' (sa1)
- tddSpecSubfConf must be configured to '3' (ssp3), '4' (ssp4) and '7' (ssp7)
- srsActivation must be configured to 'true'
- srsSubfrConf must be configured to 'sc4'
- srsBwConf must be configured to 'bw0' or 'bw1'
- srsSimAckNack must be configured to 'true'
- srsUePeriodicity cannot be configured to '2ms'.

(3) Possible rxCalibrationConfiguration values depend on the configured value of actReduceWimaxInterference.
- for actReduceWimaxInterference set to 'true', rxCalibrationConfiguration can be activated in UL subframe 2 and 7, i.e. values 'UL_Subfr2_LastSymbol' or 'UL_Subfr7_LastSymbol', as well as to 'noRxCalibration'
- for actReduceWimaxInterference set to 'false', rxCalibrationConfiguration can be activated in GP, i.e. 'GuardPeriod' i allowed to be configured, as well as to 'noRxCalibration'
actReduceWimaxInterference.relatedFeatures:
•  LTE1650 Remove Wimax interference to TDLTE during UL subframe #3/8, TDLTE conf.1:7 (Standard)  
•  LTE1388 TDD Special Subframe Configuration 3 and 4 (Standard)  
•  LTE1913 Calibration Optimization for WiMAX Coexistence (Standard)  
•  LTE3296 Harmonized Object Model for SRAN and LTE (Standard)

actRemoteSyslogTransmission.description:
This parameter defines the operator’s selection of syslog transmission to a remote server.
The operator sets this flag to true to request the BTS to begin syslog transmission to the remote syslog server. The operator sets this flag to false to request the BTS to stop syslog transmission to the remote syslog server. The BTS also stops syslog transmission automatically after the specified Remote syslog transmission duration.

It is not useful to set this parameter for FSME based BTS as remote syslog transmission is not supported on this BTS type.
When actRemoteSyslogTransmission parameter is set to true but remoteSyslogTransmissionStatus (set by system) is false then false->true sequence is needed from NMS/BTSSM.
actRemoteSyslogTransmission.notes: Related functions: Site Management (Troubleshooting) Related parameters: TRBLCADM - remoteSyslogConfig If actRemoteSyslogTransmission is set to 'true', remoteSyslogConfig must be configured.

actRepeaterMode.description:
Defines mode of the the radio module or RIU unit.

The "actRepeaterMode" parameter value Coupled needs to be used for coupled mode cells (R type configuration), value Dedicated for dedicated mode cells (cell have resources only from RIU unit) and value None for all other cells (cells do not have resources from RIU unit).

Possible modes are None, Dedicated and Coupled.

The Coupled is supported only with Configuration Type R.

The RIU is able to work either in Dedicated or Coupled mode also in case a RF unit is chained via it.

Super cell configurations are not released in conjunction with Repeater Interface Units.


If a new LNCEL instance is created with repeater mode ‘Dedicated’ then eNB will not trigger eNB restart but only ‘cell locking’.
actRepeaterMode.notes:
Related functions: Site Management (Equipment Management) Related parameters: ANTL - repeaterDelay If actRepeaterMode is set to 'Coupled' or 'Dedicated' repeaterDelay is mandatory required.
If actRepeaterMode is set to 'none' repeaterDelay shall not be configured.

Note:
In case actRepeaterMode is set to 'Dedicated' or 'Coupled', 4 RX reception is not supported, even though four antenna lines has been defined in the CHANNEL instances contained in the CHANNELGROUP instances of the related LCELL object.

actSFN.description: This parameter activates the combination of normal cells to one Single Frequency Network cell, in which same PCI is used for all subcells of the SFN cell.
actSFN.notes:
Related functions: BTS Site or Cell Configuration Related parameters: CHANNEL - antlDN
CHANNEL - direction
LNBTS - actCoMp
LNBTS - actDLCAggr
LNBTS - actInterEnbDLCAggr
LNBTS - actLBRTXPowerSaving
LNBTS_TDD - actCbrs
LNCEL - actOtdoa
LNCEL_TDD - act1TxIn2Tx
LNCEL_TDD - actMMimo
LNCEL_TDD - actSuperCell
LNCEL_TDD - actUlMuMimo
LNCEL_TDD - dlMimoMode
LNCEL_TDD - dlSectorBeamformingMode
LNCEL_TDD - prachHsFlag
LNCEL_TDD - ripAlarmingConfig-actRIPAlarming
LNCEL_TDD - sfnCellParSet
LNCEL_TDD - srsActivation
LNCEL_TDD - superCellParSet
MTRACE - enhCellVendorSpecTracing-ripTracing
ULCOMP - ulCoMpCellList If actSFN is set to 'true' all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- the related LCELL instance can contain at minimum 4 TX and 4 RX (4 antennas) and maximum twelve TXs and twelve RXs (twelve antennas) resources, i.e. the related LCELL can contain up to 24 CHANNEL instances, having up to 12 different CHANNEL-antlDN settings
- the CHANNEL instances contained in the same CHANNELGROUP instance must be assigned to the same RMOD, i.e. parameter antlDN of the CHANNEL instances contained in the same CHANNELGROUP references ANTL instances, and all those ANTL instances must be contained in the same RMOD instance
- for a cell having subcells with two antennas (CHANNEL instances of the related LCELL have two different CHANNEL-antlDN settings) dlMimoMode must be configured to 'TXDiv', 'Dynamic Open Loop MIMO' or 'Closed Loop MIMO'
- superCellParSet must be configured
- sfnCellParSet must be configured
- act1TxIn2Tx must be configured to 'false'
- actOtdoa must be configured to 'false'
- srsActivation must be configured to 'true'
- actUlMuMimo must be set to 'false'
- actLBRTXPowerSaving must be set to 'false'
- actCbrs must be set to 'false'
- actInterEnbDLCAggr must be set to 'false'
- actMMimo must be set to 'false'
- enhCellVendorSpecTracing-ripTracing must be configured to 'false' in all MTRACE instances belonging to the LNCEL/LNCEL_TDD
- ripAlarmingConfig-actRIPAlarming must be configured to 'false' in same LNCEL_TDD instance.
- dlSectorBeamFormingMode must not be configured

A SFN cell (i.e. LNCEL where actSFN is set to 'true') can contain in the related LCELL only
- subcells with two antennas, i.e. CHANNELGROUP instances with four CHANNEL instances, each two of those CHANNEL instances have the same CHANNEL-antlDN and those two CHANNEL instances with same CHANNEL-antlDN have different CHANNEL-direction settings.

actSFN must be configured to 'false' if at least one of the following conditions is applicable:
- if other HW than AirScale is used as actSFN is supported only on AirScale
- if actCoMp is set to 'fixedULCoMp' and the LNCEL instance belongs to an ulCoMpCellList

If actSFN is set to 'false' and actSuperCell is set to 'false' then all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- there must be just 1 CHANNELGROUP instance contained in the related LCELL object.
- dlSectorBeamFormingMode must be configured if the number of CHANNEL instances in the CHANNELGROUP instance of the related LCELL, having CHANNEL-direction parameter set to 'TX', is equal to 8.
- dlSectorBeamFormingMode must not be configured if the number of CHANNEL instances in the CHANNELGROUP instance of the related LCELL, having CHANNEL-direction parameter set to 'TX', is not equal to 8.
- only if cell contains one or two RX resources (i.e. related LCELL contains one or two CHANNEL instances with CHANNEL-direction set to 'RX'), prachHsFlag can be set to 'true'.

For definitions regarding carrier aggregation used in below parameter relationships, please see the definitions at parameter actDLCAggr.
If actDLCAggr is set to 'true' in the parent LNBTS of the PCell then actSFN must have the same value in the PCell and all its related own SCells.
actSFN.relatedFeatures: •  LTE3621 Single Frequency Network for 2 Pipe Scenario (Standard)

Setting the parameter to 'true' does not indicate that the eNB itself has satellite backhaul. For indication of eNB itself having satellite backhaul its eNB ID must be included in the range of eNB IDs which is configured with the LNSENB parameter satBhEnbIdRanges.

Related functions: RAN Common Signalling Related parameters: LNBTS - actLteNrDualConnectivity
LNSENB - lnSeNBId (1) If actSatBackhaul is equal to 'true' all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- an LNSENB instance must be configured
- actLteNrDualConnectivity must be configured to 'false'

actSdlc.description:
This parameter activates the feature 'Supplemental downlink carrier'.
Note: A cell that is using a "supplemental downlink carrier" is using a carrier located in any FDD band. SDLC cells are operated on downlink only and can be used only as secondary cells (SCells) in downlink carrier aggregation. Otherwise, the cells appears as barred to UEs.
When local restrictions for uplink apply, also carriers on other frequencies might be configured for downlink operation only.

Carriers that are for use on downlink only are specified/indicated by LNBTS-sdlcFreqList.

eNB will dynamically decide dependent on the current and newly required DSP deployment if eNB restart or dropping of all cells is needed.
actSdlc.notes:
Related functions: Carrier Aggregation Related parameters: CHANNEL - direction
LNBTS_FDD - actUnlicensedAcc
LNBTS_FDD - sdlcFreqList
LNCEL_FDD - actCatM
LNCEL_FDD - earfcnDL actSdlc must be 'true', if direction in all CHANNEL instances of all CHANNELGROUP instances of the LCELL related to this LNCEL_FDD are set to 'TX'.
actSdlc must be 'false', if direction in at least one CHANNEL instance of all CHANNELGROUP instances of the LCELL related to this LNCEL_FDD is set to 'RX'.
If actCatM is set to 'true', actSdlc must be configured to 'false'.
If actUnlicensedAcc is 'LAA' and earfcnDL belongs to an unlicensed band as defined at parameter actUnlicensedAcc, actSdlc must be 'true'.

actSelMobPrf.description:
This parameter activates the features 'Selective Mobility Profiles' and - in case the LNBTS parameter moProfileSelect is set to 'plmn' or 'combined' - also 'PLMN ID and SPID selected mobility profiles'.

If this parameter is 'true':
- Mobility profiles are used to configure HO mobility, Redirection and Idle Mode Mobility reconfiguration (MOPR/MODPR, MORED/MODRED and MOIMP/MODIMP).

If this parameter is 'false':
- for HO mobility:
   - if MODPR exists, then MODPR configuration is used for HO mobility. Otherwise LNHOIF, LNHOW, LNHOG configuration is used.
   - MOPR configuration is never used.
- for Redirection and Idle Mode Mobility configuration:
   - REDRT, IRFIM, UFFIM, CDFIM and GNFL configuration are always used.
   - MORED, MODRED, MOIMP and MODIMP configurations are never used.
actSelMobPrf.notes:
Related functions: Handover Control (Miscellaneous) Related parameters: LNBTS - actIdleLB
LNBTS - actIdleLBCaAware
LNCEL - targetSelMethod
MODPR - moDPrId actSelMobPrf can be set to 'true' only if a default profile MODPR instance exists or is created in parallel with the feature activation.

If (actIdleLB is 'true') AND (actSelMobPrf is 'false'), then targetSelMethod must be configured in all instances of LNCEL.
If (actIdleLBCaAware is 'true') AND (actSelMobPrf is 'false'), then targetSelMethod must be configured in all instances of LNCEL.
actSelMobPrf.relatedFeatures:

•  LTE1905 PLMN ID and SPID selected mobility profiles (Standard)

This parameter activates/deactivates the feature "Transport Separation for RAN Sharing"
If IPsec is enabled and additional transport network is deleted or modified, then actSeparationRanSharing should be disabled first.
actSeparationRanSharing.fullName: Activation Flag  Transport Separation For RAN Sharing
actSeparationRanSharing.notes:
Related parameters: IPNO - actDualUPlaneIpAddress: If actDualUPlaneAddress is set to 'true' then actSeparationRanSharing shall be set to 'false' 
IPNO - actFastIpRerouting: 
IPNO - mainTransportNwId:  In case actSeparationRanSharing=TRUE parameter "maintransportNwId" in MOC "IPNO" must be configured 
LTAC - transportNwId:  In case actSeparationRanSharing=TRUE "transportNwId" in MOC "LTAC" must be configured 
MCAPP - mcAppId: If actSeparationRanSharing = TRUE then MCAPP MO cannot be created nor is allowed to exist.  And if MCAPP exists then actSeparationRanSharing cannot be set to value TRUE.
MRBTS/LNBTS/FTM/IPNO - actDynamicIP: If actSeparationRanSharing is set to 'true', then
- MCAPP - usedLinkLayerIf shall not be configured
- actDualUPlaneIpAddress shall be set to 'false'.

If actSeparationRanSharing = TRUE, then actDynamicIP must be set to FALSE.
