actSpatialPucchBundling.description:
This parameter activates the spatial PUCCH bundling according to 3GPP Release 13.
It applies only to UEs configured with more than 5 serving cells.

- If set to 'true', and if UE's transmission mode indicates it will transmit two code words in the cell, then binary AND operation is applied for the two HARQ-ACK bits corresponding to the first and second code words. The spatial-bundled 1 HARQ-ACK bit is concatenated with HARQ-ACK bits of other serving cells and reported to the eNB on PUCCH. For a UE configured with more than 5 serving cells and PUCCH format 3 (not configured with PUCCH format 4/5) when the UE simultaneously reports periodic CSI and HARQ-ACK and/or SR on PUCCH at the same TTI, setting the parameter to 'true' can protect total volume of UCI from exceeding 22 bits without need for downlink 'scheduling avoidance' on all SCells. Note, that if the UE's downlink air condition is not good, e.g., RSRP is low, the 'true' setting can cause the downlink throughput degradation.
- If set to 'false', and if UE's transmission mode indicates it will transmit two code words in the cell, then binary AND operation is not applied for the two HARQ-ACK bits corresponding to the first and second code words. The original 2 HARQ-ACK bits are concatenated with HARQ-ACK bits of other serving cells and reported to the eNB on PUCCH. For a UE configured with more than 5 serving cells and PUCCH format 3 (not configured with PUCCH format 4/5), the 'false' setting allows the downlink 'scheduling avoidance' on all SCells for the UE, when the UE is expected to simultaneously report periodic CSI and HARQ-ACK and/or SR on PUCCH at the same TTI and the total number of UCI bits exceeds 22. 

Please refer to Section 5.2.3 of TS 36.212 for the details of the channel coding for uplink control information on PUCCH.
Note: For time being, this parameter is reserved for testing purposes only and must not be configured in commercial networks.
actSpatialPucchBundling.notes:
Related functions: Carrier Aggregation
PRACH/PUCCH configuration Related parameters: LNBTS_FDD - actUnlicensedAcc
LNCEL - maxNumScells If (actUnlicensedAcc in the LNBTS_FDD instance associated with the parent LNBTS is 'LAA') AND (maxNumScells is greater than or equal to '5'), then actSpatialPucchBundling must be configured.

actSuperCell.description: Activates the transmission of duplicated data streams via different RRHs in downlink, and the combination of uplink signals received from different RRHs.
actSuperCell.notes:
Related functions: BTS Site or Cell Configuration Related parameters: CHANNEL - antlDN
CHANNEL - direction
CHANNELGROUP - channelGroupId
COMPCONF - measBasedCellConf-lnCelId
LNBTS - actBbPooling
LNBTS - actCoMp
LNBTS - actDLCAggr
LNBTS - actInterEnbDLCAggr
LNBTS - actLBRTXPowerSaving
LNCEL - actOtdoa
LNCEL - maxNumScells
LNCEL_TDD - act1TxIn2Tx
LNCEL_TDD - actAutoPucchAlloc
LNCEL_TDD - actMMimo
LNCEL_TDD - actRIAvoidance
LNCEL_TDD - actSFN
LNCEL_TDD - actUlMuMimo
LNCEL_TDD - dlMimoMode
LNCEL_TDD - dlSectorBeamformingMode
LNCEL_TDD - ripAlarmingConfig-actRIPAlarming
LNCEL_TDD - srsActivation
LNCEL_TDD - superCellParSet
MTRACE - ripTracing
ULCOMP - ulCoMpCellList If actSuperCell is set to 'false' and actSFN is set to 'false' then all of the following conditions need to be fulfilled:
- there must be just 1 CHANNELGROUP instance contained in the related LCELL object.
- dlSectorBeamFormingMode must be configured if the number of CHANNEL instances in the CHANNELGROUP instance of the related LCELL, having CHANNEL-direction parameter set to 'TX', is equal to 8.
- dlSectorBeamFormingMode must not be configured if the number of CHANNEL instances in the CHANNELGROUP instance of the related LCELL, having CHANNEL-direction parameter set to 'TX', is not equal to 8.
- only if cell contains one or two RX resources (i.e. related LCELL contains one or two CHANNEL instances with CHANNEL-direction set to 'RX'), prachHsFlag can be set to 'true'.

If actSuperCell is set to 'true' all of the following condition need to be fulfilled:
- superCellParSet must be configured
- act1TxIn2Tx must be configured to 'false'
- actOtdoa must be configured to 'false'
- srsActivation must be configured to 'true'
- actUlMuMimo must be set to 'false'
- there must be at least 2 CHANNELGROUP instances and max 12 CHANNELGROUP instances contained in the related LCELL instance
- the related LCELL instance can contain at minimum two TX and two RX (one antenna) and maximum twelve TXs and twelve RXs (twelve antennas) resources, i.e. the related LCELL can contain up to 24 CHANNEL instances, having up to 12 different CHANNEL-antlDN settings
- the CHANNEL instances contained in the same CHANNELGROUP instance must be assigned to the same RMOD, i.e. parameter antlDN of the CHANNEL instances contained in the same CHANNELGROUP references ANTL instances, and all those ANTL instances must be contained in the same RMOD instance
- dlMimoMode must be configured to 'SingleTX' if the super cell does have subcells with one antenna (CHANNEL instances of the related LCELL have the same CHANNEL-antlDN); where for a super cell having subcells with two antennas (CHANNEL instances of the related LCELL have two different CHANNEL-antlDN settings) dlMimoMode must be configured to 'TXDiv', 'Dynamic Open Loop MIMO' or 'Closed Loop MIMO'
- enhCellVendorSpecTracing-ripTracing must be configured to 'false' in all MTRACE instances belonging to the LNCEL/LNCEL_TDD
- ripAlarmingConfig-actRIPAlarming must be configured to 'false' in same LNCEL_TDD instance.
- dlSectorBeamFormingMode must not be configured
- actBbPooling must be 'false'.
- actLBRTXPowerSaving must be 'false'
- actMMimo must be 'false'
- actInterEnbDLCAggr must be 'false'
- actRIAvoidance must be set to 'false'

A super cell can contain only
- subcells with one antenna, i.e. CHANNELGROUP instances, with two CHANNEL instances, and both CHANNEL instances have the same CHANNEL-antlDN, where one CHANNEL instance has parameter direction set to 'TX' and the other CHANNEL instance has parameter direction set to 'RX' OR
- subcells with two antennas, i.e. CHANNELGROUP instances with four CHANNEL instances, each two of those CHANNEL instances have the same CHANNEL-antlDN and those two CHANNEL instances with same CHANNEL-antlDN have different CHANNEL-direction settings.
subCells with one antenna and subCells with two antennas cannot be mixed within a super cell.
Super cell can get HW resources only from radio modules supported in super cell configurations.

actSuperCell must be configured to 'false' if at least one of the following condition is applicable:
- if actCoMp is set to 'fixedULCoMp' and the LNCEL instance belongs to an ulCoMpCellList
- if actCoMp is set to 'measBasedCoMp' and the cell is included in COMPCONF-measBasedCellConf-lnCelId.
- if AirScale HW is used

For definitions regarding carrier aggregation used in below parameter relationships, please, see the definitions at parameter actDLCAggr.
For all PCells: If (actDLCAggr is 'true' in the parent LNBTS) AND (maxNumScells is greater than '1') AND (actAutoPucchAlloc in the LNCEL_TDD PCell of the cell instance is set to 'false') then in this PCell and all related own SCells actSuperCell must be set to 'false'

Activate or deactivate the dynamic transmission mode switch function

LNCEL_TDD - actAutoPucchAlloc

MPUCCH_TDD - cqiPerNp
MPUCCH_TDD - riEnable
TMSWPR - prohibitTimerTmSwitch

- tmSwitchThresholdDef and prohibitTimerTmSwitch must be configured in TMSWPR referred by tmSwitchProfileId in this LNCEL_TDD
- actBfFallback must be configured to 'false'.

If actTmSwitch is set to 'true' AND dlMimoMode is set to ('Closed Loop MIMO (4x2)' OR 'Closed Loop MIMO (4x4)'), activatedMimoTM must be configured to 'TM4'.

The following conditions are applicable in MPUCCH_TDD of the cell only if actAutoPucchAlloc is set to 'false':
cqiPerNp must be >= '10ms' if actTmSwitch is set to 'true' and tddFrameConf is set to '1'. 
cqiPerNp must be >= '20ms' if actTmSwitch is set to 'true' and tddFrameConf is set to '2'.

actTmSwitch must be set to 'true' if in related LCELL there are 8 TX antenna line resources configured (i.e. in related LCELL there are 8 contained CHANNEL instances with parameter direction configured to 'TX') AND actLBRTXPowerSaving = 'true'.

actTtiBundling.description:
Parameter to activate or deactivate the TTI Bundling feature in a cell.

Please note that UEs in TTI bundling mode will typically use higher PDCCH aggregation levels. Cell capacity can most likely be limited by PDCCH capacity. This is especially relevant in case of cells with 3 MHz bandwidth.
actTtiBundling.notes:
Related functions: Scheduler (Uplink) Related parameters: LNBTS - enforceTtiBundling
LNCEL - actUlLnkAdp
LNCEL - actVoipCovBoost
LNCEL - cellResourceSharingMode
LNCEL - cellTechnology
LNCEL - eUlLaLowMcsThr

LNCEL - qci1DlTargetBler

LNCEL_TDD - tddFrameConf Conditions in (1.x) are valid if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'FDD' or 'TDD':
(1.1) actTtiBundling is allowed to be configured to 'true' only if all of the following conditions are fulfilled:
- actUlLnkAdp is set to 'eUlLa' or 'fUlLa'
- cellResourceSharingMode is set to 'none' or 'DLonly'.
(1.2) If actTtiBundling is set to 'true' and actVoipCovBoost is set to 'true' then harqMaxTrUlTtiBundling must be >= 12.
(1.3) If actTtiBundling is set to 'true', then actTtibRsc must be configured.

Conditions in (2.x) are valid in addition to (1.x) if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'FDD':
(2.1) If dlChBw set to '1.4 MHz', actTtiBundling must be configured to 'false'.
(2.2) If actTtiBundling is set to 'true' following condition need to be applied:
- the LNCEL parameter harqMaxTrUlTtiBundling, ttiBundlingBlerTarget, ttiBundlingBlerThreshold, ttiBundlingSinrThreshold and ttibOperMode are mandatory required
- LNBTS-qciTabOperator-enforceTtiBundling is allowed to be configured to 'true'
- when in addition actUlLnkAdp is set to 'fUlLa' the following condition must be fulfilled:
  > eUlLaLowMcsThr, eUlLaLowPrbThr must be configured.
- when in addition actCatM is set to 'true' and ulChBw is set to ‘5 MHz’, ttibMinUlPrb must be set to fixed value of 2

Conditions in (3.x) are valid in addition to (1.x) if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'TDD':
(3.1) If actTtiBundling is set to 'true' following condition need to be applied:

- LNBTS-qciTabOperator-enforceTtiBundling is allowed to be configured to 'true'

actULCAggr.description:
The parameter activates uplink carrier aggregation. The feature can only be activated in addition to downlink carrier aggregation.

If "UL_CA_with_smartSched" is activated, only UEs with pathloss less than ulCaPathlossThr could be scheduled in multiple serving cells for uplink.
Following features in detail are activated:
- LTE1092 "FDD uplink carrier aggregation for 2 CCs"

Note:
For FDD cells UL Carrier aggregation is using only Smart Scheduling, i.e. if the cellTechnology is set to 'mixed_FDD_TDD' and actULCAggr is set to 'UL_CA_without_smartSched' smart scheduling applies.
For TDD cells the bands to be aggregated need to be contiguous in the same band, i.e. only intra-band carrier aggregation is supported.

- actDLCAggr must be set to 'true'.
- ulCaPathlossThr must be configured.
- caUlIntraBandAmpr must be configured.
- dlCaPreferred must be configured.

(1.2) If actInterEnbULCAggr is 'true', actULCAggr must be different to 'false'.

(2) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'FDD' following conditions must be fulfilled in addition to (1):

actUTCBroadcast.description:
This parameter enables the feature LTE3056 support GPS and UTC time Information broadcast (SIB16).

Note: If SIB16 is configured in this cell, all Cat-M UEs in RRC Connected mode will be released when actUTCBroadcast is modified.
actUTCBroadcast.fullName: Activate GPS and UTC Time Broadcast
actUTCBroadcast.notes:
Related functions: Synchronization Related parameters: CATMPR - siRepPatternCatM
CATMPR - siWindowLenCatM
CATMPR - sib16PeriodicityCatM
CATMPR - sib2PeriodicityCatM
CATMPR - sib3sib4PeriodicityCatM
CATMPR - sib5PeriodicityCatM
LNCEL_FDD - actCatM
SIB - sibSchedulingList
SYNC - btsSyncMode LNBTS-actUTCBroadcast can be set to 'true' only if SYNC-btsSyncMode is equal to 'PhaseSync'.

Conditions in (1.x) are valid if actCatM is set to 'true':
(1.1) the condition must be fulfilled: siWindowLenCatM * NUM-CatM-SI-MSG <= PERIOD-CatM-SI-MSG.
'NUM-CatM-SI-MSG' represents the number of CatM SI messages to be scheduled:
step1. The initial NUM-CatM-SI-MSG is set to 1;
step2. If sibType5 is configured in sibSchedulingList and at least one CATMIRFIM instance is configured, the NUM-CatM-SI-MSG is added by 2,
           else if sibType4 is configured in sibSchedulingList, the NUM-CatM-SI-MSG is added by 1;
step3. If sibType16 is configured in sibSchedulingList and actUTCBroadcast is set to 'true', the NUM-CatM-SI-MSG is added by 1.
'PERIOD-CatM-SI-MSG' represents the minimum periodicity of CatM SI messages to be scheduled:
step1. The initial PERIOD-CatM-SI-MSG is set to sib2PeriodicityCatM;
step2. If sibType5 is configured in sibSchedulingList and at least one CATMIRFIM instance is configured, the PERIOD-CatM-SI-MSG is set to min (PERIOD-CatM-SI-MSG, sib3sib4PeriodicityCatM, sib5PeriodicityCatM),
           else if sibType4 is configured in sibSchedulingList, the PERIOD-CatM-SI-MSG is set to min (PERIOD-CatM-SI-MSG, sib3sib4PeriodicityCatM);
step3. If sibType16 is configured in sibSchedulingList and actUTCBroadcast is set to 'true', the PERIOD-CatM-SI-MSG is min (PERIOD-CatM-SI-MSG, sib16PeriodicityCatM).

(1.2) the condition must be fulfilled:  si_overhead <= 32%.
'si_overhead' represents the percent of radio frame used for CatM SI messages, and is calculated as below from step1 to step3.
siRepPatternCatM value mapping for the following formula {every2ndRF:20, every4thRF: 40, every8thRF: 80}
step1: si_overhead = ceil(siWindowLenCatM/siRepPatternCatM)*10/sib2PeriodicityCatM;
step2: If sibType5 is configured in sibSchedulingList and at least one CATMIRFIM instance is configured, 
                 si_overhead += ceil(siWindowLenCatM/siRepPatternCatM)*10/sib3sib4PeriodicityCatM,
                 si_overhead += ceil(siWindowLenCatM/siRepPatternCatM)*10/sib5PeriodicityCatM,
             else if sibType4 is configured in sibSchedulingList.
                 si_overhead += ceil(siWindowLenCatM/siRepPatternCatM)*10/sib3sib4PeriodicityCatM;
step3: If sibType16 is configured in sibSchedulingList and actUTCBroadcast is set to 'true', si_overhead += ceil(siWindowLenCatM/siRepPatternCatM)*10/sib16PeriodicityCatM.

actUeBasedAnrUtran.notes:
Related functions: SON (Miscellaneous) Related parameters: LNBTS - actAnrRtt
LNBTS - actHOtoHrpd
LNBTS - actUeBasedAnrUtran
LNBTS - supportedCellTechnology
LNBTS_FDD - act1xSrvcc
LNBTS_TDD - act1xSrvcc
LNCEL - a1TimeToTriggerDeactInterMeas
LNCEL - a2TimeToTriggerActWcdmaMeas
LNCEL - anrUtraRscpThres
LNCEL - cellResourceSharingMode
LNCEL - cellTechnology
LNCEL - drxRetransT
LNCEL - filterCoefficientCpichEcn0
LNCEL - filterCoefficientCpichRscp
LNCEL - hysThreshold2Wcdma
LNCEL - hysThreshold2a
LNCEL - measQuantityUtra
LNCEL - t304InterRAT
LNCEL - threshold2Wcdma
LNCEL - threshold2a
LNHOW - b2Threshold1Utra
LNHOW - b2Threshold2UtraEcn0
LNHOW - b2Threshold2UtraRscp (1) If supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'FDD' or 'TDD' or 'mixed_FDD_TDD' following conditions must be fulfilled:
(1.1) Only if actUeBasedAnrUtran is set to 'false'
- actHOtoHrpd or act1xSrvcc  can be configured to 'true'
- actAnrRtt can be configured to 'oamAssisted'.

(2) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'FDD' following conditions must be fulfilled in addition to (1):
(2.1) If actUeBasedAnrUtran is set to 'true' all of the following conditions need to be fulfilled for all cells with cellTechnology set to 'FDD':
- filterCoefficientCpichRscp, filterCoefficientCpichEcn0 and measQuantityUtra are mandatory required
- when in addition cellResourceSharingMode is not set to 'none' drxRetransT in drxProfile102 must be configured to a value greater than '8'.

(3) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'TDD' following conditions must be fulfilled in addition to (1):
(3.1) If actUeBasedAnrUtran is set to 'true' all of the following conditions need to be fulfilled for all cells with cellTechnology set to 'TDD':
- filterCoefficientCpichRscp, filterCoefficientCpichEcn0 and measQuantityUtra are mandatory required
- anrUtraRscpThres must be configured
- a1TimeToTriggerDeactInterMeas, a2TimeToTriggerActWcdmaMeas, threshold2Wcdma, hysThreshold2Wcdma, threshold2a, hysThreshold2a and t304InterRAT are mandatory required
- b2Threshold1Utra and b2Threshold2UtraRscp are mandatory required in all LNHOW instances
- b2Threshold2UtraEcn0 is mandatory required  in all LNHOW instances with  measQuantityUtra set to 'cpichEcN0'  in the superior LNCEL instance.
- when in addition cellResourceSharingMode is not set to 'none' drxRetransT in drxProfile102 must be configured to a value greater than '8'.

(4) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'mixed_FDD_TDD' conditions of (2) AND (3) must be fulfilled in addition to (1).

actUlLnkAdp.description:
Activates Uplink Link Adaptation and defines Link Adaptation mode
When set to "off" no Uplink link Adaptation function is active at all.
When set to "eUlLa" the extended Uplink Link Adaptation function is  activated.
When set to "fUlLa" the new Fast Uplink Link Adaptation function is  activated.
The other choice "slowAmcOllaATB" allows to set to active all the 3 old components of the UL LA function  as it was up to RL20.
actUlLnkAdp.notes:
Related functions: Scheduler (Uplink) Related parameters: LNCEL - actEicic
LNCEL - actTtiBundling
LNCEL - actVoipCovBoost
LNCEL - cellTechnology
LNCEL - deltaTfEnabled
LNCEL - eUlLaAtbPeriod
LNCEL - eUlLaBlerAveWin

LNCEL - eUlLaLowMcsThr
LNCEL - eUlLaLowPrbThr

LNCEL - fUlLAAtbTrigThr
LNCEL - redBwMinRbUl
LNCEL - tPeriodicPhr
LNCEL_FDD - srsActivation
LNCEL_FDD - srsPwrOffset
LNCEL_TDD - srsPwrOffset Conditions in (1.x) are valid if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'FDD' or 'TDD':
(1.1) If actEicic is 'true', then actUlLnkAdp must be set to 'eUlLa' or 'fUlLa'.
(1.2) If actUlLnkAdp is set to value 'eUlLa' all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- the parameters eUlLaAtbPeriod, eUlLaBlerAveWin, eUlLaDeltaMcs, eUlLaLowMcsThr, eUlLaLowPrbThr and eUlLaPrbIncDecFactor must be configured
- redBwMinRbUl must be less than or equal to eUlLaLowPrbThr
- deltaTfEnabled must be configured to 'false'.
(1.3) Only if actUlLnkAdp is set to 'eUlLa' or 'fUlLa', 
- actTtiBundling is allowed to be configured to 'true'
- actVoipCovBoost is allowed to be configured to 'true'.

Conditions in (2.x) are valid in addition to (1.x) if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'FDD':
(2.1) If actUlLnkAdp is set to 'fUlLa' all of the following condition must be fulfilled:
- fUlLAAtbTrigThr must be configured
- deltaTfEnabled must be configured to 'false'
- when in addition ulsSchedMethod is set to ('interference aware' or 'channel unaware'): tPeriodicPhr is not allowed to be configured to 'infinity'
- when in addition ulsSchedMethod is set to ('interference aware' or 'channel unaware') AND srsActivation is set to 'true': srsPwrOffset must be configured 
- when in addition actTtiBundling is set to 'true' following condition must be fulfilled:
  > eUlLaLowMcsThr, eUlLaLowPrbThr must be configured.
(2.2) If actUlLnkAdp is not set to 'fUlLa' and ulsSchedMethod is set to ('interference aware' or 'channel unaware'), then srsActivation must be set to 'false'.

Conditions in (3.x) are valid in addition to (1.x) if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'TDD':
(3.1) If actUlLnkAdp is set to 'fUlLa' all of the following condition must be fulfilled:
- fUlLAAtbTrigThr must be configured
- deltaTfEnabled must be configured to 'false'
- tPeriodicPhr is not allowed to be configured to 'infinity'
- when in addition srsActivation is set to 'true': srsPwrOffset must be configured
- when in addition actTtiBundling is set to 'true' following condition must be fulfilled:
  > eUlLaLowMcsThr, eUlLaLowPrbThr must be configured.

(1) All of the following conditions need to be fulfilled based on the configured actUlpcMethod
(1.1) actUlpcMethod is set to 'PuschOLPucchCL':
- ulpcPucchConfig must be configured
- ulpcReadPeriod must be configured.
(1.2) actUlpcMethod is set to 'PuschCLPucchOL':
- ulpcPuschConfig must be configured

(1.3) actUlpcMethod is set to 'PuschCLPucchCL':

(1.4) actUlpcMethod is set to  'PuschIAwPucchOL':
- deltaTfEnabled must be configured to 'false' 
- dlamcEnable must be configured to 'true'
- dlOlqcEnable must be configured to 'true'
- ulpcIAwConfig must be configured
- ulpcAlpha must be configured to 'alpha 1'
- ulpcRssiMaxIAw must be configured.
(1.5) actUlpcMethod is set to 'PuschIAwPucchCL':
- deltaTfEnabled must be configured to 'false' 
- dlamcEnable must be configured to 'true'
- dlOlqcEnable must be configured to 'true'
- ulpcIAwConfig must be configured
- ulpcAlpha must be configured to 'alpha 1'
- ulpcRssiMaxIAw must be configured
- ulpcPucchConfig must be configured
- ulpcReadPeriod must be configured.
(1.6) If (actUlpcMethod is equal to 'PuschIAwPucchOL' OR 'PuschIAwPucchCL') AND (cellType is not equal to 'large') then actEicic must be set to 'false'.

Conditions in (2.x) are valid in addition to (1.x) if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'FDD':
(2.1) If actUlpcMethod is set to 'PuschCLSrsPucchOL', all of the following conditions need to be fulfilled:
- ulpcPuschConfig must be configured
- ulpcReadPeriod must be configured
- srsPwrOffset must be configured.
(2.3) If actUlpcMethod is set to 'PuschCLSrsPucchCL', all of the following conditions need to be fulfilled:
- ulpcPucchConfig must be configured
- ulpcPuschConfig must be configured
- ulpcReadPeriod must be configured
- srsPwrOffset must be configured. 
(2.3) actUlpcMethod is not allowed to be configured to 'PuschCLSrsPucchOL' OR 'PuschCLSrsPucchCL' if actPuschMask is set to 'true'.
(2.4) If pMaxSubCell is not set to the same value in all  subCellConf list items then all of the following conditions need to be fulfilled:
- actUlpcMethod must be set to any of the following values: PuschCLPucchCL, PuschCLSrsPucchCL, PuschOLPucchOL
- if the difference between any two of the pMaxSubCell values in all subCellConf list items is between 5 and 25, then actUlPcMethod must be set to PuschCLPucchCL OR  PuschCLSrsPucchCL.
(2.5) If actUlPwrRestrScn is not set to 'none', actUlpcMethod must not be set to any of 'PuschIAwPucchCL' or 'PuschIAwPucchOL'.

Conditions in (3.x) are valid in addition to (1.x) if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'TDD':
(3.1) If actUlpcMethod is set to 'PuschCLSrsPucchOL', all of the following conditions need to be fulfilled:
- ulpcPuschConfig must be configured
- ulpcReadPeriod must be configured
- srsActivation must be configured to 'true'.
(3.2) If actUlpcMethod is set to 'PuschCLSrsPucchCL', all of the following conditions need to be fulfilled:
- ulpcPucchConfig must be configured
- ulpcPuschConfig must be configured
- ulpcReadPeriod must be configured
- srsActivation must be configured to 'true'.
(3.3) If actUlsps is set to 'true' for the cell instance, ulSpsConfig-p0NomPuschSps depends on actUlpcMethod value as defined below:
- if (actUlpcMethod != (PuschIAwPucchOL OR PuschIAwPucchCL)), p0NomPuschSps must be equal to p0NomPusch
- if (actUlpcMethod = (PuschIAwPucchOL OR PuschIAwPucchCL)), p0NomPuschSps must be equal to p0NomPuschIAw.

actUnlicensedAcc.description:
This parameter activates the functionality "Licensed - Assisted Access" according to either of the following two modes: 
- LAA mode, according to 3GPP rel.13

Hint:
When the parameter is set to “off” all cells from an unlicensed band as defined in the parameter relationships are disabled.

Related functions: License Assisted Access Related parameters: CABLINK - iqCompression

RMOD - rModId An unlicensed cell or cell in an unlicensed band is defined by the value of earfcnDL falling in the ranges of band 46a or 46d as defined at parameter earfcnDL.
Note: Additionally, only following channel centre frequencies/earfcnDLs are allowed in the following WiFi bands.
   Band 46 a:
      Channel 36 (5179.8 - 5180.2 MHz): 47088 - 47092
      Channel 40 (5199.8 - 5200.2 MHz): 47288 - 47292
      Channel 44 (5219.8 - 5220.2 MHz): 47488 - 47492
      Channel 48 (5239.8 - 5240.2 MHz): 47688 - 47692
   Band 46 d:
      Channel 149 (5744.8 - 5745.2 MHz): 52738 - 52742
      Channel 153 (5764.8 - 5765.2 MHz): 52938 - 52942
      Channel 157 (5784.8 - 5785.2 MHz): 53138 - 53142
      Channel 161 (5804.8 - 5805.2 MHz): 53338 - 53342
      Channel 165 (5824.8 - 5825.2 MHz): 53538 - 53542
See also the parameter relationships below.

Conditions in (1.x) are valid if the supportedCellTechnology of the LNBTS instance is configured to 'FDD' or 'mixed_FDD_TDD':
(1.1) If actUnlicensedAcc is unequal to 'off', then following conditions must be fulfilled:
   (1.1.1) One instance of MOC LAA must be created.
   (1.1.2) At least one instance of MOC LNUPR must be created.
   (1.1.3) numTxWithHighNonGbr must be unequal to '0'.
(1.2) if actUnlicensedAcc is 'LAA', then following conditions must be fulfilled:
   (1.2.1) Within the same LNBTS instance, all LNCEL instances from unlicensed band as defined above linked with the same RMOD instance (same value for RMOD-rModId) must get the same value configured for LNCEL_FDD-lnuprId.
   (1.2.2) For all instances of LNCEL in unlicensed band as defined above, the earfcnDL must have one of the following values: [47088...47092, 47288...47292, 47488...47492, 47688...47692, 52738...52742, 52938...52942, 53138... 53142, 53338...53342, 53538...53542].
   (1.2.3) One instance of MOC CADPRLAA must be created.
(1.3) If actUnlicensedAcc is 'LAA', then following conditions must be fulfilled for AirScale:
   (1.3.1) If four instances of LNCEL in the unlicensed band as defined in parameters actUnlicensedAcc and actUnlicensedDfs are configured and linked to the same instance of RMOD (via rModId), then
      - actDownSampling must be 'true' in all these four cells.
      - in the instances of CABLINK with CABLINK-secondEndpoint referring to RMOD with same rModId, iqCompression must be '9 bits'.
   (1.3.2) antennaGain must be configured.
   (1.3.3) laaContiguousChannelPrio must be configured.
   (1.3.4) actUnlicensedDcs must be set to 'true'
   (1.3.5) If within the same LNBTS instance there is at least one LNCEL instance configured as PCell with cellTechnology equal to 'FDD' and maxNumScells greater than or equal to '5', then for all such LNCEL instances all following conditions must be fulfilled:
      - actReducedFormat must be 'true'.
      - actSpatialPucchBundling must be configured.
(1.4) If actUnlicensedDcs is 'true' then actUnlicensedAcc must be 'LAA'.

activatedMimoTM.description:
This parameter configures the selection of the Closed Loop MIMO transmission mode TM4 or TM9 depending on the capability of the UE. Up to 4 spatial multiplexing layers can be supported based on TM4 (MIMO4x4-TM4) or TM9 (MIMO4x4-TM9, MIMO8x2-8pTM9 or MIMO8x4-8pTM9).

The following settings for the parameter activatedMimoTM are supported to configure the selection of the transmission mode for closed loop single user downlink MIMO modes configurations:
- activatedMimoTM == "TM4": all UEs select TM4 
- activatedMimoTM == "TM9": all TM9 capable UEs select TM9; all other legacy Rel.8,9 UEs select TM4
- activatedMimoTM == "TM9_maxLayer": UEs supporting up to 4 spatial multiplexing layers based on TM9 and maximum two layers based on TM4 select transmission mode 9. All other UEs select TM4.

Notes: 
(1) The parameter 'activatedMimoTM' is configurable for several Closed Loop Mimo modes (dlMimoMode: "Closed Loop MIMO (4x4) OR 'Closed Loop MIMO (8x4)'" and "Closed Loop MIMO (4x2)" Closed Loop MIMO (8x2)") to control the selection of the transmission mode.
(2) The setting  activatedMimoTM == "TM9_maxLayer" is only configurable if dlMimoMode=="Closed Loop MIMO (4x4)".
activatedMimoTM.notes:
Related functions: MIMO Control Related parameters: LNCEL_TDD - actTmSwitch
LNCEL_TDD - dlMimoMode (1.1) activatedMimoTM must be configured if dlMimoMode is set to ('Closed Loop MIMO (4x2)' OR 'Closed Loop MIMO (4x4)' OR 'Closed Loop MIMO (8x2)' OR 'Closed Loop MIMO (8x4)')). For any other dlMimoMode, activatedMimoTM is not allowed to be configured.
(1.2) If dlMimoMode is set to 'Closed Loop MIMO (4x2)' OR 'Closed Loop MIMO (8x2)' OR 'Closed Loop MIMO (8x4)') , activatedMimoTM cannot be configured to 'TM9_maxLayer'.
(1.3) If dlMimoMode is set to ('Closed Loop MIMO (4x2)' OR 'Closed Loop MIMO (4x4)') AND activatedMimoTM is set to ('TM9' OR 'TM9_maxLayer'), actTmSwitch must be configured to 'false'.
(1.4) If activatedMimoTM is NOT set to 'TM4', csiRsConfigInfo must be configured for the cell.
(1.5) If dlMimoMode is set to ('Closed Loop MIMO (8x2)' OR 'Closed Loop MIMO (8x4)' ), activatedMimoTM must not be configured to 'TM4'.

addAUeRrHo.description:
Additional margin for the maximum number of active UEs in the cell accessing the cell via hand over with HO-cause: "HO desirable for radio reasons". This margin is added to the threshold maxNumActUE.
The maximum margin depends on the bandwidth of the cell. The following values are allowed:
- for 10MHz bandwidth 0..550 (recommended: 20)
- for 15 MHz and 20 MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1, 0..800 (recommended: 30)
- for 15 MHz and 20 MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.2, 0..600 (recommended: 20)

Airscale:
The maximum margin depends on the bandwidth of the cell. The following values are allowed:
- for 10MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1 or conf.2, 0..400 (recommended: 20)
- for 20MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1 or conf.2, 0..600 (recommended: 30)

The range of this parameter may be adapated condisering baseband pooling configuration, including the value of actBbpooling and the number of cells allocated to a baseband pool.
addAUeRrHo.fullName: Add Number Active Ues Radio Reason Handover
addAUeRrHo.notes:
Related functions: Radio Admission Control Related parameters: LNCEL_TDD - actAutoPucchAlloc
LNCEL_TDD - chBw
LNCEL_TDD - maxNumActUE
LNCEL_TDD - tddFrameConf
MPUCCH_TDD - addAUeRrHo
MPUCCH_TDD - addAUeTcHo
MPUCCH_TDD - addEmergencySessions
MPUCCH_TDD - maxNumRrc If AirScale deployment (BPF property HW.Release= 4) then

The range for addAUeRrHo depends on chBw, tddFrameConf, addAUeTcHo and addAUeRrHo according to following conditions
- if chBw is set to '10 MHz',and additionally tddFrameConf is set to ('sa1' OR 'sa2'), addAUeRrHo <= 400
- if chBw is set to '20MHz' ,and additionally tddFrameConf is set to ('sa1' OR 'sa2'), addAUeRrHo <= 600.

the range for addAUeRrHo may be adapated condisering baseband pooling configuration,including the value of actBbPooling and the number of cells allocated to a baseband pool

If no AirScale deployment (BPF property HW.Release < 4) then

All of the following conditions are applicable in MPUCCH_TDD of the cell only if actAutoPucchAlloc is set to 'false'.

The range for addAUeRrHo depends on chBw, tddFrameConf, addAUeTcHo and addAUeRrHo according to following conditions
(1) if chBw is set to '10MHz'
- addAUeRrHo value range is restricted to 0...550 

(2) if chBw is set to ('15MHz' or '20MHz')
- if tddFrameConf is set to 'sa1', addAUeRrHo value range is restricted to 0...800
- if tddFrameConf is set to 'sa2', addAUeRrHo value range is restricted to 0...600

(3) (maxNumActUE + max(addAUeRrHo, addAUeTcHo)) must be equal or less than the margin values of  maxNumActUE for the used bandwidth, tddFrameConf.

Recommendation:
addEmergencySessions should be configured to a greater value than addAUeTcHo in order to give emergency sessions more chance to be established than normal handover traffic.

For definitions regarding carrier aggregation used in below parameter relationships, please, see the definitions at parameter actDLCAggr.
Following conditions need to be fulfilled in the MPUCCH_TDD instance if a cell is configured as a PCell:

(4) Precondition: actDLCAggr is set to 'true'.
- addAUeRrHo is considered in the calculation of maxNumRrc in the PCell, for details please refer to maxNumRrc.

addEmergencySessions.defaultValue: 30.0 (default value for 20 MHz BW, TDD conf.1;)
addEmergencySessions.description:
Additional margin for Emergency Sessions;
this margin increases the thresholds for active UEs, active DRBs with a factor and active QCI1-DRBs in the cell
Emergency traffic shall have high preference against normal traffic in the cell.
The addEmergencySession value is used to increase several thresholds and it has to be considered, that the system limits are never exceeded for all resources.

The maximum margin depends on the bandwidth of the cell. The following values are allowed:
- for 10MHz bandwidth 0..550 (recommended: 20)
- for 15 MHz and 20 MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1, 0..800 (recommended: 30)
- for 15 MHz and 20 MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.2, 0..600 (recommended: 20)

AirScale:
The maximum margin depends on the bandwidth of the cell. The following values are allowed:
- for 10MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1 or conf.2, 0..400 (recommended: 20)
- for 20 MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1 or conf.2, 0..600 (recommended: 30)

the range of this parameter may be adapated condisering baseband pooling configuration, including the value of actBbpooling

Related functions: Radio Admission Control Related parameters: LNCEL_TDD - addNumDrbRadioReasHo

MPUCCH_TDD - addAUeTcHo All of the following conditions are applicable in MPUCCH_TDD of the cell only if (actAutoPucchAlloc = 'false') AND (actEmerCallRedir = 'Enabled' OR actIMSEmerSessR9 = 'true').

If AirScale deployment (BPF property HW.Release= 4) then
(1) Range depends on chBw, tddFrameConf, value as follows:
- if chBw is set to '10MHz',and additionally tddFrameConf is set to ('sa1' OR 'sa2'), addEmergencySessions <= 400
- if chBw is set to '20MHz' , and additionally tddFrameConf is set to ('sa1' OR 'sa2'),addEmergencySessions <= 600
the range for addEmergencySessions may be adapated condisering baseband pooling configuration,including the value of actBbPooling and the number of cells allocated to a baseband pool
e.g. addEmergencySessions = 800 for tddFrameConf is set to ('sa1' OR 'sa2'), 20MHz in case of actBbPooling is 'TRUE' 


If no AirScale deployment (BPF property HW.Release < 4) then
(1) Range depends on chBw, tddFrameConf, value as follows:
- if chBw is set to '10MHz', addEmergencySessions must be less or equal to 550
- if chBw is set to ('15MHz' or '20MHz') and additionally tddFrameConf is set to 'sa1', addEmergencySessions must be less or equal to 800
- if chBw is set to ('15MHz' or '20MHz') and additionally tddFrameConf is set to 'sa2', addEmergencySessions must be less or equal to 600

(2) addEmergencySessions must be checked on useful values if the relating thresholds are modified (maxNumActUE, maxNumActDrb, maxNumQci1Drb), depends on used bandwidth and  TDD subframe configuratioon (tddFrameConf):
- (maxNumActUE + addEmergencySessions ) <= maximum value of maxNumActUE
- (maxNumActDrb + addEmergencySessions * 4) <= maximum value of maxNumActDrb
- (maxNumQci1Drb + addEmergencySessions ) <= maximum value of maxNumQci1Drb

Recommendation if actIMSEmerSessR9 is set to 'true':
- addEmergencySessions should be configured to a greater value than addNumQci1DrbRadioReasHo and addNumQci1DrbTimeCriticalHo because every GBR-DRB is also counted as normal DRB – and each GBR-DRB has 1 default DRB (nGBR)

addGbrTrafficRrHo.description:
Additional margin on the threshold "maxGbrTrafficLimit" in case of handover for radio reasons.
The amount of radio resources (PRBs) is calculated in % of the available PRBs depending on the system.
1.4 MHz = 6 DL PRBS*,
3.0 MHz = 15 DL PRBS*,
For 5 MHz system 25 PRBs*,
for 10 MHz system 50 PRBs*,
for 15 MHz system 75 PRBs*,
for 20 Mhz system 100 PRBs* are available.
* reduced by common resources like PUCCH, RACCH, PDCCH, SIBs and so on, which can consume some PRBs (for example three PRBs) in average. 

The parameter is only relevant if "actEnhAcAndGbrServices" is set to True and ignored otherwise.

The "addGbrTrafficRrHo" parameter should be configured significantly lower than the "maxGbrTrafficLimit" parameter to reduce admitting handover traffic and preempting other low prior traffic immediately with next cell local admission requests.
addGbrTrafficRrHo.fullName: Add GBR-DRB traffic for radio reason handover
addGbrTrafficRrHo.notes:
Related functions: Radio Admission Control Related parameters: LNCEL - addGbrTrafficTcHo
LNCEL - maxGbrTrafficLimit
LNCEL - maxNbrTrafficLimit Following conditions need to be fulfilled per LNCEL instance:
- maxGbrTrafficLimit + max(addGbrTrafficRrHo, addGbrTrafficTcHo) =< 90
- maxNbrTrafficLimit >=  maxGbrTrafficLimit + max(addGbrTrafficRrHo, addGbrTrafficTcHo)

addNumDrbRadioReasHo.defaultValue: 90.0 (default value for 20 MHz BW, TDD conf.1;)
addNumDrbRadioReasHo.description:
Additional margin for the maximum number of active DRBs in the cell accessing the cell via HO with HO-cause: "HO desirable for radio reasons". This margin is added to the threshold maxNumActDrb.
Hand over traffic shall have some preference against new upcoming traffic in the cell.

The maximum margin depends on the bandwidth of the celll and the configuration of suppExtCqiPeriod in the BTS. The following lists the maximal allowed values (not all conditions)::
- for 10MHz bandwidth 0..1650 (recommended: 60)
- for 15 MHz and 20 MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1, 0..2400 (recommended: 90)
- for 15 MHz and 20 MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.2, 0..1890 (recommended: 60)

AirScale:
The maximum margin depends on the bandwidth of the celll and the configuration of suppExtCqiPeriod in the BTS. The following lists the maximal allowed values (not all conditions)::
- for 10MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1 or conf.2, 0..1800 (recommended: 60)
- for 15MHz and 20 MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1 or conf.2, 0..3600 (recommended: 90)

The range of this parameter may be adapated considering baseband pooling configuration, including the value of actBbpooling and the number of cells allocated to a baseband pool.

addNumQci1DrbRadioReasHo.defaultValue: 16.0 (default value for 10/20 MHz BW, TDD conf.1;)
addNumQci1DrbRadioReasHo.description:
Additional margin for the maximum number of active GBRs in the cell accessing the cell via hand over with HO-cause: "HO desirable for radio reasons". This margin is added to the threshold maxNumQci1Drb.
Hand over traffic shall have some preference against new upcoming traffic in the cell.

The maximum additional margin depends on the Uplink-downlink configuration of the cell. The following values are allowed:
(1) tddFrameConf  is set to '1'(sa1)
Max value: 300 for 10 MHz and 400 for 15 MHz and 20 MHz
Default value: 16 for 10 MHz and 15 MHz and 20 MHz

(2) tddFrameConf  is set to '2'(sa2)
Max value: 150 for 10 MHz and 200 for 15 MHz and 20 MHz
Default value: 12 for 10 MHz and 15 MHz and 20 MHz

AirScale:
The maximum additional margin depends on the Uplink-downlink configuration of the cell. The following values are allowed:
- for 10MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1, 0..150 (recommended: 16)
- for 20MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.1, 0..200 (recommended: 16)
- for 10MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.2, 0..150 (recommended: 12)
- for 20MHz bandwidth with TDD conf.2, 0..200 (recommended: 12)
the range of this parameter may be adapated condisering baseband pooling configuration, including the value of actBbpooling
addNumQci1DrbRadioReasHo.fullName: Add number QCI1 DRB for radioReasHo
addNumQci1DrbRadioReasHo.notes:
Related functions: Radio Admission Control Related parameters: LNCEL_TDD - actAutoPucchAlloc
LNCEL_TDD - addNumDrbTimeCriticalHo
LNCEL_TDD - chBw
LNCEL_TDD - maxNumActDrb
LNCEL_TDD - maxNumQci1Drb
LNCEL_TDD - tddFrameConf
MPUCCH_TDD - addEmergencySessions If AirScale deployment (BPF property HW.Release= 4) then

 addNumQci1DrbRadioReasHo depends on the value of chBw, tddFrameConf

- if chBw is set to '10MHz', and tddFrameConf is set to ('sa1' OR 'sa2'), addNumQci1DrbRadioReasHo <= 150.
- if chBw is set to '20MHz', and tddFrameConf is set to ('sa1' OR 'sa2'), addNumQci1DrbRadioReasHo <= 200.

the range for addNumQci1DrbRadioReasHo may be adapated condisering baseband pooling configuration,including the value of actBbPooling 
e.g. addNumQci1DrbRadioReasHo = 400 for conf.1 or conf.2 20MHz in case of actBbPooling is 'TRUE' 

If no AirScale deployment (BPF property HW.Release < 4) then
(1)  addNumQci1DrbRadioReasHo depends on the value of chBw, tddFrameConf
- if chBw is set to '10 MHz' and additionally tddFrameConf is set to 'sa1', addNumQci1DrbRadioReasHo must be less than or equal to 300.
- if chBw is set to '10 MHz' and additionally tddFrameConf is set to 'sa2', addNumQci1DrbRadioReasHo must be less than or equal to 150.
- if chBw is set to('15MHz' or '20MHz') and additionally tddFrameConf is set to 'sa1', addNumQci1DrbRadioReasHo must be less than or equal to 400.
- if chBw is set to ('15MHz' or '20MHz') and additionally tddFrameConf is set to 'sa2', addNumQci1DrbRadioReasHo must be less than or equal to 200.

(maxNumQci1Drb + max( addNumQci1DrbRadioReasHo, addNumQci1DrbTimeCriticalHo)) <= maximum value of maxNumQci1Drb for the used bandwidth and TDD subframe configuratioon (tddFrameConf). 

(maxNumQci1Drb + addNumQci1DrbRadioReasHo) should be equal to or less than (maxNumActDrb + addNumDrbRadioReasHO)/2, because every GBR-DRB is also counted as normal DRB. 

Recommendation:
addEmergencySessions should be configured to a greater value than addNumQci1DrbRadioReasHo, in order to give emergency sessions more chance to be established than normal handover traffic, or equal to it.

addNumQci1DrbTimeCriticalHo.description:
Additional margin for the maximum number of active GBRs in the cell accessing the cell via hand over with HO-cause: "Time Critical HO". This margin is added to the threshold maxNumQci1Drb.
The parameter is only relevant if "actEnhAcAndGbrServices" is set to False and ignored otherwise.

Hand over traffic has some preference against new upcoming traffic in the cell.

The maximum additional margin depends on the bandwidth of the cell. The following values are allowed:

Values for AirScale (FSMr3 in brackets)
1.4 MHz bandwidth  0 .. 10 (10)
3 MHz bandwidth  0 .. 60 (60)
5 MHz bandwidth  0 .. 200 (200)
10 MHz bandwidth 0 .. 200 (400)
15 MHz bandwidth 0 .. 300 (500)
20 MHz bandwidth 0 .. 300 (600)

Note that the default value is not suitable for all bandwidths. The recommended values are:

1.4 MHz bandwidth  3
3 MHz bandwidth  8
5 MHz bandwidth 15
10 MHz bandwidth 20
15 MHz bandwidth 30
20 MHz bandwidth 40

Dependencies:
maxNumQci1Drb + max( addNumQci1DrbRadioReasHo, addNumQci1DrbTimeCriticalHo) must be less than the margin values for the used bandwidth (see values above. (10, 60, 200, 400, 500, 600))

- if min(ulChBw,dlChBw) is set to '3.0 MHz', addNumQci1DrbTimeCriticalHo value range is restricted to 0...60
- if min(ulChBw,dlChBw) is set to '5.0 MHz', addNumQci1DrbTimeCriticalHo value range is restricted to 0...200

- if min(ulChBw,dlChBw) is set to '15.0 MHz', addNumQci1DrbTimeCriticalHo value range is restricted to 0...500
- if min(ulChBw,dlChBw) is set to '20.0 MHz', addNumQci1DrbTimeCriticalHo value range is restricted to 0...600

(3) if actMultBearers is set to 'true', addNumQci1DrbTimeCriticalHo might restrict or will be restricted by maxNumRrc and/or maxNumRrcEmergency due to calculations needed for those parameter
(3.1) if in addition actEnhAcAndGbrServices is set to 'false' AND if actConvVoice is set to 'true' following condition need to be fulfilled
- maxNumRrc + max(addAUeRrHo, addAUeTcHo) >= maxNumQci1Drb + max(addNumQci1DrbRadioReasHo, addNumQci1DrbTimeCriticalHo)
(3.1.1) if in addition actEnhAcAndGbrServices is set to 'false' AND actIMSEmerSessR9 is set to 'true'
- maxNumRrcEmergency >= maxNumQci1Drb + max(addEmergencySessions, addNumQci1DrbRadioReasHo, addNumQci1DrbTimeCriticalHo)
(3.2) if in addition actEnhAcAndGbrServices is set to 'false' 
(maxNumQci1Drb + addNumQci1DrbTimeCriticalHo) should be half or less than (maxNumActDrb + addNumQci1DrbTimeCriticalHo), because every GBR-DRB is also counted as normal DRB and each GBR-DRB has 1 default DRB (nGBR)

Recommendation if actIMSEmerSessR9 is set to 'true' and if actEnhAcAndGbrServices is set to 'false':
- addEmergencySessions should be configured to a greater value than addNumQci1DrbTimeCriticalHo

This parameter defines the mean time, in seconds, that the  (IPv4 ARP / IPv6 ND) cache entries persist in the cache before flushing.

- Maximum: 1.5 * configured value

amountBlankedRes.description:
Determines the amount of resources to be blanked for PDSCH scheduling of UE specific transmissions.
Given percentage will be rounded to the next larger integer multiple of the system bandwidth dependent allocation granularity on PDSCH (resource block group size for resource allocation type 0). Position of resources to be blanked is derived dynamically.
Value "0" disables the PDSCH blanking sub-functionality.

angle.description: The elevation angle between the direction orthogonal to the antenna element axis and the maximum of its main beam in the elevation plane. A positive electrical tilt angle means that the antenna beam is directed below the direction orthogonal to the antenna axis. The user sets the parameter value at least once according to the configuration/network plan. Otherwise, the present value (factory or old setting) exists. Setting tilt angle of a RET device might take up to 2 minutes according to 3GPP stardards. A typical time for the calibration is approximately 15-30 seconds. According to 3GPP standards, setting tilt of several devices connected onto one antenna line is done as a series of consecutive operation by the system. In addition, set tilt and calibration (for more details of calibration, see calibrate parameter documentation) are done as consecutive operations. When such a situation occurs, accumulative time for the operations may be increased long enough as to not be feasible to be activated in one plan. Thus, in such case, time consuming operations should be devided into the 2 or more plans.
angle.notes:
Related functions: Site Management (Antenna Line Management) Related parameters: RETU - maxAngle
RETU - minAngle RETU-minAngle: angle should be not smaller then minAngle

antlDN.description: Distinguished name of object ANTL or ASIANTL
antlDN.notes:
Related functions: Site Management (Antenna Line Management) Related parameters: ANTL - antlId
ASIANTL - asiAntlId
ASIRMOD - asiRModId
CABLINK - firstEndpointDN
CABLINK - firstEndpointLabel
CABLINK - firstEndpointPortId
CABLINK - secondEndpointDN
CHANNEL - direction
CHANNEL - resourceDN
RMOD - rModId For LTE: (LCELL)
This parameter must point to DN of existing ANTL object or ASIANTL object.
This parameter must exist if resourceDN does not exist.
This parameter can not exist if resourceDN exists.

If an RMOD is referenced by MNL/MNLENT/CELLMAPPING/LCELL/CHANNELGROUP/CHANNEL-antlDN or MNL/MNLENT/CELLMAPPING/LCELL/CHANNELGROUP/CHANNEL-resourceDN, there must be a direct or indirect (chained) connection between the target RMOD  and an SMOD(FSMr3 only), BBMOD or FHS.
For a direct connection, there must be at least one CABLINK between the target RMOD and an SMOD(FSMr3 only) or BBMOD configured as follows:
- firstEndpointDN – reference the SMOD or BBMOD or FHS
- firstEndpointLabel – OPT
- firstEndpointPortId – SMOD or BBMOD port number
- secondEndpointDN – reference the RMOD
- All other parameters are optional. 
For an indirect connection via chained radios, 
- There must be one CABLINK with one endpoint referencing the target RMOD and another endpoint referencing another RMOD
- Optionally, there can be more RMOD-to-RMOD connections
- The chain must terminate with a direct conenction to an SMOD(FSMr3 only) or BBMOD or FHS

If an ASIRMOD is referenced by MNL/MNLENT/CELLMAPPING/LCELL/CHANNELGROUP/CHANNEL-antlDN, there must be a direct or indirect (chained) connection between the target ASIRMOD and BBMOD.
For a direct connection, there must be at least one CABLINK between the target ASIRMOD and BBMOD configured as follows:
- firstEndpointDN – reference BBMOD
- firstEndpointLabel – OPT
- firstEndpointPortId –  BBMOD port number
- secondEndpointDN – reference the ASIRMOD
- All other parameters are optional. 
For an indirect connection via chained ASIRMODs, 
- There must be one CABLINK with one endpoint referencing the target ASIRMOD and another endpoint referencing another ASIRMOD
- Optionally, there can be more ASIRMOD-to-ASIRMOD connections
- The chain must terminate with a direct conenction to BBMOD

This parameter must exist if this MOC belongs to LCELC
This parameter must exist if this MOC belongs to LCELW

Within the same local cell instance, per transmit direction there cannot be several CHANNEL instances referencing the same ANTL (or ASIANTL) instance.

autoAcBarringStartTimer.description:
This parameter defines the guard timer before starting automatic AC barring broadcast of overload specific parameter value in SIB messages when BTS C-Plane get in overload. 
As per TS36.331, systemInfoValueTag changes should be no more than 31 times within 3 hours. Otherwise, UE with a complete set of system information of the cell stored that has left the cell and has come back within three hours might not recognize that there was a system information change.

To avoid systemInfoValueTag overflow solely due to frequent automatic AC barring on/off, it is recommended that the sum of autoAcBarringStartTimer and autoAcbPlmnRmvlStopTimer is  equal to or greater than 900 seconds (i.e. 15 minutes).
autoAcBarringStartTimer.relatedFeatures:
•  LTE1788 Automatic access class barring (Standard)  
•  LTE2460 Automatic access class barring with PLMN disabling (Standard)  
•  LTE2828 LNCEL LNBTS refactoring (Standard)

autoAdapt.description:
This parameter offers the possibility to use existing LNCEL configuration as default mobility profile. This parameter defines auto adaptation rules for all mobility procedures except for Idle Mode Mobility Load Balancing procedures.

autoAdapt parameter is considered when MODPR applies. For details, see parameter description of LNBTS-actSelMobPrf.

If autoAdapt is 'true':
- the HO frequency lists defined in LNADJL, LNADJW and LNADJG objects are used instead of MODPR configuration. Frequency layers of newly created LNADJL, LNADJW and LNADJG objects are automatically included in the default profile. Exception for service based handover: eNB will treat the frequency list for service based handover as empty.
- VoLTE inter-frequency is not allowed.
- REDRT configuration of the corresponding cell is used instead of MODRED configuration. MODRED, if present, is not considered.

Note: Measurements are done only for adjacent objects (LNADJx) that are referred by a relationship object (LNRELx) with a frequency configured in the corresponding handover object (LNHOx).
autoAdapt.fullName: Auto adaptation to freq. layers of all neighbour cells

•  LTE1127 Service based mobility trigger (Standard)  
•  LTE490 SPID selective mobility profiles (Optional)  
•  LTE487 Idle mode mobility load balancing (Standard)  
•  LTE1942 Dedicated VoLTE inter-frequency target frequency list (Standard)

bbCardUsage.description:
If bbCardUsage parameter is set to '0' then a given baseband card is not used for hosting any baseband pools.

If bbCardUsage parameter is set to '1' then only one baseband pool is used for a given baseband card.

If bbCardUsage parameter is set to '2' then two baseband pools are used for a given baseband card.

If bbCardUsage is set to '0' then all cells connected to a given baseband card are in operational state 'disabled'

If bbCardUsage is set to '1' then all cells connected to a given baseband card are allocated to one baseband pool.

If bbCardUsage is set to '2' then cells being served by radios connected a given baseband card are distributed to two baseband pools.

If a given baseband card stays not electrically powered no new cells can be allocated to.
bbCardUsage.fullName: Amount of baseband pools being used per baseband card
bbCardUsage.notes: Related functions: Site Management (System Management) Related parameters: LNBTS - actBbPooling BBMOD-bbCardUsage parameter must be configured if LNBTS-actBbPooling is set to ‘true’ and is not relevant otherwise.

blankedPucch.description:
Defines the pointer to PRB from where the CQI-allocation shall start in order to leave some PRBs free and therefore to avoid interference with neighbor bands. 
When set to 0 the feature 'Flexible UL Bandwidth'  is deactivated.

The 'blankedPucch' is the number of blanked PUCCH PRBs, counted inward from the band edges, and indicating the sum of PRBs from upper and from lower edge. They are counted into (i.e. part of) the nCqiRb value.
When set to values different from 0 all the PRBs from 0 up to 'blankedPucch' value are not utilized by the PUCCH allocation algorithm for allocating the periodic CQI.
In other words all those PRBs up to blankedPucch are skipped by the periodic CQI allocation algorithm.
 
Example: blankedPucch = 6 would mean that CQI-allocation will start from the seventh PRB, the PRB #6. 
All the PRB up to the PRB#6 excluded (3 at each BW edge accordingly to PUCCH physical allocation policy) are left free, to avoid interferences with neighbor bands supported by other radio technologies.

The configuration of the blanked PRBs region in one operators network shall be the same for all the cells having same E-UTRA Operating Band, same channel bandwidth and same center carrier frequency (i.e. same Transmission bandwidth configuration according to 3GPP-36.104).

In case of simultaneous activation of feature LTE46 'Channel-aware Scheduler (UL)', SRS configuration must avoid that SRS signal is sent within the blanked RF area. 

This parameter is ignored by the system if LTE3230 UL interference offsets is activated. LTE3230 uses its own pre-defined configuration data.

This parameter is ignored by the system if feature LTE4738-RP001783 is active (that is if actDynamicSharedSpectrum == TRUE). Instead, in LTE4738-RP001783, blankedPucch is internally set by eNodeB to: blankedPucch= 2 * max(numBlankDlPrbsDown, numBlankDlPrbsUp).
blankedPucch.notes:
Related functions: PHY/MAC Configuration (Uplink) Related parameters: APUCCH_FDD - blankedPucch
APUCCH_FDD - selectPrachRegion
CHANNEL - resourceDN
LNCEL_FDD - actAutoPucchAlloc
LNCEL_FDD - actCatM
LNCEL_FDD - actMMimo
LNCEL_FDD - dlChBw
LNCEL_FDD - earfcnDL
LNCEL_FDD - earfcnUL
LNCEL_FDD - prachConfIndex
LNCEL_FDD - prachFreqOff
LNCEL_FDD - selectOuterPuschRegion
LNCEL_FDD - ulChBw
MPUCCH_FDD - nCqiRb
MPUCCH_FDD - nPucchF3Prbs
NBIOT_FDD - numUlNonAnchCarrierNB The following condition in (1) is applicable in MPUCCH_FDD of the cell only if actAutoPucchAlloc is set to 'false':
(1) The value of blankedPucch must be less than nCqiRb and it is considered when calculating MaxPucchResourceSize (the calculation is described under parameter nCqiRb; blankedPucch is part of nCqiRb and therefore implicitly considered in MaxPucchResourceSize ).

(2) For definitions regarding carrier aggregation used in below parameter relationships, please, see the definitions at parameter actDLCAggr.
Following conditions need to be fulfilled if a cell is configured as a PCell:
Pre-condition: actDLCAggr is 'true' in the parent LNBTS of the PCell.
- nCqiRb must be greater than the sum of nPucchF3Prbs and blankedPucch
(3) The value of blankedPucch depends on ulChBw. The following range restrictions apply dependent on the configured ulChBw:
- if ulChBw = '1.4 MHz' or '3 MHz', blankedPucch must be configured to 0
- if ulChBw set to '5 MHz' and actCatM set to 'false', blankedPucch must be configured to 0...16
- if ulChBw set to '10 MHz' and actCatM set to 'false', blankedPucch must be configured to 0...30
- if ulChBw set to '15 MHz' and actCatM set to 'false', blankedPucch must be configured to 0...40
- if ulChBw set to '20 MHz' and actCatM set to 'false', blankedPucch must be configured to 0...60
- if ulChBw set to '5 MHz' and actCatM set to 'true', blankedPucch must be configured to 0...6
- if ulChBw set to '10 MHz', '15 MHz', or '20 MHz' and actCatM set to 'true', blankedPucch must be configured to 0...20

(4)
(4.1) For ulChBw of '5 MHz', '10 MHz', '15 MHz' and '20 MHz':
if selectOuterPuschRegion is configured to 'None' or blankedPucch is less than '12', then the allowed prachFreqOff range is:
roundup ((MaxPucchResourceSize + blankedPucch) / 2) … ulChBw (in PRBs) - 6 - roundup ((MaxPucchResourceSize + blankedPucch) / 2)

(4.2) For ulChBw of '5 MHz', '10 MHz', '15 MHz' and '20 MHz': 
- if selectOuterPuschRegion is configured to 'LowerEdge' and blankedPucch is greater than or equal to '12', then the allowed prachFreqOff ranges are:
   + (0 ... roundup (blankedPucch/2) - 6) and 
   + (roundup ((MaxPucchResourceSize + blankedPucch) / 2) … ulChBw (in PRBs) - 6 - roundup ((MaxPucchResourceSize + blankedPucch) / 2))
- if selectOuterPuschRegion is configured to 'UpperEdge' and blankedPucch is greater than or equal to '12', then the allowed prachFreqOff ranges are:
   + (roundup ((MaxPucchResourceSize + blankedPucch) / 2) … ulChBw (in PRBs) - 6 - roundup ((MaxPucchResourceSize + blankedPucch) / 2)) and 
   + ((ulChBw(in PRBs) – roundup (blankedPuccch/2)) ... ulChBw(in PRBs) – 6)

(5) If numUlNonAnchCarrierNB is not equal to '0' then blankedPucch must not be set to '0'

Note: MaxPucchResourceSize calculation is described under parameter nCqiRb.

For any two cells in the eNB, if (actMMimo is 'true') AND (resourceDN is the same) AND (earfcnDL is the same) AND (earfcnUL is the same), the two cell shall be called as dual-cell (two cells on the same carrier), all of following conditions must be fulfilled:
- prachConfIndex must have the same value in both cells
- dlChBw must have the same value in both cells
- selectPrachRegion parameter must have the same value in both cells
- blankedPucch parameter must have the same value in both cells

btsSyncMode.description:
This parameter defines the synchronization mode of the SBTS.

In frequency synchronized mode, the frequency of the radio interface signal is synchronized to the reference source and the phase of the frames on the radio interface is random. The frequency sync mode can be used in FDD systems when no features are used which require phase synchronization.

In phase synchronized mode (this mode is always used in TDD), the radio interface signal is frequency synchronized, and in addition, the start of the frames in the radio interface is phase synchronized to a time reference source. In FDD systems, phase sync mode must be configured when the features which require phase synchronization (for example: OTDOA, MBMS) are used. The phase synchronization requires that the reference source (valid for FDD and TDD) is either GNSSE (1pps/ToD from external GNSS receiver) or internal GNSS receiver (FSIH only) or 1pps/Tod from Sync Hub Master or ToPP,  and in case of hybrid synchronisation, additional SyncE sources are allowed.

In loose phase and time synchronized mode (FDD only), the radio interface signal is frequency synchronized, however the phase of the radio frames is synchronized to the time reference source with a certain accuracy. The BTS time contained in the BTS frame counter is loosely synchronized to the time reference source configured  (NTP, GNSS, BSC) (i.e. with relatively low accuracy).
btsSyncMode.notes:
Related functions: Synchronization Related parameters: MNL/MNLENT/FEATCADM - actHybridSynch
MNL/MNLENT/FEATCADM - rfSharingEnabled
MNL/MNLENT/SYNC/CLOCK/syncInputList - syncInputType
SMOD_EXT - syncMaster 1)  if btsSyncMode = LoosePhaseAndTimeSync then the parameter synInputList/syncInputType shall be set at least to : '1pps/ToD from Sync Hub Master' or '1pps/ToD from external GNSS receiver' or 'internal GNSS receiver' (or '1pps/ToD from backplane' dual core Airscale) or  '2.048MHz input' or  'PDH-1', or 'PDH-2', or 'SYNCE-1' or 'SYNCE-2' or  'TOPF' (and 'TRS' for lteBTS (legacy transport) instead of other transport sources)

2) if btsSyncMode = FreqSync  then  the parameter synInputList/syncInputType shall be set at least to : '1pps/ToD from Sync Hub Master' or '1pps/ToD from external GNSS receiver' or 'internal GNSS receiver' (or '1pps/ToD from backplane' dual core Airscale) or  '2.048MHz input' or  or 'PDH-1', or 'PDH-2', or 'SYNCE-1' or 'SYNCE-2' or  'TOPF' (and 'TRS' for lteBTS (legacy transport) instead of other transport sources)

3) if btsSyncMode = PhaseSync  then  the parameter synInputList/syncInputType shall be set to : '1pps/ToD from Sync Hub Master' or '1pps/ToD from external GNSS receiver' or 'internal GNSS receiver'  (or '1pps/ToD from backplane' dual core Airscale) or 'TOPP' (and 'TRS' for  LTE-only instead of other sources). Additionally one of following values has to be defined in syncInputList in case when actHybridSynch is set to 'true'
- SYNCE-1
- SYNCE-2

Case Sync Hub Direct Forwarding (SHDF) slave in RF sharing :
If rfSharingEnabled=true and synInputList/syncInputType = '1pps/ToD from Sync Hub Master BTS' and any SMOD_EXT-syncMaster = true then btsSyncMode must be configured to 'PhaseSync'

caIntraCellHoMode.description:
The following intra-cell handover modes to mFBI mapped or native frequency with carrier aggregation needs are supported:

disabled:
intra-cell handover to mFBI mapped or native frequency with CA needs is disabled.

nonCAtoCA:
Intra-cell handover will be performed if there is no CA band combination supported both by UE and eNB for current operating band of the PCell, while there are CA band combinations supported both by UE and ENB for another operating band of the PCell.

moreDLCACapacity:
The mode covers the 'nonCAtoCA' mode. In addition to 'nonCAtoCA' mode Intra-cell handover will be also performed if there are CA band combinations which have more potential DL CA aggregation bandwidth supported both by UE and eNB for PCell on another operating band than current operating band.

LNBTS_FDD - actMFBI
LNBTS_TDD - actMFBI If caIntraCellHoMode is set to a value other than  'disabled', all following conditions must be fulfilled:
- actDLCAggr must be 'true'.
- LNBTS_TDD-actMFBI must be 'true' If at least one LNCEL instance with cellTechnology set to 'TDD' exists and caIntraCellHoMode is set to a value other than  'disabled'.
- LNBTS_FDD-actMFBI must be 'true' If at least one LNCEL instance with cellTechnology set to 'FDD' exists and caIntraCellHoMode is set to a value other than  'disabled'.

This parameter controls scheduling fairness between UEs with and without activated SCell (S-LNCEL).

cellBarred.description:
The cell barred flag indicates if the cell status is barred or not. A barred cell is a cell that a UE is not allowed to camp on, not even for emergency calls. If a cell on which a UE is currently camped becomes barred, a cell reselection is triggered.

The setting is commonly valid for all legacy category UE and Cat-M UE.
Note: This parameter is used in NB-IoT cell also.

This parameter provides the value that classifies the cell capacity weight relative to other types of cells in the network. The Cell Capacity Class Value only indicates the relative weight of resources that are configured for traffic purposes.

cellMaxActiveMDTUEsTraced.description:
Defines the maximum number of active MDT UEs configured for MDT UE measurement reporting within a cell. This value is set by the operator at MDT trace session start.

Only UEs that enter the cell (Initial Context Setup, Handover or RRC re-establishment) can be selected for MDT, i.e. will be configured for periodic measurement of reportStrongestCell (RSRP/RSRQ of serving cell and neighbor cells).

Only UEs that were configured for periodic UE measurement reporting and did not reach the reportAmount are counted as active MDT UEs.  

UEs that were configured for periodic UE measurement reporting will continue to be traced after the last measurement report in an ImmediateMDTAndTrace session until the end of the call.

Also in case when the lcrId parameter is not set, i.e. the trace session is configured for all cells in the eNB, then this parameter cellMaxActiveMDTUEsTraced limits the number of active MDT UEs to be traced in each cell. This then limits the total number of MDT UEs traced per eNB as cellMaxActiveMDTUEsTraced multiplied by the number of cells in eNB. For the whole eNB operator shall not configure more than 900 UEs to be selected for LTE2202.
cellMaxActiveMDTUEsTraced.fullName: Cell maximum active MDT UEs traced
cellMaxActiveMDTUEsTraced.notes:
Related functions: Tracing Related parameters: MTRACE - actUeThroughputMR
MTRACE - cellMaxActiveUEsTraced
MTRACE - jobType If MTRACE-actUeThroughputMR is set to true and MTRACE-jobType = ImmediateMDTOnly or MTRACE-jobType = ImmediateMDTAndTrace then MTRACE-immedMDTControl-cellMaxActiveMDTUEsTraced must be <= 300.

If MTRACE-jobType = ImmediateMDTAndTrace then MTRACE-immedMDTControl-cellMaxActiveMDTUEsTraced must be <= MTRACE-cellMaxActiveUEsTraced
cellMaxActiveMDTUEsTraced.relatedFeatures: •  LTE3857 Combined Trace and PCMD reporting (Standard)

cellMaxActiveUEsTraced.description:
Defines the maximum number of active UE connections traced within a cell for a trace session. This value is set by operator at trace session start.

When maximum number of UEs that are traced for this trace session is reached in eNB, then eNB will continue to trace the currently traced UEs until the UEs leave the cell.
Also in case when the lcrId parameter is not set, i.e. the trace session is configured for all cells in the eNB, then this parameter cellMaxActiveUEsTraced limits the number of active UEs to be traced in each cell. This then limits the total number of UEs traced per eNB as cellMaxActiveUEsTraced multiplied by the number of cells in eNB. For the whole eNB operator shall not configure more than 900 UEs to be selected for LTE2202.

If jobType is "RLFReportsOnly" the parameter cellMaxActiveUEsTraced shall be ignored.

cellName.description:
This parameter allows the operator to give a cell a unique name.

The range represents the number of bytes to store all the characters of the string. If the string is UTF-8 encoded, each character occupies between 1 to 4 bytes, depending upon the language. Note: This parameter is used in NB-IoT cell also.

cellPwrRedForMBMS.description:
This parameter is used to set the power for MBSFN transmission together with antenna maximum TX power and cell power reduction (pMax, dlCellPwrRed).
The total power of MBSFN sub-frames would be cell maximum power - cell power reduction - cell power reduction for MBMS, or  pMax - dlCellPwrRed - cellPwrRedForMBMS.

Note that when defining the values for the pmax-dlCellPwrRed - cellPwrRedForMBMS relationship assume that average transmitted energy (averaged radio module output power) should not go under 25 dBm.
cellPwrRedForMBMS.fullName: Cell power reduction for MBMS transmission
cellPwrRedForMBMS.notes:
Related functions: MBMS Related parameters: CHANNEL - antlDN
CHANNEL - direction
LNBTS - actMBMS
LNCEL - cellPwrRedForMBMS
LNCEL - cellTechnology
LNCEL - pMax
LNCEL_FDD - actCombSuperCell
LNCEL_FDD - subCellConf-pMaxSubCell Definition in (1.x) are valid if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'FDD':
(1.1) If actCombSupercell is set to 'false', the maximum value of dlCellPwrRedMaxValue is calculated with the following formula:
dlCellPwrRedMaxValue [dB] = max((pMax[dBm] - RfmMinOutputPwr[dBm] + 10 * log10(1/6) + 10*log10(4/14)), 0)
- with 
           If actMBMS = false, 0 <= dlCellPwrRed <= dlCellPwrRedMaxValue
           If actMBMS = true, 0 <= dlCellPwrRed + cellPwrRedForMBMS <= dlCellPwrRedMaxValue

(1.2) If actCombSupercell is set to 'true', the maximum value of dlCellPwrRedMaxValue is calculated with the following formula:
dlCellPwrRedMaxValue [dB] = max((LNCEL_FDD-subCellConf-pMaxSubCell [dBm] - RfmMinOutputPwr[dBm] + 10 * log10(1/6) + 10*log10(4/14)), 0)
dlCellPwrRedMaxValue shall be calculated for all configured subcells with above formula and the lowest calculated dlCellPwrRedMaxValue shall be used for the following dependency: 
- with 
           If actMBMS = false, 0 <= dlCellPwrRed <= dlCellPwrRedMaxValue
           If actMBMS = true, 0 <= dlCellPwrRed + cellPwrRedForMBMS <= dlCellPwrRedMaxValue

Note:
- 10*log10(1/6) is considering of the worst case of no DL traffic, there is only common CRS
- 10*log10(4/14) is considering of in the worst case no DL traffic, only 4 OFDMA symbols get DL singnal
- RfmMinOutputPwr is the minimum output power of the related radio module in dBm. Below this power the signal is considered abnormally low for the radio module.

Definition in (2.x) are valid if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'TDD':
(2.1) The maximum value of dlCellPwrRedMaxValue is calculated with the following formula:
(2.1.1) without 8 pipe beamforming, i.e. if the related LCELL contains less than eight CHANNEL instances with parameter direction set to 'TX':
dlCellPwrRedMaxValue [dB] = max((pMax[dBm] - RfmMinOutputPwr[dBm] + 10 * log10(1/6) + 10*log10(4/14)), 0)
- with
           If actMBMS = false, 0 <= dlCellPwrRed <= dlCellPwrRedMaxValue
           If actMBMS = true, 0 <= dlCellPwrRed + cellPwrRedForMBMS <= dlCellPwrRedMaxValue

Note:
- 10*log10(1/6) is considering of the worst case of no DL traffic, there is only common CRS
- 10*log10(4/14) is considering of in the worst case no DL traffic, only 4 OFDMA symbols get DL singnal
- RfmMinOutputPwr is the minimum output power of the related radio module in dBm. Below this power the signal is considered abnormally low for the radio module.

(2.1.2) for 8 pipe beamforming, i.e. if the related LCELL contains eight CHANNEL instances with parameter direction set to 'TX', and those CHANNEL instances refer antenna lines (parameter antlDN in the same CHANNEL instance), which are contained in one radio module (RMOD MO):
dlCellPwrRedMaxValue [dB] = max((pMax[dBm] - RfmMinOutputPwr[dBm] -3 + 10 * log10(1/6) + 10*log10(4/14)), 0)
Note: '-3' here is for calibration power reduce

cellType.description:
This parameter allows the operator to specify the size of an LTE cell.

This parameter is used for preparing the UE History IE during an outgoing handover, according to LTE1768.

It will be also considered
if the feature LTE1140 'Intra-frequency load balancing' is activated for deriving the corresponding cellBeta co-efficient.
if the features LTE1113/1496 'eICIC macro'/'eICIC micro' are activated (when eICIC is enabled, macro cell should use ‘large’, micro cell should use ‘very small’, ‘small’ and ‘medium’).
if the feature LTE1768 'Mobility robustness optimization ping-pong' is activated (CellType is included in the UE History IE when preparing a X2 handover).
if the feature LTE1800 'Downlink interference shaping' is activated (when DL Interference shaping is enabled, macro cell should use ‘large’, micro cell should use ‘very small’, ‘small’ and ‘medium’).

(1.2) If (actDrx is 'true') AND (actEicic is 'true') AND (cellType is NOT 'large'), then following conditions must be fulfilled:
- if drxProfile3-drxLongCycle is '80', then drxProfile3-drxInactivityT must be greater than or equal to '20ms'.

Channel Bandwidth defines the Downlink and Uplink bandwidth for the eNode-B transmission in a cell, and also defines the number of available Physical Resource Blocks which is transmitted in the MIB. clockMode.description:
This parameter defines whether the clock mode to be advertised during autonegotiation is automatically determined (autodetect) by the system or the value defined by the user. 
The parameter is only valid for interfaces of type 1000Base-T.
The values are:
AUTODETECT: If the Ethernet interface is part of the synchronization priority list (syncInputType==SYNCE-x), then "single port device" is advertised with auto-neg, else "multi port device".
MANUAL MASTER: The Ethernet interface advertises during auto-neg "manual master", forcing its own clock mode to the master and link partner to slave. The link is kept down if the link partner advertises "manual master" as well.
MANUAL SLAVE: The Ethernet interface advertises during auto-neg "manual slave", forcing its own clock mode to the slave and link partner to master. The link is kept down if the link partner advertises "manual slave" as well.

Hardware variants and supported ports:
FSMF: EIF1
FTIF: EIF3, EIF4
ASIA: EIF3, EIF4, EIF5
FTIH: EIF3, EIF4

Note: In case the parameter is defined for a port which actually is not supported, the parameter will be ignored by the BTS

compClkSync.description:
This parameter enables the use of Timing over Packet (ToP) and Synchronous Ethernet (SyncE) to provide phase synchronization to an Flexi Zone Micro (FZM) or Flexi Zone Pico (FZP) where the recovered SyncE clock is used as the eNodeB clock after a phase solution has been established using ToP. This mode requires that all ToP Phase (TOPP MOC) and SyncE configuration parameters be properly populated. This parameter should only be set when operating in a Single Frequency Network (SFN) where the SFN Antenna (Ant) and SFN Master backhaul is directly connected to the ToP and SyncE master clock (i.e. no additional switches or routers are inserted between the ToP, SyncE master clock and SFN Master and Ant's).
The default value is 0 (false).
compClkSync.notes:
Related parameters: MRBTS/LNBTS/FTM - sfnPort: 
MRBTS/LNBTS/FTM/SYNC - actHybridSynch: 
MRBTS/LNBTS/FTM/SYNC/STPG - synchroSourceList-clockProtocol: SMOD-coreModuleSyncInputList:  If compClkSync is set to 'true', coreModuleSyncInputList must be set to: 5: transport reference source
Note:  coreModuleSyncInputList is configured in the radio domain and there is no parameter validation between the radio and transport domains.
STPG-synchroSourceList-clockProtocol:  When the compClkSync parameter is set to "true", the Timing over Packet (clkToP) and Synchronous Ethernet (clkSyncE) synchronization sources must be configured in the clockProtocol attribute of the STPG-synchroSourceList parameter.
SYNC-actHybridSynch:  If compClkSync is set to 'true', then actHybridSynch must be set to 'false'.
FTM-sfnPort: If compClkSync is set to 'true', then sfnPort must be set to a value not equal to 'none'.

The value is set to 0 if the device does not support reporting of the compliance code or if the test target is set to a radio module.
For test target not set to a radio module, this result indicates the electrical or optical interfaces that is provided by the transceiver.
The current supported compliance codes are “1000BASE-SX”, "1000BASE-LX" and "1000BASE-BX" 

See SFF-8472.

congWeightAlg.description:
The Parameter congWeightAlg defines a priorization behaviour in layer 2 (MAC) until either the congestion situation ends or until the congestion situation is resolved by higher layers. There are two different algorithms possible:
• qciPrio: Bearers are prioritized in order of their QCI priority.
• arpPrioPerVul: First bearers with ARP vulnerability "preemptable" are prioritized in order of the ARP priority, then the bearers with ARP vulnerability "not preemptable" also in order of ARP priority.
congWeightAlg.notes: Related functions: Radio Admission Control Related parameters: LNBTS - actEnhAcAndGbrServices If actEnhAcAndGbrServices is set to 'true' congWeightAlg is mandatory required.
