connectorLabel.description:
This parameter defines which connector of the HW shall be used.
The supported connectors depend on the hardware.
FSMF:
1.) If the modDN is referencing to a SMOD of type FSMF or FSMFA:
- A maximum of two Ethernet interfaces can be taken into use
- The usage depends on the configuration of the parameter portMode, which defines whether the port EIF2 / RF/6 shall be used as a transport interface.
    I.) If the portMode is set to "Ethernet", the following connectors can be selected.
        a.) EIF1 (RJ45)
        b.) EIF2 (SFP)
    II.) If the portMode is set to "RF", the following connector can be selected.
        a.) EIF1 (RJ45)
2.) If the modDN is referencing to a TRMOD  of type FTIF:
- A maximum of two Ethernet interfaces can be taken into use
- The usage depends on the configuration of the parameter portMode, which defines whether the port EIF1/EIF3 on the FTIF can be used.
    I.) If the portMode is set to "Ethernet", the following connectors can be selected.
        a.) EIF2 (SFP) or EIF4 (RJ45). The usage is mutually exclusive
    II.) If the portMode is set to "RF", the following connectors can be selected.
        a.) EIF1 (SFP) or EIF3 (RJ45). The usage is mutually exclusive 
        b.) EIF2 (SFP) or EIF4 (RJ45). The usage is mutually exclusive

ASIA or ASIAA (AirScale system module - Indoor):
A maximum of five Ethernet interfaces can be taken into use.
The supported values are:
EIF1 (SFP+), EIF2 (SFP+), EIF3 (RJ45), EIF4 (RJ45), EIF5 (RJ45)

FSIH:
1.) If the modDN is referencing to a SMOD of type FSIH:
- A maximum of three Ethernet interfaces can be taken into use.
- The usage depends on the configuration of the parameter portMode, which defines whether the port EIF5 / RF/6 shall be used as a transport interface.
    I.) If the portMode is set to "Ethernet", the following connectors can be selected.
        a.) EIF5
        b.) EIF1 (SFP) or EIF3 (RJ45). The usage is mutually exclusive  
        c.) EIF2 (SFP) or EIF4 (RJ45). The usage is mutually exclusive 
    II.) If the portMode is set to "RF", the following connectors can be selected.
        a.) EIF1 (SFP) or EIF3 (RJ45). The usage is mutually exclusive  
        b.) EIF2 (SFP) or EIF4 (RJ45). The usage is mutually exclusive 

In addition to the above exactly one instance of ETHLK can be created with the connectorLabel set to LMP1.

EIFx refers to the connector number as used on the label on the front plate.
SFP/RJ45 refers to the type of the connector.
SFP  refers to a "Small Form-factor Pluggable".
RJ45 Registerd Jack which is commonly used in telecommunications.
connectorLabel.fullName: Label of the connector by the Ethernet link
connectorLabel.notes:
Related parameters: ETHLK - connectorLabel
ETHLK - modDN
SMOD - portMode There must be no other ETHLK instance referencing the same connector.
FSMF:
1.) If the SMOD defined in modDN is of type FSMF or FSMFA:
    I.) If the portMode is set to "Ethernet", the following connectors can be selected:
        a.) EIF1
        b.) EIF2
    II.) If the portMode is set to "RF", the following connector can be selected:
        a.) EIF1
2.) If the modDN is referencing to a TRMOD (FTIF):
    I.) If the portMode is set to "Ethernet", the following connectors can be selected:
        a.) EIF2 or EIF4. The usage is mutually exclusive
    II.) If the portMode is set to "RF", the following connectors can be selected:
        a.) EIF1 or EIF3. The usage is mutually exclusive 
        b.) EIF2 or EIF4. The usage is mutually exclusive

AirScale:
1.) If the SMOD defined in modDN is of type ASIA or  ASIAA:
The supported values are:
EIF1, EIF2, EIF3,EIF4, EIF5

FSIH:
1.) If the SMOD defined in modDN is of type FSIH:
    I.) If the portMode is set to "Ethernet", the following connectors can be selected:
        a.) EIF5
        b.) EIF1 or EIF3. The usage is mutually exclusive  
        c.) EIF2 or EIF4. The usage is mutually exclusive 
    II.) If the portMode is set to "RF", the following connectors can be selected:
        a.) EIF1 or EIF3. The usage is mutually exclusive  
        b.) EIF2 or EIF4. The usage is mutually exclusive

In addition to the above: At maximum one instance of ETHLK can be created with the connectorLabel set to LMP1.

Cloud environment:
1.) If modDN is not defined:
The supported values are:
EIF1, EIF2, EIF3,EIF4, EIF5, EIF6, EIF7, EIF8, EIF9, EIF10

consecHoFailThres.description:
If for a LTE Neighbour Relation (NR) 'consecHoFailThres' consecutive handover execution failures are observed, then the eNB triggers a re-validation for this NR via CGI measurement (if CGI measurements are allowed).

If 'consecHoFailThres=0', then no re-validation is triggered.
Note: To limit the load due to re-validations, eNB triggers  re-validation only if at least some minimum wait time since last validation of the same NR has expired.

consecHoFailThres.relatedFeatures:

cqiAperEnable.description: O&M switch for enabling / disabling aperiodic CQI / RI / PMI reporting on PUSCH.
cqiAperEnable.fullName: Enable aperiodic CQI reporting on PUSCH
cqiAperEnable.notes:
Related functions: Scheduler (Uplink) Related parameters: LNBTS_FDD - actDlIntShaping
LNBTS_TDD - actDlIntShaping
LNCEL - cellTechnology
LNCEL_FDD - actUciOnlyGrants
LNCEL_FDD - actUnlicensedAcc
LNCEL_FDD - dlChBw
LNCEL_FDD - dlMimoMode
LNCEL_FDD - earfcnDL Conditions in (1.x) are valid if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'FDD':
(1.1) If dlChBw is set to '1.4 MHz', cqiAperEnable must be configured to 'false'.
(1.2) If actUciOnlyGrants is set to 'true', cqiAperEnable must be configured to 'true'.
(1.3) If actDlIntShaping in LNBTS_FDD is set to 'true', cqiAperEnable must be configured to 'true' in all LNCEL instances where dlChBw is set to larger or equal than '5MHz'.
(1.4) If actUnlicensedAcc is 'LAA' and earfcnDL belongs to an unlicensed band as defined at parameter actUnlicensedAcc, cqiAperEnable must be 'true'.
(1.5)If dlMimoMode is set to ('Closed Loop MIMO (8x2)'  OR 'Closed Loop MIMO (8x4)' ), cqiAperEnable must be set to 'true' .

Conditions in (2.x) are valid if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'TDD':
(2.1) If actDlIntShaping is set to 'true', cqiAperEnable must be configured to 'true'.

cqiPerNp.description:
Periodic CQI / PMI feedback reporting period
The parameter defines the periodicity of periodic CQI / PMI feedback on PUCCH or PUSCH.
cqiPerNp.notes:
Related functions: PHY/MAC Configuration (Uplink) Related parameters: CAREL - lcrId
LNBTS - actDLCAggr
LNCEL - lcrId
LNCEL_TDD - actAutoPucchAlloc
LNCEL_TDD - actTmSwitch
LNCEL_TDD - tddFrameConf
MPUCCH_TDD - maxNumRrc
MPUCCH_TDD - maxNumRrcEmergency
MPUCCH_TDD - riEnable
MPUCCH_TDD - riPerM
SDRX - drxSmartProfile2-drxOnDuratT
SDRX - drxSmartProfile2-drxShortCycle
SDRX - drxSmartProfile3-drxOnDuratT
SDRX - drxSmartProfile3-drxShortCycle
SDRX - drxSmartProfile4-drxOnDuratT
SDRX - drxSmartProfile4-drxShortCycle
SDRX - drxSmartProfile5-drxOnDuratT
SDRX - drxSmartProfile5-drxShortCycle
SDRX - drxSmartProfile6-drxOnDuratT
SDRX - drxSmartProfile6-drxShortCycle All of the following conditions are applicable in MPUCCH_TDD of the cell only if actAutoPucchAlloc is set to 'false'.

In case riEnable is set to 'true' AND riPerM is set to '1', cqiPerNp cannot be set to '5ms'.

For each DRX smart profile (x=2,3,4,5,6) the following conditions must be fulfilled:
(1) If drxSmartProfile[x]-drxOnDuratT is less than cqiPerNp
- 12*drxSmartProfile[x]-drxShortCycle must be less than 1000ms.

(2) If drxSmartProfile[x]-drxOnDuratT is greater or equal than cqiPerNp
- ceil(drxSmartProfile[x]-drxOnDuratT / cqiPerNp)*floor(1000ms / drxSmartProfile[x]-drxShortCycle) must be greater or equal than 12.

ceil() is the rounded up and floor() the rounded down integer value

For definitions regarding carrier aggregation used in below parameter relationships, please, see the definitions at parameter actDLCAggr.
(1) Pre-condition: actDLCAggr is set to 'true'.
(1.1) Following relationship needs to be fulfilled in the MPUCCH_TDD instance of the PCell and all MPUCCH_TDD instances of its related own SCells:
- riPerM must be configured identical, and must be set to '1' if cqiPerNp is set to '80ms'
(1.2) Following conditions need to be fulfilled in the MPUCCH_TDD instance if a cell is configured as a PCell:
- cqiPerNp is involved in consistency checks on maxNumRrc in the PCell, and detailed rules are defined in maxNumRrc.
- cqiPerNp is involved in consistency checks on maxNumRrcEmergency in the PCell, and detailed rules are defined in maxNumRrcEmergency.
- cqiPerNp must be <= '80ms', if riEnable is set to 'false',
- cqiPerNp must be >= '20ms', if tddFrameConf is set to '2',
- cqiPerNp must be >= '10ms', if tddFrameConf is set to '1'
- cqiPerNp must be >= '10ms', if actTmSwitch is set to 'true' and tddFrameConf is set to '1'.
- cqiPerNp must be >= '20ms', if actTmSwitch is set to 'true' and tddFrameConf is set to '2'.

csFallBPrio.description:
This parameter defines priority for target RAT in selection of redirection target during CS Fallback with redirection procedure.
Value 1 means highest priority and value 6 lowest.
csFallBPrio.fullName: Redirection priority for CS fallback with redirection
csFallBPrio.notes:
Related functions: Handover Control (Miscellaneous) Related parameters: LNBTS - act1xCsfb
LNBTS - actCSFBRedir
LNBTS - actIdleLB
LNCEL - cellTechnology
LNCEL - rttCsfbType
REDRT - csFallBPrio
REDRT - redirRat Conditions in (1.x) are valid if the cellTechnology of the parent LNCEL instance is configured to 'FDD' or 'TDD':
(1.1) (1.1) If actCSFBRedir is set to 'Enabled' following condition need to be fulfilled:
- at least one instance of REDRT instance must be created per LNCEL where csFallBPrio is configured
- if reDirRat is set to 'eutra', 'cdma20001xRTT' or 'cdma20001xHRPD', csFallBPrio shall not be specified.
(1.2) If actIdleLB is set to 'false' csFallBPrio must be unique for all REDRT instances belonging to same LNCEL.
(1.3) If act1xCsfb is set to 'true' and additionally for the LNCEL instance rttCsfbType is not set to 'forbidden' all of the following conditions need to be fulfilled
- at least one instance of REDRT with redirRAT 'cdma20001xRTT' must be created for this LNCEL with configured csFallBPrio
- in each additional REDRT instance with redirRAT 'cdma20001xRTT' csFallBPrio must be configured if emerCallPrio and redirectPrio are both not specified
- in each additional REDRT instance with redirRAT 'geran', 'eutra', 'utraFDD' or 'cdma2000HRPD' csFallBPrio must be configured.

Conditions in (2.x) are valid in addition to (1.x) if the cellTechnology of the parent LNCEL instance is configured to 'FDD':
(2.1) If actCSFBRedir is set to 'Enabled' and additionally redirRat is set to 'geran' or 'utraFDD' where in the REDRT instance both redirectPrio as well as emerCallPrio are not configured, then csFallBPrio must be configured.

Conditions in (3.x) are valid in addition to (1.x) if the cellTechnology of the parent LNCEL instance is configured to 'TDD':
(3.1) If actCSFBRedir is set to 'Enabled' and additionally redirRat is set to 'geran', 'utraFDD' or 'utraTDD' where in the REDRT instance both redirectPrio as well as emerCallPrio are not configured, then csFallBPrio must be configured.

dSrTransMax.description:
This is the maximum number of the allowed dedicated Scheduling Requests. Once this limit is exceeded, UE releases all PUCCH resources.  The value 4n corresponds to 4 transmissions, 8n corresponds to 8 transmissions and so on.

Indirectly provides the UE-specific maximum time within which the UE must receive a valid uplink grant for a new transmission on UL-SCH. If this time expires, the UE releases PUCCH resources and no longer performs a dedicated Scheduling Request, but instead performs a random access Scheduling Request. This time is calculated by cell Scheduling Request periodicity * dedicated SR transmission maximum.

daisyChainPort.description:
This parameter allows user to specify Ethernet link interface used for the daisy chain traffic.

dateCode.description:
This attribute provides the manufacturing date as reported by the Small Form-Factor Pluggable (SFP) transceiver device if the device is capable of providing this information. 
The value is set to NULL if the device does not support reporting of the manufacturing date.

Date code is in ASCII containing YYMMDDVV where
YY=two low order digits of year. (00=2000)
MM=digits of month (01=Jan through 12=Dec)
DD=day of month (01-31)
VV=vendor specific lot code, may be blank

See SFF-8472.

dayLt.description:
Defines the Daylight Savings Time (DST) offset that is used by the BTS to calculate its local time.

This parameter value, derived from TIME-timeZone,  indicates if and how daylight saving time (DST) is applied to obtain the local time.
0    No adjustment for Daylight Saving Time
1   +1 hour adjustment for Daylight Saving Time
2   +2 hours adjustment for Daylight Saving Time

It is broadcast in SIB16 and is sent in the Mobility Parameters CDMA2000 Information Element (IE) in the RRC_CONNECTED mode only when the dayLtIncluded parameter is set to TRUE.

defPagCyc.description:
The default paging cycle defines the cell-specific paging DRX cycle duration. It also determines the maximum paging DRX duration applicable in the cell. 
Referred to as ' T ' in TS 36.304. Value rf32 corresponds to 32 radio frames, rf64 corresponds to 64 radio frames and so on.
defPagCyc.notes:
Related functions: System Information Broadcast (Miscellaneous) Related parameters: LNBTS - actMBMS
LNCEL - cellTechnology
LNCEL_FDD - dlChBw
LNCEL_FDD - earfcnDL
LNCEL_TDD - chBw
LNCEL_TDD - earfcn
MBSFNSYNCAREA_FDD - mbsfnDlChBw
MBSFNSYNCAREA_FDD - mbsfnEarfcn
MBSFNSYNCAREA_TDD - mbsfnDlChBw
MBSFNSYNCAREA_TDD - mbsfnEarfcn
SIB - modPeriodCoeff Conditions in (1.x) are valid if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'FDD' or 'TDD':
(1.1) The product of parameter modPeriodCoeff and defPagCyc (given in rf) must not exceed 1024.

Conditions in (2.x) are valid in addition to (1.x) if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'FDD':
If actMBMS is set to 'true', for each LNCEL containing MBSFNCEL, where LNCEL_FDD-earfcnDL equal to MBSFNSYNCAREA_FDD-mbsfnEarfcn and LNCEL_FDD-dlChBw equal to MBSFNSYNCAREA_FDD-mbsfnDlChBw, LNCEL-defPagCyc must be the same.

Conditions in (3.x) are valid in addition to (1.x) if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'TDD':
If actMBMS is set to 'true', for each LNCEL containing MBSFNCEL, where LNCEL_TDD-earfcn equal to MBSFNSYNCAREA_TDD-mbsfnEarfcn and LNCEL_TDD-chBw equal to MBSFNSYNCAREA_TDD-mbsfnDlChBw, LNCEL-defPagCyc must be the same.

degreesOfLatitude.description:
Latitude in degrees (coded value)
Relation between coded Degrees of latitude N and range of absolute latitudes X (0° <= X <= 90°) it encodes is the following:

for 0 <= N <= 2^23-2:
N <= 2^23/90*X < N+1

for N = 2^23-1:
N <= 2^23/90*X <= N+1

According to above relation an encoded value N corresponds to a range of absolute latitudes X in degrees
degreesOfLatitude.notes: Related functions: BTS Site or Cell Configuration
degreesOfLatitude.source: Nokia SBTS 18A official SingleRAN AirScale parameter dictionary

degreesOfLongitude.description:
Longitude in degrees
(coded value)
Relation between coded Degrees of longitude N and range of absolute longitudes X (-180° <= X < +180°) it encodes is the following:

N <= 2^24/360*X < N+1

N is coded in 2's complement binary on 24 bits.

According to above relation an encoded value N corresponds to a range of absolute longitudes X in degrees
degreesOfLongitude.notes: Related functions: BTS Site or Cell Configuration

delayCompType.description:
This parameter controls the way cells are grouped by the BTS to support compensation of fiber length differences in case of CPRI-OBSAI protocol mix.

The possible values of delayCompType are:
ProtocolBased- Delay compensation groups are constructed of cells using the same protocol only.  Setting of distRefPoint is not allowed.
CellBased - Delay compensation groups are constructed of cells with mixed of protocols allowed. Delay compensation is calculated for cells inside a group but not between different groups. BTS tries to create as many groups as possible. (In case of reconfiguration, the BTS will minimize number of cells that need to be taken temporarily out of service. However, it is unavoidable to stop time dependent functions during the period of re-configuration.) Setting of distRefPoint is allowed. Using distRefPoint will further restrict the group creation to be within an FSP such as an ABIA.
delayCompType.notes:
Related functions: Site Management Related parameters: BBMOD - distRefPoint

deltaPucchShift.description:
Delta cyclic shift for PUCCH formats 1/1a/1b.
This is a delta cyclic shift for PUCCH formats 1/1a/1b. The shift is the cyclic shift difference between two adjacent ACK/NACK/Scheduling Request resources using the same orthogonal cover sequence and can be decided considering multipath delay spreads for the given cell deployment.
deltaPucchShift.notes:
Related functions: PHY/MAC Configuration (Uplink) Related parameters: LNBTS - actDLCAggr
LNCEL_FDD - actAutoPucchAlloc
LNCEL_FDD - dlChBw
MPUCCH_FDD - deltaPucchShift
MPUCCH_FDD - n1PucchAn
MPUCCH_FDD - nCqiRb All of the following conditions are applicable in MPUCCH_FDD of the cell only if actAutoPucchAlloc is set to 'false'.

deltaPucchShift is used in calculation of maxPucchResourceSize (calculation defined in nCqiRb).

deltaPucchShift must be configured to '1' if at least one of the following condition is fulfilled:
- n1PucchAns is set to '10'
- dlChBw is set to '1.4 MHz' or '3 MHz'

For definitions regarding carrier aggregation used in below parameter relationships, please, see the definitions at parameter actDLCAggr.
Following conditions need to be fulfilled in the MPUCCH_FDD instance if a cell is configured as a PCell:
Pre-conditition: actDLCAggr is 'true' in the parent LNBTS of the PCell.
- deltaPucchShift must be <= 2.

destIpAddress.description:
This parameter defines the destination IP address of the TWAMP session.
IPv4 and IPv6 addresses are supported.
IPv4 address format: Dot-decimal notation (x.x.x.x). Example: 10.10.10.10.
IPv6 address format: x:x:x:x:x:x:x:x. Example: ABCD:EF01:2345:6789:ABCD:EF01:2345:6789.
The IPv6 address has to be defined always in full length. Short formats are not supported.
destIpAddress.notes:
Related parameters: TNLSVC/TNL/IPAPP/TWAMP - sourceIpAddressDN
TWAMP - destIpAddress
TWAMP - destPort
TWAMP - messageSize
TWAMP - twampDscp
TWAMP - twampId 1.) The remote destIpAddress and  the local Ip address pointed by sourceIpAddressDN,  must be configured to use the same IP version (IPv4 or IPv6), 

2.) The combination of the configured values for destIpAddress, twampDscp, messageSize and destPort must be unique across all TWAMP instances, 

3.) The remote destIpAddress shall not match any local Ip address IPIF/IPADDRESSV4.locallIpAddr (IPIF/IPADDRESSV6.locallIpAddr)

4.) If IPv4 then destIpAddress must not match 
a.) loopback addresses 127.0.0.0 - 127.255.255.255, and 
b.) private addresses 192.168.253.0 - 192.168.255.255, and 
c.) 0.0.0.0, and 
d.) link local addresses 169.254.0.1 - 169.254.255.254.

5.) If IPv6 then destIpAddress must be inside the range
a.) global unicast only from 2000::/3 or 
b.) unique local unicast (FC00::/7).
destIpAddress.relatedFeatures:
•  SR000360 IP Transport Network Measurements (Standard)  
•  RC0249 Porting of legacy transport features for Cloud BTS (Standard)
destIpAddress.source: Nokia SBTS 18A official SingleRAN AirScale parameter dictionary

detectedClock.description:
This parameter indicates the detected clock mode with an electrical Ethernet interface operating at 1000Base-T technology. The displayed value enables to determine whether the negotiated clock mode of a 1000Base-T interface, fits to the expected clock mode, when using Synchronous Ethernet.
NOT_APPLICABLE is the value with all Ethernet technologies different than 1000Base-T 
CONFIGURATION FAULT signifies that both peers at the Ethernet link could not succesfully negotiate the clock mode.
MASTER means that the Ethernet interface is operating at master clock mode, driving the Ethernet signal with the clock of the BTS.
SLAVE means that the Ethernet interface is operating at slave clock mode, allowing to use the recovered clock from the Ethernet signal as potential sync source for BTS synchronization.

dlCaPreferred.description:
The parameter defines the preference for SCell addition in case of DL+UL carrier aggregation.
dlCaPreferred is used to decide whether to add an additional downlink SCell when that additional DL SCell will result in an existing DL+UL SCell being reconfigured as a DL only SCell.
dlCaPreferred = 'DLonly'
the eNB will choose to add the additional DL SCell and reconfigure the existing DL+UL SCell to DL only.
dlCaPreferred = 'DLandUL' 
the eNB will choose to keep the existing DL+UL SCell and will NOT add the additional DL Scell.
dlCaPreferred.notes: Related functions: Carrier Aggregation Related parameters: LNBTS - actULCAggr If actULCAggr is set to 'UL_CA_with_smartSched', dlCaPreferred must be configured.

dlCellPwrRed.description:
Sets the power reduction from the antenna maximum TX power.

Cell locking is not required if dlCellPwrRed  is changed by 0.2 dB or less. If the feature ‘Automatic Locking (LTE830)’ is activated, eNB will not perform cell locking in this case. 
The user can define a lower cell output power with the cell power reduction parameter. Reduction is deducted from the antenna maximum TX power.
Note: This parameter used for NB-IoT standalone cell.
Hint for TDD cell:
If dlCellPwrRed is modified by 0.2 dB or less, more often than 32 times within 3 hours, a valueTag overflow occurs. As consequence the changed System Information (SIB2 ff.) might sporadically not be read by UEs which come back to the cell and have stored valid system information from 3h validity rule viewpoint.
dlCellPwrRed.notes:
Related functions: Power Control (Downlink) Related parameters: CHANNEL - antlDN
CHANNEL - direction
LNBTS - actMBMS
LNCEL - cellPwrRedForMBMS
LNCEL - cellTechnology
LNCEL - pMax
LNCEL_FDD - actCombSuperCell
LNCEL_FDD - subCellConf-pMaxSubCell Definition in (1.x) are valid if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'FDD':
(1.1) If actCombSupercell is set to 'false', the maximum value of dlCellPwrRedMaxValue is calculated with the following formula:
dlCellPwrRedMaxValue [dB] = max((pMax[dBm] - RfmMinOutputPwr[dBm] + 10 * log10(1/6) + 10*log10(4/14)), 0)
- with 

         If actMBMS = false, 0 <= dlCellPwrRed <= dlCellPwrRedMaxValue
         If actMBMS = true, 0 <= dlCellPwrRed + cellPwrRedForMBMS <= dlCellPwrRedMaxValue

(1.2) If actCombSupercell is set to 'true', the maximum value of dlCellPwrRedMaxValue is calculated with the following formula:
dlCellPwrRedMaxValue [dB] = max((LNCEL_FDD-subCellConf-pMaxSubCell [dBm] - RfmMinOutputPwr[dBm] + 10 * log10(1/6) + 10*log10(4/14)), 0)
dlCellPwrRedMaxValue shall be calculated for all configured subcells with above formula and the lowest calculated dlCellPwrRedMaxValue shall be used for the following dependency: 
- with 

         If actMBMS = false, 0 <= dlCellPwrRed <= dlCellPwrRedMaxValue
         If actMBMS = true, 0 <= dlCellPwrRed + cellPwrRedForMBMS <= dlCellPwrRedMaxValue

Note:
- 10*log10(1/6) is considering of the worst case of no DL traffic, there is only common CRS
- 10*log10(4/14) is considering of in the worst case no DL traffic, only 4 OFDMA symbols get DL singnal
- RfmMinOutputPwr is the minimum output power of the related radio module in dBm. Below this power the signal is considered abnormally low for the radio module.

Definition in (2.x) are valid if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'TDD':
(2.1) The maximum value of dlCellPwrRedMaxValue is calculated with the following formula:
(2.1.1) without 8 pipe beamforming, i.e. if the related LCELL contains less than eight CHANNEL instances with parameter direction set to 'TX':
dlCellPwrRedMaxValue [dB] = max((pMax[dBm] - RfmMinOutputPwr[dBm] + 10 * log10(1/6) + 10*log10(4/14)), 0)
- with
           If actMBMS = false, 0 <= dlCellPwrRed <= dlCellPwrRedMaxValue
           If actMBMS = true, 0 <= dlCellPwrRed + cellPwrRedForMBMS <= dlCellPwrRedMaxValue

Note:
- 10*log10(1/6) is considering of the worst case of no DL traffic, there is only common CRS
- 10*log10(4/14) is considering of in the worst case no DL traffic, only 4 OFDMA symbols get DL singnal
- RfmMinOutputPwr is the minimum output power of the related radio module in dBm. Below this power the signal is considered abnormally low for the radio module.

(2.1.2) With 8 pipe beamforming, i.e. if the related LCELL contains eight CHANNEL instances with parameter direction set to 'TX', and those CHANNEL instances refer antenna lines (parameter antlDN in the same CHANNEL instance), which are contained in one radio module (RMOD MO):
dlCellPwrRedMaxValue [dB] = max((pMax[dBm] - RfmMinOutputPwr[dBm] -3 + 10 * log10(1/6) + 10*log10(4/14)), 0)
Note: '-3' here is for calibration power reduce
(2.3) dlCellPwrRed range is limited to maximal 10 dB

dlChBw.description:
Downlink channel bandwidth defines the DL bandwidth for the eNode-B transmission in a cell, and also defines the number of available Physical Resource Blocks.
The downlink channel bandwidth mapping to number of Physical Resource Blocks is:
1.4 MHz = 6 DL PRBS
3.0 MHz = 15 DL PRBS
5.0 MHz = 25 DL PRBS 
10.0 MHz = 50 DL PRBS 
15.0 MHz = 75 DL PRBS
20.0 MHz = 100 DL PRBS

eNB will dynamically decide dependent on the current and newly required DSP deployment if eNB restart or dropping of all cells is needed.

Following configuration rules need to be considered:

FSMD:
maximum downlink channel bandwidth is 10 MHz if more than 2 cells are configured.

FSME: 
maximum downlink channel bandwidth is 10 MHz if more than 3 cells are configured.

Cell bandwidth 1.4 MHz:
- is not supported with FSMD/FSME

If a 'SuperCell' is activated (actSuperCell set to 'true') the bandwidth usage is limited to 5 MHz, 10 MHz, 15 MHz and 20 MHz.

UFFIM - utrFddCarFrqL (1) Following limitations do exist dependent on the activated feature:
(1.1) if actHighRrc is set to 'true' dlChBw must be configured to '15 MHz' or '20 MHz'
(1.2) dlChBw cannot be configured to '1.4 MHz' or '3 MHZ' if
- actIntraFreqLoadBal is set to 'true'
- actNbrForNonGbrBearers in the LNCEL instance is set to 'true'
- actBbPooling is set to 'true'
(1.3) dlChBw cannot be configured to '1.4 MHz' if actAmle is set to 'true' in the related LNCEL instance
(1.4) dlChBw cannot be configured to '1.4 MHz' if actLdPdcch is set to 'true' in the related LNCEL instance; for dlChBw configured to a value larger than '1.4 MHz' the allowed value of actLdPdcch still depends on the configured values for parameters phichDur and maxNrSymPdcch (all in the same LNCEL instance; for details please refer to those parameters)

(2) The configured UL and DL channel bandwidth (ulChBw, dlChBw) must be identical per LNCEL_FDD.

(3) For cells with a configured dlChBw greater than or equal to '5 MHz' following constraints exist
- the ranges of the following parameters depend on the channel bandwidth: maxNumRrcEmergency, addEmergencySessions, maxNumActUE, addNumDrbRadioReasHo, addNumDrbTimeCriticalHo, maxNumQci1Drb, addNumQci1DrbRadioReasHo, addNumQci1DrbTimeCriticalHo, addAUeRrHo, addAUeTcHo, nCqiRb, prsBandwidth (for details please refer to those parameter)
- the maximal allowed number of configurable GNFL instances depends on the configured DL channel bandwidth and the maximum code rate
- the number of IRFIM instances and the allowed sum of all inter frequency neighbor (intFrNCList) and blacklisted cells (intFrBCList) depend on the configured downlink channel bandwidth (for details please refer to: intFrNCList and intFrBCList in IRFIM)
- If act1xSrvcc is set to 'true' then csfbRegParam1xRtt must be configured in the subordinate CDFIM instance
- If actHOtoHrpd is set to 'true' then hoRegParamHrpd must be configured in the subordinate CDFIM instance
- the maximum allowed value of pdcchAggRarespHo depends on the channel bandwidth and maxNrSymPdcch (for details, please refer to pdcchAggRarespHo definition)

(3.1) If cellResourceSharingMode is not set to 'none' the minimum allowed value for dlChBw is '10 Mhz'.

(3.2) If (actDlIsh is 'true' OR amountBlankedRes > '0', dlChBw cannot be configured to '1.4 MHz' or '3 MHz'.

(3.3) if actHOtoHrpd is set to 'true', structure hoRegParamHrpd must be configured in all CDFIM instances whose cell bandwidth dlChBw is equal to or bigger than '5MHz'

(4) For cells with dlChBw equal to '1.4 MHz' or '3 MHz' the following constraints exist:
- hoRegParamHrpd must NOT be configured in the cell related CDFIM instance
- LNHOH instances must NOT be created for such cell.

- the maximum number of GNFL instances for idle mode mobility to GSM depends on the configured code rate maxCrSibDl
- the maximum number of utrFddCarFrqL list items in UFFIM instance for idle mode mobility to WCDMA depends on the configured code rate maxCrSibDl
- the maximum total number of hrpdNCList and rttNCList list items in CDFIM instance for idle mode mobility to CDMA2000 depends on the configured code rate maxCrSibDl
- positioning reference signals (OTDOA) are not supported, i.e. actOtdoa must be configured to 'false'
- the number of IRFIM instances and the allowed sum of all inter frequency neighbor (intFrNCList) and blacklisted cells (intFrBCList) depend on the configured downlink channel bandwidth (for details please refer to: intFrNCList and intFrBCList in IRFIM)
- due to the small bandwidth several restrictions apply for configuration of
> SIB (for details please refer to: sib2Scheduling/sib3Scheduling/sibSchedulingList-[siMessagePeriodicity, siMessageRepetition, siMessageSibType], siWindowLen, maxCrSibDl , acBarCsfbOc , acBarMMTelVideoOc , acBarMMTelVoiceOc , acBarOc , acBarSig)
> number of PLMN Ids per cell (for details please refer to: furtherPlmnIdL)
> admission control limits (for details please refer to: addAUeRrHo, addAUeTcHo, addNumDrbRadioReasHo, addNumDrbTimeCriticalHo, maxNumRrc, maxNumRrcEmergency, maxNumActDrb)
> scheduling (please refer to: maxNumUeDl, redBwMaxRbDl, redBwRpaEnUl, redBwEnDl, pdcchAggDefUe, pdcchAggMsg4, pdcchAggPaging, pdcchAggPreamb, pdcchAggRaresp, pdcchAggSib, deltaPucchShift, dlsUsePartPrb, enablePcPdcch, maxNrSymPdcch, n1PucchAn, phichRes, maxNumUeUl, maxNumUeDl, pdcchAggRarespHo)
> power boosting of control channels (please refewr to: dlPcfichBoost, dlPhichBoost , dlRsBoost)
> CQI and RI reporting (for details please refer to: riPerM, riPerOffset, cqiPerNp, cqiAperEnable, periodicCqiFeedbackType)
- if additionally actDLCAggr in the parent instance of LNBTS is 'true', then the parent instance of LNCEL
-- must not get any CAREL configured.

(5) For cells with dlChBw set to '3 MHz' following additional condition need to be fulfilled:
- for LTE intra-frequency and GSM idle mode mobility (created IAFIM resp. GNFL instance) maxCrSibDl >= 0.08
- if additionally act1xCsfb is set to 'true' and LTE3145 is enabled(see note1), rttCsfbType for the cell must be set to 'forbidden',
- if LTE3145 is enabled(see note1), csfbRegParam1xRtt must NOT be configured in the cell related CDFIM instance.
- if LTE3145 is enabled(see note1), LNHOX instances must not be created


- if maxCrSibDl is less than 0.12, no acbPrimaryPlmnProfileId and no acbFurtherPlmnProfileId can be configured; if maxCrSibDl is equal to or larger than 0.19, the number of acbPrimaryPlmnProfileId +acbFurtherPlmnProfileId <=3 per LNCEL; if maxCrSibDl is equal to or larger than 0.26, the number of acbPrimaryPlmnProfileId +acbFurtherPlmnProfileId <=6 per LNCEL.


(6) For cells with dlChBw equal to '1.4 MHz' following additional conditions need to be fulfilled:
- inter frequency load balancing is not supported, i.e. actInterFreqLB must be configured to 'false'
- TTI bundling is not supported, i.e. actTtiBundling must be configured to 'false'
- for idle mode mobility to GSM (created GNFL instance) maxCrSibDl > 0.11
- for idle mode mobility to CDMA2000 (created CDFIM instance) maxCrSibDl > 0.11
- if additionally act1xCsfb is set to 'true' rttCsfbType for the cell must be set to 'forbidden'
- csfbRegParam1xRtt must NOT be configured in the cell related CDFIM instance
- for LTE intra-frequency idle mode mobility (created IAFIM instance) maxCrSibDl >= 0.11
- the allowed sum of all intra frequency neighbor (intrFrNCList) and blacklisted cells (intrFrBCList) in the IAFIM instance depends the configured code rate
- access barring for originating calls and signaling is only supported if maxCrSibDl is < 0.21, i.e. acBarOc and acBarSig must not be configured
- access barring for mobile originating CS fallback and MMTEL video and voice originating calls is only supported if maxCrSibDl is < 0.24, i.e. acBarCsfbOc, acBarMMTelVideoOc and acBarMMTelVoiceOc must not be configured
- due to the small bandwidth several restrictions apply for configuration of
> DRX (for details please refer to: applyOutOfSyncState, drxOnDuratT)
> link quality control (for details please refer to: eUlLaLowPrbThr)
- actDlSlimCarrier must be set to 'false'
- if maxCrSibDl is less than 0.26, no acbPrimaryPlmnProfileId and no acbFurtherPlmnProfileId can be configured; if maxCrSibDl is equal to or larger than 0.26, 1 acbPrimaryPlmnProfileId or 1 acbFurtherPlmnProfileId can be configured.
- LNHOX instances must not be created.


(7) For 'Multiple Frequency Band Indicator' cases, i.e. at least one MFBIPR instance is created
The additional frequency band defined by addFreqBandInd and the frequency band of all LNCEL instances having same EARFCN than the profile (i.e. MFBIPR-eutraCarrierFreq is equal to LNCEL_FDD-earfcnDL) must fully overlap.
This mean all frequencies within the cell bandwidth (dlChBw) must be fully within the additional frequency band (addFreqBandInd).
For frequency band definitions see table 5.7.3-1 in 3GPP TS36.104.

(8) If actSuperCell is set to 'true', dlChBw must be set to '5 MHz', '10 MHz', '15 MHz' or '20 MHz'.
If actLiquidcell is set to 'true', dlChBw must be set to '10 MHz', '15 MHz' or '20 MHz'.

(9) The conditions for MBMS activation (see parameter actMBMS) must be fulfilled as far as the cell shall be used for MBMS broadcasting, i.e. if LNCEL_FDD-earfcnDL and LNCEL_FDD-dlChBw match with MBSFNSYNCAREA_FDD-mbsfnEarfcn and MBSFNSYNCAREA_FDD-mbsfnDlChBw, and LNCEL contains an MBSFNCEL.

(10) If csgType is set to 'CSG' then dlChBw must be set to '5 MHz', '10 MHz', '15 MHz' or '20 MHz'.

(11) If dlChBw is set to '3 MHz', maxPrbHighPrioUciGrant must be set to set to one of the following values: 4, 5, 6, 7, 8.
If dlChBw is set to a value greater than '3 MHz', maxPrbHighPrioUciGrant must be set to a value in following range: 4...20.

(12) if dlChBw is set to '1.4 MHz', prachConfIndex cannot have value in range (51..56).

(13) SIB-sibSchedulingList-siMessageSibType cannot be set to SIB16 if dlChBw is equal to '1.4 MHz' or '3 MHz'.

(14) If actCatM is set to 'true', dlChBw must be set to '5 MHz', '10 MHz', '15 MHz' or '20 MHz'.

(15) If actMBMS is set to 'true', for each LNCEL containing MBSFNCEL, where LNCEL_FDD-earfcnDL equal to MBSFNSYNCAREA_FDD-mbsfnEarfcn and LNCEL_FDD-dlChBw equal to MBSFNSYNCAREA_FDD-mbsfnDlChBw all following conditions must be fulfilled:
- SIB-modPeriodCoeff must be the same
- LNCEL-defPagCyc must be the same.

(16) If actRedFreqOffset is set to 'true', for dlChBw of '5 MHz', '10 MHz', '15 MHz' and '20 MHz':
- if dlChBw is set to '5 MHz', redFreqOffset must be set within the value range: 2.3, 2.4, 2.5
- if dlChBw is set to '10 MHz', redFreqOffset must be set within the value range: 4.6, 4.7, 4.8, 4.9, 5.0
- if dlChBw is set to '15 MHz', redFreqOffset must be set within the value range: 6.8, 6.9, 7.0, 7.1, 7.2, 7.3, 7.4, 7.5
- if dlChBw is set to '20 MHz', redFreqOffset must be set within the value range: 9.1 to 10, step 0.1

(17) For any two cells in the eNB, if (actMMimo is 'true') AND (resourceDN is the same) AND (earfcnDL is the same) AND (earfcnUL is the same), the two cell shall be called as dual-cell (two cells on the same carrier), all of following conditions must be fulfilled:
-prachConfIndex must have the same value in both cells
-dlChBw must have the same value in both cells
-selectPrachRegion parameter must have the same value in both cells
-blankedPucch parameter must have the same value in both cells

(18) For definitions regarding carrier aggregation used in below parameter relationships, please, see the definitions at parameter actDLCAggr.
Following conditions need to be fulfilled, if a cell is configured as a PCell:
Pre-condition: actDLCAggr is 'true' in the parent LNBTS of the PCell.
for each PCell, the PCell and all related own SCells with LNCEL_FDD-dlChBw unequal to 1.4 MHz, must have the same value configured for
(18.1) - rcEnableDl
(18.2) - rcEnableUl

LTE3145 enabled = actDlSlimCarrier is set to "true" and ( numBlankDlPrbsUp+ numBlankDlPrbsDown >0 )

dlInterferenceEnable.description: The parameter dlInterferenceEnable is used for enabling and disabling interference generation in downlink.

dlInterferenceSpatialMode.description:
This parameter specifies the spatial mode for the downlink interference.

If dlMimoMode is set to 'SingleTX' then one element of the structure must be present with dlInterferenceSpatialMode 'SingleTx'.
If dlMimoMode is set to 'TXDiv', '4-way TXDiv', 'Dynamic Open Loop MIMO' , 'Closed Loop Mimo', 'Closed Loop MIMO (4x2)' or 'Closed Loop MIMO (4x4)' then one element of the structure must be present with dlInterferenceSpatialMode 'TXDiv'.
If dlMimoMode is set to 'Single Stream Beamforming' or 'Dual Stream Beamforming' or 'Closed Loop MIMO (8x4)' then both elements of the structure must be present, one with dlInterferenceSpatialMode 'TXDiv' and the other with dlInterferenceSpatialMode 'Single Stream Beamforming'.
dlInterferenceSpatialMode.notes:
Related functions: DL Interference Generation Related parameters: LNCEL_TDD - dlMimoMode dlInterferenceSpatialMode must be set to 'Single Tx':
- if dlMimoMode is set to 'SingleTX'.

dlInterferenceSpatialMode must be set to 'TXDiv':
- if dlMimoMode is set to 'TXDiv', '4-way TXDiv', 'Dynamic Open Loop MIMO', 'Closed Loop Mimo', 'Closed Loop MIMO (4x2)' or 'Closed Loop MIMO (4x4)'.

dlInterferenceSpatialMode must be set to 'TXDiv' or 'Single Stream Beamforming':
- if dlMimoMode is set to 'Single Stream Beamforming' or 'Dual Stream Beamforming' or 'Closed Loop MIMO (8x4)'.
dlInterferenceSpatialMode.relatedFeatures:

•  LTE1987 CRL8461 Downlink Adaptive Close Loop SU MIMO (4x4) - TM9 (Standard)

dlMimoMode.notes:
Related functions: NB-IoT Related parameters: LNCEL - cellTechnology
LNCEL - nbIoTMode
LNCEL_FDD - dlMimoMode
NBIOT_FDD - syncSigTxMode (1) If nbIoTMode is set to ‘inband' or 'guardband', all of the following conditions need to be fullfilled
(1.1) if dlMimoMode of host LTE cell is set to 'TXDiv', ‘Dynamic Open Loop MIMO’, or ‘Closed Loop Mimo’ then dlMimoMode of NB-IoT cell must be set to “TXDiv”
(1.2) if dlMimoMode of host LTE cell is set to '4-way TXDiv', ‘Closed Loop MIMO (4x2)' or 'Closed Loop MIMO (4x4)' then dlMimoMode of NB-IoT cell must be set to “Duplicated TXDiv”
(1.3) if dlMimoMode of host LTE cell is set to 'SingleTx' then dlMimoMode of inband or guardband NB-IoT cell must be set to “SingleTx”

(2) If nbIoTMode is set to 'standalone', all of the following conditions need to be fullfilled
(2.1) if dlMimoMode is set to “SingleTx”, the CHANNELGROUP/CHANNEL instances belonging to this NB-IoT LNCEL instance must contain only one TX resource and two or four RX resource.
(2.2) if dlMimoMode is set to “TXDiv”, the CHANNELGROUP/CHANNEL instances belonging to this NB-IoT LNCEL instance must contain only two TX resources and two or four RX resource.
(2.3) if dlMimoMode is set to “Duplicated TXDiv”, the CHANNELGROUP/CHANNEL instances belonging to this NB-IoT LNCEL instance must contain only four TX resources and four RX resource.

(3) if dlMimoMode is set to “SingleTx”, syncSigTxMode must be set to 'SingleTx'
dlMimoMode.relatedFeatures:
•  LTE3543 NB-IoT Standalone (Standard)  
•  LTE3722 NB-IoT: Additional configurations (Standard)  
•  LTE4499 NB-IoT Guardband - single carrier (Standard)

dlSectorBFWeightProfName.description:
This parameter identifies the name of the downlink sector beamforming weight profile.
There are two types of the downlink sector beamforming weight profiles.
One is "predefined profile" and another is "customized profile".
"predefined profile" means the downlink sector beamforming weights shall be set as the predefined values per the specific antenna type(according to antenna spec).
"customized profile" means the operator can set the downlink sector beamforming weights via O&M interface.
Each profile name maps to the downlink sector beamforming weight of the specific antenna type(predefined profile) or the customized sector beamforming weight profile.
dlSectorBFWeightProfName.fullName: Downlink sector beamforming weight profile name
dlSectorBFWeightProfName.notes:
Related functions: Beamforming (Antenna configuration) Related parameters: LNBTS_TDD - dlSectorBFWeightCusProf
LNCEL_TDD - dlSectorBeamformingMode If dlSectorBeamformingMode is set to 'Sector Beamforming with static weights' dlSectorBFWeightProfName is mandatory required, otherwise dlSectorBFWeightProfName is not applicable.

If dlSectorBFWeightProfName is set to 'customized profile 1' ... 'customized profile 20' the dlSectorBFWeightCusProf must be configured with the requested customized profile number, otherwise dlSectorBFWeightCusProf is not applicable.

dlpcMimoComp.description:
Sets the compensation in 'TXDiv', '4-way TXDiv', 2x2 MIMO SM, 4x2 MIMO SM , 4x4 MIMO SM, 8x4 MIMO SM case into the DL power control.
Compensation of MIMO Coverage effects for MIMO Spatial Multiplexing and MIMO Diversity 
The parameter determines the power compensation factor for antenna-specific maximum power in case of a downlink transmission using at least two TX antennas. This means that every single subcarrier power determined for multiple TX antenna transmission is reduced by this factor. The parameter does not apply in case of a single TX (TM1) transmission, and thus neither affects the power of cell-specific reference signal transmission. Note that only the limited set of dlpcMimoComp values (-3dB, 0dB, 1.77dB, 3dB, 4.77dB, 6dB) can be communicated to the UE due to p-a signaling restrictions and the extended range has been determined only for finetuning purposes. Please be informed that Nokia does not quarantee a successful DL transmission using amplitude dependent modulations, especially 64QAM, if other values than the values presented in the limited set (-3dB, 0dB, 1.77dB, 3dB, 4.77dB, 6dB) are used. 
Please note, that if the Cell-Specific Reference Symbol Power Boost is activated by setting the dlRsBoost parameter, only the values 0dB and 3dB are allowed for dlpcMimoComp.
dlpcMimoComp.notes:
Related functions: Power Control (Downlink) Related parameters: LNCEL_TDD - dlDynPcRange
LNCEL_TDD - dlMimoMode
LNCEL_TDD - dlRsBoost If dlMimoMode is set different to 'Single TX' dlpcMimoComp must be configured.
dlpcMimoComp value range is restricted to values '0 dB' and '3 dB', when dlRsBoost is configured to another value than '0dB'

If dlpcMimoComp is set to '3dB', dlDynPcRange value range must be less than or equal to '3dB'. 
If dlDynPcRange is configured to another value than '0dB' and 'OFF', dlpcMimoComp value range is restricted to values '0 dB' and '3 dB'.

dlsDciCch.description:
Parameter to configure whether common channel signalling (SI, paging RACH ) use DCI format 1A or 1C on PDCCH.

If the value of the parameter is set to 'DCI format 1C' distributed VRBs are used for SI, paging and RACH.

If the value of the parameter is set to 'DCI format 1A' localized (not distributed) VRBs are used for SI, paging and RACH.
dlsDciCch.fullName: DCI format for common channel transmission
dlsDciCch.notes:
Related functions: Power Control (Downlink) Related parameters: CATMCEL - numCELevelCatM
CSBIA - csBIACellList
IRFIM - intFrBCList
IRFIM - intFrNCList
IRFIM - irfimId
LNBTS - actMBMS
LNBTS_TDD - actCsBIA
LNCEL - cellTechnology
LNCEL_FDD - actCatM
LNCEL_FDD - actDlSlimCarrier
LNCEL_TDD - dlsSchedType
NBIOT_FDD - numDlNonAnchCarrierNB Conditions in (1.x) are valid if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'FDD':
(1.1) actDlSlimCarrier of the subordinate LNCEL_FDD instance can be set to 'true' only if dlsDciCch is set to 'DCI format 1A'.
(1.2) If (actMBMS is set to 'true' and in the LNCEL instances containing MBSFNCEL) and the subordinate LNCEL_FDD instance actCatM is set to 'true', dlsDciCch must be set to 'DCI format 1A'.
(1.3)  the number of IRFIM instances and the number of list items in intFrBCList and intFrNCList  depend among others on used DCI format (for details please refer to the definition in inFrNCList and inFrBCList).
(1.4) If actCatM is set to 'true' and numCELevelCatM is set to '3' or '4', dlsDciCch must be set to 'DCI format 1A'.
(1.5)  if nbIoTMode is set to 'inband' and numDlNonAnchCarrierNB is not equal to '0' then dlsDciCch must be set to 'DCI format 1A'.

Conditions in (2.x) are valid if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'TDD':
(2.1) If dlsSchedType is set to DVRB, dlsDciCch must be set to 'DCI format 1C'.
(2.2) If actCsBIA is set to 'true' dlsDciCch must be set to 'DCI format 1A' for each cell in the csBIACellList.
(2.3) the number of IRFIM instances and the number of list items in intFrBCList and intFrNCList  depend among others on used DCI format (for details please refer to the definition in inFrNCList and inFrBCList).

dpddelay.description:
This parameter specifies the delay between the sending of two consecutive DPS INFORMATIONAL messages by the BTS. The INFORMATIONAL message indicates the BTS is still alive.
For IKEv2, the BTS raises the Dead Peer Detected (DPD) alarm if the remote peer has not sent any INFORMATIONAL message to the BTS after the BTS has sent a fixed number of INFORMATIONAL messages. 
For IKEv1 the BTS raises the DPD alarm, if the remote peer has not sent back any INFORMATIONAL messages after the time defined in the parameter dpdtimeout has expired.

(2.2) drxProfile101-drxRetransT must be greater than or equal to 8 if actMBMS is equal to 'true', maxSyncSubfrPShare in MBSFNSYNCAREA_FDD is greater than '30.000%' AND less than or equal to '40.000%', earfcnDL in LNCEL_FDD of this cell is equal to mbsfnEarfcn in MBSFNSYNCAREA_FDD and dlChBw in LNCEL_FDD of this cell is equal to mbsfnDlChBw in same MBSFNSYNCAREA_FDD.

Related functions: DRX (Smart DRX Profile) Related parameters: LNCEL - actQci1eVTT

SDRX - drxSmartProfile2-drxOnDuratT Conditions in (1.x) are valid if the cellTechnology of the parent LNCEL instance is configured to 'FDD' or 'TDD':
(1.1) If (actQci1eVTT is 'true') AND (actSmartDrx is 'true') then drxSmartProfile2-drxLongCycle must be equal to drxSmartProfile2-drxShortCycle.

Conditions in (2.x) are valid in addition to (1.x) if the cellTechnology of the parent LNCEL instance is configured to 'FDD':
All of the following conditions in (2.1.x) are applicable in MPUCCH_FDD of the cell only if actAutoPucchAlloc is set to 'false'.
(2.1) Following conditions need to be fulfilled based on the value settings of drxSmartProfile2-drxOnDuratT and cqiPerNp (calculation in cqiPerNp):
(2.1.1) If drxSmartProfile2-drxOnDuratT < cqiPerNp then 12*drxShortCycle < 1000ms.
(2.1.2) If drxSmartProfile2-drxOnDuratT >= cqiPerNp then ceil(drxOnDuratT / cqiPerNp)*floor (1000ms / drxShortCycle) >= 12.

Conditions in (3.x) are valid in addition to (1.x) if the cellTechnology of the parent LNCEL instance is configured to 'TDD':
All of the following conditions in (3.1.x) are applicable in MPUCCH_TDD of the cell only if actAutoPucchAlloc is set to 'false'.
(3.1) Following conditions need to be fulfilled based on the value settings of drxSmartProfile2-drxOnDuratT and cqiPerNp (calculation in cqiPerNp):

eIcicAbsAdaptationBeta.description:
This parameter is used in the ABS adaptation algorithm as a weighting factor to bias towards more or less ABS.
Though possible, it is not recommended to set this parameter to values higher than 2. The higher the value of this parameter, the more seldom the switch to a higher ABS pattern will occur.
The impact of this parameter on the ABS adaptation result is closely related to the number of established eICIC partnerships. Example: eIcicAbsAdaptationBeta = 1 and four established partnerships results to the same algorithm outcome as eIcicAbsAdaptationBeta = 2 and eight established partnerships.
eIcicAbsAdaptationBeta.notes:
Related functions: Handover Control (Inter RAT CDMA2000) Related parameters: LNCEL - actEicic
LNCEL - cellType This parameter must be configured only if actEicic is 'true' AND cellType is set to 'large'.
eIcicAbsAdaptationBeta.source: Nokia SBTS 18A official SingleRAN AirScale parameter dictionary

eIcicCreDelta.description:
This parameter is used in the scheduler for tagging UE’s location w.r.t cell’s range expansion (CRE) area based on the non-ABS related CQI value. The sum of this parameter and the non-ABS related CQI value determined by the DL link adaptation sets the CQI threshold for UEs tagged as 'CRE' to be re-tagged as 'non-CRE'. 
Said tagging is used in the prioritized scheduling of UEs during ABSs.

eIcicCreDelta.notes:
Related functions: Interference Mitigation Related parameters: LNCEL - actEicic

eIcicMaxCre.description:
This parameter determines the maximum allowed CIO adjustment, i.e., the maximum cell range expansion for the eICIC partner cells, equal for all eICIC partners. Once this value is reached, only reducing the CIO adjustment is allowed.

For applyFecicFunctionality = 'false', the maximum allowed value is 6dB. For applyFecicFunctionality = 'true', a value larger than 8 dB is recommended in order to exploit the FeICIC capabilities of R11 UEs.
eIcicMaxCre.notes:
Related functions: Interference Mitigation Related parameters: LNCEL - actEicic
LNCEL - cellType eIcicMaxCre is mandatory, if (actEicic is 'true') AND (cellType is 'large').
If applyFeicicFunctionality is set to 'false', value of this parameter must be smaller than or equal to 6.
eIcicMaxCre.relatedFeatures: •  LTE2210 Multi-Vendor intra-frequency load balancing extension (Standard)
eIcicMaxCre.source: Nokia SBTS 18A official SingleRAN AirScale parameter dictionary

Highest allowed muting pattern
For dynamic ABS adaptation this parameter defines the maximum pattern the algorithm can go to. 
When LTE907 TTI bundling is enabled in the macro cell together with LTE1113 it is recommended not to exceed value 'mp4'.

SIB - siWindowLen

(1.1) eIcicMaxMutePattern must be configured only if actEicic is 'true' AND cellType is set to 'large'. 

Conditions in (2.x) are valid in addition to (1.x) if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'FDD':

earfcn.description:
E-UTRA Absolute Radio Frequency Channel Number.
Supported Bands and related EARFCNs are the following:
Band 38 (2570-2619.9 MHz): 37750-38249
Band 39 (1880-1919.9 MHz): 38250-38649
Band 40 (2300-2399.9 MHz): 38650-39649
Band 41 (2496-2689.9 MHz): 39650-41589
Band 48 (3550-3699.9 MHz): 55240–56739

Please note following limitations for the hardware variants:
FZHA working on E-UTRA band 38 supports frequency range 37800...38199 (2575-2614.9 MHz)
FZFA working on E-UTRA band 39 supports frequency range 38250…38549 (1880-1909.9 MHz)
FZFD, FZFE and FZFF working on E-UTRA band 39 support frequency range 38250…38599 (1880-1914.9 MHz)
FZND, FZNK, FZNL, FZNN and FSNI working on E-UTRA band 40 support frequency range 38850...39349 (2320-2369.9 MHz)
FZHJ working on E-UTRA band 41 support frequency range 39650...41589 (2496-2689.9)
FZHN working on E-UTRA band 41 supports frequency range 40640...41139 (2595MHz-2644.9MHz)
FZHG working on E-UTRA band 41 supports frequency range 41040...41439 (2635MHz-2674.9MHz)
FZHO working on E-UTRA band 41 supports frequency range 40040...40439 (2535MHz-2574.9MHz)

Note that for intra-band contiguous CA, the spacing between the central frequencies of the two carriers must be equal or greater than 183 EARFCN (18.3 MHz) for 20 MHz +20 MHz bandwidth combination, and 159 EARFCN (15.9 MHz) for 20 MHz + 15 MHz bandwidth combination, and 138 EARFCN (13.8 MHz) for 20 MHz + 10 MHz bandwidth combination.

MFBIPR - eutraCarrierFreq
MFBIPR - freqBandIndPrio

SIB - sibSchedulingList-siMessageSibType
ULCOMP - ulCoMpCellList The phyCellId of the cell must be unique within all LNCEL instances served by the eNB having the same frequency earfcn in LNCEL_TDD.

The eutraCarrierInfo in each LNHOIF belonging to the LNCEL must be different to the earfcn.

The targetCarrierFreq in any instance of the AMLEPR  must be different to earfcn.

Applicable if actCoMp is set to 'fixedULCoMp':
- the same frequency band (earfcn) must be configured for all LNCEL_TDD instances belonging to the same ulCoMpCellList.

For 'Multiple Frequency Band Indicator' cases, i.e. at least one MFBIPR instance is created
(1) If the earfcn in the LNCEL instance is set identical to a configured eutraCarrierFreq in any MFBIPR instance, addSpectrEmissReq in this MFBIPR instance must be configured.
(2) The additional frequency band defined by addFreqBandInd and the frequency band of all LNCEL instances having same EARFCN than the profile (i.e. MFBIPR-eutraCarrierFreq is equal to LNCEL_TDD-earfcn) must fully overlap.
This mean all frequencies within the cell bandwidth (chBw) must be fully within the additional frequency band (addFreqBandInd).
For frequency band definitions see table 5.7.3-1 in 3GPP TS36.104.

The conditions for MBMS activation (see parameter actMBMS) must be fulfilled as far as the cell shall be used for MBMS broadcasting, i.e. if LNCEL_TDD-earfcn and LNCEL_TDD-chBw match with mbsfnEarcn and mbsfnDlChBw, if LNCEL contains an MBSFNCEL.

If actMBMS is set to 'true' for the eNB, actMicroDtx can be set to true only in LNCEL instances with earfcn in LNCEL_TDD not equal to mbsfnEarfcn in MBSFNSYNCAREA_TDD and chBw in this LNCEL_TDD not equal to mbsfnDlChBw in same MBSFNSYNCAREA_TDD, if the parent LNCEL instance contains an MBSFNCEL.

If actFlexScellSelect is set to 'true', then following conditions must apply:
- all instances of CARELs in all PCells must point to SCells with totally no more than two different values for LNCEL_TDD-earfcn
- for each PCell there must be not more than six CAREL instances that point to SCells with the same value for LNCEL_TDD-earfcn
- all SCells with the same value for LNCEL_TDD-earfcn must also have the same value for LNCEL_TDD-chBw.
-cellResourceSharingMode must be 'none'

If actFlexScellSelect is set to 'false' and actDLCAggr is set to 'true' then following conditions must apply:
- all instances of CARELs in all PCells must point to SCells with totally no more than two different values for earfcnDL
- for each PCell there must be no more than two instances of CAREL pointing to LNCELs with unique values for LNCEL_TDD-earfcn, both different than LNCEL_TDD-earfcn of the PCell

If siMessageSibType is set to 'SIB4' then
- a MOC IAFIM needs to be present or
- actCsgS1Mobility must be activated and a LNCSG object must be configured with csgFreqEutra equal to earfcn of the cell.

If actMBMS is set to 'true', for each LNCEL containing MBSFNCEL, where LNCEL_TDD-earfcn equal to MBSFNSYNCAREA_TDD-mbsfnEarfcn and LNCEL_TDD-chBw equal to MBSFNSYNCAREA_TDD-mbsfnDlChBw all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- SIB-modPeriodCoeff must be the same
- LNCEL-defPagCyc must be the same.

If actCbrs is 'true' and earfcn is from CBRS band as defined in parameter actCbrs, then chBw must be '10 MHz' or '20 MHz'.

If actUlPwrRestrScn in the same LNCEL_TDD instance is set to band48_NS27, the earfcn of this cell must be the range 55340 ... 56640 (including the mentioned values).

If LNBTS_TDD-actMFBI is set to 'true' and in all instances of MOC LNCEL where LNCEL_TDD-earfcn is equal to eutraCarrFreq in any instance of MOC MFBIPR and freqBandIndPrio in the same instance of MOC MFBIPR is set to broadcasted, then LNCEL-actMfbiDupFre must be configured.

emerCallPrio.description:
This parameter defines priority for target RAT in selection of redirection target during Emergency Call handling procedure.
Value 1 means highest priority and value 6 lowest.
emerCallPrio.notes:
Related functions: Handover Control (Miscellaneous) Related parameters: LNBTS - act1xCsfb
LNBTS - actEmerCallRedir
LNCEL - cellTechnology
LNCEL - rttCsfbType
REDRT - emerCallPrio
REDRT - redirRat Conditions in (1.x) are valid if the cellTechnology of the parent LNCEL instance is configured to 'FDD' or 'TDD':
(1.1) If actEmerCallRedir is set to 'true' following condition need to be fulfilled:
- at least one instance of REDRT must be created per LNCEL where emerCallPrio is configured
- if reDirRat is set to 'eutra', 'cdma20001xRTT' or 'cdma2000HRPD', emerCallPrio shall not be specified.
(1.2) emerCallPrio must be unique for all REDRT instances belonging to same LNCEL.
(1.3) If act1xCsfb is set to 'true' and additionally for the LNCEL instance rttCsfbType is not set to 'forbidden' all of the following conditions need to be fulfilled
- at least one instance of REDRT with redirRAT 'cdma20001xRTT' must be created for this LNCEL with configured emerCallPrio
- in each additional REDRT instance with redirRAT 'cdma20001xRTT' emerCallPrio must be configured if csFallBPrio and redirectPrio are both not specified
- in each additional REDRT instance with redirRAT 'geran', 'eutra', 'utraFDD' or 'cdma2000HRPD' emerCallPrio must be configured.

Conditions in (2.x) are valid in addition to (1.x) if the cellTechnology of the parent LNCEL instance is configured to 'FDD':
(2.1) If actEmerCallRedir is set to 'Enabled' and additionally redirRat is set to 'geran' or 'utraFDD' where in the REDRT instance both redirectPrio as well as csFallBPrio are not specified, then emerCallPrio must be configured.

Conditions in (3.x) are valid in addition to (1.x) if the cellTechnology of the parent LNCEL instance is configured to 'TDD':
(3.1) If actEmerCallRedir is set to 'Enabled' and additionally redirRat is set to 'geran', 'utraFDD' or 'utraTDD' where in the REDRT instance both redirectPrio  as well as csFallBPrio are not specified, then emerCallPrio must be configured.

enDCpMaxEUTRApowerOffset.defaultValue: 0 dB (no static power split is applied by the UE, i.e. the UE can transmit at its maximum power on both legs (LTE and NR).)
enDCpMaxEUTRApowerOffset.description:
enDCpMaxEUTRApowerOffset defines the power reduction applied by the eNB to the UE maximum transmit power (maxUEtxPower) to derive the maximum power value (p-MaxEUTRA) that the UE can transmit to the EUTRA when  in EN-DC as follows:
p-maxEUTRA [dBm] = maxUEtxPower[dBm] - enDCpMaxEUTRApowerOffset [dB].

Where:
- maxUEtxPower is the UE maximum UE transmit power per corresponding EN-DC power class (see TS 38.101-3). 
- p-maxEUTRA is the value configured by the eNB to the UE (see TS 36.331).

Note: p-MaxEUTRA value provided to the UE may be further limited by the UL maximum power allowed in the UE LTE PCell (i.e. via the parameter lteULpMaxOwnCell)
enDCpMaxEUTRApowerOffset.fullName: p-MaxEUTRA power offset applied in EN-DC
enDCpMaxEUTRApowerOffset.notes:
Related parameters: NRDCDPR - enDCpMaxNRpowerOffset The value of enDCpMaxNRpowerOffset depends on the value of enDCpMaxEUTRApowerOffset in the NRDCDPR instance as follows:
- if enDCpMaxEUTRApowerOffset has the value '0' [dB], enDCpMaxNRpowerOffset must be '0' [dB]
- if enDCpMaxEUTRApowerOffset has the value '1' [dB], enDCpMaxNRpowerOffset must be '7' [dB]
- if enDCpMaxEUTRApowerOffset has the value '2' [dB], enDCpMaxNRpowerOffset must be greater than or equal to '5' [dB]
- if enDCpMaxEUTRApowerOffset has the value ('3' OR '4') [dB], enDCpMaxNRpowerOffset must be greater than or equal to '3' [dB]
- if enDCpMaxEUTRApowerOffset has the value ('5' OR '6') [dB], enDCpMaxNRpowerOffset must be greater than or equal to '2' [dB]
- if enDCpMaxEUTRApowerOffset has the value '7' [dB], enDCpMaxNRpowerOffset must be greater than or equal to '1' [dB].
enDCpMaxEUTRApowerOffset.source: Nokia SBTS 18A official SingleRAN AirScale parameter dictionary

enableA3Event.description:
This parameter controls the enabling/disabling of the A3 measurements for SCell discovery and corresponding A3 event reporting.
The setting of this flag conditions the way how the SCells to add are selected as follows:
-	If the A3 measurement has been enabled on a frequency that the UE can measure without measurement gaps, SCells on such frequency will be added only if detected by the UE with sufficient quality (i.e. with power and quality level above the defined scellMeasThreshRsrq and scellMeasThreshRsrp parameter values).
-	If the A3 measurement for SCell discovery has been not enabled on a frequency, SCells on such frequency are added blindly.
-	If the A3 measurement for SCell discovery has been enabled on a frequency that the UE cannot measure without measurement gaps, SCells on such frequency are added blindly only if there is no choice from the previous two cases. 

The events A3 for SCell discovery measurement are configured with “reportOnLeave” and “reportAmount=1”.
enableA3Event.source: Nokia SBTS 18A official SingleRAN AirScale parameter dictionary

enableLaaDsPadding.description:
This parameter enables or disables the padding of blank symbols of the discovery signal transmitted on an unlicensed cell in 'LAA' mode with random data. Enabling of the padding prevents other devices operating on the frequency of an unlicensed cell in 'LAA' mode from acquiring the channel during the silent symbols of the discovery signal transmission (e.g., symbol 2, 3, 9, 10). It also increases the total transmitted power per symbol and therefore reduces the possibility of transmission collision between LTE and other technologies (e.g., Wi-Fi). It is recommended to enable the discovery signal padding if an unlicensed cell in 'LAA' mode is expected to co-exist with other radio technologies (e.g., Wi-Fi).
Note 1: This parameter takes effect only if the unlicensed cell is operated in 'LAA' mode, i.e., actUnlicensedAcc is set to 'LAA'.
Note 2: For definition of an 'unlicensed cell', please, see its definition at parameter actUnlicensedAcc.

enableLowAgg.description:
The parameter determines the enabling/disabling switch for automatic selection of lower aggregation during PDCCH scheduling. This means that a required aggregation level which is defined from UE's Channel Quality Indicator (CQI) reports may be downgraded by one step without any other particular reason (e.g. blocking due to UE hash function or overall space). Assigning of lower aggregation decreases number of blocked UEs in case of PDCCH resource deficiency, and gives possibility for greater number of PDCCH messages per TTI. A corresponding increase in PDCCH power compensates caused degradation in PDCCH code robustness.
 
There are some restrictions for utilitizing the automatic lower aggregation for an UE:  
- the required aggregation shall be at least 4,
- enableAmcPdcch and enablePcPdcch shall be enabled, and
- used PDCCH capacity for all uplink and downlink allocations shall exceed a limit defined by the threshold pdcchLowAggTh of total PDCCH capacity for allocated number of PDCCH symbols in TTI

The parameter will be ignored in FDD cells if dlChBw is set to '1.4 MHz'.
enableLowAgg.fullName: Enable lower aggregation selection for PDCCH LA
enableLowAgg.notes:
Related functions: PHY/MAC Configuration (Downlink) Related parameters: LNCEL - enableAmcPdcch

The BTS  baseband capacity utilization value is increased by 1 if the particular baseband pool is counted as used.
btsBbCapacityUsage parameter value must be always kept by BTS up to date.
BTS uses the parameter reporting to NetAct SWEM the actual BTS baseband capacity utilization level required for License Management related operations.

fourLayerMimoAvSpectralEff.description:
The four layer MIMO average spectral efficiency is used by the throughput check during SCell addition as follows .
If the throughput metric after the SCell addition is greater than the throughput metric before the SCell addition then this SCell addition is admitted. Otherwise this SCell addition is rejected. The throughput metric is the sum of xLayerMimoAvSpectralEff*bandwidth of the UE’s serving cells. Where xLayerMimoAvSpectralEff is equal to twoLayerMimoAvSpectralEff if the UE is configured with two layer MIMO on a given serving cell respectively xLayerMimoAvSpectralEff is equal to fourLayerMimoAvSpectralEff if the UE is configured with four layer MIMO on a given serving cell.

A reasonable value of the parameter can be derived from the existing KPI LTE_5747a "DL Spectral efficiency" as follows. The KPI shall be collected in conditions where all UEs are four layer MIMO capable in this cell in order not to underestimate the average value (with dlMimoMode set to "Closed Loop MIMO (4x4)" or "Closed Loop MIMO (8x4)").

The throughput check is not used by setting the parameter value to "0.5" i.e. any SCell addition will be always admitted by the check if twoLayerMimoAvSpectralEff = fourLayerMimoAvSpectralEff in all involved cells.
fourLayerMimoAvSpectralEff.fullName: Four layer MIMO average spectral efficiency
fourLayerMimoAvSpectralEff.notes:
Related functions: MIMO Control
Carrier Aggregation Related parameters: LNCEL_TDD - dlMimoMode
LNCEL_TDD - twoLayerMimoAvSpectralEff (1) Only if dlMimoMode in same LNCEL_TDD is set to ('Closed Loop MIMO (4x4)' OR 'Closed Loop MIMO (8x4)'), fourLayerMimoAvSpectralEff shall be configured.
(2) in same LNCEL_TDD fourLayerMimoAvSpectralEff >= twoLayerMimoAvSpectralEff.
fourLayerMimoAvSpectralEff.relatedFeatures:
•  LTE2532 TDD downlink carrier aggregation with 4 layers MIMO (Standard)  
•  LTE3879 TDD DL Carrier Aggregation with MIMO - 12 layers (Standard)
fourLayerMimoAvSpectralEff.source: Nokia SBTS 18A official SingleRAN AirScale parameter dictionary

freqLayListDedLteLB.description:
Specifies the dedicated target frequency layers for inter-frequency load balancing handovers. The configured values are only applicable if feature LTE2571 "Dedicated target frequency list for load balancing" is activated for inter-frequency LB frequencies, i.e. parameter actDedFreqListsLB is configured to 'inter-frequency' or 'all'(FDD only).
When the list does not contain any target frequency even if the feature is activated, the eNB will not allow inter-frequency load balancing handover to all targets. 
If LTE1942 Dedicated VoLTE Inter-frequency Handover feature is activated, then the inter-frequency load balancing handover for VoLTE UEs will only be performed for frequency layers that are in both this list and in freqLayListDedVoLteHo of the MOPR instance.

The parameter value is based on the absolute radio-frequency channel number "ARFCN".
freqLayListDedLteLB.fullName: Frequency layer list for ded. inter-frequency LB HO

freqLayListDedVoLteHo.description:

When the list does not contain any target frequency even if the feature is activated, the eNB will not allow VoLTE inter-frequency handover to all targets. 
For activated LTE1127 "Service Based Mobility Trigger" the list must include all frequency layers as defined in freqLayListServiceBasedHo of the same MOPR instance.

The parameter value is based on the absolute radio-frequency channel number "ARFCN".

furtherPlmnIdL.description:
Further PLMN IDs of the cell.
These are further PLMN IDs of the cell. The parameter indicates which operators' (PLMNID) networks are available from the cell. These PLMN identities have a cell scope.
The primary PLMN ID has to be provided separately for the eNB.

The setting is commonly valid for all legacy category UE and Cat-M UE.
Note: This parameter is used in NB-IoT cell also.
furtherPlmnIdL.notes:
Related functions: System Information Broadcast (Miscellaneous) Related parameters: LNCEL - cellTechnology
LNCEL - csgType
LNCEL - furtherPlmnIdL
LNCEL - maxCrSibDl
LNCEL_FDD - actDlSlimCarrier
LNCEL_FDD - dlChBw
LNCEL_FDD - numBlankDlPrbsDown
LNCEL_FDD - numBlankDlPrbsUp The following checks are applicable on LNCEL instance level.

Conditions in (1.x) are valid if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'FDD' or 'TDD':
(1.1) If csgType is set to 'CSG', furtherPlmnIdL shall not be configured.
(1.2) Within all LNCEL instances of the eNB maximum 7 different PLMN IDs are allowed to be configured in furtherPlmnIdL. PLMN ID means the combination of the parameters mcc, mnc and mncLength.

Conditions in (2.x) are valid in addition to (1.x) if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'FDD':
(2.1) if dlChBw is set to '3 MHz' and LTE3145 disabled (see note1), or,  if dlChBw is set to '5 MHz' and LTE3145 enabled (see note1)
- and maxCrSibDl <= 0.07, the allowed number of list items of furtherPlmnIdL is  0
- and maxCrSibDl = 0.08, the allowed number of list items of furtherPlmnIdL is 2
- and maxCrSibDl = 0.09, the allowed number of list items of furtherPlmnIdL is 3
- and maxCrSibDl > 0.09, the allowed number of list items of furtherPlmnIdL is 5
(2.2) if dlChBw is set to '1.4 MHz' OR if LTE3145 enabled  (see note1) and dlChBw is set to '3 MHz'
- and maxCrSibDl < 0.19, the allowed number of list items of furtherPlmnIdL is  1
- and 0.19 =< maxCrSibDl < 0.21, the allowed number of list items of furtherPlmnIdL is  2
- and 0.21 =< maxCrSibDl < 0.23, the allowed number of list items of furtherPlmnIdL is 3
- and 0.23 =< maxCrSibDl < 0.26, the allowed number of list items of furtherPlmnIdL is 4
- and maxCrSibDl >= 0. 26, the allowed number of list items of furtherPlmnIdL is 5

note1:
LTE3145 disabled = actDlSlimCarrier is set to 'false' or ( numBlankDlPrbsUp+ numBlankDlPrbsDown =0 )
LTE3145 enabled = actDlSlimCarrier is set to 'true' and ( numBlankDlPrbsUp+ numBlankDlPrbsDown >0 )

fwdTestDisp.description:

Pass means that all forward measured values were within the range of the configured threshold values for the forward measurements.

Forward measurement values of zero (the measurement was not available) are not used in calculalting the test disposition.

gateway.description: This parameter defines the IP address of the next hop through which the route destination IP address can be reached.
gateway.fullName: IP address of the next hop of the route
gateway.notes:
Related parameters: IPADDRESSV4 - localIpAddr
IPADDRESSV4 - localIpPrefixLength
IPRT - ipRtId 1) The Gateway IP address must be within one of the subnets configured in the BTS. 
I.e. it has to be verified that a BTS subnet  (identified by locallIpAddress and localIpPrefixLength) exists with the following property: 
The first n bits of the Gateway IP address are equal to the first n bits of a localIpAddr defined in any IPADDRESSV4 object where n= localIpPrefixLength.

2) The Gateway IPv4 address must not be equal to the highest- or lowest- IP address of the subnet.

3) In addition to the limitation above (see Note), the gateway must be outside the value range below:
- Loopback addresses 127.0.0.0 - 127.255.255.255.
- Private addresses 192.168.253.0 - 192.168.255.255.
- 0.0.0.0
- Link Local addresses 169.254.0.1 - 169.254.255.254.
- Broadcast address 255.255.255.255.

4) The Gateway IP address of a route in the main routing table (IPRT-1) must be different from BTS local network IP addresses configured in a localIpAddr parameter of any IPADDRESSV4 object.
gateway.relatedFeatures:
•  SR000589 IPv4/IPv6 Transport Stack (Standard)  
•  SR001541 Harmonized SRAN object model (Standard)  
•  RC0249 Porting of legacy transport features for Cloud BTS (Standard)
gateway.source: Nokia SBTS 18A official SingleRAN AirScale parameter dictionary

gatewayIpv6Addr.description:
This parameter defines  the IPv6 address of the next IP hop through which a remote network can be reached.
IPv6 address format: x:x:x:x:x:x:x:x. Example: ABCD:EF01:2345:6789:ABCD:EF01:2345:6789.
The IPv6 address has to be defined always in full length. Short formats are not supported.
gatewayIpv6Addr.notes:
Related parameters: IPADDRESSV6 - localIpAddr
IPADDRESSV6 - localIpPrefixLength
IPRTV6 - ipRtV6Id The Gateway IPv6 address must be within one of the subnets configured in the BTS. 
I.e. it has to be verified that a BTS subnet  (identified by ipAddressV6Id : locallIpAddress, localIpPrefixlength) exists with the following property: 
The first n bits of the gatewayIPv6Addr are equal to the first n bits of a localIpAddr defined in any IPADDRESSV6 object where n= localIpPrefixlength.

The Gateway IPv6 address value must be inside the value range below:
Unique Local Unicast 	(FC00::/7)
Global Unicast 		(2000::/3)

The Gateway IPv6 address of a route in the main routing table (IPRTV6-1) must be different from BTS local network IP addresses configured in a localIpAddr parameter of any IPADDRESSV6 object.

handoverAllowed.description:
The parameter controls handover blacklisting. The instance of LNREL and the related cell relationship, defined by ECGI, identifies the specific cell to cell relation. The parameter allows HO for this neighbor relation, only S1 HO or no HO at all.
The blacklisting applies in addition to blacklisting via the LNCEL parameter blacklistHoL.

The meaning is as follows:
 'allowed' means that any S1 or X2 outgoing handover is allowed.
'onlyS1' means that outgoing handover via S1 is allowed but not via X2.

iFLBBearCheckTimer.description:
Timer is started when S1AP sends back Initial Context Setup Response. After Timer expiration it is checked whether or not the UE has a QCI1 bearer.

The value 31 indicates that QCI1 (VOIP) bearer are not excluded from the Inter Frequency Load Balancing. Note that when QCI1 check is not performed, there is 1s wait timer before start Load Balancing.
In LTE1387 UEs with QCI1 (VOIP) bearer are excluded from the Inter Frequency Load Balancing. As the bearer establishment takes some time, SW has to wait before making a check.

idleLBCapThreshCaUeAdv.defaultValue: 100.0 (Default of 100% provides same behavior than in non-CA-aware case.)
idleLBCapThreshCaUeAdv.description:
Composite Available Capacity (CAC) threshold used to start/stop advanced CA-aware idle mode load balancing actions.

Only if the CAC value is greater than this threshold (but still smaller than or equal to idleLBCapThreshCAUe), advanced idle mode load balancing for CA capable UEs actions shall be triggered. If the CAC value is smaller than or equal to this threshold, non-CA-aware idle mode load balancing shall be used.

Note: For idleLBCapThreshCaUeAdv equal to ‘0’ or '100', CAC value calculation is not triggered if not otherwise requested. For idleLBCapThreshCaUeAdv equal to ‘0’, LTE4154 is then active under all load conditions, while for idleLBCapThreshCaUeAdv equal to ‘100’, LTE4154 is then not active under all load conditions.

idleLBCelResWeight2CC.description:
Weight factor of the serving cell frequency layer used by round robin algorithm for idle mode load balancing for 2CC CA UEs.
When the parameter is not defined, the corresponding carrier is not used in selecting main target for IdleModeMobilityControlInfo for load balancing. 
Decision which CC type used in IE sent to UE depends on UE Capabilities and other CC type configuration parameters.

Weighted round robin algorithm shall select always one target frequency for idle mode load balancing, which is matching UE capabilities, to be used as main target for idle mode load balancing and this target will have always highest  priority assigned in RRC Release message.  All other target frequency for idle mode load balancing matching UE capabilities and configured in LNCEL, IRFIM, UFFIM, CDFIM and GNFL will be added as well, but with lowered priorities as configured for SIB with kept hierarchy of priorities or with dedicated priority value configured by operator.

The algorithm shall calculate proportional weights corresponding to configured values. There is no check about the sum of weights configured by the user.
idleLBCelResWeight2CC.fullName: Cell reselection weight factor for idle mode load balancing for 2CC CA UEs
idleLBCelResWeight2CC.relatedFeatures: •  LTE2601 CA aware idle mode load balancing (Standard)
idleLBCelResWeight2CC.source: Nokia SBTS 18A official SingleRAN AirScale parameter dictionary

idleLBEutCelResWeight.description:
Weight factor of EUTRA carrier frequency used by round robin algorithm for idle mode load balancing.
Weighted round robin algorithm shall select always one target frequency for idle mode load balancing, which is matching UE capabilities, to be used as main target for idle mode load balancing and this target will have always highest  priority assigned in RRC Release message.
 All other target frequency for idle mode load balancing matching UE capabilities and configured for SIBs  will be added as well, but with lowered priorities as configured for SIB with kept hierarchy of priorities.

The algorithm shall calculate proportional weights corresponding to configured values. There is no check about the sum of weights configured by the user.
When not specified the weight is considered as 0.

idleLBEutCelResWeight4CC.description:

Weighted round robin algorithm shall select always one target frequency for idle mode load balancing for CA capable UEs, which is matching UE capabilities, to be used as main target for idle mode load balancing and this target will have always highest  priority assigned in RRC Release message.
 All other target frequency for idle mode load balancing matching UE capabilities and configured for SIBs  will be added as well, but with lowered priorities as configured for SIB with kept hierarchy of priorities.

idleTimeThresLteNR.description:
The eNB may autonomously remove a LTE NR, if the LTE NR is not used for handover for at least the time 'idleTimeThresLteNR'.


Notes: 
* LTE NRs which are 'reserved by operator' are not autonomously removed by eNB
* The eNB checks once per hour if a LTE NR has to be removed
Note:  It is recommended to chose 'idleTimeThresLteNR' to be smaller than 'idleTimeThresX2' to avoid that one eNB may autonomously close an X2 link and the peer eNB re-esatblishes the X2 link again, because autonomous removal of associated unused Neighbour Relations did not yet occur.
Note: It is recommended to chose 'idleTimeThresLteNR' to be greater than 24 hours if a Load-based power saving feature is activated at the eNB ('actLBPowerSaving' = 'true' or 'actLBRTXPowerSaving' = 'true') to avoid the autonomous removal of Neighbor Relations due to either the serving cell or the neighbor cell being switched off into the 'energySavingState' = 'energySaving' state or having transmit power reduced due to switched off TX paths when the 'energySavingState' = 'reducedEnergySaving.
idleTimeThresLteNR.fullName: Idle Time Threshold for LTE Neighbour Relations
idleTimeThresLteNR.source: Nokia SBTS 18A official SingleRAN AirScale parameter dictionary
