- ELSE IF (siMessageRepetition in all of the sib2Scheduling, sib3Scheduling and sibSchedulingList gets value 1 or 2) OR (tddSpecSubfConf gets different value than '5'(ssp5) AND eIcicMaxMutePattern gets different value than 'mp3' or 'mp4'), siWindowLen must get value equal to or greater than '20ms'
(3.3.b.2) if tddFrameConf is set to '2' following conditions need to be fulfilled:
- IF (siMessageRepetition in any of the sib2Scheduling, sib3Scheduling or sibSchedulingList is greater than '2') AND (tddSpecSubfConf is '5'(ssp5) OR eIcicMaxMutePattern is 'mp6'), siWindowLen must get value '40ms'
- ELSE IF (siMessageRepetition in all of the sib2Scheduling, sib3Scheduling and sibSchedulingList gets value 1 or 2) OR (tddSpecSubfConf gets different value than '5'(ssp5) AND eIcicMaxMutePattern gets different value than 'mp6'),  siWindowLen must get value equal to or greater than '20ms'
(3.4) siWindowLen must be greater than or equal to 20ms if actMBMS is equal to 'true' and (tddSpecSubfConf is '5'(ssp5) or '9'(ssp9)) and earfcn in LNCEL_TDD is equal to mbsfnEarfcn and chBw is equal to mbsfnDlChBw.
(3.5) siWindowLen must be greater than or equal to 10ms if actMBMS is equal to 'true' and (tddSpecSubfConf is not '5'(ssp5) or '9'(ssp9)) and earfcn in LNCEL_TDD is equal to mbsfnEarfcn and chBw is equal to mbsfnDlChBw.
(3.6) The allowed range of LNCEL_TDD-prsConfigurationIndex depends on siWindowLen, sib2xTransmit, actETWS, actCMAS, sibSchedulingList, actOtdoa, tddFrameConf. Please see the parameter LNCEL_TDD-prsConfigurationIndex for the detailed parameter relationship. 
(3.7) If actMBMS is equal to 'true' then siWindowLen must be set to the same value in all SIB instances belonging to LNCEL instances with earfcn equal in LNCEL_TDD to mbsfnEarfcn in MBSFNSYNCAREA_TDD and chBw in same LNCEL_TDD of this cell is equal to mbsfnDlChBw in same MBSFNSYNCAREA_TDD.

siWindowLenCatM.description:
The parameter SI Window Length defines the common System Information scheduling window for all SIs of Cat-M UEs.
This is broadcasted in SIB1-BR.
Refer to 3GPP 36.331 and IE si-WindowLength-BR-r13.
Note: All Cat-M UEs in RRC Connected mode will be released when this parameter is online modified.
siWindowLenCatM.notes:
Related functions: System Information Broadcast (Control) Related parameters: CATMPR - siRepPatternCatM
CATMPR - sib16PeriodicityCatM
CATMPR - sib2PeriodicityCatM
CATMPR - sib3sib4PeriodicityCatM
CATMPR - sib5PeriodicityCatM
LNBTS - actUTCBroadcast
SIB - sibSchedulingList (1.1) the condition must be fulfilled: siWindowLenCatM * NUM-CatM-SI-MSG <= PERIOD-CatM-SI-MSG.
'NUM-CatM-SI-MSG' represents the number of CatM SI messages to be scheduled:
step1. The initial NUM-CatM-SI-MSG is set to 1;
step2. If sibType5 is configured in sibSchedulingList and at least one CATMIRFIM instance is configured, the NUM-CatM-SI-MSG is added by 2,
           else if sibType4 is configured in sibSchedulingList, the NUM-CatM-SI-MSG is added by 1;
step3. If sibType16 is configured in sibSchedulingList and actUTCBroadcast is set to 'true', the NUM-CatM-SI-MSG is added by 1.
'PERIOD-CatM-SI-MSG' represents the minimum periodicity of CatM SI messages to be scheduled:
step1. The initial PERIOD-CatM-SI-MSG is set to sib2PeriodicityCatM;
step2. If sibType5 is configured in sibSchedulingList and at least one CATMIRFIM instance is configured, the PERIOD-CatM-SI-MSG is set to min (PERIOD-CatM-SI-MSG, sib3sib4PeriodicityCatM, sib5PeriodicityCatM),
           else if sibType4 is configured in sibSchedulingList, the PERIOD-CatM-SI-MSG is set to min (PERIOD-CatM-SI-MSG, sib3sib4PeriodicityCatM);
step3. If sibType16 is configured in sibSchedulingList and actUTCBroadcast is set to 'true', the PERIOD-CatM-SI-MSG is min (PERIOD-CatM-SI-MSG, sib16PeriodicityCatM).

(1.2) the condition must be fulfilled:  si_overhead <= 32%.
'si_overhead' represents the percent of radio frame used for CatM SI messages, and is calculated as below from step1 to step3.
siRepPatternCatM value mapping for the following formula {every2ndRF:20, every4thRF: 40, every8thRF: 80}
step1: si_overhead = ceil(siWindowLenCatM/siRepPatternCatM)*10/sib2PeriodicityCatM;
step2: If sibType5 is configured in sibSchedulingList and at least one CATMIRFIM instance is configured, 
                 si_overhead += ceil(siWindowLenCatM/siRepPatternCatM)*10/sib3sib4PeriodicityCatM,
                 si_overhead += ceil(siWindowLenCatM/siRepPatternCatM)*10/sib5PeriodicityCatM,
             else if sibType4 is configured in sibSchedulingList.
                 si_overhead += ceil(siWindowLenCatM/siRepPatternCatM)*10/sib3sib4PeriodicityCatM;
step3: If sibType16 is configured in sibSchedulingList and actUTCBroadcast is set to 'true', si_overhead += ceil(siWindowLenCatM/siRepPatternCatM)*10/sib16PeriodicityCatM.

sib2xTransmit.description:
As per basic system behavior, a SIB message (SIB2 and higher) is transmitted one time per each SI window, and further transmissions might be added if the message is too big (code rate is too high) for cell-edge UEs to decode it from fewer transmissions. If siWindowLen is greater than or equal to 20 ms, this parameter can be used to add another mandatory transmission per SI window for SIB2 and higher. 
Up to four transmissions can be done in a SIB window. Any further transmission is done as “best effort” and may or may not happen.

Setting sib2xTransmit=true in a system with 5 MHz or below is possible but not recommended for reasons of DL performance.

Even without sib2xTransmit set to 'true', SIB repetitions will be sent if this is required by message size and the code rate defined for SIB messages.
If siMessageRepetition is set to a value of 2 or higher, eNB tries (on best-effort basis only) to send SIB repetitions on top of the minimum number of transmissions defined by message size and code rade. In contrast to this, setting sib2xTransmit to 'true' adds a mandatory SIB repetition.

sib3sib4PeriodicityCatM.description:
This parameter indicates the periodicity of CatM SI-Message which contains SIB3-BR and SIB4-BR. SIB3-BR and SIB4-BR are sent in one SI-BR message.
This is broadcasted in SIB1-BR.
Refer to 3GPP 36.331.
Note: If SIB4 is configured in this cell, all Cat-M UEs in RRC Connected mode will be released when this parameter is online modified.
sib3sib4PeriodicityCatM.fullName: SIB3-BR and SIB4-BR periodicity for Cat-M
sib3sib4PeriodicityCatM.notes:
Related functions: System Information Broadcast (Control) Related parameters: CATMPR - siRepPatternCatM
CATMPR - siWindowLenCatM
CATMPR - sib16PeriodicityCatM
CATMPR - sib2PeriodicityCatM
CATMPR - sib5PeriodicityCatM
LNBTS - actUTCBroadcast
SIB - sibSchedulingList (1.1) the condition must be fulfilled: siWindowLenCatM * NUM-CatM-SI-MSG <= PERIOD-CatM-SI-MSG.
'NUM-CatM-SI-MSG' represents the number of CatM SI messages to be scheduled:
step1. The initial NUM-CatM-SI-MSG is set to 1;
step2. If sibType5 is configured in sibSchedulingList and at least one CATMIRFIM instance is configured, the NUM-CatM-SI-MSG is added by 2,
           else if sibType4 is configured in sibSchedulingList, the NUM-CatM-SI-MSG is added by 1;
step3. If sibType16 is configured in sibSchedulingList and actUTCBroadcast is set to 'true', the NUM-CatM-SI-MSG is added by 1.
'PERIOD-CatM-SI-MSG' represents the minimum periodicity of CatM SI messages to be scheduled:
step1. The initial PERIOD-CatM-SI-MSG is set to sib2PeriodicityCatM;
step2. If sibType5 is configured in sibSchedulingList and at least one CATMIRFIM instance is configured, the PERIOD-CatM-SI-MSG is set to min (PERIOD-CatM-SI-MSG, sib3sib4PeriodicityCatM, sib5PeriodicityCatM),
           else if sibType4 is configured in sibSchedulingList, the PERIOD-CatM-SI-MSG is set to min (PERIOD-CatM-SI-MSG, sib3sib4PeriodicityCatM);
step3. If sibType16 is configured in sibSchedulingList and actUTCBroadcast is set to 'true', the PERIOD-CatM-SI-MSG is min (PERIOD-CatM-SI-MSG, sib16PeriodicityCatM).

(1.2) the condition must be fulfilled:  si_overhead <= 32%.
'si_overhead' represents the percent of radio frame used for CatM SI messages, and is calculated as below from step1 to step3.
siRepPatternCatM value mapping for the following formula {every2ndRF:20, every4thRF: 40, every8thRF: 80}
step1: si_overhead = ceil(siWindowLenCatM/siRepPatternCatM)*10/sib2PeriodicityCatM;
step2: If sibType5 is configured in sibSchedulingList and at least one CATMIRFIM instance is configured, 
                 si_overhead += ceil(siWindowLenCatM/siRepPatternCatM)*10/sib3sib4PeriodicityCatM,
                 si_overhead += ceil(siWindowLenCatM/siRepPatternCatM)*10/sib5PeriodicityCatM,
             else if sibType4 is configured in sibSchedulingList.
                 si_overhead += ceil(siWindowLenCatM/siRepPatternCatM)*10/sib3sib4PeriodicityCatM;
step3: If sibType16 is configured in sibSchedulingList and actUTCBroadcast is set to 'true', si_overhead += ceil(siWindowLenCatM/siRepPatternCatM)*10/sib16PeriodicityCatM.

sibUpdateRateThreshold.description:
SIB update rate threshold which if exceeded will block non-critical SIB updates from being made.
Once the SIB update rate exceeds this threshold, non-critical SIB updates will not be made until the SIB update rate drops below this threshold.  Critical SIB updates will be made regardless of the current SIB update rate.  This parameter only applies to features that support non-critical SIB updates such as the PRACH Power Optimization, and Dynamic PUCCH Allocation features.  The maximum update rate to guarantee that all idle UEs receive the SIB updates is equal to or less than 31 updates per 3 hours.   

Note that this is an optional parameter.  If the operator does not create an instance of this parameter, SIB rate monitoring will be disabled and all SIB updates will be allowed regardless of the SIB update rate.

speedAndDuplex.description:
This parameter defines if auto-negotiation is enabled or disabled for an Ethernet Interface, and if auto-negotiation is enabled whether to restrict the speeds to be advertised.
AUTODETECT: Auto-negotiation is enabled and 100Base-Tx, 1000Base-T, full duplex are advertised. With 1000Base-X: Auto-negotiation is enabled and full duplex is advertised.
1000MBIT_FULL: Auto-negotiation is enabled and only 1000Base-T, full duplex is advertised. With 1000Base-X: Auto-negotiation is disabled and Ethernet interface is forced to 1000Base-X, full duplex.
100MBIT_FULL: Auto-negotiation is disabled and Ethernet interface is forced to 100Base-Tx, full duplex. Not applicable with 1000Base-X
For ASIA (AirScale system module - Indoor)
The optical 10 GE interface supports only 10GBIT_FULL.
The optical 1GE interface supports only AUTODETECT, 1000MBIT_FULL.
Note: 'AUTODETECT' setting for ASIA initiate the interface probe for 10G and if found, the speed and duplex is forced to 10GBIT_FULL since auto negotiation is not supported on 10 Gigabit Ethernet interface.
If the SFP type is 10GbaseSR or 10GbaseLR, then speedAndDuplex must be set to 10GBIT_FULL.

Related parameters: ETHLK - connectorLabel 1.) It is mandatory to set this parameter if the connectorLabel is set to a value other than "LMP1".

spid.description:
Single SPID value or first SPID value of a range which shall be mapped to a Cat-M Mobility Profile.
3GPP 36.300 defines the following SPID range:
Values 1-128 are Operator specific SPIDs
Values 129-256 are Reference SPID values
spid.notes:
Related functions: Handover Control (Intra LTE) Related parameters: CATMCEL - moPrMappingListCatM-mcc
CATMCEL - moPrMappingListCatM-mnc
CATMCEL - moPrMappingListCatM-mncLength
CATMCEL - moPrMappingListCatM-moPrIdCatM
CATMCEL - moPrMappingListCatM-spidLast
CATMCEL - moProfileSelectCatM Definitions used in below parameter relationships:
- PLMN ID: Different PLMN IDs can be configured in moPrMappingListCatM with the combination of the parameters mcc, mnc and mncLength. PLMN ID means the combination of the parameters mcc, mnc and mncLength.
- SPID range: Several spid ranges can be configured in moPrMappingListCatM with parameters spid and spidLast. SPID range means the range from spid to spidLast. If spidLast is not configured, SPID range means the single spid value.

spid must be less than spidLast.
spidLast can only be configured if spid is configured.

If moProfileSelectCatM is set to 'spid', then all the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- in the elements of moPrMappingListCatM where moPrIdCatM is configured, spid must be configured.
- SPID ranges must be unique with no overlaps in all elements of moPrMappingListCatM within CATMCEL.

If moProfileSelectCatM is set to 'combined', then all the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- if configured, the pair of SPID range and PLMN ID must be unique in all elements of moPrMappingListCatM within CATMCEL (i.e. SPID range must be unique with no overlaps in all the elements for the same PLMN ID).
- in the elements of moPrMappingListCatM where SPID range is not configured, PLMN ID must be unique in all these elements of moPrMappingListCatM within CATMCEL.
- in the elements of moPrMappingListCatM where PLMN ID is not configured, SPID range must be unique with no overlaps in all these elements of moPrMappingListCatM within CATMCEL.
- in the elements of moPrMappingListCatM where moPrIdCatM is configured, either spid or PLMN ID or both must be configured.

srsBandwidth.description:
Defines together with srsBwConf (srs bandwidth configuration)  the bandwidth for srs for non beamforming or beamforming configured UEs . Please refer to table 5.5.3.2-1 to 5.5.3.2-4 in 3GPP TS36.211. This depends on the value of LNCEL-srsDlMimoModeDepConf-srsBeamformingType.

If LNCEL-srsDlMimoModeDepConf-srsBeamformingType is set to 'nonBeamforming', then srsBandwidth defines the bandwidth of one SRS symbol for UEs which are configured to the RRC transmission mode tm1 to tm4.
If LNCEL-srsDlMimoModeDepConf-srsBeamformingType is set to 'beamforming', then srsBandwidth defines the bandwidth of one SRS symbol for UEs which are configured to the RRC transmission mode tm7 or tm8.
srsBandwidth.source: Nokia SBTS 18A official SingleRAN AirScale parameter dictionary

srsBwConf.description:
Defines together with the channel bandwidth (chBw) and the srsBandwidthNonBf (srs bandwidth for non beamforming users) or srsBandwidthBf (srs bandwidth for beamforming users) the bandwidth of one srs symbol. 
Please refer to table 5.5.3.2-1 to 5.5.3.2-4 in 3GPP TS36.211 for different system bandwidth.
If dlMimoMode is set to a beamforming mode ("Single Stream Beamforming" or "Dual Stream Beamforming") , than srsBandwidthForNonBf is chosen to define the bandwidth of one srs symbol for UEs which rrc transmission mode is set to tm0 to tm4. srsBandwidthForBf is chosen to define the bandwidth of one srs symbol for UEs which rrc transmission mode is set to tm7 or tm8. 
If dlMimoMode is set to a non beamforming mode  ("SingleTX", "TXDiv", "4-way TXDiv", "Dynamic Open Loop MIMO", "Closed Loop Mimo" or "Closed Loop MIMO (4x2)"), than srsBandwidthForNonBf is chosen to define the bandwidth of one srs symbol for all UEs.
srsBwConf.notes:
Related functions: Beamforming (SRS configuration) Related parameters: LNCEL_TDD - actReduceWimaxInterference If srsActivation in the LNCEL_TDD instance is set to 'true', srsBwConf must be configured.

If actReduceWimaxInterference is set to 'true', srsBwConf can only be configured to '0bw' or '1bw'.

srsDlMimoModeDepConf.description:
SRS configuration parameter specific for non beamforming and optional beamforming users.

In case of carrier aggregation, dlMimoMode/actTmSwitch setting under both PCell and SCell shall be considered.
If dlMimoMode is set to a non beamforming mode ('SingleTX', 'TXDiv', '4-way TXDiv', 'Closed Loop Mimo', 'Closed Loop MIMO (4x2)' or 'Closed Loop MIMO (4x4)'), then one structure element is mandatory for the configuration for non beamforming users (srsBeamformingType 'nonBeamforming'). 
If dlMimoMode is set to 'Dynamic Open Loop MIMO' and actTmSwitch is set to false, then one structure element is mandatory for the configuration for non beamforming users (srsBeamformingType 'nonBeamforming').
If dlMimoMode is set to 'Dynamic Open Loop MIMO' and actTmSwitch is set to true,  then the structure must contain 2 elements, one for non beamforming user (srsBeamformingType 'nonBeamforming') and one for beamforming user (srsBeamformingType 'beamforming') configuration.
If dlMimoMode is set to a beamforming mode ('Single Stream Beamforming' or 'Dual Stream Beamforming' or 'Closed Loop MIMO (8x2)' or 'Closed Loop MIMO (8x4)'), then the structure must contain 2 elements, one for non beamforming user (srsBeamformingType 'nonBeamforming') and one for beamforming user (srsBeamformingType 'beamforming') configuration.

srsDlMimoModeDepConf.notes:
Related functions: Beamforming (SRS configuration) Related parameters: CAREL - lcrId
LNCEL_TDD - actTmSwitch

If two sets of srsDlMimoModeDepConf are configured, the srsDlMimoModeDepConf-beamformingType must be set different in the sets ('nonBeamforming', 'beamforming').

Following conditions need to be considered:
- if dlMimoMode is set to ('SingleTX' or 'TXDiv' or '4-way TXDiv' or 'Closed Loop MIMO' or 'Closed Loop MIMO (4x2)' or 'Closed Loop MIMO (4x4)') or (dlMimoMode is set to 'Dynamic Open Loop MIMO' and actTmSwitch is set to 'false') only one srsDlMimoModeDepConf set with beamformingType set to 'nonBeamforming' must be configured, a second item is not allowed
- if dlMimoMode is set to ('Single Stream Beamforming' or 'Dual Stream Beamforming' or 'Closed Loop MIMO (8x2)' or 'Closed Loop MIMO (8x4)') or (dlMimoMode is set to 'Dynamic Open Loop MIMO' and actTmSwitch is set to 'true') two srsDlMimoModeDepConf sets must be configured

srsPwrOffset.description:
UE specific power offset to be used for Sounding Reference Signal transmission power calculation in UE uplink power control equation (P3).

Note: The actual power offset depends on value of deltaTfEnabled.
For deltaTfEnabled = 'true' (KS = 1.25) the actual parameter value is "srsPwrOffset-3" corresponding to the dB-range of -3 dB to 12 dB in steps of 1 dB. For deltaTfEnabled = 'false' (KS = 0) the actual parameter value is "-10.5 + 1.5 * srsPwrOffset" value corresponding to the dB-range -10.5 dB to 12 dB in steps of 1.5 dB.

subscriberMDTObtainLocation.description:
This parameter controls whether the eNB requests the UE to attempt to provide detailed location information. It is only used for UEs which are requestred in Subscriber MDT configuration to provide GNSS location information in MDT Subscriber Trace session.
The UE is requested to attempt to have valid detailed location information available whenever sending a measurement report for which it is configured to include available detailed location information. The UE may not succeed e.g. because the user manually disabled the GPS hardware, due to no/poor satellite coverage. Further details, e.g. regarding when to activate GNSS, are up to UE implementation.

False - The eNB does not send the obtainLocationConfig-r11 field in RRC signaling to UE

True - The eNB sends the obtainLocationConfig-r11 field in RRC signaling to UEs which are GNSS capable, are 3GPP Release 11 (or higher) and are requestred in Subscriber MDT configuration to provide GNSS location information in MDT Subscriber Trace session.

suppExtCqiPeriod.description:
This parameter enables the use of PUCCH configuration to support more RRC connected UEs. 
All cell in this eNB only configurate old PUCCH CSI look-up table(LTE1130) 
If suppExtCqiPeriod is set to 'false’, all TDD cells in the eNB where LTE1130 is activated use the legacy PUCCH CSI look-up table.
If suppExtCqiPeriod is set to 'true’, all TDD cells in the eNB must have LTE1130 activated. In this case a PUCCH CSI look-up table which allows to support more RRC connected UEs is taken into use.
suppExtCqiPeriod.notes:
Related functions: Radio Admission Control Related parameters: APUCCH_TDD - aPucchAddAUeRrHo
APUCCH_TDD - aPucchAddAUeTcHo

LNCEL_TDD - maxNumActUE (1) If suppExtCqiPeriod is set to 'false', all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- the range for parameters addNumDrbRadioReasHo, addNumDrbTimeCriticalHo, maxNumActDrb and maxNumActUE in LNCEL_TDD depends on the configured cell bandwidth and used HW
- if in addition in LNCEL_TDD autoPucchAlloc is 'true', the range for parameters aPucchAddAUeRrHo and aPucchAddAUeTcHo in APUCCH_TDD depends on the configured cell bandwidth and used HW

(2) If suppExtCqiPeriod is set to 'true', all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- if actEicic is configured to 'true', the cellType must be 'large' for the same LNCEL instance
- in each LNCEL_TDD, autoPucchAlloc must be configured to 'true'
- in each APUCCH_TDD, aPucchSrPeriodUpperLimit must be configured to '40' 
- the extended range for parameters addNumDrbRadioReasHo, addNumDrbTimeCriticalHo, maxNumActDrb and maxNumActUE in LNCEL_TDD is allowed to be configured, the range itself depends on the configured cell bandwidth and used HW
- the extended range for parameters  aPucchAddAUeRrHo and aPucchAddAUeTcHo in APUCCH_TDD is allowed to be configured, the range itself depends on the configured cell bandwidth and used HW

supportedCellTechnology.description:
This parameter specifies if the LTE cells the eNB operates shall have single technology (values 'FDD' and 'TDD') or if it shall serves cells in both technologies (value 'mixed_FDD_TDD').

Note:
Only AirScale hardware is capable to support a mixed cell technology configuration.
'mixed_FDD_TDD' is not supported yet.
supportedCellTechnology.notes:
Related functions: Site Management (System Management) Related parameters: LNBTS - supportedCellTechnology
LNBTS_FDD - lnBts_FddId
LNBTS_TDD - lnBts_TddId
LNCEL - cellTechnology Hardware conditions:
(1.1) FSMr3 hardware supports only single technology of cells per eNB, i.e. supported Technology must be configured to 'FDD' OR 'TDD'.
(1.2) AirScale hardware is not restricted in the configuration.
(1.3) supportedCellTechnology must be configured to 'FDD' OR 'TDD', value 'mixed_FDD_TDD' is not supported yet.

(2.1) If supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'FDD' all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- an instance of LNBTS_FDD must be configured in the eNB
- all LNCEL instances of the eNB must be configured with cellTechnology value 'FDD' or 'NB-IoT-FDD'
(2.2) If supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'TDD' all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- an instance of LNBTS_TDD must be configured in the eNB
- all LNCEL instances of the eNB must be configured with cellTechnology value 'TDD'.
(2.3) If supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'mixed_FDD_TDD' all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- an instance of LNBTS_FDD AND an instance of LNBTS_TDD must be configured in the eNB.

This parameter defines the type of the synchronitazion input.

The option "2.048 MHz input" applies only to frequency sync mode.

The option "2.048 MHz input" does not apply to the FZM.

When CLOCK_FDD::syncMaster is set to false BTS operates a sync slave. In the following case no sync input needs to be configured within syncInputList, and syncInputList shall be empty .

When DualModeSyncSlave = ‘dual mode disabled’ (i.e. BTS is not operating in a dual mode configuration), at least one sync input must be configured within syncInputType. When dualModeSyncSlave = 'dual mode without holdover' or 'dual mode with holdover', the BTS is operated as sync slave in a dual mode configuration, receiving sync via a CPRI Ir interface. In this case, no sync input needs to be configured within syncInputType, and and syncInputList shall be empty.

Every sync input configured within the parameter syncInputType must be given an associated priority within the parameter syncInputPrio.

Simultaneous configuration of the values 1 (1pps/ToD from Sync Hub Master) and 2 (1pps/ToD from external GNSS receiver) is precluded. Each of the listed sync input types can be configured only once.

When '1pps/ToD from external GNSS receiver' is configured in syncInputType, one instance of the MOC GNSSE is mandatorily required.
When '1pps/ToD from internal GNSS receiver' is configured in syncInputType, one instance of the MOC GNSSI is mandatorily required.

When 'PDH-1'  or 'PDH-2'  is configured in syncInputType, one instance of the MOC PDH shall be configured.

When 'SYNCE-1'  or 'SYNCE-2'  is configured in syncInputType, one instance of the MOC SYNCE shall be configured.

When 'TOPP' is configured in syncInputType, one instance of the MOC TOPP shall be configured.
When 'TOPF' is configured in syncInputType, one instance of the MOC TOPF shall be configured.

When '1pps/ToD from backplane' is configured in syncInputType, 2 instances of MOCs SMOD are mandatorily required.

Value “TRS” can be set only in case of LTE product.

If at least one cell actOtdoa is set to 'true', at least one sync source type must be configured as following way:
- otdoaSyncSourceType must be set to ""GNSS"", if syncInputPrio is ""1"" and syncInputType is 1pps/ToD from external GNSS or internal GNSS.
- otdoaSyncSourceType must be set to ""ToP-P"", if syncInputPrio is ""1"" and syncInputType is TRS(transport reference source).

SMOD_EXT - utranSupport Remarks : The conditions below cover SHDF only and RP3-01 only scenarios. SHDF and RP3-01 mixed cases are not covered by the configuration below. These cases are not prohibited, but operator shall pay a special attention.

1. Sync Hub Direct Forwarding (SHDF) must be used for the following types of configurations
- LTE-LTE sharing   
- LTE-GSM+LTE-LTE sharing   
- AirScale system modules 
 Note: Other types of RF sharing or non-RF sharing configurations can use either SHDF or RP3 Sync between BTSs. 

1a. When there are two FSMFs in the same BTS, there will be two CLOCK instances. 
       SHDF case will have
       - 1 CLOCK instance with any syncInputList/syncInputType AND syncMaster set to "true" and outputConfiguration1Pps set to ‘EnabledWithoutBtsInputReference'.
       - 1 CLOCK instance with syncInputList/syncInputType set to "1pps/ToD from Sync Hub Master " AND syncMaster set to "true".
      or RP3 case will have
      - 1 CLOCK instance with any syncInputList/syncInputType AND syncMaster set to "true". 
      - 1 CLOCK instance with no syncInputList AND syncMaster set to "false".

1b. When there is one AirScale and one FSMF in the same BTS, there will be two CLOCK instances. It shall always be SHDF and will have - 1 CLOCK instance with any syncInputList/syncInputType AND syncMaster set to "true". - 1 CLOCK instance with syncInputList/syncInputType set to "1pps/ToD from Sync Hub Master" AND syncMaster set to "true".

2. Sync Hub Direct Forwarding (SHDF) master in RF sharing shall have the following configurations:
 - CLOCK-outputConfiguration1Pps must not set to disabled
 -If BTS is the head of the Sync Hub chain, CLOCK-syncLinputList/syncInputType must not set to "1pps/ToD from Sync Hub Master"
 - CLOCK_FDD-syncMaster is set to TRUE
 - SMOD_EXT-syncMaster is set to TRUE

3. Sync Hub Direct Forwarding (SHDF) slave in RF sharing shall have the following configurations:
 - CLOCK-outputConfiguration1Pps set to disabled if it is the end of the chain, else any enabled configurations.
 - CLOCK-syncLinputList/syncInputType must be set to "1pps/ToD from Sync Hub Master"
 - CLOCK_FDD-syncMaster is set to TRUE
 - SMOD_EXT-syncMaster is set to TRUE
 
4. RP3 master in RF sharing shall have the following configurations:
 - CLOCK-outputConfiguration1Pps set to disabled
 - CLOCK-syncLinputList/syncInputType must NOT be set to "1pps/ToD from Sync Hub Master" or "1pps/ToD from backplane"
 - CLOCK_FDD-syncMaster is set to TRUE
 - SMOD_EXT-syncMaster is set to FALSE
 
5. RP3 slave in RF sharing shall have the following configurations:
 - CLOCK-outputConfiguration1Pps set to disabled
 - CLOCK-syncLinputList/syncInputType must NOT be set to "1pps/ToD from Sync Hub Master" or "1pps/ToD from backplane"
 - CLOCK_FDD-syncMaster is set to FALSE
 - SMOD_EXT-syncMaster is set to TRUE

tPollRetr.description:
This parameter specifies the parameter t-pollRetransmit of [36.331]
This timer is used by the transmitting side of an AM RLC entity in order to retransmit a poll. This value is used both in UL (by the UE) and in DL (by the eNB).
The used minimum value of the timer shall be larger than the calculated round-trip time with considerations of HARQ retransmissions and out-of-sequence arrival. The value of the timer shall be larger than twice of the timerReorder.

tS1RelOvDeltG.description:
Delta for Supervision Timer For The Execution Phase Of An S1 Handover to GSM
TS1RELOCoverallDelta_GSM is used to calculate the duration of the timer TS1RELOCoverall which is used to guard against failure of the MME to inform the source eNB of the outcome of the UEs attempt to connect to the target during S1 handover to another 3GPP RAT. TS1RELOCoverall is started in the source eNB when the RRC: MOBILITY FROM EUTRA COMMAND message is sent to the UE and is stopped when S1AP: UE CONTEXT RELEASE COMMAND is received from the MME to confirm the outcome. If the timer expires the handover is aborted and the UE context is released. In future releases the UE will be allowed to rejoin the source cell. The duration of TS1RELOCoverall is calculated by adding the value of TS1RELOCoverallDelta_GSM to that of T304_InterRAT. The value of TS1RELOCoverallDelta_GSM should be set to an estimate of an upper bound of the time taken for the RNC to communicate via the MME to the eNB during normal network conditions.
tS1RelOvDeltG.fullName: Delta for supervision timer for HO execution to GSM
tS1RelOvDeltG.source: Nokia SBTS 18A official SingleRAN AirScale parameter dictionary

TS1RELOCoverall is started in the source eNB when the RRC: MOBILITY FROM EUTRA COMMAND message is sent to the UE and is stopped when S1AP: UE CONTEXT RELEASE COMMAND is received from the MME to confirm the outcome. If the timer expires the handover is aborted and the UE context is released. In future releases the UE will be allowed to rejoin the source cell. The duration of TS1RELOCoverall is calculated by adding the value of TS1RELOCoverallDelta_UTRAN to that of T304_InterRAT. The value of TS1RELOCoverallDelta_UTRAN should be set to an estimate of an upper bound of the time taken for the RNC to communicate via the MME to the eNB during normal network conditions.

targetLoadNonGbrDl.description:
Target load for usage of nonGBR Uu I/F resources in DL direction.

If all load components (GBR, non-GBR, PDCCH) indicated by the load evaluation profile selected  in 'mlbEicicOperMode' are below their individual target load values, a cell is considered having its load balanced.
Target Load represents the operating point = load at which the cell should work according to its dimensioning and the traffic model.
Because of using the minimum of the values, if either targetLoadGbrDl or targetLoadNonGbrDl or targetLoadPdcch are set to 0%, the cell will never offer any available capacity for Load Balancing to its neighbor cells.

tceIpAddress.description:
IP address of the trace collection entity of 3rd Party Tool. This will be used only if  3rd Party Tracing for Cell Trace is enabled and the provided IP address is different from NetAct IP address.
This is the IP address of Trace Collection Entity i.e to which all trace records are sent for the user Trace Session.

If feature LTE955 is activated, the operator must provide an IPv6 address, otherwise the operator must provide an IPv4 address.

For IPv4, the parameter has to be entered in dotted decimal format.

For IPv6, the parameter has to be entered according to formats specified in RFC2460.

IPv4 address ranges:
It is not allowed to configure the address 0.0.0.0, the broadcast address 255.255.255.255 or an address within the range of multicast addresses
(224.0.0.0-239.255.255.255) or loop-back addresses (127.0.0.0-127.255.255.255).

IPv6 address ranges:
It is recommended to configure only an address within the range of Unique Local Unicast addresses (FC00::/7) or Global Unicast addresses (2000::/3).

tddFrameConf.description:
The TDD Uplink-downlink Configuration parameter indicates the uplink-downlink subframe configuration in TDD.
The Subframe Assignment need to be configured according to 3GPP 36.211. The parameter is transmitted in the System Information Broadcast and corresponds to the subframeAssignment (sa#) as specified in 3GPP 36.331.
Currently only Subframe assignment 1 and 2 (sa1, sa2) are supported.

- srsUePeriodicity cannot be configured to '2ms'.

If tddFrameConf is set to '2' (sa2) following condition must be fulfilled 
- prsConfigurationIndex must be from the set {153,158,473,478,1113,1118,2393,2398}
- prachConfIndex is restricted to values 3, 4 and 6 or 51...53
- srsSubfrConf shall be configured to 'sc0', 'sc1', 'sc8', 'sc10'.
- cqiPerNp shall be configured to a value greater than '5ms'
- actTtiBundling must be set to 'false', i.e. if actTtiBundling is set to 'true' tddFrameConf must be set to '1' (sa1)
- prsNumDlFrames is not limited
- csiRsSubfrConf must be one of

  > for macro cells and actEicic set to 'true': {8, 18, 28, 38, 48, 58, 68, 78, 88, 98, 108, 118, 128, 138, 148}

If actReduceWimaxInterference is set to 'true' tddFrameConf can only be configured to '1' (sa1).

If actMultipleCarrier is not set to 'false', the related LNCEL/LNCEL_TDD instances by those LCELL instance which share the same TX HW resource must have same tddFrameConf configured.

The range of the following parameters depend on the TDD subframe configuration: maxNumActUE, addAUeRrHo, addAUeTcHo, maxNumActDrb, addNumDrbRadioReasHo, addNumDrbTimeCriticalHo, maxNumQci1Drb, addNumQci1DrbRadioReasHo, addNumQci1DrbTimeCriticalHo, maxNumRrc, maxNumRrcEmergency, addEmergencySessions (for details please refer to each parameter listed).

tddFrameConf affects MaxPucchResourceSize (calculation defined in nCqiRb).

The allowed values for cellResourceSharingMode depend in specific configurations on tddFrameConf (please refer to cellResourceSharingMode for details)

Allowed values of rxCalibrationConfiguration depend on the configured tddFrameConf (for details please refer to rxCalibrationConfiguration)

For definitions regarding carrier aggregation used in below parameter relationships, please, see the definitions at parameter actDLCAggr.
Precondition: actDLCAggr is set to 'true'
Following relationships needs to consider always a PCell and all related own SCells:
- tddFrameConf must be configured identical
- cqiPerNp must be >='20ms' in PCell if tddFrameConf is set to '2', and must be >='10ms' in PCell if tddFrameConf is set to '1'
- tddFrameConf is involved in consistency checks on maxNumRrc in PCell, and detailed rules are defined in maxNumRrc
- tddFrameConf is involved in consistency checks on maxNumRrcEmergency in PCell, and detailed rules are defined in maxNumRrcEmergency

Applicable if actCoMp is set to 'fixedULCoMp':
- the same tddFrameConf value must be configured for all LNCEL instances belonging to the same ulCoMpCellList

tddFrameConf is involved in consistency checks for siWindowLen when actEicic is set to 'true' and cellType is set to 'large'. Details can be found with siWindowLen.

If cellType is set to 'large' AND actEicic has value 'true', following conditions must be fulfilled:
- if tddFrameConf is set to '1' prsConfigurationIndex must get value 159, 479, 1119 or 2399
- if tddFrameConf is set to '2' prsConfigurationIndex must get value 158, 478, 1118 or 2398

If tddFrameConf is equal to '1', earfcn in LNCEL_TDD is equal to mbsfnEarfcn in MBSFNSYNCAREA_TDD and chBw in this LNCEL_TDD is equal to mbsfnDlChBw in same MBSFNSYNCAREA_TDD then actMBMS must be equal to 'false'.

The allowed range of prsConfigurationIndex depends on sib2xTransmit, actETWS, actCMAS, siWindowLen, sibSchedulingList, actOtdoa, tddFrameConf. Please see the parameter LNCEL_TDD-prsConfigurationIndex for the detailed parameter relationship.
The allowed range of csiRsSubfrConf depends on sib2xTransmit, actETWS, actCMAS, actOtdoa, tddFrameConf, actEicic, tddSpecSubfConf, cellType  and eIcicMaxMutePattern. Please see the parameter LNCEL_TDD-csiRsConfigInfo-csiRsSubfrConf for the detailed parameter relationship.

If actMicroDtx is set to 'true', then following conditions must be fulfilled:
- if actOtdoa is set to 'true' and tddFrameConf is set to '1', then prsConfigurationIndex must be set to one of the following values: '159', '479', '1119' or '2399'.
- if actOtdoa is set to 'true' and tddFrameConf is set to '2', then prsConfigurationIndex must be set to one of the following values: '158', '478', '1118' or '2398'.
- if tddFrameConf is set to '1' then csiRsSubfrConf must be set to one of the following values: 9, 19, 29, 39, 49, 59, 69, 79, 89, 99, 109, 119, 129, 139 or 149. 
- if tddFrameConf is set to '2' then csiRsSubfrConf must be set to one of the following values: 8, 18, 28, 38, 48, 58, 68, 78, 88, 98, 108, 118, 128, 138 or 148;

If actMMimo is set to 'true', following conditions must be fulfilled:
- tddFrameConf is set to '1' (sa1) and tddSpecSubfConf is set to '7' (ssp7) OR 
- tddFrameConf is set to '2' (sa2) and (tddSpecSubfConf is set to '5' (ssp5) or '6' (ssp6), or '7' (ssp7))

For any two or more cells in the eNB, if (actMMimo is 'true') AND (resourceDN is the same for all channels under the same LCELL instance), the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- The value of mMimoAntArrayMode must be identical
- The value of tddFrameConf must be identical
- The value of tddSpecSubfConf must be identical

tddSpecSubfConf can only be configured to '3' (ssp3), '4' (ssp4) or '7' (ssp7) if
- actReduceWimaxInterference is set to 'true'
There is no limitation for disabled functionality for tddSpecSubfConf.

If tddSpecSubfConf is set to '3' (ssp3) or '4' (ssp4) all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- prachConfIndex is restricted to values 3...7
- maxNumUeDlDwPTS can't be configured to '0'.
- srsOnTwoSymUpPts must be configured to 'false'.

If tddSpecSubfConf is set to '5' (ssp5) all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- prachConfIndex is restricted to values 3...7, 23..25, 33..35 or 51...53
- maxNumUeDlDwPTS must be configured to '0'.

If tddSpecSubfConf is set to '7' (ssp7) all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- prachConfIndex is restricted to values 3...7 or 51..53
- maxNumUeDlDwPTS can't be configured to '0'.

If tddSpecSubfConf is set to '6' (ssp6) or '9' (ssp9) all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- prachConfIndex is restricted to values 3...7, 33..35 or 51..53
- maxNumUeDlDwPTS can't be configured to '0'.

Allowed values of rxCalibrationConfiguration depend on the configured tddSpecSubfConf (for details please refer to rxCalibrationConfiguration)

If actMultipleCarrier is not set  to 'false', the related LNCEL/LNCEL_TDD instances by those LCELL instance which share the same TX HW resource must have same tddFrameConf configured.

Applicable if actCoMp is set to 'fixedULCoMp':
- the same special subframe configuration (tddSpecSubfConf) must be configured for all LNCEL instances belonging to the same ulCoMpCellList.

For definitions regarding carrier aggregation used in below parameter relationships, please, see the definitions at parameter actDLCAggr.
Precondition: actDLCAggr is set to 'true'
Following relationship needs to consider always a PCell and all related own SCells:
- tddSpecSubfConf must be configured identical, if the earfcn in LNCEL_TDD of the PCell and the SCell are in the same band.

If tddSpecSubfConf is 'ssp5' or 'ssp9', actMBMS is equal to 'true', earfcn in LNCEL_TDD is equal to mbsfnEarfcn in MBSFNSYNCAREA_TDD and chBw in LNCEL_TDD is equal to mbsfnDlChBw in same MBSFNSYNCAREA_TDD then siWindowLen must be greater than or equal to 20ms.
If tddSpecSubfConf is not 'ssp5' or 'ssp9', actMBMS is equal to 'true', earfcn in LNCEL_TDD is equal to mbsfnEarfcn and chBw in LNCEL_TDD is equal to mbsfnDlChbw then siWindowLen must be greater than or equal to 10ms.

The allowed range of csiRsSubfrConf depends on sib2xTransmit, actETWS, actCMAS, actOtdoa, tddFrameConf, actEicic, tddSpecSubfConf, cellType and eIcicMaxMutePattern. Please see the parameter LNCEL_TDD-csiRsConfigInfo-csiRsSubfrConf for the detailed parameter relationship.

Only if tddSpecSubfConf set to '6' or '7',  allowRollDwPTS can be set to 'true'.
Only if tddSpecSubfConf set to '5','6' or '7', actRIAvoidance can be set to 'true'.

If actMMimo is set to 'true', following conditions must be fulfilled:
- tddFrameConf is set to '1' (sa1) and tddSpecSubfConf is set to '7' (ssp7) OR 
- tddFrameConf is set to '2' (sa2) and (tddSpecSubfConf is set to '5' (ssp5), or '6' (ssp6), or '7' (ssp7))

For any two or more cells in the eNB, if (actMMimo is 'true') AND (resourceDN is the same for all channels under the same LCELL instance), the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- The value of mMimoAntArrayMode must be identical
- The value of tddFrameConf must be identical
- The value of tddSpecSubfConf must be identical

threshold1.description:
Threshold Th1 for RSRP
If RSRP of serving cell is greater than Th1, only the serving cell is measured.

The dBm value is mapped to the 3GPP IE value according to TS 36.133:
* -140 dBm means a threshold lower than -140 dBm
* values between -139 dBm and -44 dBm mean a threshold lower than the configured value but higher than or equal to the (value - 1 dB)
* -43 dBm means a threshold higher than or equal to -44 dBm

threshold3aInterFreqHpue.description:

type A5 where the event is triggered if the serving cell becomes worse than
threshold3InterFreqHpue AND the neighbour cell becomes better than threshold3aInterFreqHpue.

The dBm value is mapped to the 3GPP IE value according to TS 36.133:
* -140 dBm means a threshold lower than -140 dBm
* values between -139 dBm and -44 dBm mean a threshold lower than the configured value but higher than or equal to the (value - 1 dB)
* -43 dBm means a threshold higher than or equal to -44 dBm

timDelACContPreempt.description:
This timer delays the continuation of the admission control for pre-empted bearers.
If eNB sends the S1AP message E-RAB RELEASE INDICATION for pre-empted bearers to MME, the MME needs time to release the indicated bearers in the EPC. Until the release of a bearer S-GW might still send downlink data packets for this bearer to eNB. The expected avarage time is covered by this timer that delays the continuation of the admisison control by the given timer value.

tlsRenegotiationInterval.description:
This parameter defines the time interval in seconds to trigger secure renegotiation of a TLS session, used in management connections, according to RFC 5746. If the parameter is set to non-zero, BTS triggers secure renegotiation on a TLS session if the session allows secure renegotiation and the session has been alive for a period defined by this timer after initial setup or last renegotiation, whichever occurs most recently. If the parameter is set to zero, BTS does not trigger time-based secure renegotiation.

Note: this parameter can only be set to 0, or between 300 and 86400.
tlsRenegotiationInterval.notes:
Related parameters: MNL - productVariantPlanned
MNL/MNLENT - targetDNType
MPLANENW - tlsRenegotiationInterval tlsRenegotiationInterval must have the same value in all MPLANENW instances
if MNL::productVariantPlanned = cBTS, then this parameter must be the same value for MNL/MNLENT::targetDNType = VM and all MNL/MNLENT::targetDNType = RAP

topComMode.description:
This parameter defines the communication mode of ToP to be either "IP Unicast" or "Ethernet Multicast".
"IP Unicast" is applicable for network topologies with partial on-path support.

"Ethernet Multicast" is applicable for timing network topologies with full on-path support,
relating to the full on-path profile as defined at ITU-T G.8275.1.
"Ethernet Multicast" uses the ITU-T G.8275.1 defined multicast address for ToP.
topComMode.notes:
Related parameters: MNL/MNLENT/SYNC/TOP/TOPP - masterIpAddr  
MNL/MNLENT/SYNC/TOP/TOPP - syncMessageRate  
MNL/MNLENT/SYNC/TOP/TOPP - topEthMulticastAddress   pubic; 1) If the topComMode is set to 0:IP Unicast, then the parameters syncMessageRate and masterIpAddr shall be set.
2) If topComMode is set to 1:Ethernet Multicast then  the parameter topEthMulticastAddress shall be set else it does not apply
topComMode.relatedFeatures: •  SR000383 Timing over Packet with phase synchronization (Standard)
topComMode.source: Nokia SBTS 18A official SingleRAN AirScale parameter dictionary

topDomainNumber.description:
This parameter selects the ToP domain number the BTS integrated slave clock belongs to.

The recommended values depend on the selected value in parameter ieeeTelecomProfile (TOPF) or topStandardProfile (TOPP) 
 When TOP with frequency synchronization is used the recommended values are: 
 - IEEE1588 telecom profile: 0 
 - ITU telecom profile: 4 
When TOP with phase synchronization is used, the default value is 0
Note:
For compliance with the CCSA YD/T 2375, the ToP domain number must be configured to 0
For compliance with the ITU-T G.8275.1, the ToP domain number must be configured within the range: 24...43
For compliance with the ITU-T G.8275.2, the ToP domain number must be configured within the range: 44...63

trafficType.description:
This parameter specifies a traffic type.
Allowed values are:
CPLANE: Signalling transport (C-plane) between eNB and MME (S1AP protocol) and signalling transport between eNB nodes (X2AP protocol).
ICMP: ICMP traffic with high and low priority.
IKE: IPSec IKE traffic.
MPLANE: Transport of O&M data  between eNB and the OPS System with high and low priority.
SPLANE: Synchronization plane traffic (Timing over Packet)
BFD(BFD1 to BFD16): Bidirectional Forwarding Detection
SSE: Site Support Equipment
HighPrioICMPv6: ICMPv6 traffic with high and low priority.

trafficTypesMap.description:
This tables maps traffic types to DSCP values. 
In this release the table contains entries for 
- Control plane traffic
- ICMP traffic
- IPSec IKE traffic
- Management plane traffic
- Synchronization plane traffic
- BFD1 to BFD16
- Site support equipment (SSE).(This is not supported for FlexiZone Micro)
- ICMP Neighbour Solicitation/Advertisement and MLD messages(HighPrioICMPv6). (This is supported only in FSMR3 and FlexiZone Micro HW)

The default mapping is as follows:
TrafficType    DSCP   (PHB)
----------------------------------
CPLANE:        46     (EF)
ICMP:          10     (AF11)
IKE:           34     (AF41)
MPLANE:        34     (AF41)
SPLANE:        46     (EF)
BFD1 to BFD16: 34     (AF41)
SSE:           10     (AF11)
HighPrioICMPv6:56     (EF)

ttibAltUlPrbThreshold.description:
This parameter determines the minimum gain which must be achieved by using interference-aware scheduling (IAS)or channel-aware scheduling (CAS)  for UEs in  TTI bundling mode, which looks for spectrum positions with minimized interference. If the achieved gain is smaller than this threshold, UEs in TTI bundling mode are given UL grants in alternating positions on the spectrum, for added diversity gain. 
If parameter is set to 0, a UE in  TTI bundling mode is always given UL grants using interference-aware scheduling (IAS) or channel-aware scheduling (CAS).
ttibAltUlPrbThreshold.fullName: Alternating UL PRB threshold for TTI bundling mode
ttibAltUlPrbThreshold.notes:
Related functions: Scheduler (Uplink) Related parameters: LNCEL - cellTechnology Conditions in (1.x) are valid if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'FDD':
(1.1) ttibAltUlPrbThreshold must be configured.

Conditions in (2.x) are valid if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'TDD' or 'NB-IoT-FDD':
(2.1) ttibAltUlPrbThreshold cannot be configured.

ttibMinDelayAfterBearerSetup.description:
This parameter determines the minimum time a UE in non TTI bundling mode must spend after VoLTE bearer setup before it can enter TTI bundling mode.

If ttiOperMode is set to any of (sinrBasedNotWithMeasGap, sinrBasedTtibOnAllowed, sinrBasedTtibOnOffAllowed),  UE enters TTI bundling mode only after ttibMinDelayAfterBearerSetup subframes have elapsed since VoLTE Bearer Setup.

Setting this parameter to zero disables this functionality, i.e. a UE can enter TTI bundling mode as soon as the VoLTE bearer is established.
ttibMinDelayAfterBearerSetup.fullName: Minimum time to enter TTI bundling after Bearer Setup
ttibMinDelayAfterBearerSetup.notes:
Related functions: Scheduler (Uplink) Related parameters: LNCEL - cellTechnology
LNCEL - ttibOperMode Conditions in (1.x) are valid if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'FDD':
(1.1) if ttibOperMode is set to any of (sinrBasedNotWithMeasGap, sinrBasedTtibOnAllowed, sinrBasedTtibOnOffAllowed), then ttibMinDelayAfterBearerSetup must be configured 

Conditions in (2.x) are valid if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'TDD' or 'NB-IoT-FDD':

ttibSinrThresholdIn.description:
If ttibOperMode is configured to use SINR-based conditions, this is the threshold for switching UEs from normal (non-TTI-Bundling) mode into TTI-bundling mode. The calculation also includes the UE’s power headroom, so essentially this threshold condition looks at how much energy the UE can deliver at the eNB’s receiver input. 
If ttibOperMode is configured to use BLER-based conditions, this parameter is not used.
ttibSinrThresholdIn.fullName: SINR threshold for entering TTI bundling mode
ttibSinrThresholdIn.notes:
Related functions: Scheduler (Uplink) Related parameters: LNCEL - ttibOperMode

- ttibSinrThresholdOut and ttibSinrThresholdIn must be configured
- ttibSinrThresholdOut must be >= ttibSinrThresholdIn + 1 dB

twoLayerMimoAvSpectralEff.description:
The two layer MIMO average spectral efficiency is used by the throughput check during SCell addition as follows .
If the throughput metric after the SCell addition is greater than the throughput metric before the SCell addition then this SCell addition is admitted. Otherwise this SCell addition is rejected. The throughput metric is the sum of xLayerMimoAvSpectralEff*bandwidth of the UE’s serving cells. Where xLayerMimoAvSpectralEff is equal to twoLayerMimoAvSpectralEff if the UE is configured with two layer MIMO on a given serving cell respectively xLayerMimoAvSpectralEff is equal to fourLayerMimoAvSpectralEff if the UE is configured with four layer MIMO on a given serving cell.

A reasonable value of the parameter can be derived from the existing KPI LTE_5747a "DL Spectral efficiency" with dlMimoMode set to "Closed Loop Mimo" or "Closed Loop MIMO (4x2)" or "Closed Loop MIMO (8x2)".

The throughput check is not used by setting the parameter value to "0.5" i.e. any SCell addition will be always admitted by the check if twoLayerMimoAvSpectralEff = fourLayerMimoAvSpectralEff in all involved cells.
twoLayerMimoAvSpectralEff.fullName: Two layer MIMO average spectral efficiency
twoLayerMimoAvSpectralEff.notes:
Related functions: MIMO Control
Carrier Aggregation Related parameters: LNCEL_TDD - dlMimoMode
LNCEL_TDD - fourLayerMimoAvSpectralEff (1) Only if dlMimoMode in same LNCEL_TDD is set to ('Dynamic Open Loop MIMO' OR 'Closed Loop Mimo' OR 'Closed Loop MIMO (4x2)' OR 'Closed Loop MIMO (8x2)' OR 'Closed Loop MIMO (4x4)' OR 'Closed Loop MIMO (8x4)' OR 'Dual Stream Beamforming'), twoLayerMimoAvSpectralEff shall be configured.
(2) If dlMimoMode in same LNCEL_TDD is set to ('Closed Loop MIMO (4x4)' OR 'Closed Loop MIMO (8x4)'): fourLayerMimoAvSpectralEff >= twoLayerMimoAvSpectralEff.
twoLayerMimoAvSpectralEff.relatedFeatures:
•  LTE2532 TDD downlink carrier aggregation with 4 layers MIMO (Standard)  
•  LTE3879 TDD DL Carrier Aggregation with MIMO - 12 layers (Standard)
twoLayerMimoAvSpectralEff.source: Nokia SBTS 18A official SingleRAN AirScale parameter dictionary

uCellChannelSList.description:
The list of Wi-Fi channels to be selected (multiple choice selection).
A field encoded as a bitmap, where bit N is set to "0" if the corresponding channel is not in selection list, and set to "1" if the corresponding channel is within the selection list.

Bitmask with bits defined as follows: 
Bit 0 - channel 149
Bit 1 - channel 153
Bit 2 - channel 157
Bit 3 - channel 161
Bit 4 - channel 165
Bit 5 - channel 32
Bit 6 - channel 36
Bit 7 - channel 40
Bit 8 - channel 44
Bit 9 - channel 48
Bit 10 - channel 52
Bit 11 - channel 56
Bit 12 - channel 60
Bit 13 - channel 64
Bit 14 - channel 68
Bit 15 - channel 96
Bit 16 - channel 100
Bit 17 - channel 104
Bit 18 - channel 108
Bit 19 - channel 112
Bit 20 - channel 116
Bit 21 - channel 120
Bit 22 - channel 124
Bit 23 - channel 128
Bit 24 - channel 132
Bit 25 - channel 136
Bit 26 - channel 140
Bit 27 - channel 144
uCellChannelSList.notes:
Related functions: License Assisted Access Related parameters: LNBTS_FDD - actLUnlicensedDcs
LNBTS_FDD - actUnlicensedDfs
LNCEL_FDD - earfcnDL
LNCEL_FDD - lnuprId
LNUPR - lnuprId
RMOD - rModId (1) If actUnlicensedDcs is equal to 'true', then all following conditions must be fulfilled:
(1.1) uCellChannelSList must be configured.
(1.2) Bit 5 of uCellChannelSList must be '0'. (Note: use of channel 32 is currently not supported).
(1.3) For each instance of LNUPR:
          If N is the maximum number of instances of LNCEL_FDD
         - with LNCEL_FDD-earfcnDL from an unlicensed band, as defined in parameter LNBTS_FDD-actUnlicensedAcc, and
         - with LNCEL_FDD-lnuprId equal to LNUPR-lnuprId, and 
         - with the LNCEL_FDD instances linked to the same instance of RMOD (via rModId),
         then in uCellChannelSList of this instance of LNUPR there shall be at least N WiFi channels activated (N bits equal to ‘1’) within a range corresponding to 62 MHz.

(1.4) If lteUItuRegion is set to 'USA':
(1.4.1) If two instances of LNCEL in the unlicensed band are configured and linked to the same instance of RMOD (via rModId), then the corresponding uCellChannelSList must contain at least two bits set to '1' that are separated by no more than two bits set to '0' in at least one of the bit ranges {0..4} or {5...9}.
(1.4.2) If three instances of LNCEL in the unlicensed band are configured and linked to the same instance of RMOD (via rModId), then the corresponding uCellChannelSList must contain at least three bits set to '1' that are separated by no more than one bit set to '0' in at least one of the bit ranges {0..4} or {5...9}.
(1.4.3) If four instances of LNCEL in the unlicensed band are configured and linked to the same instance of RMOD (via rModId) then the corresponding uCellChannelSList must contain at least four bits set to '1' that are separated by no bits set to '0' in at least one of the bit ranges {0..4} or {5...9}.

(1.5) If lteUItuRegion is set to 'ETSI':
(1.5.1) all channels in the following bit ranges must be disabled: {0..14}, {21..23}
(1.5.2) if one instance of LNCEL in the unlicensed band is configured and linked to the same instance of RMOD (via rModId), then the corresponding uCellChannelSList must contain at least one bit set to '1' in at least one of the bit ranges {16..20} or {24..27}.
(1.5.3) if two instances of LNCEL in the unlicensed band are configured and linked to the same instance of RMOD (via rModId), then the corresponding uCellChannelSList must contain at least two bits set to '1' that are separated by no bits set to '0' in at least one of the bit ranges {16..20} or {24..27}.
(1.5.4) if three instances of LNCEL in the unlicensed band are configured and linked to the same instance of RMOD (via rModId), then the corresponding uCellChannelSList must contain at least three bits set to '1' that are separated by no bits set to '0' in at least one of the bit ranges {16..20} or {24..27}.
(1.5.5) If four instances of LNCEL in the unlicensed band are configured and linked to the same instance of RMOD (via rModId) then the corresponding uCellChannelSList must contain at least four bits set to '1' that are separated by no bits set to '0' in at least one of the bit ranges {16..20} or {24..27}.

(2) If actUnlicensedDfs is 'true' then all following conditions must be fulfilled:
(2.1) In all instances of LNUPR, uCellChannelSList bits 5, 14 and 15 must be set to '0'.
(3) If actUnlicensedDfs is 'false', then uCellChannelSList bits {10...27} must be '0'.

uciOnlyMaxCodeRate.description: Maximum code rate for UCI only transmissions in UL.
uciOnlyMaxCodeRate.fullName: Maximum code rate for UCI-only TX in UL
uciOnlyMaxCodeRate.notes:
Related functions: Carrier Aggregation Related parameters: LNBTS - actDLCAggr
LNCEL - actEicic
LNCEL - cellType
LNCEL - maxNumScells 1>	if (cellType == ‘Large’)
2>	if ((actDLCAggr == ‘true’) && (maxNumScells > 1))
3>	uciOnlyMaxCodeRate must be configured mandatorily;
1>	else if (cellType != ‘Large’)
2>	if ((actDLCAggr == ‘true’) && (actEicic == ‘true’))
3>	uciOnlyMaxCodeRate must be configured mandatorily;
The rationale of above relationship is that: uciOnlyMaxCodeRate must be configured mandatorily when UCI only report is necessary to be triggered. For example, 3CC CA+eICIC on Macro needs UCI only report, so uciOnlyMaxCodeRate must be configured; “2CC CA+eICIC on Micro” or “3CC CA+eICIC on Micro” needs UCI only report, so uciOnlyMaxCodeRate must be configured. About when UCI only report is necessary to be triggered, please refer to RRMT.7970.
uciOnlyMaxCodeRate.relatedFeatures:

ulChBw.description:
Uplink channel bandwidth defines the UL bandwidth for the eNB transmission in a cell, and also defines the number of available Physical Resource Blocks.

If a 'SuperCell' is activated (actSuperCell set to 'true') the bandwidth usage is limited to 5 MHz, 10 MHz, 15 MHz and 20 MHz.
Uplink channel bandwidth defines the UL bandwidth for the eNB transmission in a cell, and also defines the number of available Physical Resource Blocks.

The uplink channel bandwidth mapping to number of Physical Resource Blocks is: 
1.4 MHz = 6 UL PRBS
3.0 MHz = 15 UL PRBS
5.0 MHz = 25 UL PRBS 
10.0 MHz = 50 UL PRBS 
15.0 MHz = 75 UL PRBS
20.0 MHz = 100 UL PRBS

Maximum 10 MHz uplink channel bandwidth may be used with single FSMD to configure more than 2 cells or with single FSME to configure more than 3 cells.

1.4 MHz and 3.0 MHz uplink channel bandwidth is only supported  on FSMF.

eNB will dynamically decide dependent on the current and newly required DSP deployment if eNB restart or dropping of all cells is needed.

(7)
(7.1) For ulChBw of '3 MHz', '5 MHz', '10 MHz', '15 MHz' and '20 MHz':

- if selectOuterPuschRegion is configured to 'UpperEdge' and blankedPucch is greater than or equal to '12', then the allowed prachFreqOff ranges are:

ulCoMpSinrThreshold.description:
Signal-Interference-Noise Ratio to be use for uplink CoMP operation.
The received uplink signal from a neighbor cell is combined to the serving cell signal if its SINR is less than ulCoMPSinrThreshold below the SINR of the serving cell signal.
The recommended default value is for:
- 2RX CoMP: 10 dB
- 4RX CoMP: 15 dB

Note:
For 4-RX / 8-RX CoMP with Softbit combination, the parameter is not used. A3 measurement configuration is done in a3UlCoMpConfig.

ulDelay.description: Antenna Line Uplink Delay in nanoseconds, is used to compensate the antenna line UL delay difference between main and diversity Rx branches of the cell. This is needed to avoid gain (i.e. performance) loss due to the time difference between Rx branches data. For example, offset of 1/2 chip period (130ns) introduces diversity gain degradation of about 1dB. Different delays are met e.g. when two radio modules are cross-connected together via RX diversity outputs. User may provide absolute UL delay values for all Rx branches of the cell, or optionally only the positive difference referred to the smallest delay branch and leave smallest delay branch value to zero. It's not required to apply the UL delay when the delay for Rx branches of the cell are about equal. Note: Multiradio Combiner (MRC) delay shall not be included in this parameter. The MRC delays are taken into account as default by the system when the Multiradio Combiner is commissioned into use.

ulInterferenceOffset.description:
This parameter adds an interference value to the UL measurements, to bias the selection of the UE's preferred scheduling area away from a PRB region with power restrictions.
Value (in percent of the A-MPR or equivalent power reduction) that the UL scheduler adds to the measured UE's UL interference in a PRB range where UL Tx power restrictions apply (A-MPR etc., from TS36.101), on top of the value needed to compensate the UL power reduction given by the scenario identified by ulPwrRestrScen (band18_26: 1.5 dB; band30_NS21: 3 dB; band13_NS07: {8dB or 12dB for lower PUSCH region depending on UL grant size, 0dB or 12dB for center PUSCH region depending on UL grant size, 0dB for upper PUSCH region}; band1_NS05: {11dB for lower PUSCH region, 0dB or 3dB or 5dB for center PUSCH region depending on UL grant size, 1dB or 5dBdB for upper PUSCH region depending on UL grant size}). Example: an offset of +50% adds 0.75 dB on top of the 1.5 dB that is required for compensation in the band18_26 scenario.
This serves to bias the selection of the UE's preferred scheduling area away from the PRB range with Tx power restrictions. No offset is added to PM counter values.
ulInterferenceOffset.notes:
Related functions: BTS Site or Cell Configuration
Power Control (Uplink) Related parameters: LNCEL_FDD - actUlPwrRestrScn ulInterferenceOffset must be configured if actUlPwrRestrScn is not set to 'none'.

•  LTE3230 UL interference offsets (Standard)  
•  LTE3242 A-MPR (Standard)

ulpcAlpha.description:
Used as a fractional path loss compensation factor: alpha. It controls received SNR variance (fairness) for user data and sounding reference symbol.
Alpha can't control the fractional pathloss compensation for the sounding in the case PUSCH masking is activated (actPuschMask equal to 'true') as SRS is disabled in this case.

Recommended default values are
- for FDD cell: 'alpha 1'
- for TDD cell: 'alpha 0.8'.

Note: This parameter is used in NB-IoT cell also.
ulpcAlpha.notes: Related functions: Power Control (Uplink) Related parameters: LNCEL - actUlpcMethod If parameter actUlpcMethod is set to 'PuschIAwPucchCL' or 'PuschIAwPucchOL' ulpcAlpha must be configured to 'alpha 1'.
ulpcAlpha.range:
0: alpha 0 
1: alpha 0.4 
2: alpha 0.5 
3: alpha 0.6 
4: alpha 0.7 
5: alpha 0.8 
6: alpha 0.9 
7: alpha 1

•  LTE27 Open loop UL power control and DL power setting (Standard)  
•  LTE28 Closed loop UL power control (Optional)

•  LTE944 PUSCH masking (Standard)
ulpcAlpha.source: Nokia SBTS 18A official SingleRAN AirScale parameter dictionary

Offset added to the Received Interference Power (RIP) level to determine the RACH preamble target power.
The Received Interference Power (RIP) is measured over the PRACH PRBs in the PRACH TTIs and is then averaged over a period of time to generate an average PRACH RIP value. The preamble target power is then calculated by adding the value of this parameter to the average PRACH RIP value.

ulpcReadPeriod.description:
Time interval for sending averaged RSSI and SINR values to the decision matrix to determine power corrections in closed-loop uplink power control.
The value range is split in two parts: 
Values 10 ... 1000 indicate that discontinuous filtering is ON (i.e. during times of inactivity, RSSI/SINR target values will drift towards their window centers); filter read-out period = parameter value
values 1010 ... 2000 indicate that discontinuous filtering is OFF; filter read-out period = parameter value - 1000.
ulpcReadPeriod.fullName: Time interval for power command decisions
ulpcReadPeriod.notes:
Related functions: Power Control (Uplink) Related parameters: LNCEL - actUlpcMethod
LNCEL - cellTechnology
LNCEL_FDD - subCellConf-pMaxSubCell Conditions in (1.x) are valid if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'FDD' or 'TDD':
(1.1) ulpcReadPeriod must be configured if actUlpcMethod is set to 'PuschOLPucchCL', 'PuschCLPucchOL', 'PuschCLPucchCL', 'PuschCLSrsPucchOL', 'PuschCLSrsPucchCL' or 'PuschIAwPucchCL'.

Conditions in (2.x) are valid in addition to (1.x) if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'FDD':
(2.1) If pMaxSubCell is not set to the same value in all subCellConf list items AND if the difference between any two of the pMaxSubCell values in all subCellConf list items is between 5 and 25, then ulpcReadPeriod must be set to '10' or '1010'.
ulpcReadPeriod.relatedFeatures:
•  LTE28 Closed loop UL power control (Optional)  
•  LTE3296 Harmonized Object Model for SRAN and LTE (Standard)
ulpcReadPeriod.source: Nokia SBTS 18A official SingleRAN AirScale parameter dictionary

ulsFdPrbAssignAlg.description:
Scheduler Type for FD scheduler
Defines the scheduling method which shall be applied in frequency domain for the scheduler in UL
- the "RoundRobinFD" scheduler assigns the physical resources equally fair to the UEs selected by the TD scheduler until the PRBs are sufficient for the service or the physical resources of the cell are exhaust
- the "ExhaustiveFD" scheduler assigns in the priority sequence defined by the TD scheduler as many physical resources as possible to the UEs until the number of PRBs are sufficient for the service or the resources of the cell are exhaust
- the "MixedFD" scheduler is a joint FD scheduler which assigns the PRBs for SRB and GBR bearers by the exhaustive FD scheduler and the PRBs for the nonGBR bearers by the Round Robin FD scheduler to the UEs.
ulsFdPrbAssignAlg.notes:
Related functions: Scheduler (Uplink) Related parameters: LNCEL - actEicic
LNCEL - actNbrForNonGbrBearers
LNCEL - cellTechnology
LNCEL - cellType
LNCEL - ulsMaxPacketAgg
LNCEL - ulsSchedMethod
LNCEL_TDD - actUlMuMimo Conditions in (1.x) are valid if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'FDD' or 'TDD':
(1.1) If (actEicic = 'true') AND (cellType is NOT 'large'), then ulsFdPrbAssignAlg must NOT be 'RoundRobinFD'.

Conditions in (2.x) are valid in addition to (1.x) if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'FDD':
(2.1) ulsFdPrbAssignAlg must be configured to 'MixedFD' if at least one of the following conditions for the LNCEL instance is fulfilled:
- ulsSchedMethod is set to 'interference aware' or 'channel aware'
- actNbrForNonGbrBearers is set to 'true'
(2.2) If ulsFdPrbAssignAlg is set to 'RoundRobinFD' (packet aggregation is disabled for VoIP bearer), ulsMaxPacketAgg must be set to '1'.

Conditions in (3.x) are valid in addition to (1.x) if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'TDD':
(3.1) ulsFdPrbAssignAlg must be configured to 'MixedFD' if one of the following conditions for the LNCEL instance is fulfilled:
- ulsSchedMethod is set to 'channel aware'
- actUlMuMimo is set to 'true' in child LNCEL_TDD
- actNbrForNonGbrBearers is set to 'true'.

ulsMaxPacketAgg.description:
Maximum number of aggregated VoIP packets in UL (with Inter Arrival Time of 20 ms)
Defines the maximum number of VoIP packets which may be aggregated for UL transmission based on a IAT of 20 ms. If the IAT of the VoIP packets is 10 ms the maximum packet aggregation is {1,3,5,7}.
Note that values of the parameter are {1,2,3,4} regardless of Inter Arrival Time, therefore following mapping is used to configure UL Packet Aggregation for IAT of 10ms – ulsMaxPacketAgg value (aggregation level with IAT of 10ms) -> 1 (1), 2 (3), 3 (5), 4 (7).
ulsMaxPacketAgg.notes: Related functions: Scheduler (Uplink) Related parameters: LNCEL - ulsFdPrbAssignAlg If ulsFdPrbAssignAlg is set to 'RoundRobinFD' (packet aggregation is disabled for VoIP bearer) ulsMaxPacketAgg must be set to ‘1’.
ulsMaxPacketAgg.relatedFeatures: •  LTE10 EPS bearers for conversational voice (Optional)

ulsMinRbPerUe.description:
Defines the minimum PRB allocation for UEs which are power limited.

Note: When LTE2098 "VoLTE uplink coverage boosting" is activated, the configured value is not relevant for VoLTE power limited UEs.

ulsSchedMethod.description:
Defines the scheduling method which shall be applied in the cell for the UL branch.
Selects the method for the scheduling of the UEs in UL. 
For FDD cells, three methods can be chosen - the channel unaware UL scheduler, the interference aware UL scheduler and the channel aware UL scheduler.
For TDD cells, two methods can be chosen - the channel unaware UL scheduler and the channel aware UL scheduler.
ulsSchedMethod.fullName: Scheduling method of the UL scheduler
ulsSchedMethod.notes:
Related functions: Scheduler (Uplink) Related parameters: LNCEL - cellTechnology
LNCEL - tPeriodicPhr
LNCEL - ulsFdPrbAssignAlg
LNCEL - ulsNumSchedAreaUl
LNCEL_FDD - actPuschMask
LNCEL_FDD - actUlPwrRestrScn
LNCEL_FDD - srsActivation
LNCEL_FDD - srsPwrOffset
LNCEL_FDD - ulChBw
LNCEL_TDD - chBw
LNCEL_TDD - srsActivation
LNCEL_TDD - srsPwrOffset Conditions in (1.x) are valid if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'FDD':
(1.1) If ulChBw is set to '1.4 MHz' or '3 MHz', ulsSchedMethod must be configured to 'channel unaware'.
(1.2) If ulsSchedMethod is set to 'channel aware' all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
(1.2.1) when in addition actPuschMask is set to 'false', srsActivation must be set to 'true' and srsPwrOffset must be configured
(1.2.2) when in addition actPuschMask is set to 'true', srsActivation must be set to 'false'
(1.3) If ulsSchedMethod is set to ('interference aware' or 'channel aware') all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- ulsFdPrbAssignAlg must be configured to 'Mixed FD'
- tPeriodicPhr is not allowed to be configured to 'infinity'
(1.4) If ulsSchedMethod is set to ('interference aware' or 'channel unaware') all of the following condition must be fulfilled:
(1.4.1) when in addition actUlLnkAdp is not set to 'fUlLa': srsActivation must be set to 'false' 
(1.4.2) when in addition actUlLnkAdp is set to 'fUlLa' AND srsActivation is set to 'true': srsPwrOffset must be configured.
(1.5) if ulsSchedMethod is set to ('interference aware' or 'channel aware') then ulsNumSchedAreaUl must be present and configured.
(1.6) If actUlPwrRestrScn is not set to 'none', ulsSchedMethod must be set to any of 'channel aware' or 'interference aware'.

Conditions in (2.x) are valid if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'TDD':
(2.1) ulsSchedMethod must be configured to 'channel unaware' OR 'channel aware'
(2.2) If ulsSchedMethod is set to 'channel aware' all of the following conditions need to be fulfilled:
- ulsFdPrbAssignAlg must be configured to 'Mixed FD'
- tPeriodicPhr is not allowed to be configured to 'infinity'
- srsActivation must be configured to 'true'
- srsPwrOffset must be configured.
(2.3) If ulsSchedMethod is set to 'channel unaware' following condition need to be fulfilled:
- when in addition actUlLnkAdp is set to 'fUlLa' AND srsActivation is set to 'true': srsPwrOffset must be configured.
(2.4) If ulsSchedMethod is set to 'channel aware', then ulsNumSchedAreaUl must be present and configured.

If for an UTRAN Neighbour Relation (UtranNR) a UTRAN handover procedure is started and since the last validation of UtranNR at least  the time 'utranPrdRevalWaitTmr' has elapsed, then eNB triggers a re-validation for this UtranNR via CGI measurement (if CGI measurements are allowed).

validatePlanAgainstDetectedHW.description:
Perform configuration plan validation against the hardware detected by the BTS. 
This parameter indicates whether or not planned configuration changes are validated against the capabilities of the hardware physically installed and detected by the BTS. 

When set to "true", the BTS configuration is validated against the detected hardware as part of configuration plan validation. If the current BTS configuration violates a constraint of the detected hardware, configuration plan validation fails and the configuration plan is rejected. Additionally, if the configuration references hardware that is not yet physically installed in the BTS, configuration plan validation fails. 

If set to "false", the configuration plan is not validated against the detected hardware. In this case, planned configuration changes may be made prior to the installation of the appropriate hardware.

The validation functionality represented by this parameter is performed both for the configuration plan in which its value is modified as well as for subsequent configuration plans.
validatePlanAgainstDetectedHW.notes:
Related functions: Site Management (System Management) Related parameters: LNBTS - actBbPooling
LNBTS - planFileActivationMode validatePlanAgainstDetectedHW must be 'true' if 
- LNBTS-planFileActivationMode is either 'noServiceLossAllowed' or 'partialServiceLossAllowed'.

vlanAwareSwitch.defaultValue: 0 (Default value is not to include VLAN aware switching.)
vlanAwareSwitch.description:
This parameter controls the VLAN behavior of the Transport Ethernet switching. It is applicable when the switching feature is enabled. 
If set to "true", ethernet frames tagged with a VLAN ID shall be switched between two ethernet member ports of a layer 2 bridge only, if both ports are member of the same VLAN. Else the packet shall be dropped. The handling of untagged frames depends on the parameter acceptableFrameTypes.

If set to "false", any VLAN information is not considered when switching. The switching is purely based on MAC Destination address lookup result.
vlanAwareSwitch.fullName: Flag to decide if VLAN aware switching is used
vlanAwareSwitch.source: Nokia LTE18 official BTS parameter dictionary (FDD)

vlanAwarenessEnabled.defaultValue: 0.0 (Default value is not to include VLAN information in the switching decision.)
vlanAwarenessEnabled.description:
This parameter defines whether VLAN based separation of Ethernet broadcast domains is enabled (true) or not (false).

When enabled, a frame's VLAN information is considered together with the VLAN configuration of the switch for VLAN ingress filtering, learning, switching decision and VLAN egress tagging/detagging.

When disabled, a frame's VLAN information together with the VLAN configuration of the switch is not considered for VLAN ingress filtering, learning VLAN egress tagging/detagging.
Instead, the switching decision is only based on MAC destination address lookup.

vswrAlarmTxPwrThreshold.description:
Defines minimum level of TX power required for raising VSWR (voltage standing wave ratio) related faults.

Note: Default threshold value shall be used in typical cases. The parameter might be adjusted to reduce number of false VSWR alarms only when the alarms are caused by known issues with interferences between antenna lines.

Note: Adjustment of TX power threshold is supported by RP1 Flexi Radio’s Rel2.1 or higher. For other hardware variant units, the parameter is ignored.

Note: During online commissioning, Element Manager will limit maximal allowed value of the parameter basing on maximal TX carrier power supported by the hardware variant, decreasing this value by 10dB additionally.
vswrAlarmTxPwrThreshold.fullName: TX power threshold for VSWR alarms
vswrAlarmTxPwrThreshold.notes: Related functions: Site Management (Antenna Line Management)

x2CfUpRdmDelayTmr.description:
eNB generates a random delay time from the interval [0, x2CfUpRdmDelayTmr] for X2 eNB Configuration Update procedure. This random delay time is added to x2CfUpRspTmr while waiting for a X2 eNB Configuration Update Acknowledge from other eNB. It is also added to "Time to Wait" if a failure response is received, before starting another retry of X2 eNB Configuration Update procedure.

If 'x2CfUpRdmDelayTmr' is set to ‘0’, then no random delay is applied. 

The random delay serves to avoid bursts of X2 eNB Configuration Update procedures within the network.
x2CfUpRdmDelayTmr.fullName: X2 configuration update random delay timer
x2CfUpRdmDelayTmr.relatedFeatures:
•  LTE1769 X2 Neighbor Information Exchange (Standard)  
•  CRL18955 [17A] X2 ENB Config Update overload protection (Standard)

x2PrdRevalWaitTmr.description:
If for an intra-eNB LTE Neighbour Relation (NR), respectively for an inter-eNB NR with available X2 link a handover preparation is started and since the last validation of the NR at least  the time 'x2PrdRevalWaitTmr' has elapsed, then eNB triggers a re-validation for this NR via CGI measurement (if CGI measurements are allowed).

If 'x2PrdRevalWaitTmr' is set to '0', then no re-validation is triggered.
Note 1: To limit the load due to re-validations, eNB triggers  re-validation only if at least some minimum wait time since last validation of the same NR has expired.
Note 2: To retrieve the CGI measurement for the re-validation, the eNB will start Active ANR mode and use a UE different from the one which needs the handover.
x2PrdRevalWaitTmr.relatedFeatures:
•  LTE1685 Neighbor Relation Robustness (Standard)  
•  LTE2828 LNCEL LNBTS refactoring (Standard)
x2PrdRevalWaitTmr.source: Nokia SBTS 18A official SingleRAN AirScale parameter dictionary
